      "slug": "reference/cli",
      "html": "<h1>Model-Compose CLI Reference</h1>\n<p>model-compose provides a command-line interface for managing AI model workflows and orchestration.</p>\n<h2>Installation</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Install for development\npip install -e .\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Commands</h2>\n<h3><code>model-compose up</code></h3>\n<p>Start the controller in the current directory.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Start the controller\nmodel-compose up\n\n# Run in detached mode\nmodel-compose up -d\n</code></pre>\n<p>The controller will look for a <code>model-compose.yml</code> file in the current directory and start the defined components, gateway, and listeners.</p>\n<h3><code>model-compose down</code></h3>\n<p>Stop the running controller.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose down\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>model-compose start</code></h3>\n<p>Start existing services that were previously created.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose start\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>model-compose stop</code></h3>\n<p>Stop running services without removing them.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose stop\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>model-compose run</code></h3>\n<p>Execute a specific workflow once with optional input parameters.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Run a workflow with input\nmodel-compose run &lt;workflow-name&gt; --input '{&quot;key&quot;: &quot;value&quot;}'\n\n# Run without input\nmodel-compose run &lt;workflow-name&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration</h2>\n<p>The CLI reads configuration from <code>model-compose.yml</code> files in the current directory. These files define:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Controller</strong>: HTTP/MCP servers</li>\n<li><strong>Components</strong>: Reusable API calls and model tasks</li>\n<li><strong>Workflows</strong>: Job sequences with data flow</li>\n<li><strong>Listeners</strong>: Webhook callbacks</li>\n<li><strong>Gateways</strong>: Tunneling services</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Examples</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Start a workflow controller\ncd examples/providers/openai/openai-chat-completions\nmodel-compose up\n\n# Run a specific workflow\ncd examples/model-tasks/chat-completion\nmodel-compose run chat-workflow --input '{&quot;message&quot;: &quot;Hello, world!&quot;}'\n\n# Stop all services\nmodel-compose down\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Options and Flags</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><code>-d, --detach</code>: Run in detached mode (for <code>up</code> command)</li>\n<li><code>--input</code>: Provide JSON input for workflow execution (for <code>run</code> command)</li>\n<li><code>--help</code>: Show help information for any command</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Environment Variables</h2>\n<p>The CLI respects standard environment variables for model API keys and configurations as defined in your workflow components.</p>\n<h2>Troubleshooting</h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Ensure <code>model-compose.yml</code> exists in the current directory</li>\n<li>Check that required environment variables are set for external model APIs</li>\n<li>Use <code>--help</code> flag with any command for detailed usage information</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Model-Compose CLI Reference"
      }
    },

      "html": "<h1>Model-Compose Configuration Reference</h1>\n<p>This reference guide provides comprehensive documentation for all configuration options in model-compose. Use this as your authoritative source for YAML configuration syntax, available options, and usage patterns.</p>\n<h2>Quick Navigation</h2>\n<h3>Core Configuration</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/controller\">Controller</a> - HTTP and MCP server configuration</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/workflow\">Workflow</a> - Job orchestration and execution logic</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/component\">Component</a> - Reusable service definitions and common properties</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Infrastructure &amp; Services</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/system\">System</a> - Infrastructure service management (Docker Compose)</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/listener\">Listener</a> - Webhook and callback handling</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/gateway\">Gateway</a> - Tunneling and external access</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/tracer\">Tracer</a> - Tracing configuration and observability</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/logger\">Logger</a> - Logging configuration and output management</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Reference</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/language-codes\">Language Codes</a> - Standardized language codes for multilingual components</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Components</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/http-client\">HTTP Client</a> - External API integration</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/http-server\">HTTP Server</a> - Web server hosting</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/mcp-client\">MCP Client</a> - Model Context Protocol client</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/mcp-server\">MCP Server</a> - Model Context Protocol server</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model\">Model</a> - AI/ML model inference</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/vector-store\">Vector Store</a> - Vector database operations</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/key-value-store\">Key-Value Store</a> - Key-value data storage</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/shell\">Shell</a> - System command execution</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/text-splitter\">Text Splitter</a> - Document processing</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/workflow\">Workflow</a> - Nested workflow execution</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Configuration Structure Overview</h2>\n<p>A complete model-compose.yml file typically includes these top-level sections:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Server configuration\ncontroller:\n  type: http-server | mcp-server\n  # ... controller settings\n\n# Workflow definitions\nworkflow:  # or workflows: for multiple\n  # ... workflow configuration\n\n# Component definitions\ncomponent:  # or components: for multiple\n  # ... component configuration\n\n# Infrastructure services (optional)\nsystem:     # or systems: for multiple\n  # ... system configuration (e.g., docker-compose)\n\nlistener:   # or listeners: for multiple\n  # ... listener configuration\n\ngateway:    # or gateways: for multiple\n  # ... gateway configuration\n\ntracer:     # or tracers: for multiple\n  # ... tracing configuration\n\nlogger:     # or loggers: for multiple\n  # ... logging configuration\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Patterns</h2>\n<h3>Single vs Multiple Definitions</h3>\n<p>Most configuration sections support both singular and plural forms:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Single definition\ncontroller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n\n# Multiple definitions  \ncomponents:\n  - id: api-client\n    type: http-client\n  - id: local-model\n    type: model\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Variable Interpolation</h3>\n<p>All configuration sections support dynamic values through variable interpolation:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Environment Variables</strong>: <code>${env.API_KEY}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Input Data</strong>: <code>${input.field}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Job Results</strong>: <code>${job-name.output}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Type Conversion</strong>: <code>${input.count as number}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Default Values</strong>: <code>${input.optional | default}</code></li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Common Properties</h3>\n<p>Many configuration objects share common properties:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Property</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>varies</td>\n<td>Unique identifier</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>required</td>\n<td>Configuration type</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>runtime</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>embedded</code></td>\n<td>Runtime environment (<code>embedded</code> or <code>docker</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_concurrent_count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>varies</td>\n<td>Maximum concurrent operations</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Getting Started</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Choose Your Controller</strong>: Start with <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/controller\">Controller</a> to set up your server</li>\n<li><strong>Define Your Workflow</strong>: Use <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/workflow\">Workflow</a> to orchestrate your logic</li>\n<li><strong>Add Components</strong>: Select from <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/component\">Component</a> types for your functionality</li>\n<li><strong>Configure Infrastructure</strong>: Add <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/listener\">Listener</a>, <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/gateway\">Gateway</a>, <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/tracer\">Tracer</a>, or <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/logger\">Logger</a> as needed</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Examples Directory</h2>\n<p>For working examples of these configurations, see the <code>examples/</code> directory in the repository:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>examples/providers/openai/openai-chat-completions/</code> - Simple HTTP client workflow</li>\n<li><code>examples/make-inspiring-quote-voice/</code> - Multi-step workflow with dependencies</li>\n<li><code>examples/model-tasks/</code> - Various local model configurations</li>\n<li><code>examples/vector-store/</code> - Vector database usage patterns</li>\n<li><code>examples/key-value-store/</code> - Key-value store usage patterns</li>\n<li><code>examples/mcp-servers/</code> - MCP server implementations</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Configuration Validation</h2>\n<p>Model-compose validates all configuration at startup. Common validation errors include:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Missing required fields</strong>: Ensure all required properties are specified</li>\n<li><strong>Invalid types</strong>: Check data types match expected values (string, integer, boolean)</li>\n<li><strong>Invalid references</strong>: Verify component IDs and job names exist</li>\n<li><strong>Conflicting options</strong>: Some fields are mutually exclusive (e.g., <code>endpoint</code> vs <code>path</code>)</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Environment Variables</strong>: Store sensitive data like API keys in environment variables</li>\n<li><strong>Descriptive IDs</strong>: Use clear, descriptive names for components, jobs, and workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Modular Design</strong>: Break complex configurations into smaller, reusable pieces</li>\n<li><strong>Documentation</strong>: Use <code>title</code> and <code>description</code> fields to document your configurations</li>\n<li><strong>Version Control</strong>: Keep your model-compose.yml files in version control</li>\n<li><strong>Testing</strong>: Test configurations with different input scenarios</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Need Help?</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Issues</strong>: Report problems at <a href=\"https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues\">GitHub Issues</a></li>\n<li><strong>Examples</strong>: Browse the <code>examples/</code> directory for working configurations</li>\n<li><strong>Field Definitions</strong>: Check the source code for detailed field definitions and constraints</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Model-Compose Configuration Reference"
      }

      "slug": "reference/compose/component",
      "html": "<h1>Component Configuration Reference</h1>\n<p>Components are reusable service definitions that perform specific tasks within workflows. They encapsulate functionality such as HTTP requests, AI model inference, data processing, and external service integration.</p>\n<h2>Basic Structure</h2>\n<h3>Single Component</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: agent | http-client | http-server | mcp-server | mcp-client | model | model-memory | model-tokenizer | model-trainer | datasets | vector-store | graph-store | search-engine | key-value-store | file-store | workflow | shell | text-splitter | image-processor | video-scene-detector | video-frame-extractor | web-scraper | web-browser\n  id: component-id\n  runtime: embedded | docker  # default: embedded\n  max_concurrent_count: 1\n  default: false\n  # ... type-specific configuration\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple Components</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: api-client\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.example.com\n    \n  - id: local-model\n    type: model\n    model: microsoft/DialoGPT-medium\n    \n  - id: data-processor\n    type: shell\n    command: python process.py\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Component Types</h2>\n<p>Model-compose supports the following component types:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Documentation</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>agent</code></td>\n<td>Autonomous AI agent with tool use</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/agent\">agent.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>http-client</code></td>\n<td>HTTP client for making API requests</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/http-client\">http-client.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>http-server</code></td>\n<td>HTTP server for hosting services</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/http-server\">http-server.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>mcp-server</code></td>\n<td>MCP server for protocol support</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/mcp-server\">mcp-server.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>mcp-client</code></td>\n<td>MCP (Model Context Protocol) client</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/mcp-client\">mcp-client.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code></td>\n<td>AI model inference (local/remote)</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model\">model.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model-memory</code></td>\n<td>Session-based conversation memory</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model-memory\">model-memory.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model-tokenizer</code></td>\n<td>Model tokenization (encode, decode, count)</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model-tokenizer\">model-tokenizer.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model-trainer</code></td>\n<td>Model fine-tuning (SFT, classification, LoRA)</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model-trainer\">model-trainer.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>datasets</code></td>\n<td>Dataset loading and transformation</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/datasets\">datasets.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>vector-store</code></td>\n<td>Vector database operations</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/vector-store\">vector-store.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>graph-store</code></td>\n<td>Graph database operations</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/graph-store\">graph-store.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>search-engine</code></td>\n<td>Full-text search engine (SQLite FTS5)</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/search-engine\">search-engine.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>key-value-store</code></td>\n<td>Key-value data storage</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/key-value-store\">key-value-store.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>file-store</code></td>\n<td>File/object storage (local, AWS S3, GCP Storage, Azure Blob)</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/file-store\">file-store.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>workflow</code></td>\n<td>Sub-workflow execution</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/workflow\">workflow.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>shell</code></td>\n<td>Shell command execution</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/shell\">shell.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text-splitter</code></td>\n<td>Text processing and splitting</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/text-splitter\">text-splitter.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>image-processor</code></td>\n<td>Image transformation and processing</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/image-processor\">image-processor.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>video-scene-detector</code></td>\n<td>Video scene change detection</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/video-scene-detector\">video-scene-detector.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>video-frame-extractor</code></td>\n<td>Decode video and extract frames as images</td>\n<td><a href=\"components/video-frame-extractor.md\">video-frame-extractor.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>web-scraper</code></td>\n<td>Web page scraping with CSS/XPath</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/web-scraper\">web-scraper.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>web-browser</code></td>\n<td>Browser automation via Chrome DevTools Protocol</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/web-browser\">web-browser.md</a></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Common Configuration Properties</h2>\n<p>All components inherit these common properties from <code>CommonComponentConfig</code>:</p>\n<h3>Core Properties</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>Unique identifier for the component</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Component type (see table above)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>runtime</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>embedded</code></td>\n<td>Runtime environment: <code>embedded</code>, <code>process</code>, or <code>docker</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_concurrent_count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>Maximum concurrent actions this component can handle</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>default</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Whether to use this component when none is explicitly specified</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Actions</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>action</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Single action definition for the component (shorthand for single-action components)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of actions available within this component (for multi-action components)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>Components can define a single action using <code>action:</code> (singular) or multiple actions using <code>actions:</code> (plural). This is consistent with the <code>component:</code> / <code>components:</code> pattern used elsewhere.</p>\n<h2>Component Usage Patterns</h2>\n<h3>Single Action Component</h3>\n<p>For simple components with one primary action, wrap the action-specific fields under <code>action:</code>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multi-Action Component</h3>\n<p>For components supporting multiple operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.slack.com\n  actions:\n    - id: send-message\n      path: /chat.postMessage\n      method: POST\n      body:\n        channel: ${input.channel}\n        text: ${input.text}\n        \n    - id: list-channels\n      path: /conversations.list\n      method: GET\n      params:\n        limit: 200\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Default Component</h3>\n<p>Mark a component as default to use it when no specific component is referenced:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: primary-model\n    type: model\n    model: gpt-4o\n    default: true\n    \n  - id: backup-model\n    type: model\n    model: gpt-3.5-turbo\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Runtime Configuration</h2>\n<p>Components can run in different runtime environments. The runtime determines where and how the component executes.</p>\n<h3>Embedded Runtime (Default)</h3>\n<p>The default runtime that executes components in the current process.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  runtime: embedded  # or omit this line (embedded is default)\n  model: microsoft/DialoGPT-medium\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Characteristics:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Runs in the same process as the controller</li>\n<li>Fastest startup time and lowest overhead</li>\n<li>Shares memory space with the main application</li>\n<li>Best for lightweight tasks and quick operations</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Use Cases:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Simple API calls and HTTP requests</li>\n<li>Lightweight data transformations</li>\n<li>Quick model inference with small models</li>\n<li>Components that need fast response times</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Process Runtime</h3>\n<p>Runs components in separate Python processes for process isolation while maintaining faster startup than Docker.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  runtime: process\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Characteristics:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Runs in a separate Python process</li>\n<li>Process-level memory and resource isolation</li>\n<li>Faster startup than Docker, slower than embedded</li>\n<li>Independent crash handling (one component crash won't affect others)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Use Cases:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Heavy models that could consume significant memory</li>\n<li>Multiple GPU utilization (separate processes for each GPU)</li>\n<li>Blocking operations that shouldn't block the main event loop</li>\n<li>Components that need isolation but don't require containers</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Advanced Configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  runtime:\n    type: process\n    env:\n      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: &quot;0&quot;\n      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: &quot;max_split_size_mb:512&quot;\n    start_timeout: 120\n    stop_timeout: 30\n  model: stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Docker Runtime</h3>\n<p>Runs components in isolated Docker containers for enhanced security and reproducibility.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  runtime: docker\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Characteristics:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Complete process and resource isolation</li>\n<li>Reproducible environment across deployments</li>\n<li>Better security through containerization</li>\n<li>Higher startup overhead</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Use Cases:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Production deployments requiring isolation</li>\n<li>Large models that need resource limits</li>\n<li>Components with specific dependency requirements</li>\n<li>Multi-tenant scenarios requiring security</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Choosing a Runtime</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Runtime</th>\n<th>Startup Speed</th>\n<th>Isolation</th>\n<th>Overhead</th>\n<th>Best For</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>embedded</strong></td>\n<td>Fast</td>\n<td>None</td>\n<td>Minimal</td>\n<td>Default choice, lightweight tasks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>process</strong></td>\n<td>Medium</td>\n<td>Process</td>\n<td>Medium</td>\n<td>Heavy models, GPU isolation, crash isolation</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>docker</strong></td>\n<td>Slow</td>\n<td>High</td>\n<td>High</td>\n<td>Production, security-critical workloads</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Concurrency Control</h2>\n<p>Control how many actions can run simultaneously:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  max_concurrent_count: 5\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n</code></pre>\n<p>This allows up to 5 concurrent HTTP requests from this component.</p>\n<h2>Component Lifecycle</h2>\n<p>Components follow this lifecycle:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Initialization</strong>: Component is created and configured</li>\n<li><strong>Setup</strong>: Runtime environment is prepared (Docker images pulled, dependencies installed)</li>\n<li><strong>Ready</strong>: Component is available to handle actions</li>\n<li><strong>Execution</strong>: Actions are processed according to workflow requirements</li>\n<li><strong>Shutdown</strong>: Component resources are cleaned up</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Components are referenced in workflows through jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: api-call\n      component: http-client-id\n      action: post-data\n      input:\n        data: ${input.payload}\n        \n    - id: process-result\n      component: shell-processor\n      input:\n        result: ${api-call.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Components support dynamic configuration through variable interpolation:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Environment Variables</strong>: <code>${env.API_KEY}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Input Data</strong>: <code>${input.field}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Previous Results</strong>: <code>${previous-job.output}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Type Conversion</strong>: <code>${input.count as number}</code></li>\n<li><strong>Default Values</strong>: <code>${input.optional | default-value}</code></li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>Components can be configured with error handling strategies:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  retry_count: 3\n  timeout: 30\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Security Considerations</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Credentials</strong>: Store sensitive data in environment variables</li>\n<li><strong>Network</strong>: Use HTTPS endpoints when possible</li>\n<li><strong>Isolation</strong>: Consider Docker runtime for untrusted code execution</li>\n<li><strong>Access Control</strong>: Limit file system access and network permissions</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Naming</strong>: Use descriptive component IDs that indicate their purpose</li>\n<li><strong>Modularity</strong>: Design components for specific, well-defined tasks</li>\n<li><strong>Reusability</strong>: Create generic components that can be used across workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Configuration</strong>: Use environment variables for deployment-specific settings</li>\n<li><strong>Documentation</strong>: Document custom actions and expected inputs/outputs</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Implement appropriate retry and timeout strategies</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Management</strong>: Set appropriate concurrency limits for resource-intensive operations</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<ul>\n<li>Browse individual component documentation in the <a href=\"components/\">components/</a> directory</li>\n<li>See <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/workflow\">workflow.md</a> for information on using components in workflows</li>\n<li>Check <a href=\"../../examples/\">examples/</a> for real-world component configurations</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Component Configuration Reference"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/agent",
      "html": "<h1>Agent Component</h1>\n<p>The agent component enables building autonomous AI agents that use workflows as tools. It implements a ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) loop where an LLM iteratively reasons about a task, calls tools, and processes results until a final answer is produced.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: agent\n  tools:\n    - search-web\n    - analyze-image\n  action:\n    model:\n      component: gpt-4o\n      input:\n        messages: ${messages}\n        tools: ${tools}\n    system_prompt: You are a helpful research assistant.\n    user_prompt: ${input.question}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>agent</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>tools</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of workflow IDs to use as tools</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_iteration_count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>10</code></td>\n<td>Maximum number of ReAct loop iterations</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of agent actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>Agent actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>LLM model configuration for this action</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>system_prompt</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>System prompt. When set, a system message is prepended to the conversation</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>user_prompt</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>User prompt. Supports variable interpolation</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_iteration_count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Maximum iterations (overrides component-level setting)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>If <code>user_prompt</code> is not specified, the agent's component input is used as the user message.</p>\n<h3>Model Configuration</h3>\n<p>The <code>model</code> object specifies which component to use for LLM calls:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>component</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>ID of the component to use for LLM calls</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>action</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>ID of the action to invoke on the component</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>input</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Input mapping from agent internal state to component input</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Model Input Variables</h3>\n<p>The <code>model.input</code> mapping supports the following variables:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Variable</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>${messages}</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Conversation message history (user, assistant, tool messages) managed by the agent</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>${tools}</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Function calling schemas automatically generated from workflow tool definitions</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>${input.*}</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td>Agent's original input variables (e.g., <code>${input.question}</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Agent with Tools</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: gpt-4o\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages: ${input.messages}\n        tools: ${input.tools}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message}\n\n  - id: research-agent\n    type: agent\n    tools:\n      - search-web\n    action:\n      model:\n        component: gpt-4o\n        input:\n          messages: ${messages}\n          tools: ${tools}\n      system_prompt: You are a helpful research assistant.\n      user_prompt: ${input.question}\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: search-web\n    description: &quot;Search the web for information&quot;\n    jobs:\n      - component: tavily\n        input:\n          query: ${input.query}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multi-Action Agent</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: agent\n  tools:\n    - search-web\n    - fetch-url\n    - analyze-image\n  max_iteration_count: 15\n  actions:\n    - id: research\n      model:\n        component: gpt-4o\n        input:\n          messages: ${messages}\n          tools: ${tools}\n      system_prompt: You are a thorough research assistant.\n      user_prompt: ${input.question}\n\n    - id: summarize\n      model:\n        component: claude-sonnet\n        input:\n          messages: ${messages}\n      system_prompt: You are a concise summarizer.\n      user_prompt: ${input.text}\n      max_iteration_count: 1\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Agent with Custom Model Action</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: llm-server\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: http://localhost:8000/v1\n    actions:\n      - id: chat\n        path: /chat/completions\n        body:\n          model: llama-3.1-70b\n          messages: ${input.messages}\n          tools: ${input.tools}\n          temperature: 0.7\n        output: ${response.choices[0].message}\n\n      - id: chat-precise\n        path: /chat/completions\n        body:\n          model: llama-3.1-70b\n          messages: ${input.messages}\n          tools: ${input.tools}\n          temperature: 0.1\n        output: ${response.choices[0].message}\n\n  - id: coding-agent\n    type: agent\n    tools:\n      - read-file\n      - write-file\n      - run-tests\n    action:\n      model:\n        component: llm-server\n        action: chat-precise\n        input:\n          messages: ${messages}\n          tools: ${tools}\n      system_prompt: You are an expert coding assistant. Read files, write code, and run tests to complete the task.\n      user_prompt: ${input.task}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Agent without Tools</h3>\n<p>An agent can operate without tools for single-turn inference:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: agent\n  action:\n    model:\n      component: gpt-4o\n      input:\n        messages: ${messages}\n    system_prompt: You are a helpful assistant.\n    user_prompt: ${input.question}\n    max_iteration_count: 1\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Tool Configuration</h2>\n<h3>Workflow as Tool</h3>\n<p>Agent tools are defined as workflows. Each workflow becomes a callable function for the LLM.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: search-web\n    name: web_search\n    description: &quot;Search the web and return relevant results&quot;\n    jobs:\n      - component: tavily-client\n        input:\n          query: ${input.query @(description The search query string)}\n          max_results: ${input.max_results as integer | 5 @(description Maximum number of results to return)}\n</code></pre>\n<p>The workflow's input parameters are automatically converted to a function calling schema:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Parameter names come from <code>${input.&lt;name&gt;}</code> bindings</li>\n<li>Types are inferred from type annotations (e.g., <code>as integer</code>)</li>\n<li>Descriptions come from <code>@(description ...)</code> annotations</li>\n<li>Default values come from <code>| &lt;default&gt;</code> syntax</li>\n<li>Parameters without defaults are marked as required</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Generated Function Schema</h3>\n<p>The above workflow generates the following function calling schema:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;function&quot;,\n  &quot;function&quot;: {\n    &quot;name&quot;: &quot;web_search&quot;,\n    &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Search the web and return relevant results&quot;,\n    &quot;parameters&quot;: {\n      &quot;type&quot;: &quot;object&quot;,\n      &quot;properties&quot;: {\n        &quot;query&quot;: {\n          &quot;type&quot;: &quot;string&quot;,\n          &quot;description&quot;: &quot;The search query string&quot;\n        },\n        &quot;max_results&quot;: {\n          &quot;type&quot;: &quot;integer&quot;,\n          &quot;description&quot;: &quot;Maximum number of results to return&quot;,\n          &quot;default&quot;: 5\n        }\n      },\n      &quot;required&quot;: [&quot;query&quot;]\n    }\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>How It Works</h2>\n<h3>ReAct Loop</h3>\n<p>The agent follows this execution cycle:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Build Messages</strong>: Construct initial messages from <code>system_prompt</code> and <code>user_prompt</code></li>\n<li><strong>Call LLM</strong>: Send messages and tool schemas to the model component</li>\n<li><strong>Check Response</strong>: If the response contains tool calls, continue; otherwise return the content</li>\n<li><strong>Execute Tools</strong>: Run all tool calls in parallel via workflow execution</li>\n<li><strong>Append Results</strong>: Add tool results to the message history</li>\n<li><strong>Repeat</strong>: Go back to step 2 (up to <code>max_iteration_count</code> times)</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>Parallel Tool Execution</h3>\n<p>When the LLM returns multiple tool calls in a single response, the agent executes them concurrently for optimal performance.</p>\n<h3>Model Component Requirements</h3>\n<p>The model component must return a response in the following format:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;content&quot;: &quot;The response text&quot;,\n  &quot;tool_calls&quot;: [\n    {\n      &quot;id&quot;: &quot;call_abc123&quot;,\n      &quot;function&quot;: {\n        &quot;name&quot;: &quot;web_search&quot;,\n        &quot;arguments&quot;: &quot;{\\&quot;query\\&quot;: \\&quot;model-compose documentation\\&quot;}&quot;\n      }\n    }\n  ]\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p>This is compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API response format. Use an <code>http-client</code> component with appropriate <code>output</code> mapping to extract the message object.</p>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference agent components in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: agent-task\n      component: research-agent\n      action: research\n      input:\n        question: ${input.user_question}\n\n    - id: format-output\n      component: formatter\n      input:\n        raw_answer: ${agent-task.output}\n      depends_on: [ agent-task ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Agent components support dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: agent\n  tools:\n    - search-web\n    - analyze-data\n  action:\n    model:\n      component: ${env.DEFAULT_LLM | gpt-4o}\n      input:\n        messages: ${messages}\n        tools: ${tools}\n    system_prompt: ${env.SYSTEM_PROMPT | You are a helpful assistant.}\n    user_prompt: ${input.question}\n    max_iteration_count: ${env.MAX_ITERATIONS as integer | 10}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Tool Design</strong>: Design workflows with clear descriptions and well-typed parameters for better LLM tool selection</li>\n<li><strong>Iteration Limits</strong>: Set appropriate <code>max_iteration_count</code> to prevent infinite loops and control costs</li>\n<li><strong>Model Selection</strong>: Choose model components that support function calling (e.g., GPT-4o, Claude, Llama 3.1+)</li>\n<li><strong>Input Mapping</strong>: Use <code>model.input</code> to pass agent-managed state (<code>${messages}</code>, <code>${tools}</code>) to the model component</li>\n<li><strong>System Prompts</strong>: Use <code>system_prompt</code> to define the agent's role and behavior guidelines</li>\n<li><strong>Tool Granularity</strong>: Keep tools focused on single responsibilities for better agent reasoning</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Tools should return descriptive error messages to help the agent recover</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Research Agents</strong>: Search the web, fetch URLs, and synthesize information</li>\n<li><strong>Coding Agents</strong>: Read files, write code, and run tests autonomously</li>\n<li><strong>Data Analysis Agents</strong>: Query databases, process data, and generate reports</li>\n<li><strong>Customer Support Agents</strong>: Look up information, perform actions, and respond to users</li>\n<li><strong>Multi-Step Reasoning</strong>: Break down complex tasks using tool-assisted reasoning</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Agent Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/datasets",
      "html": "<h1>Datasets Component</h1>\n<p>The datasets component provides declarative dataset loading and transformation built on top of the HuggingFace <code>datasets</code> library. It supports loading from the HuggingFace Hub or local files, concatenating multiple datasets, selecting subsets by rows or columns, filtering, and mapping with templated formatting.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  action:\n    method: load\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n    split: train\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>datasets</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of dataset operations (load, concat, select, filter, map)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>All dataset behavior is driven through actions; the component itself has no other top-level fields.</p>\n<h2>Methods</h2>\n<h3>Load</h3>\n<p>Load a dataset from a provider. The provider determines the remaining fields.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  action:\n    method: load\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n    split: train\n    fraction: 0.1\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>load</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>provider</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Dataset provider: <code>huggingface</code>, <code>local</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>split</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Dataset split to load (e.g., <code>train</code>, <code>test</code>, <code>validation</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>streaming</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Enable streaming mode for large datasets</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>keep_in_memory</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Keep dataset in memory</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cache_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Directory to cache downloaded files</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>save_infos</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Save dataset info to cache</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fraction</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Fraction of dataset to load (0.0 ~ 1.0)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>shuffle</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Shuffle dataset before applying fraction selection</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>HuggingFace provider fields:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>HuggingFace dataset name or path</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>name</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Dataset configuration name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>revision</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Dataset revision/version to load</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>token</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Authentication token for private datasets</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>trust_remote_code</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Allow executing remote code for dataset loading</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Local provider fields:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>loader</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Loader type: <code>json</code>, <code>csv</code>, <code>parquet</code>, <code>text</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>data_files</code></td>\n<td>string/array/object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Path to data files (string, list, or split mapping)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>data_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Directory containing data files</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Concat</h3>\n<p>Concatenate multiple datasets.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">action:\n  method: concat\n  datasets:\n    - ${jobs.load-first.output}\n    - ${jobs.load-second.output}\n  direction: vertical\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>concat</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>datasets</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>List of datasets to concatenate</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>direction</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>vertical</code></td>\n<td><code>vertical</code> for rows, <code>horizontal</code> for columns</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>info</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Dataset info to use for the concatenated dataset</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>split</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Name of the split for the concatenated dataset</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Select</h3>\n<p>Select a subset of rows by index or columns by name.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Select columns\naction:\n  method: select\n  dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n  axis: columns\n  columns: [&quot;instruction&quot;, &quot;output&quot;]\n\n# Select rows\naction:\n  method: select\n  dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n  axis: rows\n  indices: [0, 1, 2, 5, 10]\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>select</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>dataset</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Source dataset to select from</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>axis</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>columns</code></td>\n<td><code>rows</code> (by indices) or <code>columns</code> (by names)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>indices</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Row indices to select (when <code>axis: rows</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>columns</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Column names to select (when <code>axis: columns</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Filter</h3>\n<p>Filter rows in a dataset.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">action:\n  method: filter\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>filter</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Map</h3>\n<p>Apply a template-based transformation to produce a new column from existing columns.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">action:\n  method: map\n  dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n  template: &quot;Instruction: {instruction}\\nResponse: {output}&quot;\n  output_column: text\n  remove_columns: [&quot;instruction&quot;, &quot;output&quot;]\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>map</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>dataset</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Source dataset to map</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>template</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Template string with <code>{column_name}</code> placeholders</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output_column</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Name of the new column to create</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>remove_columns</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Columns to remove after mapping</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions</h2>\n<p>A single component can declare multiple dataset operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  actions:\n    - id: load\n      method: load\n      provider: huggingface\n      path: ${input.path}\n      split: ${input.split}\n      fraction: ${input.fraction}\n\n    - id: concat\n      method: concat\n      datasets: ${input.datasets}\n\n    - id: select-columns\n      method: select\n      dataset: ${input.dataset}\n      axis: columns\n      columns: ${input.columns}\n\n    - id: select-rows\n      method: select\n      dataset: ${input.dataset}\n      axis: rows\n      indices: ${input.indices}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Load and Format for Training</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset\n    type: datasets\n    actions:\n      - id: load\n        method: load\n        provider: huggingface\n        path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n        split: train\n\n      - id: format\n        method: map\n        dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n        template: &quot;### Instruction:\\n{instruction}\\n\\n### Response:\\n{output}&quot;\n        output_column: text\n        remove_columns: [&quot;instruction&quot;, &quot;input&quot;, &quot;output&quot;]\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: prepare-training-data\n    jobs:\n      - id: load\n        component: dataset\n        action: load\n\n      - id: format\n        component: dataset\n        action: format\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n        depends_on: [load]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Merge Two Datasets</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: concat-datasets\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-first\n        component: dataset\n        action: load\n        input:\n          path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n          split: train\n\n      - id: load-second\n        component: dataset\n        action: load\n        input:\n          path: yahma/alpaca-cleaned\n          split: train\n\n      - id: concat\n        component: dataset\n        action: concat\n        input:\n          datasets:\n            - ${jobs.load-first.output}\n            - ${jobs.load-second.output}\n        depends_on: [load-first, load-second]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Local Dataset Loading</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  action:\n    method: load\n    provider: local\n    loader: json\n    data_files: ./data/training-set.jsonl\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  action:\n    method: load\n    provider: local\n    loader: csv\n    data_files:\n      train: ./data/train.csv\n      test: ./data/test.csv\n    split: train\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Private Dataset with Authentication</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  action:\n    method: load\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: my-org/private-dataset\n    token: ${env.HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN}\n    split: train\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: datasets\n  action:\n    method: load\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: ${env.DATASET_PATH | tatsu-lab/alpaca}\n    split: ${input.split | train}\n    fraction: ${input.fraction as number | 1.0}\n    streaming: ${input.streaming as boolean | false}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Use <code>fraction</code> for iteration</strong>: Load a small fraction during development to keep workflows snappy</li>\n<li><strong>Cache locally</strong>: Set <code>cache_dir</code> to avoid re-downloading large datasets on every run</li>\n<li><strong>Stream for huge datasets</strong>: Enable <code>streaming: true</code> when the dataset does not fit in memory</li>\n<li><strong>Format with <code>map</code></strong>: Use the <code>map</code> method to build the exact text column shape your trainer expects</li>\n<li><strong>Pin revisions</strong>: Set <code>revision:</code> for reproducible training runs</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Training data preparation</strong>: Combine with <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model-trainer\">model-trainer.md</a> to feed fine-tuning jobs</li>\n<li><strong>Evaluation set assembly</strong>: Load test/validation splits and forward to evaluators</li>\n<li><strong>Dataset transformation</strong>: Pre-process before vectorization for <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/vector-store\">vector-store.md</a></li>\n<li><strong>Sample inspection</strong>: Use <code>select</code> with <code>axis: rows</code> to extract small samples for debugging</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Datasets Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/file-store",
      "html": "<h1>File Store Component</h1>\n<p>The file store component provides a unified interface for storing, retrieving, and managing files across local filesystems and major cloud object storage services (AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, Azure Blob Storage). It supports operations like put, get, delete, exists, and list, with streaming I/O for handling large files without memory overhead.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: local\n  base_path: ./storage\n  action:\n    method: put\n    path: ${input.filename}\n    source: ${input.file}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<p>All file-store drivers share these common settings:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>file-store</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Backend driver: <code>local</code>, <code>aws-s3</code>, <code>gcp-storage</code>, <code>azure-blob</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>base_path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>local: cwd / cloud: bucket root</td>\n<td>Base prefix for all action <code>path</code> inputs. Not included in the logical <code>path</code> users see</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of file store actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Action Configuration</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Operation method: <code>put</code>, <code>get</code>, <code>delete</code>, <code>exists</code>, <code>list</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Supported Drivers</h2>\n<h3>Local Filesystem</h3>\n<p>Store files on the local filesystem:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: local\n  base_path: ./storage\n</code></pre>\n<p>The local driver has no additional fields beyond the common <code>base_path</code>.</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong><code>base_path</code> default</strong>: current working directory. Explicit configuration is recommended.</li>\n<li><strong>Auto directory creation</strong>: <code>put</code> automatically creates intermediate directories within <code>base_path</code> (matching the flat-namespace behavior of cloud drivers).</li>\n<li><strong>Path traversal protection</strong>: Action <code>path</code> values that escape <code>base_path</code> via <code>../</code> or absolute paths are rejected.</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>AWS S3</h3>\n<p>Store objects in Amazon S3 or S3-compatible storage (MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, etc.):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-app-assets\n  region: ap-northeast-2\n  access_key_id: ${env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}\n  secret_access_key: ${env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}\n  base_path: workflows/\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>AWS S3 Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>bucket</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>S3 bucket name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>region</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>AWS region. Uses SDK default if not set</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>endpoint</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Custom endpoint for S3-compatible storage (MinIO, R2, etc.)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>access_key_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Auto-loaded from environment/IAM role if not set</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>secret_access_key</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Auto-loaded from environment/IAM role if not set</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_token</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>STS temporary credentials</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Using S3-compatible storage (MinIO):</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  endpoint: http://minio.local:9000\n  access_key_id: ${env.MINIO_ACCESS_KEY}\n  secret_access_key: ${env.MINIO_SECRET_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Google Cloud Storage</h3>\n<p>Store objects in Google Cloud Storage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: gcp-storage\n  bucket: my-app-assets\n  project: my-gcp-project\n  credentials_path: ./gcp-service-account.json\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>GCP Storage Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>bucket</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>GCS bucket name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>project</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>GCP project ID. Uses SDK default if not set</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>credentials_path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Path to service account JSON key file. Uses Application Default Credentials if not set</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Azure Blob Storage</h3>\n<p>Store blobs in Azure Blob Storage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: azure-blob\n  container: my-container\n  connection_string: ${env.AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Azure Blob Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>container</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Blob container name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>connection_string</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Azure Storage connection string (simplest authentication)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>account_name</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Storage account name (when not using <code>connection_string</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>account_key</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Account key (when not using <code>connection_string</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Note</strong>: <code>connection_string</code> and <code>(account_name, account_key)</code> are mutually exclusive. If neither is provided, <code>DefaultAzureCredential</code> (environment-based) is attempted.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h2>Path Semantics</h2>\n<p>All action <code>path</code> inputs are <strong>logical paths</strong> from the user's perspective. The component-level <code>base_path</code> is automatically prepended internally but never appears in user-facing path strings.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Position</th>\n<th>Meaning</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Action input <code>path</code></td>\n<td>Logical path. Internally composed as <code>base_path + path</code> for the driver call</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Result <code>path</code></td>\n<td>Logical path. Can be passed directly to subsequent <code>get</code>/<code>delete</code>/<code>exists</code> actions</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Result <code>url</code></td>\n<td>External-facing URL. HTTPS for cloud, <code>file://</code> for local. Includes <code>base_path</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>This logical/physical separation:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Prevents <code>base_path</code> from being applied twice in chained actions.</li>\n<li>Lets users change <code>base_path</code> without rewriting path references.</li>\n<li>Allows <code>url</code> to be used in external systems (logs, downstream components, user-facing outputs).</li>\n</ul>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Path values can use <code>/</code></strong>: Paths like <code>dir1/dir2/file.txt</code> are valid and natural. On local drivers, this maps to a directory tree; on cloud drivers, slashes are just characters in the flat-namespace key.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h2>File Store Operations</h2>\n<h3>Put — Store Data</h3>\n<p>Write data to the store. On cloud drivers this uploads an object; on local it writes a file.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: put\n    path: images/${input.id}.png\n    source: ${input.file}\n    content_type: image/png\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Put Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>put</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Logical path within the store</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>source</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Data to store (see <a href=\"#source-handling\">Source Handling</a>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>content_type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>inferred from path extension</td>\n<td>MIME type</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>metadata</code></td>\n<td>dict</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Object metadata (cloud only; ignored on local)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>multipart_threshold</code></td>\n<td>int | string</td>\n<td><code>8MB</code></td>\n<td>Size threshold for switching to multipart upload (cloud only)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>chunk_size</code></td>\n<td>int | string</td>\n<td><code>8MB</code></td>\n<td>Chunk size for streaming/multipart</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Logical path (same as input — usable in subsequent actions)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>External-facing URL (HTTPS or <code>file://</code>). Does not guarantee access permission</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Bytes written</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.content_type</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>MIME type if known</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Get — Retrieve Data</h3>\n<p>Read data from the store. Three modes are available depending on where the output goes.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Mode 1: Default — bytes in memory (small files only)\ncomponent:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: get\n    path: images/${input.id}.png\n    output:\n      data: ${result.content}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Mode 2: Save to local file (large files — recommended)\ncomponent:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: get\n    path: ${input.path}\n    save_to: /tmp/${input.id}.bin\n    output:\n      saved_to: ${result.save_to}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Mode 3: Stream to next job (lazy consumption)\ncomponent:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: get\n    path: ${input.path}\n    streaming: true\n    output:\n      stream: ${result.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Get Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>get</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Logical path to retrieve</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>save_to</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Local path to save into. Parent directory must exist. If an existing directory is given, the file is saved inside it using the basename of <code>path</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>streaming</code></td>\n<td>bool | string</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>If <code>true</code>, returns a <code>StreamResource</code> for lazy consumption in subsequent jobs</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>chunk_size</code></td>\n<td>int | string</td>\n<td><code>8MB</code></td>\n<td>Streaming/download chunk size</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value (common fields):</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Logical path (same as input)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>External-facing URL</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Bytes downloaded</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.content_type</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>MIME type if known</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.modified_at</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>ISO 8601 timestamp of last modification, if available</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Mode-specific fields:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Mode</th>\n<th>Additional Field</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Default (no <code>save_to</code>, <code>streaming: false</code>)</td>\n<td><code>result.content</code></td>\n<td>Downloaded bytes</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>With <code>save_to</code></td>\n<td><code>result.save_to</code></td>\n<td>Local path where the file was saved (resolved path when a directory was given)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>With <code>streaming: true</code></td>\n<td><code>result.content</code></td>\n<td><code>StreamResource</code> for chunk-wise consumption</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Large files</strong>: Avoid the default in-memory mode. Use <code>save_to</code> if you want the file on disk, or <code>streaming: true</code> to pipe it into the next job lazily. The default mode loads the entire file into memory and is only appropriate for small files.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong><code>save_to</code> + <code>streaming: true</code></strong>: Setting both is rejected at schema validation time. Choose one — save to disk, or stream to the next job.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h3>Delete — Remove Data</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: delete\n    path: temp/${input.id}.bin\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Delete Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>delete</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Logical path to delete</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Logical path (same as input)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.deleted</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td>Always <code>true</code> if the request succeeded</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Idempotent</strong>: <code>delete</code> returns <code>deleted: true</code> even when the object did not exist (matches S3/GCS/Azure behavior). To check existence before deletion, combine <code>exists</code> + <code>delete</code> explicitly. Network or permission errors raise exceptions rather than returning <code>deleted: false</code>.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h3>Exists — Check Existence</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: exists\n    path: ${input.path}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Exists Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>exists</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Logical path to check</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Logical path (same as input)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.exists</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td>Whether the object exists</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>List — Enumerate Objects</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: my-bucket\n  action:\n    method: list\n    path: images/\n    recursive: true\n    pattern: &quot;*.png&quot;\n    max_result_count: 100\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>List Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>list</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Path prefix filter. On local, lists directory contents; on cloud, matches the key prefix. End with <code>/</code> for directory/namespace semantics</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>recursive</code></td>\n<td>bool | string</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>If <code>true</code>, descend into subdirectories (local) or list across <code>/</code> boundaries (cloud). If <code>false</code>, only the immediate level under <code>path</code> is returned</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>pattern</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Glob pattern (e.g. <code>*.jpg</code>, <code>**/*.png</code>) to filter results. Matched against each item's logical <code>path</code> relative to <code>base_path</code>. Use <code>**</code> to span subdirectories regardless of <code>recursive</code> semantics</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_result_count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>driver default (S3: 1000, GCS: 1000, Azure: 5000)</td>\n<td>Maximum items per response</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>next_token</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Pass the <code>next_token</code> from the previous response to continue pagination. Omit on the first call</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.items</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>List of object descriptors</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.items[i].path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Logical path — usable directly in subsequent <code>get</code>/<code>delete</code>/<code>exists</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.items[i].url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>External-facing URL</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.items[i].size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Object size in bytes</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.items[i].content_type</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>MIME type if available</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.items[i].modified_at</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>ISO 8601 timestamp</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Items in this response (not total)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.next_token</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>Pagination token. <code>null</code> if no more pages</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong><code>recursive</code> behavior by driver:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Driver</th>\n<th><code>recursive: false</code></th>\n<th><code>recursive: true</code></th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>local</code></td>\n<td>Files directly under <code>path</code> only; subdirectories are not descended into</td>\n<td>Walks all subdirectories under <code>path</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>aws-s3</code> / <code>gcp-storage</code> / <code>azure-blob</code></td>\n<td>Adds a <code>/</code> delimiter — only keys without further <code>/</code> after the prefix are returned (one &quot;level&quot;)</td>\n<td>All keys matching the prefix, regardless of <code>/</code> boundaries</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Glob patterns and pagination</strong>: <code>pattern</code> is applied as a post-filter after the driver returns a page. On cloud drivers, a response page may be smaller than <code>max_result_count</code> (or even empty) when many items don't match the pattern — <code>next_token</code> is still honored, so keep paginating until it becomes <code>null</code>.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Subdirectories are not listed</strong>: <code>list</code> only returns files. Directory entries (local) and common prefixes (cloud) are excluded from <code>items</code>. To enumerate the directory structure, use <code>recursive: true</code> and derive the structure from each item's <code>path</code>.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h2>Source Handling</h2>\n<p>The <code>source</code> field accepts multiple types and is processed based on the runtime Python type after variable rendering:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Rendered Type</th>\n<th>Processing</th>\n<th>Memory</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>UploadFile</code> (HTTP upload)</td>\n<td>Stream from internal file/buffer in chunks</td>\n<td>O(chunk_size)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>StreamResource</code></td>\n<td>Consumed chunk by chunk</td>\n<td>O(chunk_size)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>File-like (<code>read()</code> method)</td>\n<td>Wrapped as <code>StreamResource</code></td>\n<td>O(chunk_size)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>bytes</code> / <code>bytearray</code></td>\n<td>Wrapped as <code>BytesStreamResource</code>. Split into chunks if larger than <code>multipart_threshold</code></td>\n<td>O(data_size)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>str</code></td>\n<td>Encoded as UTF-8 and stored as text. <strong>Not interpreted as a file path</strong></td>\n<td>O(text_size)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Patterns</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># 1. Save an HTTP-uploaded file directly (most common case)\n- method: put\n  path: uploads/${input.filename}\n  source: ${input.file}                    # UploadFile is auto-detected\n\n# 2. Upload a local file by explicit path\n- method: put\n  path: backups/data.bin\n  source: ${input.file_path as file;path}  # Cast to file path\n\n# 3. Lazy-pipe a stream from a previous job\n- method: put\n  path: processed/output.bin\n  source: ${jobs.transform.response.stream}  # StreamResource\n\n# 4. Pass raw bytes\n- method: put\n  path: data/payload.bin\n  source: ${jobs.encode.response.data}     # bytes\n\n# 5. Save text\n- method: put\n  path: logs/message.txt\n  source: &quot;Hello, world&quot;                   # str saved as text\n</code></pre>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Strings are never interpreted as file paths</strong>: <code>source: &quot;/etc/passwd&quot;</code> writes the literal string <code>/etc/passwd</code> as text content — it does not read that file. To upload a local file, use <code>${var as file;path}</code> casting or pass an <code>UploadFile</code>/<code>StreamResource</code>.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple file store operations under one component:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: assets\n    type: file-store\n    driver: aws-s3\n    bucket: my-app-assets\n    base_path: workflows/\n    actions:\n      - id: upload-image\n        method: put\n        path: images/${input.id}.png\n        source: ${input.image_file}\n        content_type: image/png\n\n      - id: download-image\n        method: get\n        path: images/${input.id}.png\n        save_to: /tmp/${input.id}.png\n\n      - id: check-image\n        method: exists\n        path: images/${input.id}.png\n\n      -
