id: delete-image\n        method: delete\n        path: images/${input.id}.png\n\n      - id: list-images\n        method: list\n        path: images/\n        max_result_count: 50\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Large File Handling</h2>\n<p>File stores support GB-scale files (model weights, videos, audio datasets) without loading them into memory:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Upload</strong>: Pass a file path (via <code>${var as file;path}</code>), an <code>UploadFile</code>, or a <code>StreamResource</code> — the component streams the content in chunks.</li>\n<li><strong>Cloud multipart</strong>: Files above <code>multipart_threshold</code> (default 8MB) are automatically uploaded via multipart APIs (S3 <code>upload_part</code>, GCS resumable upload, Azure block blob).</li>\n<li><strong>Download to disk</strong>: Set <code>save_to</code> to write directly to a local file, chunk by chunk.</li>\n<li><strong>Download as stream</strong>: Set <code>streaming: true</code> to return a <code>StreamResource</code> for the next job to consume lazily.</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Streaming a large video between jobs:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: process-large-video\n    jobs:\n      - id: fetch\n        component: s3-bucket\n        action: download-video\n        input:\n          path: ${input.video_path}\n          streaming: true\n\n      - id: transcode\n        component: video-converter\n        input:\n          source: ${jobs.fetch.response.content}\n</code></pre>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong><code>StreamResource</code> is single-use</strong>: It can only be consumed once. If two jobs need the same data, download to a file with <code>save_to</code> and share the path.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h2>Advanced Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Storing AI Model Outputs</h3>\n<p>Save generated images, audio, or video produced by other components:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: generate-and-save\n    jobs:\n      - id: generate\n        component: image-generator\n        input:\n          prompt: ${input.prompt}\n\n      - id: save\n        component: s3-bucket\n        action: upload-image\n        input:\n          path: generations/${input.user_id}/${input.request_id}.png\n          source: ${jobs.generate.response.image}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: s3-bucket\n    type: file-store\n    driver: aws-s3\n    bucket: my-generations\n    base_path: outputs/\n    actions:\n      - id: upload-image\n        method: put\n        path: ${input.path}\n        source: ${input.source}\n        content_type: image/png\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Workflow Asset Management</h3>\n<p>Use list pagination to process many files:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: archive\n    type: file-store\n    driver: gcp-storage\n    bucket: my-archive\n    actions:\n      - id: list-batch\n        method: list\n        path: batch/${input.date}/\n        max_result_count: 100\n        next_token: ${input.token}\n        output:\n          files: ${result.items}\n          next: ${result.next_token}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Cross-Driver Migration</h3>\n<p>Copy files from local to cloud using streaming:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: migrate-to-s3\n    jobs:\n      - id: fetch\n        component: local-files\n        action: read\n        input:\n          path: ${input.filename}\n          streaming: true\n\n      - id: upload\n        component: s3-bucket\n        action: write\n        input:\n          path: archive/${input.filename}\n          source: ${jobs.fetch.response.content}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: local-files\n    type: file-store\n    driver: local\n    base_path: ./old-storage\n    actions:\n      - id: read\n        method: get\n        path: ${input.path}\n        streaming: ${input.streaming}\n\n  - id: s3-bucket\n    type: file-store\n    driver: aws-s3\n    bucket: archive-bucket\n    actions:\n      - id: write\n        method: put\n        path: ${input.path}\n        source: ${input.source}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>URL Semantics</h2>\n<p>The <code>url</code> field returned by <code>put</code>/<code>get</code>/<code>list</code> follows driver-specific conventions:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Driver</th>\n<th><code>url</code> Format</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>local</code></td>\n<td><code>file://&lt;base_path&gt;/&lt;path&gt;</code> (absolute)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>aws-s3</code></td>\n<td><code>https://&lt;bucket&gt;.s3.&lt;region&gt;.amazonaws.com/&lt;base_path&gt;&lt;path&gt;</code> (or <code>endpoint</code>-based)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gcp-storage</code></td>\n<td><code>https://storage.googleapis.com/&lt;bucket&gt;/&lt;base_path&gt;&lt;path&gt;</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>azure-blob</code></td>\n<td><code>https://&lt;account&gt;.blob.core.windows.net/&lt;container&gt;/&lt;base_path&gt;&lt;path&gt;</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Access not guaranteed</strong>: The <code>url</code> is a standard URL pointer to the object. Whether anonymous access succeeds depends on IAM policies and bucket/object ACLs. The component does not provide presigned URLs — use external tooling if signed URLs are required.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h2>Driver Scope</h2>\n<p>File-store drivers only target systems with <strong>native protocol support that does not require OS-level mounting</strong>. Mount-dependent systems (NFS, SMB/CIFS, SSHFS) should be mounted at the OS level and accessed through the <code>local</code> driver:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">- id: nfs-storage\n  type: file-store\n  driver: local\n  base_path: /mnt/nfs-share/workflows   # OS-mounted path\n</code></pre>\n<p>S3-compatible storage (MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, etc.) is supported via the <code>aws-s3</code> driver's <code>endpoint</code>.</p>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>Common failure modes:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Authentication</strong>: Invalid credentials, expired tokens, missing IAM permissions</li>\n<li><strong>Not found</strong>: <code>get</code>/<code>exists</code> for missing objects (<code>exists</code> returns <code>false</code>, <code>get</code> raises)</li>\n<li><strong>Quota/storage limits</strong>: Bucket-level quotas exceeded</li>\n<li><strong>Network</strong>: Transient connectivity issues — SDKs retry chunks automatically</li>\n<li><strong>Path validation</strong>: Action <code>path</code> containing <code>..</code>, absolute paths, or consecutive <code>/</code> is rejected</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Use workflow error handling for downstream recovery:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: fetch\n      component: assets\n      action: download\n      input:\n        path: ${input.path}\n      on_error:\n        - id: fallback\n          component: backup-store\n          action: download\n          input:\n            path: ${input.path}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>All settings support variable interpolation, including credentials, paths, and source data:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: file-store\n  driver: aws-s3\n  bucket: ${env.S3_BUCKET}\n  region: ${env.AWS_REGION | us-east-1}\n  access_key_id: ${env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}\n  secret_access_key: ${env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}\n  base_path: ${env.S3_PREFIX | workflows/}\n  action:\n    method: put\n    path: ${input.namespace}/${input.filename}\n    source: ${input.file}\n    metadata:\n      workflow: ${context.workflow_id}\n      user: ${input.user_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Security Considerations</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Path traversal (local)</strong>: Action <code>path</code> values escaping <code>base_path</code> (<code>../</code>, absolute paths) are rejected. The local driver enforces this because traversal poses a real filesystem risk.</li>\n<li><strong>Path normalization (cloud)</strong>: Cloud object keys allow arbitrary strings, but the component still rejects absolute paths, <code>.</code>/<code>..</code> segments, and consecutive <code>/</code> to prevent accidental key collisions. This is normalization, not a security boundary — IAM/bucket policies remain the actual boundary.</li>\n<li><strong>Credentials</strong>: Store <code>access_key_id</code>/<code>secret_access_key</code>/<code>connection_string</code> etc. in environment variables, not in YAML.</li>\n<li><strong><code>save_to</code></strong>: Permission is delegated to the OS. Do not bind untrusted user input directly to <code>save_to</code> — the workflow author is responsible for sanitizing.</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Explicit <code>base_path</code></strong>: Always set <code>base_path</code> rather than relying on defaults — makes the component's scope self-documenting.</li>\n<li><strong>Streaming for large files</strong>: Use <code>save_to</code> (to disk) or <code>streaming: true</code> (to next job) for files larger than a few MB.</li>\n<li><strong>Path conventions</strong>: Use slash-delimited logical paths (<code>category/subcategory/file.ext</code>) — they work identically on local and cloud drivers.</li>\n<li><strong>Cast source types</strong>: Use <code>${var as file;path}</code> for explicit file uploads; let <code>UploadFile</code>/<code>StreamResource</code>/<code>bytes</code> flow naturally otherwise.</li>\n<li><strong>Credentials via environment</strong>: Reference credentials with <code>${env.*}</code>, never paste them in YAML.</li>\n<li><strong>Multipart tuning</strong>: For very large files, increase <code>multipart_threshold</code> and <code>chunk_size</code> to reduce request overhead — but keep within memory budget.</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>AI output storage</strong>: Save generated images, audio, video from model components</li>\n<li><strong>Input asset handling</strong>: Receive HTTP-uploaded files and persist them</li>\n<li><strong>Cross-workflow data sharing</strong>: Pass large artifacts between workflow runs via shared storage</li>\n<li><strong>Batch processing</strong>: List, fetch, transform, and re-upload files in bulk</li>\n<li><strong>Backup and archival</strong>: Mirror local data to cloud storage</li>\n<li><strong>Model weight distribution</strong>: Stream large model weights from object storage at startup</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "File Store Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/graph-store",
      "html": "<h1>Graph Store Component</h1>\n<p>The graph store component enables storing, querying, and traversing graph data using various backend databases. It supports operations like inserting nodes and relationships, updating properties, querying with native graph query languages, deleting elements, and traversing graph paths, making it ideal for knowledge graphs, social networks, recommendation engines, and relationship-driven data models.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  url: bolt://localhost:7687\n  username: neo4j\n  password: password\n  action:\n    method: query\n    query: &quot;MATCH (n:Person) RETURN n LIMIT 10&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>graph-store</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Backend driver: <code>neo4j</code>, <code>arangodb</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of graph store actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>All graph store actions share these common settings:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Operation method: <code>query</code>, <code>insert</code>, <code>update</code>, <code>delete</code>, <code>traverse</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Output mapping to transform action results</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Supported Drivers</h2>\n<h3>Neo4j</h3>\n<p>Neo4j for native property graph storage with Cypher query language:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  url: bolt://localhost:7687\n  username: neo4j\n  password: password\n  database: mydb\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Neo4j Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>bolt://localhost:7687</code></td>\n<td>Neo4j connection URL (<code>bolt://</code>, <code>neo4j://</code>, <code>neo4j+s://</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>username</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Username for authentication</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>password</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Password for authentication</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target database name. Uses default database if not specified</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>30s</code></td>\n<td>Client operation timeout</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>ArangoDB</h3>\n<p>ArangoDB for multi-model graph, document, and key-value storage with AQL query language:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: arangodb\n  host: localhost\n  port: 8529\n  username: root\n  password: password\n  database: social\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>ArangoDB Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>host</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>localhost</code></td>\n<td>Server hostname or IP address</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>8529</code></td>\n<td>Server port number (1-65535)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>protocol</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>http</code></td>\n<td>Connection protocol: <code>http</code>, <code>https</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>username</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Username for authentication</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>password</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Password for authentication</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>_system</code></td>\n<td>Target database name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>30s</code></td>\n<td>Client operation timeout</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Graph Store Operations</h2>\n<h3>Query</h3>\n<p>Execute native graph queries using the driver's query language (Cypher for Neo4j, AQL for ArangoDB):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Neo4j - Cypher\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  url: bolt://localhost:7687\n  action:\n    method: query\n    query: &quot;MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]-&gt;(friend) WHERE p.name = $name RETURN friend&quot;\n    params:\n      name: ${input.name}\n    output:\n      friends: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># ArangoDB - AQL\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: arangodb\n  action:\n    method: query\n    query: &quot;FOR p IN persons FILTER p.name == @name FOR f IN OUTBOUND p friendships RETURN f&quot;\n    params:\n      name: ${input.name}\n    output:\n      friends: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Query Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>query</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>query</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Native graph query string</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>params</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Query parameters to bind</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target database (Neo4j only, overrides component setting)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>collection</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target collection context (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>List of result records as dictionaries</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Insert</h3>\n<p>Add nodes and/or relationships to the graph:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: insert\n    nodes:\n      label: Person\n      properties:\n        name: ${input.name}\n        age: ${input.age}\n    output:\n      result: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Insert a relationship\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: insert\n    relationships:\n      type: KNOWS\n      from: ${input.from_id}\n      to: ${input.to_id}\n      properties:\n        since: ${input.year}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Insert multiple nodes at once\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: insert\n    nodes:\n      - label: Person\n        properties:\n          name: Alice\n      - label: Person\n        properties:\n          name: Bob\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Insert Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>insert</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>nodes</code></td>\n<td>object/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Node(s) to insert with <code>label</code> and <code>properties</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>relationships</code></td>\n<td>object/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Relationship(s) to insert with <code>type</code>, <code>from</code>, <code>to</code>, and <code>properties</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>collection</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target collection (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>edge_collection</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Edge collection for relationships (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>graph</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Named graph to operate on (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Node Format:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>label</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Node label (Neo4j) or collection name (ArangoDB)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>properties</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>Key-value properties for the node</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Optional node key (ArangoDB <code>_key</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Relationship Format:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Relationship type (Neo4j) or edge collection name (ArangoDB)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>from</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Source node ID</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>to</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Target node ID</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>properties</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>Optional key-value properties for the relationship</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.created_nodes</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Number of nodes created</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.created_relationships</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Number of relationships created</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Update</h3>\n<p>Modify properties or labels of existing nodes and relationships:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: update\n    node_id: ${input.node_id}\n    properties:\n      age: ${input.new_age}\n      email: ${input.email}\n    labels: Senior\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Update a relationship\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: update\n    relationship_id: ${input.rel_id}\n    properties:\n      weight: ${input.new_weight}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Update Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>update</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>node_id</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>ID(s) of node(s) to update</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>relationship_id</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>ID(s) of relationship(s) to update</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>properties</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Properties to set on the target element(s)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>labels</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Label(s) to add to target node(s) (Neo4j only)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>collection</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target collection (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.affected_rows</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Number of elements updated</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Delete</h3>\n<p>Remove nodes and/or relationships from the graph:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: delete\n    node_id: ${input.node_id}\n    detach: true\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Delete a relationship only\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: delete\n    relationship_id: ${input.rel_id}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Delete Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>delete</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>node_id</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>ID(s) of node(s) to delete</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>relationship_id</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>ID(s) of relationship(s) to delete</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>detach</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Also delete connected relationships when deleting nodes</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>collection</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target collection (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Note</strong>: In Neo4j, deleting a node with existing relationships requires <code>detach: true</code> (default). Setting <code>detach: false</code> will fail if the node has connections.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.affected_rows</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Number of elements deleted</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Traverse</h3>\n<p>Perform graph traversal to discover connected nodes along paths:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  action:\n    method: traverse\n    start_node: ${input.person_id}\n    direction: both\n    max_depth: 3\n    relationship_types: [KNOWS, WORKS_WITH]\n    node_labels: [Person]\n    output:\n      connections: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># ArangoDB traversal using named graph\ncomponent:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: arangodb\n  action:\n    method: traverse\n    start_node: persons/${input.person_key}\n    graph: social_graph\n    direction: out\n    max_depth: 2\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Traverse Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>traverse</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>start_node</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Starting node ID for traversal</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>direction</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>out</code></td>\n<td>Traversal direction: <code>in</code>, <code>out</code>, <code>both</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_depth</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>3</code></td>\n<td>Maximum traversal depth (minimum: 1)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>relationship_types</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Filter to specific relationship types</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>node_labels</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Filter to nodes with specific labels</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>graph</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Named graph to traverse (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>edge_collection</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Edge collection to traverse (ArangoDB only)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value (Neo4j):</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result[].node</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>Discovered node properties</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result[].depth</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Distance from start node</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result[].relationship_types</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Relationship types along the path</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value (ArangoDB with named graph):</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result[].node</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>Discovered vertex document</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result[].depth</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Distance from start vertex</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple graph store operations on one component:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: neo4j\n  url: bolt://localhost:7687\n  username: neo4j\n  password: password\n  actions:\n    - id: add-person\n      method: insert\n      nodes:\n        label: Person\n        properties:\n          name: ${input.name}\n          age: ${input.age}\n\n    - id: add-friendship\n      method: insert\n      relationships:\n        type: KNOWS\n        from: ${input.from_id}\n        to: ${input.to_id}\n        properties:\n          since: ${input.since}\n\n    - id: find-person\n      method: query\n      query: &quot;MATCH (p:Person {name: $name}) RETURN p&quot;\n      params:\n        name: ${input.name}\n\n    - id: find-connections\n      method: traverse\n      start_node: ${input.node_id}\n      direction: both\n      max_depth: 2\n      relationship_types: [KNOWS]\n\n    - id: update-person\n      method: update\n      node_id: ${input.node_id}\n      properties:\n        age: ${input.new_age}\n\n    - id: remove-person\n      method: delete\n      node_id: ${input.node_id}\n      detach: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Node ID Formats</h2>\n<h3>Neo4j</h3>\n<p>Neo4j uses <code>elementId()</code> format (e.g., <code>4:abc123:0</code>). These are returned by insert operations and used in update/delete/traverse actions.</p>\n<h3>ArangoDB</h3>\n<p>ArangoDB uses <code>collection/key</code> format (e.g., <code>persons/12345</code>). When <code>node_id</code> or <code>relationship_id</code> contains a <code>/</code>, the collection name is extracted automatically. Otherwise, the <code>collection</code> field is used.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Full ID format - collection is extracted automatically\naction:\n  method: update\n  node_id: persons/12345\n  properties:\n    age: 31\n\n# Key-only format - requires collection field\naction:\n  method: update\n  collection: persons\n  node_id: &quot;12345&quot;\n  properties:\n    age: 31\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Build knowledge graph pipelines using workflows:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: build-knowledge-graph\n    title: Build Knowledge Graph\n    description: Extract entities and relationships, then store in graph\n    jobs:\n      - id: extract-entities\n        component: llm\n        input:\n          prompt: &quot;Extract person entities from: ${input.text}&quot;\n        output: ${output as json}\n\n      - id: store-entities\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: add-person\n        input:\n          name: ${jobs.extract-entities.output.name}\n          age: ${jobs.extract-entities.output.age}\n        depends_on: [extract-entities]\n\n  - id: find-related-people\n    title: Find Related People\n    jobs:\n      - id: traverse\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: find-connections\n        input:\n          node_id: ${input.person_id}\n        output: ${output as json}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: knowledge-graph\n    type: graph-store\n    driver: neo4j\n    url: bolt://localhost:7687\n    username: neo4j\n    password: password\n    actions:\n      - id: add-person\n        method: insert\n        nodes:\n          label: Person\n          properties:\n            name: ${input.name}\n            age: ${input.age}\n\n      - id: find-connections\n        method: traverse\n        start_node: ${input.node_id}\n        direction: both\n        max_depth: 2\n        relationship_types: [KNOWS]\n\n  - id: llm\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages:\n          - role: user\n            content: ${input.prompt}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Advanced Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Knowledge Graph with RAG</h3>\n<p>Combine graph store with vector store for graph-enhanced RAG:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: graph-rag-query\n    jobs:\n      - id: find-entity\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: search-entity\n        input:\n          name: ${input.entity}\n\n      - id: get-neighbors\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: find-connections\n        input:\n          node_id: ${jobs.find-entity.output.result[0].id}\n        depends_on: [find-entity]\n\n      - id: generate-answer\n        component: llm\n        input:\n          prompt: |\n            Based on the following knowledge graph context, answer the question.\n\n            Entity: ${input.entity}\n            Connected entities: ${jobs.get-neighbors.output.result}\n\n            Question: ${input.question}\n        depends_on: [get-neighbors]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: knowledge-graph\n    type: graph-store\n    driver: neo4j\n    url: bolt://localhost:7687\n    actions:\n      - id: search-entity\n        method: query\n        query: &quot;MATCH (n) WHERE n.name = $name RETURN n, elementId(n) AS id&quot;\n        params:\n          name: ${input.name}\n\n      - id: find-connections\n        method: traverse\n        start_node: ${input.node_id}\n        direction: both\n        max_depth: 2\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Social Network Analysis</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: social-graph\n    type: graph-store\n    driver: arangodb\n    host: localhost\n    database: social\n    username: root\n    password: password\n    actions:\n      - id: mutual-friends\n        method: query\n        query: |\n          FOR friend1 IN OUTBOUND @person1 friendships\n            FOR friend2 IN OUTBOUND @person2 friendships\n              FILTER friend1._id == friend2._id\n              RETURN friend1\n        params:\n          person1: ${input.person1_id}\n          person2: ${input.person2_id}\n\n      - id: shortest-path\n        method: query\n        query: |\n          FOR v, e IN OUTBOUND\n            SHORTEST_PATH @from TO @to friendships\n            RETURN { vertex: v, edge: e }\n        params:\n          from: ${input.from_id}\n          to: ${input.to_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Fraud Detection Graph</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: fraud-graph\n    type: graph-store\n    driver: neo4j\n    url: bolt://localhost:7687\n    actions:\n      - id: find-suspicious-patterns\n        method: query\n        query: |\n          MATCH (a:Account)-[:TRANSFERRED_TO]-&gt;(b:Account)-[:TRANSFERRED_TO]-&gt;(c:Account)\n          WHERE a = c AND a &lt;&gt; b\n          RETURN a, b, c,\n                 [(a)-[t:TRANSFERRED_TO]-&gt;(b) | t.amount] AS amounts\n        output:\n          circular_transfers: ${result}\n\n      - id: trace-money-flow\n        method: traverse\n        start_node: ${input.account_id}\n        direction: out\n        max_depth: 5\n        relationship_types: [TRANSFERRED_TO]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>Graph store operations can fail for various reasons:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Connection Issues</strong>: Database server unreachable</li>\n<li><strong>Authentication Errors</strong>: Invalid credentials</li>\n<li><strong>Query Errors</strong>: Syntax errors in Cypher/AQL queries</li>\n<li><strong>Constraint Violations</strong>: Unique constraint conflicts on insert</li>\n<li><strong>Not Found</strong>: Node or relationship ID does not exist</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Use workflow error handling to manage failures:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: store-data\n      component: knowledge-graph\n      action: add-person\n      input:\n        name: ${input.name}\n      on_error:\n        - id: log-failure\n          component: logger\n          input:\n            message: &quot;Failed to store: ${input.name}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Graph store supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: graph-store\n  driver: ${env.GRAPH_DB_DRIVER | neo4j}\n  url: ${env.NEO4J_URL | bolt://localhost:7687}\n  username: ${env.NEO4J_USER}\n  password: ${env.NEO4J_PASSWORD}\n  action:\n    method: query\n    query: &quot;MATCH (n:${input.label}) WHERE n.name = $name RETURN n&quot;\n    params:\n      name: ${input.name}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Use Native Queries for Complex Operations</strong>: For complex graph patterns, prefer the <code>query</code> method with Cypher/AQL over multiple insert/update calls</li>\n<li><strong>Detach Delete by Default</strong>: Always use <code>detach: true</code> when deleting nodes to avoid orphaned relationship errors</li>\n<li><strong>Limit Traversal Depth</strong>: Set appropriate <code>max_depth</code> to prevent runaway traversals on large graphs</li>\n<li><strong>Parameterize Queries</strong>: Use <code>params</code> instead of string interpolation in query strings to prevent injection and improve caching</li>\n<li><strong>Use Named Graphs (ArangoDB)</strong>: Prefer named graphs over ad-hoc edge collections for consistent traversal behavior</li>\n<li><strong>Index Key Properties</strong>: Create indexes on frequently queried properties in your graph database for better performance</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Inserts</strong>: For bulk loading, use the <code>query</code> method with batch Cypher/AQL rather than individual insert operations</li>\n<li><strong>Connection Reuse</strong>: Define one graph store component and reference it from multiple workflows</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Knowledge Graphs</strong>: Store and query structured knowledge with entities and relationships</li>\n<li><strong>Social Networks</strong>: Model user connections, find mutual friends, shortest paths</li>\n<li><strong>Recommendation Engines</strong>: Traverse user-item-category graphs for personalized suggestions</li>\n<li><strong>Fraud Detection</strong>: Identify suspicious patterns like circular transfers or unusual connections</li>\n<li><strong>Dependency Analysis</strong>: Map software dependencies, infrastructure relationships</li>\n<li><strong>Genealogy / Org Charts</strong>: Model hierarchical relationships with traversal queries</li>\n<li><strong>Supply Chain</strong>: Track product flows through manufacturing and distribution networks</li>\n<li><strong>Network Topology</strong>: Model and analyze IT infrastructure, routing, and connectivity</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Graph Store Component"
      }
    },
