      "slug": "reference/compose/components/http-client",
      "html": "<h1>HTTP Client Component</h1>\n<p>The HTTP client component enables making HTTP requests to external APIs and services. It supports various HTTP methods, authentication, streaming responses, and asynchronous completion handling.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n    Content-Type: application/json\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>http-client</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>base_url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Base URL for HTTP requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Default HTTP headers to include in all requests</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>HTTP client actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>endpoint</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Full URL endpoint (mutually exclusive with <code>path</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>URL path to append to <code>base_url</code> (mutually exclusive with <code>endpoint</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>POST</code></td>\n<td>HTTP method: <code>GET</code>, <code>POST</code>, <code>PUT</code>, <code>DELETE</code>, <code>PATCH</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>HTTP headers to include in the request</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>body</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Request body data</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>params</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>URL query parameters</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>stream_format</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Stream format: <code>server-sent-events</code>, <code>json-lines</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>completion</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Asynchronous completion configuration</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple API Call</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple Actions Component</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.github.com\n  headers:\n    Authorization: token ${env.GITHUB_TOKEN}\n    Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json\n  actions:\n    - id: get-user\n      path: /user\n      method: GET\n      output:\n        username: ${response.login}\n        \n    - id: list-repos\n      path: /user/repos\n      method: GET\n      params:\n        type: owner\n        sort: updated\n      output:\n        repositories: ${response[*].name}\n        \n    - id: create-repo\n      path: /user/repos\n      method: POST\n      body:\n        name: ${input.repo_name}\n        description: ${input.description}\n        private: false\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Full URL Endpoint</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  action:\n    endpoint: https://httpbin.org/post\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      data: ${input.payload}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Query Parameters</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.weather.com\n  action:\n    path: /v1/current\n    method: GET\n    params:\n      key: ${env.WEATHER_API_KEY}\n      q: ${input.city}\n      aqi: yes\n    output:\n      temperature: ${response.current.temp_c}\n      condition: ${response.current.condition.text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Streaming Responses</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    stream_format: server-sent-events\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt}\n      stream: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Asynchronous Completion</h2>\n<p>HTTP client supports asynchronous request completion through polling or callbacks.</p>\n<h3>Polling Completion</h3>\n<p>Monitor request status by polling a completion endpoint:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n  action:\n    path: /jobs\n    method: POST\n    body:\n      task: ${input.task_type}\n      data: ${input.data}\n    completion:\n      type: polling\n      path: /jobs/${response.job_id}\n      method: GET\n      status: status\n      success_when: [ completed, finished ]\n      fail_when: [ failed, error ]\n      interval: 5s\n      timeout: 300s\n    output:\n      result: ${response.result}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Polling Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>polling</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>endpoint</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Full URL for polling (mutually exclusive with <code>path</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Path to append to <code>base_url</code> for polling</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>GET</code></td>\n<td>HTTP method for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Headers for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>body</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Body data for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>params</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Query parameters for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>status</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Field path to check for completion status</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>success_when</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Status values indicating success</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fail_when</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Status values indicating failure</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>interval</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Time interval between polls (e.g., <code>5s</code>, <code>30s</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Maximum time to wait (e.g., <code>300s</code>, <code>5m</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Callback Completion</h3>\n<p>Wait for external callback notification:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n  action:\n    path: /jobs\n    method: POST\n    body:\n      task: ${input.task_type}\n      callback_url: https://myapp.com/callback\n    completion:\n      type: callback\n      wait_for: ${response.job_id}\n    output:\n      result: ${response.result}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Callback Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>callback</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait_for</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Callback identifier to wait for</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Stream Formats</h2>\n<h3>Server-Sent Events</h3>\n<p>Handle Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">stream_format: server-sent-events\n</code></pre>\n<h3>JSON Lines</h3>\n<p>Handle newline-delimited JSON streams:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">stream_format: json-lines\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Authentication Patterns</h2>\n<h3>Bearer Token</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_TOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>API Key</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  X-API-Key: ${env.API_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Basic Auth</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  Authorization: Basic ${env.BASIC_AUTH_TOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Custom Headers</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  X-Custom-Auth: ${env.CUSTOM_TOKEN}\n  X-Client-ID: ${env.CLIENT_ID}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>HTTP client automatically handles HTTP status codes:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>2xx</strong>: Success - response data is available</li>\n<li><strong>4xx/5xx</strong>: Error - workflow execution stops with error</li>\n</ul>\n<p>For custom error handling, use completion configuration with specific status checks.</p>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>HTTP client supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: ${env.API_BASE_URL}\n  action:\n    path: /users/${input.user_id}\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n    body:\n      name: ${input.name}\n      age: ${input.age as number}\n      active: ${input.active as boolean | true}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Base URL</strong>: Use <code>base_url</code> with <code>path</code> for better maintainability</li>\n<li><strong>Environment Variables</strong>: Store sensitive data like API keys in environment variables</li>\n<li><strong>Headers</strong>: Set common headers at the component level</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Use completion configuration for long-running tasks</li>\n<li><strong>Timeouts</strong>: Set appropriate timeout values for asynchronous operations</li>\n<li><strong>Rate Limiting</strong>: Consider API rate limits when setting polling intervals</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference HTTP client in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: api-call\n      component: my-http-client\n      action: get-data\n      input:\n        endpoint_id: users\n        \n    - id: process-result\n      component: processor\n      input:\n        data: ${api-call.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>API Integration</strong>: Connect to external REST APIs</li>\n<li><strong>Webhooks</strong>: Send data to webhook endpoints</li>\n<li><strong>Authentication</strong>: Obtain and use access tokens</li>\n<li><strong>Data Fetching</strong>: Retrieve data from web services</li>\n<li><strong>File Upload</strong>: Upload files via HTTP POST</li>\n<li><strong>Monitoring</strong>: Check service health endpoints</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "HTTP Client Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/http-server",
      "html": "<h1>HTTP Server Component</h1>\n<p>The HTTP server component enables creating HTTP endpoints and servers within your model-compose workflow. It supports managing server lifecycle, defining endpoints, handling requests/responses, and integrating with external processes.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8000\n  start: [ uvicorn, main:app, --reload ]\n  action:\n    path: /api/endpoint\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      message: ${input.message}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>http-server</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>8000</code></td>\n<td>Port on which the HTTP server will listen (1-65535)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>base_path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Base path to prefix all HTTP routes exposed by this component</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Headers to be included in all outgoing HTTP requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>manage</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Configuration used to manage the HTTP server lifecycle</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of HTTP endpoint actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Server Management</h3>\n<p>The <code>manage</code> configuration controls server lifecycle:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scripts</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Shell scripts for server management</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>working_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Working directory for the scripts</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>env</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Environment variables to set when executing scripts</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Management Scripts</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Script</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>install</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to install dependencies</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>build</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to build the server</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>clean</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to clean the server environment</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>start</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Script to start the server</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>HTTP server actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>URL path for this HTTP server endpoint</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>POST</code></td>\n<td>HTTP method: <code>GET</code>, <code>POST</code>, <code>PUT</code>, <code>DELETE</code>, <code>PATCH</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>HTTP headers to include in responses</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>body</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Default response body template</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>params</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Expected URL query parameters</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>stream_format</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Stream format: <code>server-sent-events</code>, <code>json-lines</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>completion</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Asynchronous completion configuration</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Echo Server</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  start: [ uvicorn, main:app, --reload ]\n  port: 8000\n  action:\n    method: POST\n    path: /echo\n    headers:\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      text: ${input.text}\n    output:\n      text: ${response.echo.text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Server with Multiple Endpoints</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      start: [ python, server.py ]\n      install: [ pip, install, -r, requirements.txt ]\n    working_dir: ./server\n    env:\n      PORT: 8080\n      DEBUG: true\n  actions:\n    - id: health-check\n      path: /health\n      method: GET\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        status: healthy\n        timestamp: ${now}\n    \n    - id: process-data\n      path: /process\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        result: ${input.data | process}\n        processed_at: ${now}\n      \n    - id: get-status\n      path: /status\n      method: GET\n      params:\n        format: json\n      body:\n        server_status: running\n        uptime: ${uptime}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Server with Custom Management</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 3000\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      install:\n        - [ npm, install ]\n        - [ npm, run, build ]\n      clean: [ rm, -rf, node_modules, dist ]\n      start: [ npm, start ]\n    working_dir: ./frontend\n    env:\n      NODE_ENV: production\n      API_URL: http://localhost:8080\n  action:\n    path: /api/webhook\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      received: ${input}\n      processed: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Asynchronous Completion</h2>\n<p>HTTP server supports asynchronous request completion through polling or callbacks.</p>\n<h3>Polling Completion</h3>\n<p>Monitor request status by polling a completion endpoint:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8000\n  action:\n    path: /long-task\n    method: POST\n    body:\n      task_id: ${generate_id}\n      data: ${input.data}\n    completion:\n      type: polling\n      path: /status/${response.task_id}\n      method: GET\n      status: status\n      success_when: [ completed, finished ]\n      fail_when: [ failed, error ]\n      interval: 5s\n      timeout: 300s\n    output:\n      result: ${response.result}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Polling Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>polling</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>URL path for polling endpoint</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>GET</code></td>\n<td>HTTP method for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Headers for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>body</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Body data for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>params</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Query parameters for polling requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>status</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Field path to check for completion status</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>success_when</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Status values indicating success</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fail_when</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Status values indicating failure</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>interval</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Time interval between polls</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Maximum time to wait</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Callback Completion</h3>\n<p>Wait for external callback notification:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8000\n  action:\n    path: /async-task\n    method: POST\n    body:\n      task_id: ${generate_id}\n      callback_url: https://myapp.com/callback\n      data: ${input.data}\n    completion:\n      type: callback\n      wait_for: ${response.task_id}\n    output:\n      result: ${response.result}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Callback Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>callback</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait_for</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Callback identifier to wait for</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Stream Formats</h2>\n<h3>Server-Sent Events</h3>\n<p>Handle Server-Sent Events (SSE) streams:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">stream_format: server-sent-events\n</code></pre>\n<h3>JSON Lines</h3>\n<p>Handle newline-delimited JSON streams:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">stream_format: json-lines\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Server Lifecycle Management</h2>\n<h3>Installation Scripts</h3>\n<p>Run multiple installation commands:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  scripts:\n    install:\n      - [ pip, install, -r, requirements.txt ]\n      - [ npm, install ]\n      - [ chmod, +x, start-server.sh ]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Build Process</h3>\n<p>Build the server before starting:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  scripts:\n    build:\n      - [ npm, run, build ]\n      - [ docker, build, -t, myserver, . ]\n    start: [ docker, run, -p, 8000:8000, myserver ]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Configuration</h3>\n<p>Set environment variables for server processes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  env:\n    DATABASE_URL: ${env.DATABASE_URL}\n    API_KEY: ${env.API_KEY}\n    LOG_LEVEL: info\n  working_dir: ./server\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration Patterns</h2>\n<h3>With External Servers</h3>\n<p>Launch and manage external server processes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      start: [ python, -m, flask, run ]\n    env:\n      FLASK_APP: app.py\n      FLASK_ENV: development\n  port: 5000\n  action:\n    path: /api/data\n    method: POST\n</code></pre>\n<h3>With Docker Containers</h3>\n<p>Manage containerized services:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      start: [ docker, run, -d, -p, 8080:80, nginx ]\n      clean: [ docker, stop, nginx ]\n  port: 8080\n</code></pre>\n<h3>API Gateway Pattern</h3>\n<p>Create multiple endpoints for different services:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api/v1\n  actions:\n    - id: auth\n      path: /auth\n      method: POST\n      \n    - id: users\n      path: /users\n      method: GET\n      \n    - id: data\n      path: /data\n      method: POST\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>HTTP server automatically handles:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Server startup failures</strong>: Component initialization fails if server cannot start</li>\n<li><strong>Port conflicts</strong>: Automatic error if port is already in use</li>\n<li><strong>Script execution errors</strong>: Management scripts that fail will stop component initialization</li>\n</ul>\n<p>For custom error handling, use completion configuration with specific status checks.</p>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>HTTP server supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  port: ${env.SERVER_PORT as integer | 8000}\n  action:\n    path: /api/${input.version}\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_TOKEN}\n    body:\n      user_id: ${input.user_id}\n      data: ${input.data}\n      timestamp: ${now}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Port Management</strong>: Use environment variables for port configuration</li>\n<li><strong>Process Management</strong>: Use proper start scripts with process managers</li>\n<li><strong>Health Checks</strong>: Implement health check endpoints for monitoring</li>\n<li><strong>Security</strong>: Never expose sensitive data in response bodies</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Cleanup</strong>: Use clean scripts to properly shutdown services</li>\n<li><strong>Logging</strong>: Configure appropriate logging levels in environment variables</li>\n<li><strong>Base Paths</strong>: Use base_path for API versioning and organization</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference HTTP server in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: start-server\n      component: my-http-server\n      action: health-check\n      \n    - id: process-request\n      component: my-http-server\n      action: process-data\n      input:\n        data: ${input.request_data}\n        \n    - id: handle-response\n      component: processor\n      input:\n        server_response: ${process-request.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>API Servers</strong>: Create REST API endpoints</li>\n<li><strong>Webhooks</strong>: Handle incoming webhook requests</li>\n<li><strong>Microservices</strong>: Launch and manage service processes</li>\n<li><strong>Development Servers</strong>: Start development environments</li>\n<li><strong>Mock Services</strong>: Create mock API endpoints for testing</li>\n<li><strong>Proxy Services</strong>: Route requests to backend services</li>\n<li><strong>Static File Servers</strong>: Serve static content and assets</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "HTTP Server Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/image-processor",
      "html": "<h1>Image Processor Component</h1>\n<p>The image processor component provides a comprehensive set of image manipulation operations including resizing, cropping, rotating, flipping, and various filters. It's built on the Pillow (PIL) library and supports common image formats while enabling complex image processing workflows.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: resize\n    image: ${input.image}\n    width: 800\n    height: 600\n    scale_mode: fit\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>image-processor</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of image processing actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>All image processor actions share these common settings:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Processing method: <code>resize</code>, <code>crop</code>, <code>rotate</code>, <code>flip</code>, <code>grayscale</code>, <code>blur</code>, <code>sharpen</code>, <code>adjust-brightness</code>, <code>adjust-contrast</code>, <code>adjust-saturation</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>image</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Input image (file path, base64 string, or variable reference)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Output variable mapping</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Image Processing Methods</h2>\n<h3>Resize</h3>\n<p>Resize images with different scaling modes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: resize\n    image: ${input.image}\n    width: 1024\n    height: 768\n    scale_mode: fit\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Resize Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>width</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target width in pixels (at least one of width/height required)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>height</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target height in pixels (at least one of width/height required)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scale_mode</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>fit</code></td>\n<td>Scaling mode: <code>fit</code>, <code>fill</code>, <code>stretch</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Scale Modes:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong><code>fit</code></strong>: Maintain aspect ratio, fit inside target dimensions (may have empty space)</li>\n<li><strong><code>fill</code></strong>: Maintain aspect ratio, fill target dimensions (may crop excess)</li>\n<li><strong><code>stretch</code></strong>: Ignore aspect ratio, stretch to exact dimensions</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Crop</h3>\n<p>Extract a rectangular region from an image:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: crop\n    image: ${input.image}\n    x: 100\n    y: 100\n    width: 400\n    height: 300\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Crop Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>x</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>X coordinate of top-left corner</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>y</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Y coordinate of top-left corner</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>width</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Crop width in pixels</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>height</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Crop height in pixels</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Rotate</h3>\n<p>Rotate an image by a specified angle:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: rotate\n    image: ${input.image}\n    angle: 45\n    expand: true\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Rotate Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>angle</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Rotation angle in degrees (positive = counter-clockwise)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>expand</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Expand canvas to fit rotated image (prevents cropping)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Flip</h3>\n<p>Flip an image horizontally or vertically:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: flip\n    image: ${input.image}\n    direction: horizontal\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Flip Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>direction</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Flip direction: <code>horizontal</code> or <code>vertical</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Grayscale</h3>\n<p>Convert an image to grayscale:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: grayscale\n    image: ${input.image}\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Blur</h3>\n<p>Apply Gaussian blur to an image:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: blur\n    image: ${input.image}\n    radius: 5.0\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Blur Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>radius</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td><code>2.0</code></td>\n<td>Blur radius in pixels (higher = more blur)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Sharpen</h3>\n<p>Enhance image sharpness:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: sharpen\n    image: ${input.image}\n    factor: 2.0\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Sharpen Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>factor</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td><code>1.0</code></td>\n<td>Sharpening factor (1.0 = original, &gt;1.0 = sharper)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Adjust Brightness</h3>\n<p>Adjust image brightness:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: adjust-brightness\n    image: ${input.image}\n    factor: 1.3\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Brightness Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>factor</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Brightness factor (1.0 = original, &lt;1.0 = darker, &gt;1.0 = brighter)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Adjust Contrast</h3>\n<p>Adjust image contrast:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: adjust-contrast\n    image: ${input.image}\n    factor: 1.5\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Contrast Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>factor</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Contrast factor (1.0 = original, &lt;1.0 = less contrast, &gt;1.0 = more contrast)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Adjust Saturation</h3>\n<p>Adjust image color saturation:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: adjust-saturation\n    image: ${input.image}\n    factor: 1.2\n    output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Saturation Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>factor</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Saturation factor (0.0 = grayscale, 1.0 = original, &gt;1.0 = more saturated)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple image processing operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  actions:\n    - id: thumbnail\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 200\n      height: 200\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${thumbnail}\n\n    - id: enhance\n      method: sharpen\n      image: ${input.image}\n      factor: 1.5\n      output: ${enhanced}\n\n    - id: convert-grayscale\n      method: grayscale\n      image: ${input.image}\n      output: ${grayscale}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Image Enhancement Pipeline</h3>\n<p>Apply multiple enhancements sequentially:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: enhance-photo\n    jobs:\n      - id: sharpen\n        component: image-processor\n        action: sharpen-image\n        input:\n          image: ${input.photo}\n        output:\n          sharpened: ${output}\n\n      - id: adjust-colors\n        component: image-processor\n        action: boost-saturation\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.sharpen.output.sharpened}\n        output:\n          enhanced: ${output}\n        depends_on: [ sharpen ]\n\n      - id: final-brightness\n        component: image-processor\n        action: brighten\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.adjust-colors.output.enhanced}\n        depends_on: [ adjust-colors ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: sharpen-image\n        method: sharpen\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 1.5\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: boost-saturation\n        method: adjust-saturation\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 1.2\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: brighten\n        method: adjust-brightness\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 1.1\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Photo Filters</h3>\n<p>Create Instagram-style filters:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: vintage-filter\n    title: Apply Vintage Filter\n    jobs:\n      - id: desaturate\n        component: image-processor\n        action: adjust-saturation\n        input:\n          image: ${input.photo}\n        output:\n          desaturated: ${output}\n\n      - id: warm-contrast\n        component: image-processor\n        action: adjust-contrast\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.desaturate.output.desaturated}\n        output:\n          filtered: ${output}\n        depends_on: [ desaturate ]\n\n      - id: brighten\n        component: image-processor\n        action: adjust-brightness\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.warm-contrast.output.filtered}\n        depends_on: [ warm-contrast ]\n\n  - id: noir-filter\n    title: Apply Noir Filter\n    jobs:\n      - id: convert-grayscale\n        component: image-processor\n        action: grayscale\n        input:\n          image: ${input.photo}\n        output:\n          grayscale: ${output}\n\n      - id: boost-contrast\n        component: image-processor\n        action: adjust-contrast\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.convert-grayscale.output.grayscale}\n        depends_on: [ convert-grayscale ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: adjust-saturation\n        method: adjust-saturation\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 0.7\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: adjust-contrast\n        method: adjust-contrast\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 1.2\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: adjust-brightness\n        method: adjust-brightness\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 1.05\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: grayscale\n        method: grayscale\n        image: ${input.image}\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Responsive Image Generation</h3>\n<p>Generate multiple sizes for responsive web design:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: generate-responsive-images\n    jobs:\n      - id: mobile\n        component: image-processor\n        action: mobile-size\n        input:\n          image: ${input.original}\n        output:\n          mobile: ${output}\n\n      - id: tablet\n        component: image-processor\n        action: tablet-size\n        input:\n          image: ${input.original}\n        output:\n          tablet: ${output}\n\n      - id: desktop\n        component: image-processor\n        action: desktop-size\n        input:\n          image: ${input.original}\n        output:\n          desktop: ${output}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: mobile-size\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 640\n        scale_mode: fit\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: tablet-size\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 1024\n        scale_mode: fit\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: desktop-size\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 1920\n        scale_mode: fit\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Watermark Preparation</h3>\n<p>Prepare images for watermarking:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: prepare-for-watermark\n    title: Prepare Image for Watermarking\n    jobs:\n      - id: resize-image\n        component: image-processor\n        action: resize-standard\n        input:\n          image: ${input.photo}\n        output:\n          resized: ${output}\n\n      - id: adjust-brightness\n        component: image-processor\n        action: reduce-brightness\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.resize-image.output.resized}\n        output:\n          prepared: ${output}\n        depends_on: [ resize-image ]\n\n      - id: enhance-contrast\n        component: image-processor\n        action: boost-contrast\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.adjust-brightness.output.prepared}\n        depends_on: [ adjust-brightness ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: resize-standard\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 1200\n        scale_mode: fit\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: reduce-brightness\n        method: adjust-brightness\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 0.9\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: boost-contrast\n        method: adjust-contrast\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: 1.1\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Smart Cropping</h3>\n<p>Center crop with different aspect ratios:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  actions:\n    - id: crop-square\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 800\n      height: 800\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${result}\n\n    - id: crop-landscape\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 1200\n      height: 675\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${result}\n\n    - id: crop-portrait\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 675\n      height: 1200\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Advanced Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Conditional Image Processing</h3>\n<p>Apply different processing based on image properties:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: smart-resize\n    jobs:\n      - id: process-image\n        component: image-processor\n        action: ${input.orientation == 'landscape' ? 'resize-landscape' : 'resize-portrait'}\n        input:\n          image: ${input.photo}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: resize-landscape\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 1600\n        height: 900\n        scale_mode: fit\n\n      - id: resize-portrait\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 900\n        height: 1600\n        scale_mode: fit\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Batch Image Processing</h3>\n<p>Process multiple images in parallel:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: batch-thumbnail-creation\n    jobs:\n      - id: process-batch\n        component: image-processor\n        action: create-thumbnail\n        input:\n          images: ${input.image_batch}  # Array of images\n        output:\n          thumbnails: ${output}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: create-thumbnail\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.images}\n        width: 200\n        height: 200\n        scale_mode: fill\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Color Correction Pipeline</h3>\n<p>Automatic color correction workflow:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: auto-correct-colors\n    jobs:\n      - id: adjust-brightness\n        component: image-processor\n        action: auto-brightness\n        input:\n          image: ${input.photo}\n        output:\n          brightness_corrected: ${output}\n\n      - id: adjust-contrast\n        component: image-processor\n        action: auto-contrast\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.adjust-brightness.output.brightness_corrected}\n        output:\n          contrast_corrected: ${output}\n        depends_on: [ adjust-brightness ]\n\n      - id: adjust-saturation\n        component: image-processor\n        action: auto-saturation\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.adjust-contrast.output.contrast_corrected}\n        depends_on: [ adjust-contrast ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: auto-brightness\n        method: adjust-brightness\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: ${input.brightness_factor | 1.1}\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: auto-contrast\n        method: adjust-contrast\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: ${input.contrast_factor | 1.2}\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: auto-saturation\n        method: adjust-saturation\n        image: ${input.image}\n        factor: ${input.saturation_factor | 1.1}\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Image Format Support</h2>\n<p>The image processor supports common image formats through Pillow:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>JPEG/JPG</strong>: Lossy compression, good for photos</li>\n<li><strong>PNG</strong>: Lossless compression, supports transparency</li>\n<li><strong>WebP</strong>: Modern format with better compression</li>\n<li><strong>GIF</strong>: Animation support (first frame processed)</li>\n<li><strong>BMP</strong>: Uncompressed bitmap</li>\n<li><strong>TIFF</strong>: High-quality, multi-page support</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<h3>E-commerce Product Images</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: product-image-pipeline\n    jobs:\n      - id: main-image\n        component: image-processor\n        action: product-main\n        input:\n          image: ${input.product_photo}\n        output:\n          main: ${output}\n\n      - id: thumbnail\n        component: image-processor\n        action: product-thumb\n        input:\n          image: ${input.product_photo}\n        output:\n          thumb: ${output}\n\n      - id: zoom-view\n        component: image-processor\n        action: product-zoom\n        input:\n          image: ${input.product_photo}\n        output:\n          zoom: ${output}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: image-processor\n    actions:\n      - id: product-main\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 800\n        height: 800\n        scale_mode: fit\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: product-thumb\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 150\n        height: 150\n        scale_mode: fill\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: product-zoom\n        method: resize\n        image: ${input.image}\n        width: 2000\n        height: 2000\n        scale_mode: fit\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Social Media Image Preparation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  actions:\n    - id: instagram-square\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 1080\n      height: 1080\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${instagram_square}\n\n    - id: instagram-story\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 1080\n      height: 1920\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${instagram_story}\n\n    - id: twitter-post\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 1200\n      height: 675\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${twitter_post}\n\n    - id: facebook-cover\n      method: resize\n      image: ${input.image}\n      width: 820\n      height: 312\n      scale_mode: fill\n      output: ${facebook_cover}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Image processor supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: image-processor\n  action:\n    method: ${input.operation | resize}\n    image: ${input.image}\n    width: ${input.target_width as integer | 800}\n    height: ${input.target_height as integer | 600}\n    scale_mode: ${input.mode as select/fit,fill,stretch | fit}\n    # For adjustments\n    factor: ${input.adjustment_factor as number | 1.0}\n    # For rotation\n    angle: ${input.rotation_angle as number | 0}\n    expand: ${input.expand_canvas as boolean | false}\n    # For blur\n    radius: ${input.blur_radius as number | 2.0}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Choose Appropriate Scale Mode</strong>: Use <code>fit</code> for previews, <code>fill</code> for thumbnails, <code>stretch</code> only when necessary</li>\n<li><strong>Preserve Aspect Ratios</strong>: Maintain original proportions for most use cases</li>\n<li><strong>Quality vs Size</strong>: Balance image quality with file size for web delivery</li>\n<li><strong>Pipeline Order</strong>: Apply resize before filters for better performance</li>\n<li><strong>Use Appropriate Formats</strong>: JPEG for photos, PNG for graphics with transparency</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Processing</strong>: Process multiple images in parallel when possible</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Validate image inputs and handle corrupt files gracefully</li>\n<li><strong>Caching</strong>: Cache processed images to avoid redundant operations</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Performance Considerations</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Resize First</strong>: Always resize before applying filters to reduce processing time</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Operations</strong>: Process multiple images in parallel workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Quality Settings</strong>: Adjust quality parameters based on use case</li>\n<li><strong>Format Selection</strong>: Choose efficient formats (WebP) for web delivery</li>\n<li><strong>Memory Management</strong>: Process very large images in streaming mode when available</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Thumbnail Generation</strong>: Create preview images for galleries</li>\n<li><strong>Responsive Images</strong>: Generate multiple sizes for different devices</li>\n<li><strong>Photo Enhancement</strong>: Apply filters and adjustments to improve photos</li>\n<li><strong>Social Media</strong>: Prepare images for various social platforms</li>\n<li><strong>E-commerce</strong>: Process product photos for online stores</li>\n<li><strong>Content Management</strong>: Optimize images for web publishing</li>\n<li><strong>Image Normalization</strong>: Standardize image sizes and formats</li>\n<li><strong>Watermark Preparation</strong>: Prepare images for watermarking systems</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Image Processor Component"
      }
    },

      "slug": "reference/compose/components/key-value-store",
      "html": "<h1>Key-Value Store Component</h1>\n<p>The key-value store component enables storing, retrieving, and managing key-value pairs using various backend databases. It supports operations like get, set, delete, and exists, making it ideal for caching, session management, and data sharing between workflows.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  host: localhost\n  port: 6379\n  action:\n    method: set\n    key: &quot;session:${input.session_id}&quot;\n    value: ${input.data}\n    ttl: 3600\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>key-value-store</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Backend driver: <code>redis</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of key-value store actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>All key-value store actions share these common settings:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Operation method: <code>get</code>, <code>set</code>, <code>delete</code>, <code>exists</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Supported Drivers</h2>\n<h3>Redis</h3>\n<p>Redis for high-performance in-memory key-value storage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  host: localhost\n  port: 6379\n  database: 0\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Redis Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Redis connection URL (e.g., <code>redis://localhost:6379</code>, <code>rediss://localhost:6379</code> for TLS)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>host</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>localhost</code></td>\n<td>Server hostname or IP address</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>6379</code></td>\n<td>Server port number (1-65535)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>secure</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Use TLS/SSL for connections (equivalent to <code>rediss://</code> protocol)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>0</code></td>\n<td>Database number (0-15)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>password</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Redis password</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Note</strong>: <code>url</code> and <code>host</code> are mutually exclusive. If <code>url</code> is provided, <code>host</code>/<code>port</code>/<code>secure</code>/<code>database</code> are ignored.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Using URL:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  url: redis://localhost:6379/0\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Using host/port with authentication:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  host: redis.example.com\n  port: 6379\n  password: ${env.REDIS_PASSWORD}\n  database: 1\n  secure: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Key-Value Store Operations</h2>\n<h3>Get Value</h3>\n<p>Retrieve a value by key:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  action:\n    method: get\n    key: &quot;session:${input.session_id}&quot;\n    output:\n      data: ${result.value}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Get Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>get</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>key</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Key to retrieve</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.value</code></td>\n<td>any | null</td>\n<td>Stored value. <code>null</code> if key does not exist</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Set Value</h3>\n<p>Store a value with optional TTL:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  action:\n    method: set\n    key: &quot;cache:${input.prompt_hash}&quot;\n    value: ${input.response}\n    ttl: 3600\n    output:\n      ok: ${result.success}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Set Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>set</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>key</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Key to store</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>value</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Value to store</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>ttl</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Time-to-live in seconds. <code>null</code> = no expiry</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.success</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td>Whether the operation succeeded</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Delete Key</h3>\n<p>Remove a key from the store:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  action:\n    method: delete\n    key: &quot;session:${input.session_id}&quot;\n    output:\n      deleted: ${result.count}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Delete Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>delete</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>key</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Key to delete</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Number of keys deleted (0 or 1)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Check Existence</h3>\n<p>Check if a key exists:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  action:\n    method: exists\n    key: &quot;session:${input.session_id}&quot;\n    output:\n      exists: ${result.exists}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Exists Action Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>exists</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>key</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Key to check</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Return Value:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result.exists</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td>Whether the key exists</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple key-value store operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  host: localhost\n  port: 6379\n  actions:\n    - id: save-session\n      method: set\n      key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n      value: ${input.session_data}\n      ttl: 86400\n      output:\n        success: ${result.success}\n\n    - id: load-session\n      method: get\n      key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n      output:\n        session: ${result.value}\n\n    - id: delete-session\n      method: delete\n      key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n      output:\n        deleted: ${result.count}\n\n    - id: check-session\n      method: exists\n      key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n      output:\n        exists: ${result.exists}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Value Serialization</h2>\n<p>The key-value store handles value serialization automatically:</p>\n<h3>Storing Values (<code>set</code>)</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Input Type</th>\n<th>Storage</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>string</code></td>\n<td>Stored as-is</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>dict</code>, <code>list</code></td>\n<td>Serialized via <code>json.dumps()</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>int</code>, <code>float</code>, <code>bool</code></td>\n<td>Converted to string</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Retrieving Values (<code>get</code>)</h3>\n<p>On retrieval, the component attempts JSON parsing:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>If JSON parsing succeeds, returns the parsed object (dict, list, etc.)</li>\n<li>If JSON parsing fails, returns the raw string</li>\n</ol>\n<p>This means objects and arrays stored via <code>set</code> are automatically deserialized on <code>get</code>.</p>\n<h2>Advanced Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>API Response Caching</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: cached-chat\n    jobs:\n      - id: check-cache\n        component: cache\n        action: get-response\n        input:\n          prompt_hash: ${input.prompt}\n\n      - id: generate\n        component: openai\n        condition: ${jobs.check-cache.output.cached == null}\n        input:\n          prompt: ${input.prompt}\n\n      - id: save-cache\n        component: cache\n        action: set-response\n        condition: ${jobs.check-cache.output.cached == null}\n        input:\n          prompt_hash: ${input.prompt}\n          response: ${jobs.generate.output.message}\n    output:\n      message: ${jobs.check-cache.output.cached ?? jobs.generate.output.message}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: cache\n    type: key-value-store\n    driver: redis\n    host: localhost\n    actions:\n      - id: get-response\n        method: get\n        key: &quot;chat:${input.prompt_hash}&quot;\n        output:\n          cached: ${result.value}\n      - id: set-response\n        method: set\n        key: &quot;chat:${input.prompt_hash}&quot;\n        value: ${input.response}\n        ttl: 3600\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Session Management</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: session-store\n    type: key-value-store\n    driver: redis\n    url: redis://localhost:6379/1\n    actions:\n      - id: save\n        method: set\n        key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n        value:\n          history: ${input.history}\n          preferences: ${input.preferences}\n        ttl: 86400\n\n      - id: load\n        method: get\n        key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n        output:\n          session: ${result.value}\n\n      - id: logout\n        method: delete\n        key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Workflow Data Sharing</h3>\n<p>Share intermediate results between different workflow executions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: shared-store\n    type: key-value-store\n    driver: redis\n    host: localhost\n    actions:\n      - id: store-result\n        method: set\n        key: &quot;pipeline:${input.run_id}:${input.step}&quot;\n        value: ${input.result}\n        ttl: 7200\n\n      - id: fetch-result\n        method: get\n        key: &quot;pipeline:${input.run_id}:${input.step}&quot;\n        output:\n          data: ${result.value}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>Key-value store operations can fail for various reasons:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Connection Issues</strong>: Redis server unreachable</li>\n<li><strong>Authentication Errors</strong>: Invalid password or access denied</li>\n<li><strong>Key Not Found</strong>: <code>get</code> returns <code>null</code> for non-existent keys (not an error)</li>\n<li><strong>Memory Limits</strong>: Redis server out of memory</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Use workflow error handling to manage failures:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: load-data\n      component: cache\n      action: load\n      input:\n        key: ${input.key}\n      on_error:\n        - id: fallback\n          component: database\n          input:\n            key: ${input.key}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Key-value store supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: key-value-store\n  driver: redis\n  host: ${env.REDIS_HOST | localhost}\n  port: ${env.REDIS_PORT | 6379}\n  password: ${env.REDIS_PASSWORD}\n  action:\n    method: set\n    key: &quot;${input.namespace}:${input.key}&quot;\n    value: ${input.data}\n    ttl: ${input.ttl}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Key Naming</strong>: Use consistent key naming conventions with namespaces (e.g., <code>session:user123</code>, <code>cache:api:response</code>)</li>\n<li><strong>TTL Management</strong>: Always set TTL for cache entries to prevent unbounded memory growth</li>\n<li><strong>Value Size</strong>: Keep values reasonably sized; use references for large objects</li>\n<li><strong>Connection Reuse</strong>: Define one key-value store component and reference it from multiple workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Handle <code>null</code> return values from <code>get</code> gracefully in workflow conditions</li>\n<li><strong>Security</strong>: Store Redis passwords in environment variables, use TLS for remote connections</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference key-value store in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: check-cache\n      component: cache\n      action: get-data\n      input:\n        key: ${input.cache_key}\n\n    - id: process\n      component: processor\n      condition: ${jobs.check-cache.output.data == null}\n      input:\n        raw_data: ${input.data}\n      depends_on: [ check-cache ]\n\n    - id: update-cache\n      component: cache\n      action: set-data\n      condition: ${jobs.check-cache.output.data == null}\n      input:\n        key: ${input.cache_key}\n        value: ${jobs.process.output.result}\n      depends_on: [ process ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Session Storage</strong>: Store user session data across requests</li>\n<li><strong>API Response Caching</strong>: Cache expensive API call results with TTL</li>\n<li><strong>Workflow Data Sharing</strong>: Share intermediate results between workflow executions</li>\n<li><strong>Feature Flags</strong>: Store and retrieve feature toggles</li>\n<li><strong>Rate Limiting</strong>: Track request counts per user/IP</li>\n<li><strong>Temporary Data</strong>: Store short-lived data with automatic expiration</li>\n<li><strong>External Integration</strong>: Read/write data from existing Redis instances</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Key-Value Store Component"
      }
    },

      "slug": "reference/compose/components/mcp-client",
      "html": "<h1>MCP Client Component</h1>\n<p>The MCP (Model Context Protocol) client component enables invoking tools and services from external MCP servers. MCP is a standardized protocol for AI agents to interact with external tools, databases, and services in a consistent way.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://localhost:8080/mcp\n  action:\n    tool: list-files\n    arguments:\n      directory: ${input.path}\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.MCP_TOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>mcp-client</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>URL of the MCP server to invoke tools</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>HTTP headers to include when connecting to the MCP server</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of MCP tool actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>MCP client actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>tool</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>Name of the tool to invoke on the MCP server</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>arguments</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Arguments to pass to the tool</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Optional HTTP headers to include in the tool call</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Tool Invocation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://localhost:8080/mcp\n  action:\n    tool: get-weather\n    arguments:\n      location: ${input.city}\n      units: metric\n    output:\n      temperature: ${response.current.temp}\n      condition: ${response.current.condition}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>File System Operations</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://localhost:3000/mcp\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.FILE_SERVER_TOKEN}\n  actions:\n    - id: list-files\n      tool: list-directory\n      arguments:\n        path: ${input.directory}\n        recursive: false\n      output:\n        files: ${response.files}\n        \n    - id: read-file\n      tool: read-file\n      arguments:\n        path: ${input.file_path}\n      output:\n        content: ${response.content}\n        encoding: ${response.encoding}\n        \n    - id: write-file\n      tool: write-file\n      arguments:\n        path: ${input.output_path}\n        content: ${input.file_content}\n        encoding: utf-8\n      output:\n        success: ${response.success}\n        bytes_written: ${response.bytes_written}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Database Operations</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://database-server:8080/mcp\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.DB_ACCESS_TOKEN}\n  actions:\n    - id: query-users\n      tool: execute-query\n      arguments:\n        sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = ?\n        parameters: [ true ]\n      output:\n        users: ${response.rows}\n        count: ${response.row_count}\n        \n    - id: create-user\n      tool: execute-insert\n      arguments:\n        table: users\n        data:\n          name: ${input.user_name}\n          email: ${input.user_email}\n          created_at: ${now}\n      output:\n        user_id: ${response.inserted_id}\n        success: ${response.success}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>API Gateway Pattern</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://api-gateway:9000/mcp\n  headers:\n    X-API-Key: ${env.GATEWAY_API_KEY}\n    Content-Type: application/json\n  actions:\n    - id: send-notification\n      tool: send-email\n      arguments:\n        to: ${input.recipient}\n        subject: ${input.subject}\n        body: ${input.message}\n        template: notification\n      output:\n        message_id: ${response.message_id}\n        status: ${response.delivery_status}\n        \n    - id: log-event\n      tool: create-log-entry\n      arguments:\n        level: info\n        message: ${input.log_message}\n        metadata:\n          user_id: ${input.user_id}\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n          timestamp: ${now}\n      output:\n        log_id: ${response.log_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Machine Learning Tools</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://ml-server:8080/mcp\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.ML_API_TOKEN}\n  actions:\n    - id: image-classification\n      tool: classify-image\n      arguments:\n        image_url: ${input.image_url}\n        model: resnet50\n        top_k: 5\n      output:\n        predictions: ${response.predictions}\n        confidence_scores: ${response.scores}\n        \n    - id: text-sentiment\n      tool: analyze-sentiment\n      arguments:\n        text: ${input.text}\n        language: en\n      output:\n        sentiment: ${response.sentiment}\n        confidence: ${response.confidence}\n        scores: ${response.detailed_scores}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Authentication Patterns</h2>\n<h3>Bearer Token</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  Authorization: Bearer ${env.MCP_TOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>API Key</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  X-API-Key: ${env.MCP_API_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Custom Authentication</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  X-Auth-Token: ${env.MCP_AUTH_TOKEN}\n  X-Client-ID: ${env.CLIENT_ID}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Tool Discovery and Validation</h2>\n<p>MCP clients can discover available tools from servers:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://localhost:8080/mcp\n  actions:\n    - id: list-tools\n      tool: __list_tools__\n      output:\n        available_tools: ${response.tools}\n        \n    - id: describe-tool\n      tool: __describe_tool__\n      arguments:\n        tool_name: ${input.tool_name}\n      output:\n        description: ${response.description}\n        parameters: ${response.parameters}\n        examples: ${response.examples}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>MCP client handles various error conditions:</p>\n<h3>Connection Errors</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Server Unavailable</strong>: Component fails if MCP server is unreachable</li>\n<li><strong>Authentication Failed</strong>: Invalid credentials result in workflow failure</li>\n<li><strong>Network Timeouts</strong>: Configurable timeout handling</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Tool Execution Errors</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: http://localhost:8080/mcp\n  action:\n    tool: risky-operation\n    arguments:\n      data: ${input.data}\n    # Tool errors are propagated as workflow failures\n    # Use workflow error handling to manage failures\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>MCP client supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-client\n  url: ${env.MCP_SERVER_URL}\n  action:\n    tool: ${input.operation_type}\n    arguments:\n      param1: ${input.value1}\n      param2: ${input.value2 as number}\n      param3: ${input.flag as boolean | false}\n    headers:\n      X-Request-ID: ${generate_uuid}\n      X-Timestamp: ${now}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Service Discovery</strong>: Use tool discovery to understand available capabilities</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Implement proper error handling for network and tool failures</li>\n<li><strong>Authentication</strong>: Store sensitive credentials in environment variables</li>\n<li><strong>Timeouts</strong>: Configure appropriate timeout values for long-running tools</li>\n<li><strong>Validation</strong>: Validate tool arguments before making calls</li>\n<li><strong>Logging</strong>: Log tool invocations for debugging and monitoring</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Management</strong>: Be mindful of rate limits and resource usage</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference MCP client in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: discover-tools\n      component: mcp-client\n      action: list-tools\n      \n    - id: process-data\n      component: mcp-client\n      action: transform-data\n      input:\n        data: ${input.raw_data}\n        transformation: normalize\n        \n    - id: store-result\n      component: mcp-client\n      action: save-to-database\n      input:\n        table: processed_data\n        records: ${process-data.output.result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Tool Categories</h2>\n<h3>File System Tools</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><code>read-file</code>: Read file contents</li>\n<li><code>write-file</code>: Write data to files</li>\n<li><code>list-directory</code>: List directory contents</li>\n<li><code>create-directory</code>: Create directories</li>\n<li><code>delete-file</code>: Remove files</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Database Tools</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><code>execute-query</code>: Run SQL queries</li>\n<li><code>execute-insert</code>: Insert records</li>\n<li><code>execute-update</code>: Update records</li>\n<li><code>execute-delete</code>: Delete records</li>\n<li><code>get-schema</code>: Retrieve table schema</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>HTTP Tools</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><code>make-request</code>: Perform HTTP requests</li>\n<li><code>download-file</code>: Download files from URLs</li>\n<li><code>upload-file</code>: Upload files to endpoints</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>System Tools</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><code>execute-command</code>: Run system commands</li>\n<li><code>get-environment</code>: Retrieve environment variables</li>\n<li><code>check-process</code>: Monitor process status</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>AI/ML Tools</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><code>text-generation</code>: Generate text using language models</li>\n<li><code>image-classification</code>: Classify images</li>\n<li><code>sentiment-analysis</code>: Analyze text sentiment</li>\n<li><code>translation</code>: Translate text between languages</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>MCP Protocol Standards</h2>\n<p>The Model Context Protocol defines standard interfaces for:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Tool Discovery</strong>: Enumerate available tools and their schemas</li>\n<li><strong>Tool Execution</strong>: Invoke tools with typed parameters</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Management</strong>: Access files, databases, and external services</li>\n<li><strong>Session Management</strong>: Maintain context across tool calls</li>\n<li><strong>Error Reporting</strong>: Standardized error responses and handling</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>External Service Integration</strong>: Connect to third-party APIs and services</li>\n<li><strong>Database Operations</strong>: Perform CRUD operations on databases</li>\n<li><strong>File System Access</strong>: Read, write, and manage files</li>\n<li><strong>System Administration</strong>: Execute system commands and scripts</li>\n<li><strong>AI/ML Model Inference</strong>: Run predictions using external models</li>\n<li><strong>Data Processing</strong>: Transform and validate data using external tools</li>\n<li><strong>Notification Services</strong>: Send emails, SMS, and push notifications</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "MCP Client Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/mcp-server",
      "html": "<h1>MCP Server Component</h1>\n<p>The MCP (Model Context Protocol) server component enables creating and hosting MCP-compliant servers that expose tools and services for AI agents and other MCP clients. It provides a standardized way to make your services accessible through the Model Context Protocol.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080\n  start: [ python, mcp_server.py ]\n  action:\n    tool: process-text\n    arguments:\n      text: ${input.text}\n      operation: normalize\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must
