be <code>mcp-server</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>8000</code></td>\n<td>Port on which the MCP server will listen (1-65535)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>base_path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Base path to prefix all MCP routes exposed by this component</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>manage</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Configuration used to manage the MCP server lifecycle</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of MCP tool actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Server Management</h3>\n<p>The <code>manage</code> configuration controls server lifecycle:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scripts</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Shell scripts for server management</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>working_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Working directory for the scripts</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>env</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Environment variables to set when executing scripts</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Management Scripts</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Script</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>install</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to install dependencies</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>build</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to build the server</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>clean</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to clean the server environment</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>start</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Script to start the server</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>MCP server actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>tool</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>Name of the tool to expose via the MCP server</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>arguments</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Default arguments for the tool</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Optional HTTP headers to include in tool responses</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple MCP Tool Server</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      start: [ python, text_processor.py ]\n    working_dir: ./mcp-tools\n    env:\n      MCP_PORT: 8080\n  action:\n    tool: process-text\n    arguments:\n      text: ${input.text}\n      operation: ${input.operation | normalize}\n    output:\n      result: ${response.processed_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multi-Tool MCP Server</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 9000\n  base_path: /tools\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      install: [ pip, install, -r, requirements.txt ]\n      start: [ python, -m, mcp_toolkit.server ]\n    working_dir: ./toolkit\n    env:\n      DATABASE_URL: ${env.DATABASE_URL}\n      API_KEY: ${env.TOOLKIT_API_KEY}\n  actions:\n    - id: file-operations\n      tool: file-manager\n      arguments:\n        operation: ${input.file_operation}\n        path: ${input.file_path}\n        content: ${input.file_content}\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      output:\n        success: ${response.success}\n        data: ${response.data}\n        \n    - id: database-query\n      tool: db-query\n      arguments:\n        query: ${input.sql_query}\n        parameters: ${input.query_params}\n      output:\n        rows: ${response.rows}\n        affected: ${response.affected_rows}\n        \n    - id: text-analysis\n      tool: analyze-text\n      arguments:\n        text: ${input.text}\n        analysis_type: ${input.type | sentiment}\n      output:\n        result: ${response.analysis_result}\n        confidence: ${response.confidence_score}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Docker-Based MCP Server</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      build: \n        - [ docker, build, -t, mcp-ml-server, . ]\n        - [ docker, network, create, mcp-network ]\n      clean: \n        - [ docker, stop, mcp-ml-server ]\n        - [ docker, network, rm, mcp-network ]\n      start: [ docker, run, -d, -p, 8080:8080, --network, mcp-network, mcp-ml-server ]\n    working_dir: ./ml-server\n    env:\n      MODEL_PATH: /models/trained_model.pkl\n      CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES: 0\n  actions:\n    - id: image-classify\n      tool: classify-image\n      arguments:\n        image_data: ${input.image_base64}\n        model: ${input.model_name | resnet50}\n        top_k: ${input.top_results as integer | 5}\n      output:\n        predictions: ${response.predictions}\n        probabilities: ${response.probabilities}\n        \n    - id: text-generate\n      tool: generate-text\n      arguments:\n        prompt: ${input.prompt}\n        max_tokens: ${input.max_length as integer | 100}\n        temperature: ${input.creativity as float | 0.7}\n      output:\n        generated_text: ${response.text}\n        token_count: ${response.tokens_used}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>File System MCP Server</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 3000\n  base_path: /filesystem\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      start: [ node, filesystem-mcp-server.js ]\n    working_dir: ./fs-server\n    env:\n      ALLOWED_PATHS: /home/user/documents,/tmp\n      MAX_FILE_SIZE: 10MB\n  actions:\n    - id: read-file\n      tool: read-file\n      arguments:\n        path: ${input.file_path}\n        encoding: ${input.encoding | utf-8}\n      output:\n        content: ${response.file_content}\n        size: ${response.file_size}\n        modified: ${response.last_modified}\n        \n    - id: write-file\n      tool: write-file\n      arguments:\n        path: ${input.file_path}\n        content: ${input.content}\n        encoding: ${input.encoding | utf-8}\n        create_dirs: ${input.create_directories as boolean | true}\n      output:\n        success: ${response.written}\n        bytes: ${response.bytes_written}\n        \n    - id: list-directory\n      tool: list-files\n      arguments:\n        directory: ${input.dir_path}\n        recursive: ${input.recursive as boolean | false}\n        include_hidden: ${input.show_hidden as boolean | false}\n      output:\n        files: ${response.file_list}\n        directories: ${response.dir_list}\n        total_count: ${response.item_count}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Server Lifecycle Management</h2>\n<h3>Installation and Dependencies</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  scripts:\n    install:\n      - [ pip, install, mcp-toolkit&gt;=1.0.0 ]\n      - [ pip, install, -r, requirements.txt ]\n      - [ npm, install, &quot;@mcp/server-sdk&quot; ]\n  working_dir: ./server\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Build Process</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  scripts:\n    build:\n      - [ npm, run, build ]\n      - [ python, setup.py, build ]\n    clean: [ rm, -rf, dist, build, node_modules ]\n    start: [ node, dist/server.js ]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  env:\n    MCP_SERVER_NAME: MyCustomServer\n    MCP_SERVER_VERSION: 1.0.0\n    LOG_LEVEL: info\n    DATABASE_URL: ${env.DATABASE_URL}\n    API_KEYS: ${env.EXTERNAL_API_KEYS}\n  working_dir: ./mcp-server\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Tool Categories and Examples</h2>\n<h3>Data Processing Tools</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">actions:\n  - id: transform-data\n    tool: data-transformer\n    arguments:\n      data: ${input.raw_data}\n      transformations: ${input.transform_list}\n      output_format: ${input.format | json}\n    \n  - id: validate-data\n    tool: data-validator\n    arguments:\n      data: ${input.data}\n      schema: ${input.validation_schema}\n    output:\n      valid: ${response.is_valid}\n      errors: ${response.validation_errors}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>System Administration Tools</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">actions:\n  - id: system-info\n    tool: get-system-info\n    output:\n      cpu_usage: ${response.cpu_percent}\n      memory_usage: ${response.memory_percent}\n      disk_usage: ${response.disk_usage}\n    \n  - id: process-management\n    tool: manage-process\n    arguments:\n      action: ${input.action}  # start, stop, restart, status\n      process_name: ${input.process}\n    output:\n      status: ${response.process_status}\n      pid: ${response.process_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>API Integration Tools</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">actions:\n  - id: external-api-call\n    tool: api-client\n    arguments:\n      endpoint: ${input.api_endpoint}\n      method: ${input.http_method | GET}\n      headers: ${input.request_headers}\n      body: ${input.request_body}\n    output:\n      response_data: ${response.data}\n      status_code: ${response.status}\n      response_time: ${response.elapsed_ms}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Authentication and Security</h2>\n<h3>Access Control</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080\n  headers:\n    X-API-Version: 1.0\n    Access-Control-Allow-Origin: &quot;*&quot;\n  actions:\n    - id: secure-operation\n      tool: protected-tool\n      headers:\n        Authorization: required\n        X-Client-ID: ${input.client_id}\n      arguments:\n        data: ${input.secure_data}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Rate Limiting and Validation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  env:\n    RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE: 100\n    MAX_PAYLOAD_SIZE: 1MB\n    ALLOWED_ORIGINS: localhost,myapp.com\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration Patterns</h2>\n<h3>As a Service Backend</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /mcp\n\ncomponent:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080\n  actions:\n    - id: service-a\n      tool: process-request\n      arguments:\n        service: service_a\n        payload: ${input}\n    \n    - id: service-b\n      tool: process-request\n      arguments:\n        service: service_b\n        payload: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Database Service Layer</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 5432\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      start: [ python, db_mcp_server.py ]\n    env:\n      DB_CONNECTION: ${env.DATABASE_URL}\n  actions:\n    - id: query\n      tool: execute-query\n    - id: insert\n      tool: execute-insert\n    - id: update\n      tool: execute-update\n    - id: delete\n      tool: execute-delete\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Microservice Architecture</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: auth-service\n    type: mcp-server\n    port: 8001\n    base_path: /auth\n    \n  - id: data-service\n    type: mcp-server\n    port: 8002\n    base_path: /data\n    \n  - id: notification-service\n    type: mcp-server\n    port: 8003\n    base_path: /notify\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling and Monitoring</h2>\n<h3>Server Health Checks</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">actions:\n  - id: health-check\n    tool: server-health\n    output:\n      status: ${response.health_status}\n      uptime: ${response.server_uptime}\n      version: ${response.server_version}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Error Reporting</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">manage:\n  env:\n    ERROR_REPORTING_ENDPOINT: ${env.ERROR_WEBHOOK_URL}\n    LOG_ERRORS_TO_FILE: true\n    ERROR_LOG_PATH: /var/log/mcp-server-errors.log\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>MCP server supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: ${env.MCP_PORT as integer | 8080}\n  base_path: /api/${env.API_VERSION | v1}\n  action:\n    tool: ${input.tool_name}\n    arguments:\n      param1: ${input.value1}\n      param2: ${input.value2 as number}\n      timestamp: ${now}\n    headers:\n      X-Request-ID: ${generate_uuid}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Tool Documentation</strong>: Provide clear descriptions for all exposed tools</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Implement comprehensive error handling and reporting</li>\n<li><strong>Security</strong>: Validate all inputs and implement proper authentication</li>\n<li><strong>Performance</strong>: Monitor resource usage and implement appropriate limits</li>\n<li><strong>Logging</strong>: Log all tool invocations for debugging and auditing</li>\n<li><strong>Versioning</strong>: Version your MCP server and tools appropriately</li>\n<li><strong>Dependencies</strong>: Manage server dependencies and startup requirements</li>\n<li><strong>Graceful Shutdown</strong>: Implement proper cleanup on server shutdown</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference MCP server in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: start-mcp-server\n      component: my-mcp-server\n      action: health-check\n      \n    - id: process-data\n      component: my-mcp-server\n      action: transform-data\n      input:\n        data: ${input.raw_data}\n        \n    - id: validate-result\n      component: my-mcp-server\n      action: validate-data\n      input:\n        data: ${process-data.output.result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>AI Model Serving</strong>: Expose machine learning models as MCP tools</li>\n<li><strong>Database Abstraction</strong>: Provide standardized database access</li>\n<li><strong>File System Operations</strong>: Enable file system access through MCP</li>\n<li><strong>API Gateway</strong>: Create unified access to multiple backend services</li>\n<li><strong>Data Processing Pipeline</strong>: Expose data transformation tools</li>\n<li><strong>System Administration</strong>: Provide system management capabilities</li>\n<li><strong>Custom Business Logic</strong>: Expose domain-specific operations</li>\n<li><strong>Integration Hub</strong>: Centralize access to external services</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>MCP Protocol Compliance</h2>\n<p>MCP servers must implement:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Tool Registration</strong>: Register available tools and their schemas</li>\n<li><strong>Tool Execution</strong>: Execute tools with proper parameter validation</li>\n<li><strong>Error Responses</strong>: Return standardized error information</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Management</strong>: Handle concurrent requests appropriately</li>\n<li><strong>Protocol Versioning</strong>: Support MCP protocol version negotiation</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "MCP Server Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/model",
      "html": "<h1>Model Component</h1>\n<p>The model component enables loading and running AI/ML models locally using HuggingFace transformers. It supports various tasks including text generation, chat completion, text embedding, classification, translation, summarization, image-to-text processing, and text-to-speech synthesis.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  action:\n    prompt: ${input.prompt}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 1024\n      temperature: 0.7\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>model</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Model task type: <code>text-generation</code>, <code>chat-completion</code>, <code>text-embedding</code>, <code>text-classification</code>, <code>translation</code>, <code>summarization</code>, <code>image-to-text</code>, <code>text-to-speech</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>huggingface</code></td>\n<td>Model provider (currently only HuggingFace supported)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code></td>\n<td>string/object</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Model identifier or configuration object</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cache_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Directory to cache model files</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>local_files_only</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Force loading from local files only</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>device_mode</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>auto</code></td>\n<td>Device allocation mode: <code>auto</code>, <code>single</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>device</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>cpu</code></td>\n<td>Computation device: <code>cpu</code>, <code>cuda</code>, <code>cuda:0</code>, etc.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>precision</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Numerical precision: <code>auto</code>, <code>float32</code>, <code>float16</code>, <code>bfloat16</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>low_cpu_mem_usage</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Load model with minimal CPU RAM usage</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fast_tokenizer</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Whether to use fast tokenizer if available</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Model Source Configuration</h3>\n<p>You can specify models as a string or detailed configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Simple string format\nmodel: microsoft/DialoGPT-medium\n\n# Detailed configuration\nmodel:\n  model_id: microsoft/DialoGPT-medium\n  provider: huggingface\n  revision: main\n  filename: pytorch_model.bin\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>HuggingFace model identifier</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>provider</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>huggingface</code></td>\n<td>Model provider</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>revision</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Model version or branch</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>filename</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Specific file in model repo</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Task Types and Examples</h2>\n<h3>Text Generation</h3>\n<p>Generate text from prompts using language models:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  action:\n    prompt: ${input.prompt}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 2048\n      temperature: 0.8\n      top_p: 0.9\n      top_k: 50\n      do_sample: true\n      num_return_sequences: 1\n    output:\n      generated_text: ${response.generated_text}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Text Generation Parameters:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Parameter</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_output_length</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1024</code></td>\n<td>Maximum tokens to generate</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>min_output_length</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>Minimum tokens to generate</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>temperature</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>1.0</code></td>\n<td>Sampling temperature (creativity)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>top_p</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>0.9</code></td>\n<td>Nucleus sampling threshold</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>top_k</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>50</code></td>\n<td>Top-K sampling limit</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>num_beams</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>Beam search width</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>do_sample</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Enable sampling vs greedy</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>stop_sequences</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Stop generation sequences</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>batch_size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>Batch processing size</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Chat Completion</h3>\n<p>Generate conversational responses using chat models:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: chat-completion\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  action:\n    messages:\n      - role: system\n        content: ${input.system_prompt}\n      - role: user\n        content: ${input.user_message}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 1024\n      temperature: 0.7\n      top_p: 0.9\n    output:\n      response: ${response.message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Message Format:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">messages:\n  - role: system\n    content: You are a helpful assistant.\n  - role: user \n    content: What is machine learning?\n  - role: assistant\n    content: Machine learning is...\n  - role: tool\n    call_id: call_123\n    name: search_web\n    content: Search results...\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Text Embedding</h3>\n<p>Generate vector embeddings for text:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-embedding\n  model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text}\n    output:\n      embedding: ${response.embedding}\n      dimensions: ${response.embedding | length}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Text Classification</h3>\n<p>Classify text into predefined categories:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-classification\n  model: cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest\n  labels: [ positive, negative, neutral ]\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text}\n    output:\n      predicted_label: ${response.label}\n      confidence: ${response.score}\n      all_scores: ${response.scores}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Translation</h3>\n<p>Translate text between languages:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: translation\n  model: Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-fr\n  source_language: en\n  target_language: fr\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text}\n    output:\n      translated_text: ${response.translation_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Summarization</h3>\n<p>Summarize long text into shorter versions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: summarization\n  model: facebook/bart-large-cnn\n  action:\n    text: ${input.article_text}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 150\n      min_output_length: 50\n    output:\n      summary: ${response.summary_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Image-to-Text</h3>\n<p>Generate text descriptions from images:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: image-to-text\n  model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-base\n  action:\n    image: ${input.image_url}\n    output:\n      caption: ${response.generated_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Text to Speech</h3>\n<p>Generate speech audio from text using TTS models. This task uses <code>driver: custom</code> with a <code>family</code> field to select the model family, and a <code>method</code> field to select the generation method.</p>\n<p><strong>Component Settings:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>text-to-speech</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>custom</code></td>\n<td>Model driver</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>family</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Model family (currently <code>qwen</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Model identifier</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Generation method: <code>generate</code>, <code>clone</code>, <code>design</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Common Action Fields:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>TTS generation method</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Text to synthesize into speech</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>language</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Language of the text using <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/language-codes\">standardized codes</a></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Method: <code>generate</code></h4>\n<p>Generate speech using a built-in voice with optional style instructions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-speech\n  driver: custom\n  family: qwen\n  model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice\n  device: cuda:0\n  max_concurrent_count: 1\n  action:\n    method: generate\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    voice: ${input.voice | vivian}\n    instructions: ${input.instructions | &quot;&quot;}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>voice</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>vivian</code></td>\n<td>Built-in voice name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>instructions</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>&quot;&quot;</code></td>\n<td>Emotion/style instructions for the voice</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Method: <code>clone</code></h4>\n<p>Clone a voice from reference audio and generate speech:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-speech\n  driver: custom\n  family: qwen\n  model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base\n  device: cuda:0\n  max_concurrent_count: 1\n  action:\n    method: clone\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    ref_audio: ${input.ref_audio as audio}\n    ref_text: ${input.ref_text as text}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>ref_audio</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Path or URL to the reference audio for voice cloning</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>ref_text</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Transcription text of the reference audio</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Method: <code>design</code></h4>\n<p>Design a new voice from a natural language description and generate speech:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-speech\n  driver: custom\n  family: qwen\n  model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign\n  device: cuda:0\n  max_concurrent_count: 1\n  action:\n    method: design\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    instructions: ${input.instructions as text}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>instructions</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Description of the desired voice</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Supported Models (Qwen Family)</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Method</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice</code></td>\n<td><code>generate</code></td>\n<td>Built-in voices with style control</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base</code></td>\n<td><code>clone</code></td>\n<td>Voice cloning from reference audio</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign</code></td>\n<td><code>design</code></td>\n<td>Voice design from text description</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions</h2>\n<p>Define multiple actions for different model operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  device: cuda\n  precision: float16\n  actions:\n    - id: generate-creative\n      prompt: ${input.creative_prompt}\n      params:\n        temperature: 1.2\n        top_p: 0.9\n        max_output_length: 2048\n      output:\n        creative_text: ${response.generated_text}\n    \n    - id: generate-factual\n      prompt: ${input.factual_prompt}\n      params:\n        temperature: 0.3\n        top_p: 0.8\n        max_output_length: 1024\n      output:\n        factual_text: ${response.generated_text}\n    \n    - id: generate-code\n      prompt: &quot;Generate Python code:\\n${input.code_prompt}&quot;\n      params:\n        temperature: 0.1\n        stop_sequences: [ &quot;```&quot;, &quot;\\n\\n\\n&quot; ]\n        max_output_length: 1024\n      output:\n        generated_code: ${response.generated_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Device and Performance Configuration</h2>\n<h3>GPU Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: microsoft/DialoGPT-large\n  device: cuda:0\n  precision: float16\n  low_cpu_mem_usage: true\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multi-GPU Setup</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: microsoft/DialoGPT-xlarge\n  device_mode: auto\n  precision: bfloat16\n</code></pre>\n<h3>CPU Optimization</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-embedding\n  model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n  device: cpu\n  precision: float32\n  fast_tokenizer: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Caching and Storage</h2>\n<h3>Model Caching</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  cache_dir: ./models_cache\n  local_files_only: false\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Offline Usage</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: ./local_models/my-model\n  local_files_only: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Advanced Configuration Examples</h2>\n<h3>Streaming Text Generation</h3>\n<p>The <code>streaming</code> action field is only available on tasks that produce time-series output one chunk at a time: <code>text-generation</code>, <code>chat-completion</code>, and <code>image-to-text</code>. Other tasks (such as <code>text-embedding</code>, <code>text-classification</code>, <code>translation</code>, <code>summarization</code>, <code>text-to-speech</code>) return their result atomically and do not accept a <code>streaming</code> field. Streaming also requires <code>batch_size: 1</code> with a single input.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  action:\n    text: ${input.prompt}\n    streaming: true\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 4096\n      temperature: 0.8\n      do_sample: true\n    output: ${result[]}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Batch Processing</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-embedding\n  model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text_list}  # Array of texts\n    params:\n      batch_size: 32\n    output:\n      embeddings: ${response.embeddings}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Custom Stop Sequences</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: codegen-350M\n  action:\n    prompt: &quot;def ${input.function_name}(${input.parameters}):\\n&quot;\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 512\n      temperature: 0.2\n      stop_sequences: [ &quot;\\ndef &quot;, &quot;\\nclass &quot;, &quot;\\n\\n&quot; ]\n    output:\n      generated_function: ${response.generated_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>Model components handle various error conditions:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Model Loading Errors</strong>: Invalid model IDs or network issues</li>\n<li><strong>GPU Memory Errors</strong>: Insufficient VRAM for model size</li>\n<li><strong>Input Validation</strong>: Invalid prompts or parameters</li>\n<li><strong>Generation Errors</strong>: Model inference failures</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Use workflow error handling to manage these cases:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: generate-text\n      component: text-model\n      input:\n        prompt: ${input.prompt}\n      on_error:\n        - id: fallback-generation\n          component: smaller-model\n          input:\n            prompt: ${input.prompt}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Models support dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: ${env.MODEL_NAME | HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B}\n  action:\n    prompt: ${input.prompt}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: ${input.max_length as integer | 1024}\n      temperature: ${input.creativity as float | 0.7}\n      device: ${env.COMPUTE_DEVICE | cpu}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Model Selection</strong>: Choose appropriate model sizes for your hardware</li>\n<li><strong>Device Management</strong>: Use GPU when available, fall back to CPU</li>\n<li><strong>Memory Management</strong>: Enable <code>low_cpu_mem_usage</code> for large models</li>\n<li><strong>Caching</strong>: Set <code>cache_dir</code> to persist downloaded models</li>\n<li><strong>Precision</strong>: Use lower precision (float16/bfloat16) to save memory</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Processing</strong>: Process multiple inputs together when possible</li>\n<li><strong>Stop Sequences</strong>: Use stop sequences to control generation length</li>\n<li><strong>Temperature Tuning</strong>: Lower temperature for factual, higher for creative tasks</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference model components in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: embedding-generation\n      component: embedding-model\n      input:\n        text: ${input.document}\n      output:\n        document_embedding: ${output.embedding}\n        \n    - id: similarity-search\n      component: vector-store\n      input:\n        query_embedding: ${embedding-generation.output.document_embedding}\n        \n    - id: response-generation\n      component: chat-model\n      input:\n        context: ${similarity-search.output.matches}\n        question: ${input.question}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Supported Models</h2>\n<h3>Text Generation Models</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>GPT Models</strong>: GPT-2, GPT-Neo, GPT-J</li>\n<li><strong>LLaMA Models</strong>: LLaMA, Alpaca, Vicuna</li>\n<li><strong>Code Models</strong>: CodeGen, CodeT5, InCoder</li>\n<li><strong>Instruction Models</strong>: Flan-T5, UL2</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Chat Models</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Conversational</strong>: DialoGPT, BlenderBot</li>\n<li><strong>Instruction Following</strong>: ChatGLM, Alpaca</li>\n<li><strong>Code Chat</strong>: CodeLlama-Instruct</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Embedding Models</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Sentence Transformers</strong>: all-MiniLM, all-mpnet-base</li>\n<li><strong>Specialized</strong>: E5, BGE, Instructor</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Classification Models</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Sentiment</strong>: RoBERTa-sentiment, DistilBERT</li>\n<li><strong>Topic</strong>: BERT-base-classification</li>\n<li><strong>Intent</strong>: Custom fine-tuned models</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Multimodal Models</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Image Captioning</strong>: BLIP, ViT-GPT2</li>\n<li><strong>Visual QA</strong>: BLIP-VQA, ViLT</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Text-to-Speech Models</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Qwen3-TTS</strong>: Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B (CustomVoice, Base, VoiceDesign)</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Text Generation</strong>: Create articles, stories, code</li>\n<li><strong>Chatbots</strong>: Build conversational AI systems</li>\n<li><strong>Content Analysis</strong>: Classify and analyze text</li>\n<li><strong>Search</strong>: Generate embeddings for semantic search</li>\n<li><strong>Translation</strong>: Translate between languages</li>\n<li><strong>Summarization</strong>: Create summaries of long documents</li>\n<li><strong>Code Generation</strong>: Generate and complete code snippets</li>\n<li><strong>Image Understanding</strong>: Describe and analyze images</li>\n<li><strong>Text-to-Speech</strong>: Synthesize speech from text with voice generation, cloning, and design</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Model Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/model-memory",
      "html": "<h1>Model Memory Component</h1>\n<p>The model-memory component provides session-based conversation history management for AI models. It declaratively handles storing, loading, summarizing, and windowing of chat messages, enabling stateful multi-turn conversations without custom code.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-memory\n  storage:\n    driver: sqlite\n    path: ./memory.db\n  window: 20\n  actions:\n    - id: load\n      method: load\n    - id: save\n      method: save\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>model-memory</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>buffer</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{driver: memory}</code></td>\n<td>In-memory buffer settings. Temporarily holds appended data before save</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>storage</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{driver: sqlite}</code></td>\n<td>Persistent storage settings. Target for save/load/delete</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>window</code></td>\n<td>int | object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Window settings. If int, inflates to <code>{max_turn_count: N}</code>. If omitted, returns all messages</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>summary</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Summary settings. If omitted, no summarization is performed</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Buffer Settings</h3>\n<p>The buffer temporarily holds unsaved messages added via <code>append</code>. Messages exist only here until <code>save</code> is called.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>memory</code></td>\n<td>Buffer driver: <code>memory</code> (process memory)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Constraint</strong>: Within the same workflow execution, <code>append</code> → <code>save</code> must run in the same process. The buffer is process-local and not shared across processes.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h3>Storage Settings</h3>\n<p>Persistent storage. On <code>save</code>, buffered turns are persisted here. <code>load</code> and <code>delete</code> also target this storage.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>sqlite</code></td>\n<td>Storage driver: <code>sqlite</code> (default), <code>redis</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>SQLite Storage (Default)</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>.model-memory.db</code></td>\n<td>SQLite database file path</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-memory\n  storage:\n    driver: sqlite\n    path: ./memory.db\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Redis Storage</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>host</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>localhost</code></td>\n<td>Redis host</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>int</td>\n<td><code>6379</code></td>\n<td>Redis port</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Redis URL (use instead of host/port)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>password</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Redis password</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>int</td>\n<td><code>0</code></td>\n<td>Redis database number</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>secure</code></td>\n<td>bool</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Whether to use TLS</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-memory\n  storage:\n    driver: redis\n    host: redis-server\n    port: 6379\n    password: ${env.REDIS_PASSWORD}\n    database: 1\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Window Settings</h3>\n<p>Controls how many recent messages are retained. Can be specified as an integer (shorthand for <code>max_turn_count</code>) or as an object.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_turn_count</code></td>\n<td>int</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Keep only the most recent N turns</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_message_count</code></td>\n<td>int</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Keep only the most recent N messages (respects turn boundaries)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>When both fields are set, the <strong>first exceeded condition</strong> takes effect.</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>max_turn_count</code>: Limits by turn count. Simply <code>turns[-N:]</code>.</li>\n<li><code>max_message_count</code>: Limits by message count, but never splits a turn. Accumulates from the newest turn backwards until the limit would be exceeded.</li>\n</ul>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Shorthand (most recent 10 turns)\nwindow: 10\n\n# Object form\nwindow:\n  max_turn_count: 10\n\n# Message count based\nwindow:\n  max_message_count: 20\n\n# Combined (whichever limit is exceeded first)\nwindow:\n  max_turn_count: 10\n  max_message_count: 40\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Summary Settings</h3>\n<p>The <code>summary</code> block follows the same component invoke pattern as <code>AgentModelConfig</code>.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>component</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Component ID to use for summarization</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>action</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>Action ID of the component</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>input</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>None</code></td>\n<td>Input mapping when invoking the component. If omitted, a complete <code>messages</code> array is auto-assembled from <code>instruction</code>, <code>previous_summary</code>, and the turns being summarized</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>instruction</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>&quot;Summarize the following conversation concisely:&quot;</code></td>\n<td>Summarization instruction</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>How Summary Works</h4>\n<p>Summary is <strong>updated incrementally at append time</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>When <code>append</code> is called, if turns exceed the window, excess turns are pruned in-memory</li>\n<li>Pruned turns + existing summary are sent to the LLM to generate a new summary (in-memory)</li>\n<li>When <code>save</code> is called, the current in-memory state (turns + summary) is persisted to storage</li>\n<li><code>load</code> is read-only — even if unsummarized turns exist in storage, they are not modified (auto-summarized on next <code>append</code>)</li>\n</ol>\n<h4>Summary Input Modes</h4>\n<p><strong>Default (no <code>input</code> specified)</strong> — model-memory assembles <code>{ &quot;messages&quot;: [...] }</code> and passes it directly. The messages array contains: <code>instruction</code> (as a system message), <code>previous_summary</code> (as a system message), and the original conversation turns with their roles preserved.</p>\n<p><strong>Custom <code>input</code> mapping</strong> — when you specify <code>input</code>, you take full control of the request shape. The following raw variables are exposed for use in your mapping:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Variable</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>${messages}</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Raw conversation turns being summarized (no instruction or previous_summary mixed in)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>${instruction}</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>The configured summarization instruction</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>${previous_summary}</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Existing summary text (for incremental updates)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Behavior Matrix</h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>window</th>\n<th>summary</th>\n<th>Behavior</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>not set</td>\n<td>not set</td>\n<td>Returns all raw messages</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>set</td>\n<td>not set</td>\n<td>Returns only messages within window range; excess is permanently deleted</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>not set</td>\n<td>set</td>\n<td>Summarizes everything; returns <code>messages: []</code>. <strong>Note</strong>: summarization runs on every <code>append</code>, so this mode invokes the summary LLM on every turn — high cost/latency. Pair with <code>window</code> to summarize only when turns overflow.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>set</td>\n<td>set</td>\n<td>Returns recent messages within window + summary of the rest</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Message Storage Model</h3>\n<ul>\n<li>Messages are treated as <strong>opaque objects</strong>. Fields like role, content, etc. are not validated.</li>\n<li>Storage unit is individual message objects.</li>\n<li>1 turn = the messages bundle passed in a single <code>append</code> or <code>save</code> call.</li>\n<li>Window <strong>respects turn boundaries</strong> (never splits in the middle of a turn).</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Actions</h2>\n<h3>append</h3>\n<p>Adds 1 turn (message bundle) to the buffer. Does not persist to storage. Performs in-memory prune + summarize if window is exceeded.</p>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Precondition</strong>: <code>load</code> must have been called first with the same <code>session_id</code>.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Input:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Session identifier</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>messages</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Array of messages for 1 turn (opaque objects)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>save</h3>\n<p>Persists the buffer's current state (turns + summary) to storage. If <code>messages</code> is provided, performs an implicit append (with prune + summarize) before persisting.</p>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Precondition</strong>: <code>load</code> must have been called first with the same <code>session_id</code>. Calling <code>save</code> on an unloaded session raises an error.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Input:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Session identifier</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>messages</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>no</td>\n<td>Array of messages for 1 turn — if provided, appends then persists</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>load</h3>\n<p>Reads the session's memory from storage and returns it (read-only, no storage modification). Return format varies based on window/summary settings. Data read from storage is cached in the buffer's session cache, so subsequent <code>save</code> operations work without re-querying storage.</p>\n<p><strong>Input:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Session identifier</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;summary&quot;: &quot;The user asked about the weather...&quot;,\n  &quot;messages&quot;: [\n    {&quot;role&quot;: &quot;user&quot;, &quot;content&quot;: &quot;What should I have for lunch?&quot;},\n    {&quot;role&quot;: &quot;assistant&quot;, &quot;content&quot;: &quot;How about pasta?&quot;}\n  ]\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>summary</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Summary text. Empty string if summary is not configured</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>messages</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>Raw messages within window range. All messages if neither window nor summary is set. Empty array if only summary is configured</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>clear</h3>\n<p>Rolls back to the state at the last persist point. Restores to the snapshot from right after <code>load</code> or <code>save</code>, canceling all subsequent append/prune/summarize operations. Does not affect persisted data in storage.</p>\n<p><strong>Input:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Session identifier</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>delete</h3>\n<p>Deletes the session's entire history from storage, including summary.</p>\n<p><strong>Input:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Session identifier</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Chat with Memory (Shortcut Mode)</h3>\n<p>The most common pattern: load → generate → save(messages).</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: gpt-4o\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages: ${input.messages}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n\n  - id: chat-memory\n    type: model-memory\n    storage:\n      driver: sqlite\n      path: ./memory.db\n    window: 20\n    summary:\n      component: gpt-4o\n      input:\n        messages: ${messages}\n      instruction: &quot;Summarize the following conversation concisely:&quot;\n    actions:\n      - id: load\n        method: load\n      - id: save\n        method: save\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: chat-turn\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: load\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n\n      - id: generate\n        component: gpt-4o\n        input:\n          messages:\n            - role: system\n              content: ${input.system_prompt}\n            - role: system\n              content: ${jobs.load-memory.output.summary}\n            - ...${jobs.load-memory.output.messages}\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.user_message}\n        depends_on: [load-memory]\n\n      - id: save-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: save\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n          messages:\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.user_message}\n            - role: assistant\n              content: ${jobs.generate.output}\n        depends_on: [generate]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Flexible Mode (Separate Append Steps)</h3>\n<p>For fine-grained control: load → append(user) → generate → append(assistant) → save.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: chat-turn-flexible\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: load\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n\n      - id: append-user\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: append\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n          messages:\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.user_message}\n        depends_on: [load-memory]\n\n      - id: generate\n        component: gpt-4o\n        input:\n          messages:\n            - role: system\n              content: ${input.system_prompt}\n            - role: system\n              content: ${jobs.load-memory.output.summary}\n            - ...${jobs.load-memory.output.messages}\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.user_message}\n        depends_on: [load-memory]\n\n      - id: append-ai\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: append\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n          messages:\n            - role: assistant\n              content: ${jobs.generate.output}\n        depends_on: [generate, append-user]\n\n      - id: save-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: save\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n        depends_on: [append-ai]\n</code></pre>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Note (flexible mode)</strong>: Since <code>append-user</code> and <code>append-ai</code> create separate turns, a small window may prune the user turn while keeping only the assistant turn. To guarantee &quot;1 conversation turn = user + assistant bundle&quot;, use the shortcut mode with <code>save(messages: [user, assistant])</code>, or set a sufficiently large window in flexible mode.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h3>Redis Storage for Production</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-memory\n  storage:\n    driver: redis\n    url: ${env.REDIS_URL}\n    password: ${env.REDIS_PASSWORD}\n  window:\n    max_turn_count: 50\n    max_message_count: 200\n  summary:\n    component: gpt-4o\n    instruction: &quot;Provide a brief summary of this conversation:&quot;\n  actions:\n    - id: load\n      method: load\n    - id: save\n      method: save\n    - id: delete\n      method: delete\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Memory with All Actions</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-memory\n  storage:\n    driver: sqlite\n    path: ./chat.db\n  window: 30\n  actions:\n    - id: append\n      method: append\n    - id: save\n      method: save\n    - id: load\n      method: load\n    - id: clear\n      method: clear\n    - id: delete\n      method: delete\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Choose the right mode</strong>: Use shortcut mode (<code>save</code> with messages) for simple chatbots; use flexible mode (separate <code>append</code> steps) when you need fine-grained control</li>\n<li><strong>Set appropriate windows</strong>: Balance between context quality and token costs. 20-50 turns is typical for most chatbots</li>\n<li><strong>Enable summarization</strong>: For long conversations, combine <code>window</code> + <code>summary</code> to retain context without losing important information</li>\n<li><strong>Use Redis in production</strong>: SQLite works well for development and single-instance deployments; switch to Redis for multi-instance or distributed setups</li>\n<li><strong>Session management</strong>: Use meaningful session IDs (e.g., user ID + conversation ID) to support multiple concurrent conversations</li>\n<li><strong>Clean up sessions</strong>: Use the <code>delete</code> action to remove completed or abandoned conversation histories</li>\n</ol>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Model Memory Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/model-tokenizer",
      "html": "<h1>Model Tokenizer Component</h1>\n<p>The model-tokenizer component provides standalone tokenization capabilities for text processing. It loads a tokenizer model once at the component level and reuses it across actions, supporting encode, decode, and token counting operations.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model: gpt2\n  action:\n    method: encode\n    text: ${input.text}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>model-tokenizer</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Tokenizer task type: <code>text</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>huggingface</code></td>\n<td>Tokenizer driver</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code></td>\n<td>string/object</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Model identifier or configuration object</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>use_fast</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Whether to use the fast tokenizer if available</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Model Source Configuration</h3>\n<p>You can specify models as a string or detailed configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Simple string format\nmodel: gpt2\n\n# HuggingFace model with options\nmodel:\n  provider: huggingface\n  repository: bert-base-uncased\n  revision: main\n  token: ${env.HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN}\n\n# Local model\nmodel: /path/to/tokenizer\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>provider</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>huggingface</code></td>\n<td>Model provider: <code>huggingface</code>, <code>local</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>repository</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>HuggingFace model repository (when provider is <code>huggingface</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>path</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Local model path (when provider is <code>local</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>revision</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Model version or branch</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cache_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Directory to cache model files</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>local_files_only</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Force loading from local files only</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>token</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>HuggingFace access token for private models</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Methods</h2>\n<h3>Encode</h3>\n<p>Tokenize text into token IDs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model: gpt2\n  action:\n    method: encode\n    text: ${input.text}\n    max_length: 512\n    padding: true\n    truncation: true\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>encode</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Input text to tokenize</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_length</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Maximum token length</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>padding</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Whether to pad to max_length</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>truncation</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Whether to truncate to max_length</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;input_ids&quot;: [15496, 995],\n  &quot;attention_mask&quot;: [1, 1]\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Decode</h3>\n<p>Convert token IDs back to text:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model: gpt2\n  action:\n    method: decode\n    token_ids: ${input.token_ids}\n    skip_special_tokens: true\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>decode</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>token_ids</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Token IDs to decode</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>skip_special_tokens</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Whether to skip special tokens in output</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello world&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Count</h3>\n<p>Count the number of tokens in text:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model: gpt2\n  action:\n    method: count\n    text: ${input.text}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>count</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Input text to count tokens for</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Output:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;count&quot;: 5\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Multiple Actions</h2>\n<p>Define multiple actions for different tokenization operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model: gpt2\n  actions:\n    - id: encode\n      method: encode\n      text: ${input.text}\n      max_length: 512\n      truncation: true\n\n    - id: count\n      method: count\n      text: ${input.text}\n\n    - id: decode\n      method: decode\n      token_ids: ${input.token_ids}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Token Counting for Input Validation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: token-counter\n    type: model-tokenizer\n    task: text\n    model: gpt2\n    action:\n      method: count\n      text: ${input.text}\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: validate-input\n    jobs:\n      - id: count-tokens\n        component: token-counter\n        input:\n          text: ${input.prompt}\n        output:\n          token_count: ${output.count}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Preprocessing for Model Input</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: tokenizer\n    type: model-tokenizer\n    task: text\n    model: bert-base-uncased\n    action:\n      method: encode\n      text: ${input.text}\n      max_length: 512\n      padding: true\n      truncation: true\n\n  - id: classifier\n    type: model\n    task: text-classification\n    model: bert-base-uncased\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Private Model with Authentication</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n    token: ${env.HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN}\n  action:\n    method: count\n    text: ${input.text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Offline Usage</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: gpt2\n    cache_dir: /data/tokenizer-cache\n    local_files_only: true\n  action:\n    method: encode\n    text: ${input.text}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Tokenizer components support dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-tokenizer\n  task: text\n  model: ${env.TOKENIZER_MODEL | gpt2}\n  action:\n    method: encode\n    text: ${input.text}\n    max_length: ${input.max_length as integer | 512}\n    truncation: ${input.truncation as boolean | true}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Reuse tokenizers</strong>: The tokenizer is loaded once per component and reused across all action invocations</li>\n<li><strong>Match tokenizer to model</strong>: Use the same tokenizer model as your inference model for consistent results</li>\n<li><strong>Use fast tokenizers</strong>: Keep <code>use_fast: true</code> (default) for better performance</li>\n<li><strong>Token counting</strong>: Use the <code>count</code> method to validate input lengths before sending to models</li>\n<li><strong>Caching</strong>: Set <code>cache_dir</code> to persist downloaded tokenizer files</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Input validation</strong>: Count tokens before sending to LLM APIs with token limits</li>\n<li><strong>Text preprocessing</strong>: Encode text for custom model pipelines</li>\n<li><strong>Token analysis</strong>: Analyze tokenization behavior across different models</li>\n<li><strong>Batch preparation</strong>: Encode and pad texts for batch processing</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Model Tokenizer Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/model-trainer",
      "html": "<h1>Model Trainer Component</h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Development Status</strong>: The configuration schema is defined and stable, but the training execution backend is still under active development. Schema fields below reflect the current declarative interface; expect runtime support to land in upcoming releases.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p>The model-trainer component declares supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and classification training jobs. It supports LoRA adapters, quantization, optimizer and scheduler selection, mixed-precision training, and gradient checkpointing — all configured declaratively so the same workflow can target different hardware profiles by swapping a few fields.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  action:\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    text_column: text\n    learning_rate: 5e-5\n    num_epochs: 3\n    output_dir: ./output/model\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>model-trainer</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Training task: <code>sft</code>, <code>classification</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lora</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>LoRA adapter configuration</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>quantization</code></td>\n<td>string/object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Model quantization configuration</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>LoRA Configuration</h3>\n<p>LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) trains a small set of adapter parameters instead of the full model, dramatically reducing memory and time requirements.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  lora:\n    rank: 8\n    alpha: 16\n    dropout: 0.05\n    target_modules: [&quot;q_proj&quot;, &quot;v_proj&quot;]\n    bias: none\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>rank</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>8</code></td>\n<td>LoRA rank</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>alpha</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>16</code></td>\n<td>LoRA alpha for scaling</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>dropout</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>0.05</code></td>\n<td>LoRA dropout rate</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>target_modules</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target modules for LoRA. Auto-detected when omitted</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>bias</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>none</code></td>\n<td>Bias training strategy: <code>none</code>, <code>all</code>, <code>lora_only</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Quantization Configuration</h3>\n<p>Reduce memory footprint by loading the base model in lower precision. Provide a string shorthand or a full config object.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Shorthand\ncomponent:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  quantization: 4bit\n\n# Full object — same shape as the model component's quantization config\ncomponent:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  quantization:\n    type: 4bit\n    # provider-specific fields\n</code></pre>\n<p>See <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model\">model.md</a> for the full quantization schema.</p>\n<h2>Training Tasks</h2>\n<h3>SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)</h3>\n<p>Fine-tune a causal language model on instruction or chat data. The action requires either a <code>text_column</code> (pre-formatted text) or both <code>prompt_column</code> and <code>response_column</code> (chat-style data).</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  lora:\n    rank: 8\n    alpha: 16\n  action:\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    text_column: text\n    max_seq_length: 1024\n    packing: true\n    learning_rate: 2e-4\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 4\n    gradient_accumulation_steps: 4\n    num_epochs: 3\n    output_dir: ./output/sft-model\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>dataset</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Training dataset reference</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>eval_dataset</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Evaluation dataset reference</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text_column</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Column containing pre-formatted training text</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>prompt_column</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Column containing chat prompts</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>response_column</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Column containing chat responses</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>system_column</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Column containing chat system prompts</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_seq_length</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>512</code></td>\n<td>Maximum sequence length for training</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>packing</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Pack multiple short examples into one sequence for efficiency</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p>Either <code>text_column</code> or both <code>prompt_column</code> and <code>response_column</code> must be specified.</p>\n<h3>Classification</h3>\n<p>Fine-tune a model for classification. The classification action shares all common training fields (no task-specific extras beyond the shared base).</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: classification\n  action:\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    eval_dataset: ${input.eval_dataset}\n    learning_rate: 3e-5\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 16\n    num_epochs: 5\n    output_dir: ./output/classifier\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Training Parameters</h2>\n<p>All training actions accept these shared parameters from <code>CommonModelTrainerActionConfig</code>:</p>\n<h3>Essential</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>learning_rate</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>5e-5</code></td>\n<td>Learning rate for training</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>per_device_train_batch_size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>8</code></td>\n<td>Training batch size per device</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>per_device_eval_batch_size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Evaluation batch size per device. Falls back to train batch size</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>num_epochs</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>3</code></td>\n<td>Number of training epochs</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Optimizer and Scheduler</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>optimizer</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>adamw_torch</code></td>\n<td>Optimizer (see list below)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lr_scheduler_type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>linear</code></td>\n<td>Learning rate scheduler type</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Optimizer options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>AdamW variants: <code>adamw_torch</code>, <code>adamw_torch_fused</code>, <code>adamw_torch_xla</code>, <code>adamw_torch_npu_fused</code>, <code>adamw_apex_fused</code>, <code>adamw_anyprecision</code>, <code>adamw_bnb_8bit</code>, <code>adamw_8bit</code> (alias for <code>adamw_bnb_8bit</code>), <code>adamw_hf</code></li>\n<li>Specialized: <code>adafactor</code>, <code>adalomo</code>, <code>lomo</code></li>\n<li>Memory-efficient: <code>apollo_adamw</code>, <code>galore_adamw</code>, <code>galore_adamw_8bit</code>, <code>galore_adafactor</code>, <code>galore_adamw_layerwise</code>, <code>galore_adamw_8bit_layerwise</code>, <code>galore_adafactor_layerwise</code></li>\n<li>Advanced: <code>grokadamw</code>, <code>schedule_free_radamw</code>, <code>stableadamw</code></li>\n<li>Traditional: <code>sgd</code>, <code>adagrad</code>, <code>rmsprop</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>LR scheduler options:</strong> <code>linear</code>, <code>cosine</code>, <code>cosine_with_restarts</code>, <code>polynomial</code>, <code>constant</code>, <code>constant_with_warmup</code>, <code>inverse_sqrt</code>, <code>reduce_lr_on_plateau</code>, <code>cosine_with_min_lr</code>, <code>warmup_stable_decay</code></p>\n<h3>Output and Logging</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>./output</code></td>\n<td>Directory to save the trained model</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>eval_steps</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>500</code></td>\n<td>Steps between evaluations</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>save_steps</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Steps between model saves. Falls back to <code>eval_steps</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>logging_steps</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>10</code></td>\n<td>Steps between logging</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Optimization</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>weight_decay</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>0.01</code></td>\n<td>Weight decay for regularization</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>warmup_steps</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>100</code></td>\n<td>Number of warmup steps</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_grad_norm</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>1.0</code></td>\n<td>Maximum gradient norm for gradient clipping</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gradient_accumulation_steps</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>Number of gradient accumulation steps</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Memory and Precision</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gradient_checkpointing</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Enable gradient checkpointing to save memory</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fp16</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Enable FP16 mixed precision training</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>bf16</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Enable BF16 mixed precision training (recommended for A100/H100)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Reproducibility</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>seed</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Random seed for reproducibility</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>LoRA Fine-Tuning on a Single GPU</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    lora:\n      rank: 8\n      alpha: 16\n      dropout: 0.05\n    quantization: 4bit\n    action:\n      dataset: ${input.dataset}\n      text_column: text\n      max_seq_length: 1024\n      packing: true\n      learning_rate: 2e-4\n      per_device_train_batch_size: 4\n      gradient_accumulation_steps: 4\n      num_epochs: 3\n      warmup_steps: 100\n      logging_steps: 10\n      eval_steps: 500\n      bf16: true\n      gradient_checkpointing: true\n      output_dir: ./output/lora-model\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Chat-Style Training Data</h3>\n<p>When training data is split into separate prompt and response columns:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  action:\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    prompt_column: instruction\n    response_column: output\n    system_column: system\n    max_seq_length: 2048\n    learning_rate: 5e-5\n    num_epochs: 3\n    output_dir: ./output/chat-model\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Full Pipeline: Dataset + Trainer</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset\n    type: datasets\n    actions:\n      - id: load\n        method: load\n        provider: huggingface\n        path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n        split: train\n\n      - id: format\n        method: map\n        dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n        template: &quot;### Instruction:\\n{instruction}\\n\\n### Response:\\n{output}&quot;\n        output_column: text\n        remove_columns: [&quot;instruction&quot;, &quot;input&quot;, &quot;output&quot;]\n\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    lora:\n      rank: 8\n      alpha: 16\n    action:\n      dataset: ${input.dataset}\n      text_column: text\n      learning_rate: 2e-4\n      num_epochs: 3\n      output_dir: ./output/finetuned\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: train\n    jobs:\n      - id: load\n        component: dataset\n        action: load\n\n      - id: format\n
