component: dataset\n        action: format\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n        depends_on: [load]\n\n      - id: train\n        component: trainer\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.format.output}\n        depends_on: [format]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Classification</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: classification\n  action:\n    dataset: ${input.train_dataset}\n    eval_dataset: ${input.eval_dataset}\n    learning_rate: 3e-5\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 16\n    per_device_eval_batch_size: 32\n    num_epochs: 5\n    eval_steps: 200\n    save_steps: 500\n    output_dir: ./output/classifier\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model-trainer\n  task: sft\n  lora:\n    rank: ${env.LORA_RANK as integer | 8}\n    alpha: ${env.LORA_ALPHA as integer | 16}\n  action:\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    text_column: ${input.text_column | text}\n    learning_rate: ${input.learning_rate as number | 5e-5}\n    num_epochs: ${input.num_epochs as integer | 3}\n    output_dir: ${env.OUTPUT_DIR | ./output}\n    bf16: ${input.bf16 as boolean | true}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Start with LoRA</strong>: Use LoRA before attempting full fine-tuning — it is faster, cheaper, and easier to recover from</li>\n<li><strong>Match precision to hardware</strong>: Use <code>bf16</code> on A100/H100; <code>fp16</code> on older GPUs; neither on CPUs</li>\n<li><strong>Pair quantization with LoRA</strong>: <code>quantization: 4bit</code> plus LoRA enables fine-tuning on consumer GPUs</li>\n<li><strong>Tune <code>gradient_accumulation_steps</code></strong>: When VRAM forces a small <code>per_device_train_batch_size</code>, increase accumulation to keep the effective batch size large</li>\n<li><strong>Pack short examples</strong>: Set <code>packing: true</code> for SFT when most examples are short — significant throughput win</li>\n<li><strong>Pin <code>seed</code></strong>: Set a seed for reproducible experiments</li>\n<li><strong>Pre-format with <code>datasets</code></strong>: Use the <a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/datasets\">datasets.md</a> component's <code>map</code> method to produce a clean <code>text_column</code></li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Instruction tuning</strong>: Fine-tune a base model on instruction-following data with LoRA + 4-bit quantization</li>\n<li><strong>Domain adaptation</strong>: Continue training on domain-specific text to specialize a general model</li>\n<li><strong>Classification</strong>: Fine-tune encoder models for sentiment, intent, or topic classification</li>\n<li><strong>Style transfer</strong>: Train on writing samples to capture a tone or persona</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Related Components</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/datasets\">datasets.md</a> — Prepare and format training data</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model\">model.md</a> — Inference for the resulting fine-tuned model</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/reference/compose/components/model-tokenizer\">model-tokenizer.md</a> — Standalone tokenization for input validation</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Model Trainer Component"
      }
    },

      "slug": "reference/compose/components/search-engine",
      "html": "<h1>Search Engine Component</h1>\n<p>The search-engine component provides full-text search over arbitrary document collections. It supports document indexing, BM25-ranked keyword search, and deletion through a declarative configuration. Multiple named indexes can be hosted on a single backend.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  storage_dir: ./data\n  database: search.db\n  actions:\n    - id: index\n      method: index\n      index: docs\n      fields:\n        - name: document_id\n          type: id\n        - name: title\n          type: text\n        - name: content\n          type: text\n      documents: ${input.documents}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>search-engine</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Search engine backend driver: <code>sqlite</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>storage_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>./sqlite-search</code></td>\n<td>Directory where the backing database file is stored (sqlite driver)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>search.db</code></td>\n<td>Database file name. Multiple indexes are stored as virtual tables in the same database (sqlite driver)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>SQLite Driver</h3>\n<p>The <code>sqlite</code> driver uses SQLite FTS5 for BM25-ranked full-text search. The index is stored as a virtual table in a single SQLite file and is created automatically on the first <code>index</code> action.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  storage_dir: ./data\n  database: search.db\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Methods</h2>\n<h3>Index</h3>\n<p>Insert documents into a search index. Fields are declared on the first call and reused for subsequent appends.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  action:\n    method: index\n    index: docs\n    fields:\n      - name: document_id\n        type: id\n      - name: title\n        type: text\n      - name: content\n        type: text\n    documents: ${input.documents}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>index</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>index</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Target index name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>fields</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Index schema field definitions. Optional when appending to an existing index</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>documents</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>List of documents (objects) to index</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Field Types:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>Tokenized for full-text search</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>id</code></td>\n<td>Exact-match identifier (used by <code>delete</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>keyword</code></td>\n<td>Tag-like value matched as a single token</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Example documents:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">[\n  {&quot;document_id&quot;: &quot;1&quot;, &quot;title&quot;: &quot;Python tutorial&quot;, &quot;content&quot;: &quot;Learn Python basics&quot;},\n  {&quot;document_id&quot;: &quot;2&quot;, &quot;title&quot;: &quot;JavaScript guide&quot;, &quot;content&quot;: &quot;Modern JavaScript features&quot;}\n]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Search</h3>\n<p>Run a BM25-ranked keyword search over an index.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  action:\n    method: search\n    index: docs\n    query: ${input.query}\n    search_fields: ${input.search_fields}\n    limit: 10\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>search</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>index</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Target index name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>query</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Search query string</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>search_fields</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Fields to search in. When omitted, all <code>text</code> fields are searched</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>limit</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>10</code></td>\n<td>Maximum number of search results to return</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Delete</h3>\n<p>Remove documents from an index by their id-field values.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  action:\n    method: delete\n    index: docs\n    document_ids: ${input.document_ids}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>delete</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>index</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Target index name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>document_ids</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>List of document ID values to delete</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions</h2>\n<p>Combine index, search, and delete in a single component:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  storage_dir: ./data\n  database: search.db\n  actions:\n    - id: index\n      method: index\n      index: docs\n      fields:\n        - name: document_id\n          type: id\n        - name: title\n          type: text\n        - name: content\n          type: text\n      documents: ${input.documents}\n\n    - id: search\n      method: search\n      index: docs\n      query: ${input.query}\n      search_fields: ${input.search_fields}\n      limit: ${input.limit}\n\n    - id: delete\n      method: delete\n      index: docs\n      document_ids: ${input.document_ids}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Document Search Workflow</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: search\n    type: search-engine\n    driver: sqlite\n    storage_dir: ./data\n    database: search.db\n    actions:\n      - id: index\n        method: index\n        index: docs\n        fields:\n          - name: document_id\n            type: id\n          - name: title\n            type: text\n          - name: content\n            type: text\n        documents: ${input.documents}\n\n      - id: search\n        method: search\n        index: docs\n        query: ${input.query}\n        limit: ${input.limit | 10}\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: index-documents\n    job:\n      component: search\n      action: index\n      input: ${input}\n\n  - id: search-documents\n    job:\n      component: search\n      action: search\n      input: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple Indexes in One Backend</h3>\n<p>A single component can host multiple indexes by varying the <code>index</code> name in each action:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  storage_dir: ./data\n  database: search.db\n  actions:\n    - id: index-articles\n      method: index\n      index: articles\n      fields:\n        - name: article_id\n          type: id\n        - name: body\n          type: text\n      documents: ${input.articles}\n\n    - id: index-products\n      method: index\n      index: products\n      fields:\n        - name: sku\n          type: id\n        - name: name\n          type: text\n        - name: category\n          type: keyword\n      documents: ${input.products}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: search-engine\n  driver: sqlite\n  storage_dir: ${env.SEARCH_DATA_DIR | ./data}\n  action:\n    method: search\n    index: docs\n    query: ${input.query}\n    limit: ${input.limit as integer | 10}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Declare fields once</strong>: Provide <code>fields</code> on the first <code>index</code> call; subsequent appends to the same index can omit it</li>\n<li><strong>Choose the right field type</strong>: Use <code>id</code> for identifiers used in deletion, <code>keyword</code> for tag-like values, <code>text</code> for searchable content</li>\n<li><strong>Scope queries</strong>: Pass <code>search_fields</code> to limit search to specific text fields when documents have many fields</li>\n<li><strong>Persistent storage</strong>: Place <code>storage_dir</code> outside ephemeral runtime directories so the index survives restarts</li>\n<li><strong>Single backend, many indexes</strong>: Reuse one component for related indexes rather than spinning up multiple search-engine components</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Document retrieval</strong>: Keyword search over manuals, knowledge bases, and articles</li>\n<li><strong>Hybrid search</strong>: Combine with <code>vector-store</code> for keyword + semantic retrieval</li>\n<li><strong>Audit and discovery</strong>: Search across logs, transcripts, and chat history</li>\n<li><strong>RAG keyword stage</strong>: Pre-filter candidates by keyword match before vector ranking</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Search Engine Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/shell",
      "html": "<h1>Shell Component</h1>\n<p>The shell component enables executing system commands and shell scripts within your model-compose workflows. It provides secure command execution with environment management, timeout controls, and output capture for integrating system operations with AI workflows.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  action:\n    command: [ ls, -la, /tmp ]\n    working_dir: /home/user\n    timeout: 30.0\n    env:\n      PATH: /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>shell</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>base_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Base working directory for all actions</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>env</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Environment variables for all actions</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>manage</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Configuration for environment setup and cleanup</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of shell command actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Management Configuration</h3>\n<p>The <code>manage</code> configuration controls environment setup:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scripts</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Shell scripts for setup and cleanup</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>working_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Working directory for management scripts</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>env</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Environment variables for management scripts</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Management Scripts</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Script</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>install</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to install dependencies</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>clean</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>One or more scripts to clean up environment</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>Shell actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>command</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Shell command as list of arguments</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>working_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Working directory for the command</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>env</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Environment variables for the command</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Maximum execution time in seconds</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Command Execution</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  action:\n    command: [df, -h]\n    output:\n      disk_usage: ${result.stdout}\n      exit_code: ${result.exit_code}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>File System Operations</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  action:\n    command: [ find, /var/log, -name, &quot;*.log&quot;, -mtime, &quot;+7&quot; ]\n    working_dir: /tmp\n    timeout: 60.0\n    env:\n      LANG: en_US.UTF-8\n    output:\n      old_log_files: ${result.stdout}\n      error_output: ${result.stderr}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple Shell Actions</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  base_dir: /opt/project\n  env:\n    PROJECT_ENV: production\n    LOG_LEVEL: info\n  actions:\n    - id: backup-data\n      command: [ rsync, -av, data/, backup/ ]\n      timeout: 300.0\n      output:\n        backup_result: ${result.stdout}\n        success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n    \n    - id: check-disk-space\n      command: [ du, -sh, backup/ ]\n      output:\n        backup_size: ${result.stdout}\n        \n    - id: cleanup-old-files\n      command: [ find, backup/, -mtime, &quot;+30&quot;, -delete ]\n      timeout: 120.0\n      output:\n        cleanup_result: ${result.stdout}\n        files_deleted: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n        \n    - id: verify-backup\n      command: [ ls, -la, backup/ ]\n      output:\n        backup_contents: ${result.stdout}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>System Administration Tasks</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      install: \n        - [ apt, update ]\n        - [ apt, install, -y, htop, iotop, nethogs ]\n    working_dir: /tmp\n    env:\n      DEBIAN_FRONTEND: noninteractive\n  actions:\n    - id: system-info\n      command: [ uname, -a ]\n      output:\n        system_info: ${result.stdout}\n    \n    - id: memory-usage\n      command: [ free, -h ]\n      output:\n        memory_stats: ${result.stdout}\n        \n    - id: cpu-usage\n      command: [ top, -bn1 ]\n      timeout: 10.0\n      output:\n        cpu_stats: ${result.stdout}\n        \n    - id: network-stats\n      command: [ ss, -tuln ]\n      output:\n        network_connections: ${result.stdout}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Development and Build Tasks</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  base_dir: /workspace/project\n  env:\n    NODE_ENV: production\n    CI: true\n  manage:\n    scripts:\n      install:\n        - [ npm, install ]\n        - [ npm, run, build ]\n      clean: [ rm, -rf, node_modules, dist ]\n  actions:\n    - id: run-tests\n      command: [ npm, test ]\n      timeout: 300.0\n      output:\n        test_results: ${result.stdout}\n        test_passed: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n    \n    - id: lint-code\n      command: [ npm, run, lint ]\n      output:\n        lint_results: ${result.stdout}\n        lint_passed: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n        \n    - id: build-project\n      command: [ npm, run, build ]\n      timeout: 600.0\n      output:\n        build_output: ${result.stdout}\n        build_success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Data Processing Tasks</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  base_dir: /data\n  env:\n    PYTHONPATH: /opt/scripts\n  actions:\n    - id: process-csv\n      command: [ python3, process_data.py, --input, ${input.csv_file}, --output, ${input.output_file} ]\n      timeout: 1800.0  # 30 minutes\n      output:\n        processing_result: ${result.stdout}\n        rows_processed: ${result.stdout | extract_number}\n        \n    - id: validate-output\n      command: [ python3, validate.py, ${input.output_file} ]\n      output:\n        validation_result: ${result.stdout}\n        is_valid: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n        \n    - id: compress-data\n      command: [ gzip, ${input.output_file} ]\n      output:\n        compressed_file: ${input.output_file}.gz\n        compression_success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Docker and Container Operations</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  env:\n    DOCKER_HOST: unix:///var/run/docker.sock\n  actions:\n    - id: build-image\n      command: [ docker, build, -t, ${input.image_name}, . ]\n      working_dir: ${input.build_context}\n      timeout: 900.0\n      output:\n        build_output: ${result.stdout}\n        image_built: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n    \n    - id: run-container\n      command: [ docker, run, -d, --name, ${input.container_name}, ${input.image_name} ]\n      output:\n        container_id: ${result.stdout}\n        container_started: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n        \n    - id: check-container-status\n      command: [ docker, ps, --filter, name=${input.container_name} ]\n      output:\n        container_status: ${result.stdout}\n        \n    - id: get-container-logs\n      command: [ docker, logs, ${input.container_name} ]\n      output:\n        container_logs: ${result.stdout}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Environment Management</h2>\n<h3>Environment Variables</h3>\n<p>Set environment variables at different scopes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  # Component-level environment (applies to all actions)\n  env:\n    GLOBAL_VAR: global_value\n    PATH: /custom/bin:${env.PATH}\n  actions:\n    - id: show-env\n      command: [env]\n      # Action-level environment (overrides component-level)\n      env:\n        ACTION_VAR: action_value\n        GLOBAL_VAR: overridden_value\n      output:\n        environment: ${result.stdout}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Working Directory Management</h3>\n<p>Control working directories for commands:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  base_dir: /opt/project  # Default for all actions\n  actions:\n    - id: list-project-files\n      command: [ ls, -la ]\n      # Uses base_dir: /opt/project\n      \n    - id: check-logs\n      command: [ tail, -f, app.log ]\n      working_dir: /var/log  # Override base_dir\n      \n    - id: run-script\n      command: [ ./run_tests.sh ]\n      working_dir: ${input.script_directory}  # Dynamic directory\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Command Output Handling</h2>\n<h3>Standard Output and Error</h3>\n<p>Access command output and error streams:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  action:\n    command: [ python3, script.py ]\n    output:\n      stdout_content: ${result.stdout}\n      stderr_content: ${result.stderr}\n      exit_code: ${result.exit_code}\n      success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n      command_duration: ${result.duration}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Output Processing</h3>\n<p>Process command output with transformations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  action:\n    command: [ ps, aux ]\n    output:\n      # Extract specific information from ps output\n      process_count: ${result.stdout | lines | length}\n      cpu_usage_lines: ${result.stdout | lines | grep('python')}\n      memory_info: ${result.stdout | extract_memory_info}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Security and Safety</h2>\n<h3>Command Validation</h3>\n<p>Use parameterized commands to prevent injection:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  actions:\n    - id: safe-file-operation\n      # Safe: command is a list\n      command: [ grep, ${input.pattern}, ${input.filename} ]\n      \n    - id: validate-input\n      # Validate inputs before using\n      command: [ find, ${input.directory | validate_path}, -name, ${input.filename | escape_shell} ]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Timeout Protection</h3>\n<p>Set timeouts to prevent hanging processes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  actions:\n    - id: long-running-task\n      command: [ rsync, -av, large_directory/, backup/ ]\n      timeout: 3600.0  # 1 hour timeout\n      \n    - id: quick-check\n      command: [ ping, -c, 1, ${input.hostname} ]\n      timeout: 10.0    # 10 second timeout\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Resource Limits</h3>\n<p>Use system tools to limit resource usage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  actions:\n    - id: limited-process\n      command: [ timeout, 300, nice, -n, 10, python3, heavy_script.py ]\n      # Uses timeout and nice to limit execution time and priority\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<h3>Exit Code Checking</h3>\n<p>Handle command failures appropriately:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: backup-database\n      component: shell-executor\n      action: backup-db\n      input:\n        database_name: ${input.db_name}\n      output:\n        backup_file: ${output.backup_path}\n      on_error:\n        - id: cleanup-partial-backup\n          component: shell-executor\n          action: cleanup-files\n          input:\n            files_to_remove: ${backup-database.output.backup_path}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: shell-executor\n    type: shell\n    actions:\n      - id: backup-db\n        command: [ mysqldump, ${input.database_name} ]\n        timeout: 1800.0\n        output:\n          backup_path: /tmp/backup_${now}.sql\n          success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n          \n      - id: cleanup-files\n        command: [ rm, -f, ${input.files_to_remove} ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration Patterns</h2>\n<h3>System Monitoring</h3>\n<p>Monitor system resources and health:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: system-health-check\n    jobs:\n      - id: check-disk-usage\n        component: system-monitor\n        action: disk-usage\n        \n      - id: check-memory\n        component: system-monitor\n        action: memory-stats\n        \n      - id: check-processes\n        component: system-monitor\n        action: process-list\n        \n      - id: generate-report\n        component: report-generator\n        input:\n          disk_info: ${check-disk-usage.output.disk_usage}\n          memory_info: ${check-memory.output.memory_stats}\n          process_info: ${check-processes.output.process_list}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: system-monitor\n    type: shell\n    actions:\n      - id: disk-usage\n        command: [ df, -h ]\n        output:\n          disk_usage: ${result.stdout}\n          \n      - id: memory-stats\n        command: [ free, -h ]\n        output:\n          memory_stats: ${result.stdout}\n          \n      - id: process-list\n        command: [ ps, aux, --sort=-pcpu ]\n        output:\n          process_list: ${result.stdout}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Data Pipeline Integration</h3>\n<p>Integrate shell commands in data processing pipelines:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: data-processing-pipeline\n    jobs:\n      - id: download-data\n        component: data-fetcher\n        action: download-file\n        input:\n          url: ${input.data_url}\n          \n      - id: process-data\n        component: data-processor\n        action: transform-csv\n        input:\n          input_file: ${download-data.output.downloaded_file}\n        depends_on: [ download-data ]\n        \n      - id: analyze-results\n        component: ai-analyzer\n        input:\n          processed_data: ${process-data.output.processed_file}\n        depends_on: [ process-data ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: data-fetcher\n    type: shell\n    actions:\n      - id: download-file\n        command: [ curl, -o, /tmp/data.csv, ${input.url} ]\n        timeout: 300.0\n        output:\n          downloaded_file: /tmp/data.csv\n          download_success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n          \n  - id: data-processor\n    type: shell\n    base_dir: /opt/data-tools\n    actions:\n      - id: transform-csv\n        command: [ python3, transform.py, --input, ${input.input_file}, --output, /tmp/processed.csv ]\n        timeout: 600.0\n        output:\n          processed_file: /tmp/processed.csv\n          processing_success: ${result.exit_code == 0}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Shell components support dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: shell\n  action:\n    command: [ ${env.BACKUP_TOOL | rsync}, -av, ${input.source_dir}, ${input.dest_dir} ]\n    working_dir: ${env.WORK_DIR | /tmp}\n    timeout: ${input.timeout as float | 300.0}\n    env:\n      BACKUP_DATE: ${now | date_format('%Y-%m-%d')}\n      USER_ID: ${input.user_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Security</strong>: Always use parameterized commands, never concatenate user input into shell strings</li>\n<li><strong>Timeouts</strong>: Set appropriate timeouts for all commands to prevent hanging</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Check exit codes and handle command failures gracefully</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Management</strong>: Monitor CPU, memory, and disk usage for long-running commands</li>\n<li><strong>Environment Isolation</strong>: Use clean environments and avoid depending on system-specific configurations</li>\n<li><strong>Logging</strong>: Capture both stdout and stderr for debugging and monitoring</li>\n<li><strong>Path Safety</strong>: Validate and sanitize file paths before use</li>\n<li><strong>Permissions</strong>: Run commands with minimal required privileges</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference shell components in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: prepare-environment\n      component: shell-runner\n      action: setup-env\n      input:\n        project_dir: ${input.project_path}\n        \n    - id: run-analysis\n      component: shell-runner\n      action: analyze-data\n      input:\n        data_file: ${input.data_file}\n      depends_on: [ prepare-environment ]\n      \n    - id: cleanup\n      component: shell-runner\n      action: cleanup-temp\n      depends_on: [ run-analysis ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>System Administration</strong>: Monitor system health, manage services, perform maintenance</li>\n<li><strong>Data Processing</strong>: Execute data transformation scripts and tools</li>\n<li><strong>Build and Deployment</strong>: Run build systems, deploy applications, manage containers</li>\n<li><strong>File Operations</strong>: Manipulate files, directories, and archives</li>\n<li><strong>Network Operations</strong>: Test connectivity, download files, interact with services</li>\n<li><strong>Testing and Validation</strong>: Run test suites, validate outputs, check system state</li>\n<li><strong>Backup and Recovery</strong>: Create backups, restore data, manage archives</li>\n<li><strong>Integration</strong>: Bridge between different systems and tools</li>\n</ul>\n",

      "slug": "reference/compose/components/text-splitter",
      "html": "<h1>Text Splitter Component</h1>\n<p>The text splitter component enables splitting large text documents into smaller, manageable chunks. This is essential for processing long documents with language models that have token limits, creating embeddings for vector databases, or preparing text for batch processing operations.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.document}\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 200\n    separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot; &quot;, &quot;&quot; ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>text-splitter</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of text splitting actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>Text splitter actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Input text to be split into chunks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>chunk_size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1000</code></td>\n<td>Maximum number of characters per chunk</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>chunk_overlap</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>200</code></td>\n<td>Number of overlapping characters between chunks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>separators</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Custom separators for splitting (defaults to standard text separators)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Basic Text Splitting</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.document_text}\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 200\n    output:\n      chunks: ${response.chunks}\n      chunk_count: ${response.chunks | length}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Custom Separator Splitting</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.article}\n    chunk_size: 500\n    chunk_overlap: 50\n    separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot;. &quot;, &quot; &quot;, &quot;&quot; ]\n    output:\n      text_chunks: ${response.chunks}\n      total_chunks: ${response.chunks | length}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple Splitting Strategies</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  actions:\n    - id: paragraph-splitting\n      text: ${input.document}\n      chunk_size: 2000\n      chunk_overlap: 100\n      separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot; ]\n      output:\n        paragraph_chunks: ${response.chunks}\n    \n    - id: sentence-splitting\n      text: ${input.document}\n      chunk_size: 500\n      chunk_overlap: 50\n      separators: [ &quot;. &quot;, &quot;! &quot;, &quot;? &quot;, &quot;\\n&quot; ]\n      output:\n        sentence_chunks: ${response.chunks}\n        \n    - id: word-splitting\n      text: ${input.document}\n      chunk_size: 200\n      chunk_overlap: 20\n      separators: [ &quot; &quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot;\\t&quot; ]\n      output:\n        word_chunks: ${response.chunks}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Separator Strategies</h2>\n<h3>Hierarchical Separators</h3>\n<p>Use hierarchical separators to maintain document structure:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.structured_document}\n    separators: [\n      &quot;\\n\\n\\n&quot;,    # Major sections\n      &quot;\\n\\n&quot;,      # Paragraphs\n      &quot;\\n&quot;,        # Lines\n      &quot;. &quot;,        # Sentences\n      &quot; &quot;,         # Words\n      &quot;&quot;           # Characters (last resort)\n    ]\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 100\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Document-Type Specific Separators</h3>\n<h4>Markdown Documents</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.markdown_content}\n    separators: [\n      &quot;\\n## &quot;,     # Sections\n      &quot;\\n### &quot;,    # Subsections\n      &quot;\\n\\n&quot;,      # Paragraphs\n      &quot;\\n&quot;,        # Lines\n      &quot; &quot;,         # Words\n      &quot;&quot;\n    ]\n    chunk_size: 800\n    chunk_overlap: 80\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Code Documents</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.source_code}\n    separators: [\n      &quot;\\nclass &quot;,      # Class definitions\n      &quot;\\ndef &quot;,        # Function definitions\n      &quot;\\n\\n&quot;,          # Empty lines\n      &quot;\\n&quot;,            # Line breaks\n      &quot; &quot;,             # Spaces\n      &quot;&quot;\n    ]\n    chunk_size: 1200\n    chunk_overlap: 100\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Academic Papers</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.research_paper}\n    separators: [\n      &quot;\\n# &quot;,          # Main sections\n      &quot;\\n## &quot;,         # Subsections\n      &quot;\\n\\n&quot;,          # Paragraphs\n      &quot;. &quot;,            # Sentences\n      &quot; &quot;,             # Words\n      &quot;&quot;\n    ]\n    chunk_size: 1500\n    chunk_overlap: 150\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Chunk Overlap Strategies</h2>\n<h3>Minimal Overlap for Independent Processing</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text}\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 0      # No overlap - for independent chunk processing\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Moderate Overlap for Context Preservation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text}\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 200    # 20% overlap - maintains context between chunks\n</code></pre>\n<h3>High Overlap for Semantic Continuity</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text}\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 400    # 40% overlap - ensures semantic continuity\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration with Vector Databases</h2>\n<p>Create embeddings for vector storage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: document-indexing\n    jobs:\n      - id: split-document\n        component: text-splitter\n        input:\n          document: ${input.document_content}\n        output:\n          text_chunks: ${output.chunks}\n          \n      - id: generate-embeddings\n        component: embedding-model\n        input:\n          texts: ${split-document.output.text_chunks}\n        output:\n          embeddings: ${output.embeddings}\n        depends_on: [ split-document ]\n          \n      - id: store-vectors\n        component: vector-store\n        action: batch-insert\n        input:\n          vectors: ${generate-embeddings.output.embeddings}\n          metadata: ${input.metadata}\n          chunks: ${split-document.output.text_chunks}\n        depends_on: [ generate-embeddings ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: text-splitter\n    type: text-splitter\n    action:\n      text: ${input.document}\n      chunk_size: 1000\n      chunk_overlap: 200\n      separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot;. &quot;, &quot; &quot;, &quot;&quot; ]\n\n  - id: embedding-model\n    type: model\n    task: text-embedding\n    model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n    action:\n      text: ${input.texts}\n    \n  - id: vector-store\n    type: vector-store\n    driver: chroma\n    collection: documents\n    actions:\n      - id: batch-insert\n        method: insert\n        vector: ${input.vectors}\n        metadata: \n          text: ${input.chunks}\n          document_id: ${input.metadata.document_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>RAG System Integration</h2>\n<p>Prepare documents for Retrieval-Augmented Generation:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: prepare-knowledge-base\n    jobs:\n      - id: split-documents\n        component: document-splitter\n        input:\n          documents: ${input.document_collection}\n        output:\n          all_chunks: ${output.processed_chunks}\n          \n      - id: filter-chunks\n        component: chunk-filter\n        input:\n          chunks: ${split-documents.output.all_chunks}\n          min_length: 100\n          max_length: 2000\n        output:\n          filtered_chunks: ${output.valid_chunks}\n        depends_on: [ split-documents ]\n          \n      - id: create-embeddings\n        component: embedding-model\n        input:\n          texts: ${filter-chunks.output.filtered_chunks}\n        depends_on: [ filter-chunks ]\n        \n      - id: index-knowledge\n        component: vector-store\n        input:\n          embeddings: ${create-embeddings.output.embeddings}\n          text_chunks: ${filter-chunks.output.filtered_chunks}\n        depends_on: [ create-embeddings ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: document-splitter\n    type: text-splitter\n    actions:\n      - id: split-by-document\n        text: ${input.document_text}\n        chunk_size: 1200\n        chunk_overlap: 120\n        separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot;. &quot;, &quot; &quot; ]\n        output:\n          processed_chunks: ${response.chunks}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Batch Processing</h2>\n<p>Process multiple documents efficiently:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: batch-document-processing\n    jobs:\n      - id: split-all-documents\n        component: batch-splitter\n        input:\n          document_batch: ${input.documents}\n        output:\n          chunked_documents: ${output.batch_results}\n          \n      - id: process-chunks\n        component: text-processor\n        input:\n          chunk_batches: ${split-all-documents.output.chunked_documents}\n        depends_on: [ split-all-documents ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: batch-splitter\n    type: text-splitter\n    actions:\n      - id: process-batch\n        text: ${input.document_batch}  # Array of documents\n        chunk_size: 1000\n        chunk_overlap: 150\n        separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot;. &quot;, &quot; &quot;, &quot;&quot; ]\n        output:\n          batch_results: ${response.chunks}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Advanced Configuration Examples</h2>\n<h3>Adaptive Chunk Sizing</h3>\n<p>Adjust chunk size based on content type:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  actions:\n    - id: technical-content\n      text: ${input.technical_doc}\n      chunk_size: 1500  # Larger chunks for technical content\n      chunk_overlap: 150\n      separators: [ &quot;\\n## &quot;, &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot;, &quot; &quot; ]\n      \n    - id: narrative-content\n      text: ${input.story}\n      chunk_size: 800   # Smaller chunks for narrative content\n      chunk_overlap: 100\n      separators: [ &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;. &quot;, &quot; &quot; ]\n      \n    - id: code-content\n      text: ${input.source_code}\n      chunk_size: 2000  # Large chunks to preserve code structure\n      chunk_overlap: 200\n      separators: [ &quot;\\nclass &quot;, &quot;\\ndef &quot;, &quot;\\n\\n&quot;, &quot;\\n&quot; ]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Quality-Based Filtering</h3>\n<p>Filter chunks based on quality criteria:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: quality-chunking\n    jobs:\n      - id: initial-split\n        component: text-splitter\n        input:\n          text: ${input.document}\n          \n      - id: filter-quality\n        component: chunk-quality-filter\n        input:\n          chunks: ${initial-split.output.chunks}\n          min_words: 20\n          max_words: 500\n          filter_short_sentences: true\n        depends_on: [ initial-split ]\n        \ncomponents:\n  - id: text-splitter\n    type: text-splitter\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text}\n      chunk_size: 1000\n      chunk_overlap: 100\n      output:\n        chunks: ${response.chunks}\n        # Additional quality metrics\n        avg_chunk_length: ${response.chunks | map(length) | avg}\n        chunk_lengths: ${response.chunks | map(length)}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Overlap Visualization</h2>\n<p>Understanding how overlap works:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Example with chunk_size=100, chunk_overlap=20\n# Document: &quot;This is a very long document that needs to be split into smaller chunks for processing...&quot;\n#\n# Chunk 1: &quot;This is a very long document that needs to be split into smaller chunks for proces&quot; (100 chars)\n# Chunk 2: &quot;chunks for processing with some additional text that continues the document...&quot; (starts 80 chars into previous chunk)\n# Chunk 3: &quot;continues the document with more content...&quot; (starts 80 chars into chunk 2)\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Text splitter supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: text-splitter\n  action:\n    text: ${input.document_text}\n    chunk_size: ${input.max_chunk_size as integer | 1000}\n    chunk_overlap: ${input.overlap_ratio as integer | 200}\n    separators: ${input.custom_separators | ['\\n\\n', '\\n', ' ', '']}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Choose Appropriate Chunk Size</strong>: Balance between context preservation and processing efficiency</li>\n<li><strong>Use Hierarchical Separators</strong>: Start with larger text units and fall back to smaller ones</li>\n<li><strong>Consider Content Type</strong>: Adjust separators and chunk sizes based on document structure</li>\n<li><strong>Maintain Context</strong>: Use appropriate overlap to preserve meaning across chunks</li>\n<li><strong>Test with Your Data</strong>: Experiment with different settings on representative documents</li>\n<li><strong>Monitor Performance</strong>: Track chunk quality and processing efficiency</li>\n<li><strong>Handle Edge Cases</strong>: Account for very short or very long documents</li>\n<li><strong>Preserve Structure</strong>: Use separators that respect document formatting</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference text splitter in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: split-text\n      component: text-splitter\n      input:\n        document: ${input.long_document}\n        chunk_size: 1200\n        \n    - id: process-chunks\n      component: text-processor\n      input:\n        chunks: ${split-text.output.chunks}\n      depends_on: [ split-text ]\n      \n    - id: combine-results\n      component: result-combiner\n      input:\n        processed_chunks: ${process-chunks.output.results}\n      depends_on: [ process-chunks ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Document Embeddings</strong>: Split documents for vector database storage</li>\n<li><strong>RAG Systems</strong>: Prepare knowledge base chunks for retrieval</li>\n<li><strong>LLM Processing</strong>: Break large documents into model-compatible sizes</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Analysis</strong>: Process large documents in manageable chunks</li>\n<li><strong>Content Indexing</strong>: Create searchable text segments</li>\n<li><strong>Multi-modal Processing</strong>: Prepare text for cross-modal analysis</li>\n<li><strong>Document Summarization</strong>: Create summaries from document sections</li>\n<li><strong>Information Extraction</strong>: Extract entities and relationships from text chunks</li>\n</ul>\n",

      "slug": "reference/compose/components/vector-store",
      "html": "<h1>Vector Store Component</h1>\n<p>The vector store component enables storing, searching, and managing vector embeddings using various backend databases. It supports operations like inserting, updating, searching, and deleting vectors with metadata, making it ideal for semantic search, recommendation systems, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) applications.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  action:\n    collection: documents\n    method: insert\n    vector: ${input.embedding}\n    metadata:\n      text: ${input.text}\n      source: ${input.source}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>vector-store</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Backend driver: <code>chroma</code>, <code>milvus</code>, <code>qdrant</code>, <code>faiss</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of vector store actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>All vector store actions share these common settings:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Operation method: <code>insert</code>, <code>update</code>, <code>search</code>, <code>delete</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>id_field</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>id</code></td>\n<td>Field name used to identify vectors</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>vector_field</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>vector</code></td>\n<td>Field name where vector embeddings are stored</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>batch_size</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>0</code></td>\n<td>Number of items to process in a single batch</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Supported Drivers</h2>\n<h3>Chroma</h3>\n<p>ChromaDB for local and server-based vector storage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  mode: local\n  storage_dir: ./chroma_data\n  # Or server mode:\n  # mode: server\n  # host: localhost\n  # port: 8000\n  # protocol: http\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Chroma Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>mode</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>local</code></td>\n<td>Mode: <code>local</code> or <code>server</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>storage_dir</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>./chroma</code></td>\n<td>Local storage directory</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>host</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>localhost</code></td>\n<td>Server hostname (server mode)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>8000</code></td>\n<td>Server port (server mode)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>protocol</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>http</code></td>\n<td>Connection protocol: <code>http</code>, <code>https</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>tenant</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target tenant name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Target database name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>float</td>\n<td><code>30.0</code></td>\n<td>Operation timeout in seconds</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Milvus</h3>\n<p>Milvus for high-performance vector similarity search:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: milvus\n  host: localhost\n  port: 19530\n  database: default\n  collection: embeddings\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Qdrant</h3>\n<p>Qdrant for vector similarity search and storage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: qdrant\n  host: localhost\n  port: 6333\n  collection: vectors\n</code></pre>\n<h3>FAISS</h3>\n<p>Facebook AI Similarity Search for local vector operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: faiss\n  index_path: ./faiss_index\n  dimension: 384\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Vector Store Operations</h2>\n<h3>Insert Vectors</h3>\n<p>Add new vectors to the store:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  action:\n    collection: documents\n    method: insert\n    vector: ${input.embedding}\n    vector_id: ${input.document_id}\n    metadata:\n      text: ${input.text}\n      category: ${input.category}\n      timestamp: ${now}\n    output:\n      inserted_id: ${response.id}\n      success: ${response.success}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Update Vectors</h3>\n<p>Modify existing vectors and metadata:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  action:\n    collection: documents\n    method: update\n    vector_id: ${input.document_id}\n    vector: ${input.new_embedding}\n    metadata:\n      text: ${input.updated_text}\n      last_modified: ${now}\n    insert_if_not_exist: true\n    output:\n      updated: ${response.success}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Search Vectors</h3>\n<p>Find similar vectors using similarity search:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  action:\n    collection: documents\n    method: search\n    query: ${input.query_embedding}\n    top_k: 10\n    metric_type: COSINE\n    filter:\n      category: science\n      timestamp:\n        gte: 2024-01-01\n    output_fields: [text, category, score]\n    output:\n      matches: ${response.results}\n      scores: ${response.scores}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Delete Vectors</h3>\n<p>Remove vectors from the store:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  action:\n    collection: documents\n    method: delete\n    vector_id: ${input.document_id}\n    # Or delete by filter:\n    filter:\n      category: outdated\n      timestamp:\n        lt: 2023-01-01\n    output:\n      deleted_count: ${response.deleted}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple vector store operations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  storage_dir: ./vector_db\n  actions:\n    - id: add-document\n      collection: documents\n      method: insert\n      vector: ${input.embedding}\n      vector_id: ${input.doc_id}\n      metadata:\n        title: ${input.title}\n        content: ${input.content}\n        category: ${input.category}\n      output:\n        document_id: ${response.id}\n    \n    - id: search-similar\n      collection: documents\n      method: search\n      query: ${input.query_vector}\n      top_k: 5\n      filter:\n        category: ${input.search_category}\n      output_fields: [title, content, score]\n      output:\n        similar_docs: ${response.results}\n    \n    - id: update-document\n      collection: documents\n      method: update\n      vector_id: ${input.doc_id}\n      vector: ${input.new_embedding}\n      metadata:\n        content: ${input.updated_content}\n        last_updated: ${now}\n    \n    - id: remove-document\n      collection: documents\n      method: delete\n      vector_id: ${input.doc_id}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Filtering and Querying</h2>\n<h3>Filter Conditions</h3>\n<p>Vector stores support various filter conditions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">filter:\n  # Exact match\n  category: technology\n  \n  # Range queries\n  score:\n    gte: 0.8\n    lt: 1.0\n  \n  # Array membership\n  tags:\n    in: [AI, &quot;machine learning&quot;]\n  \n  # Negation\n  status:\n    neq: deleted\n  \n  # Multiple conditions (AND)\n  category: science\n  published:\n    gte: 2024-01-01\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Supported Filter Operators</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Operator</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Example</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>eq</code></td>\n<td>Equal to</td>\n<td><code>category: tech</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>neq</code></td>\n<td>Not equal to</td>\n<td><code>status: { neq: deleted }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gt</code></td>\n<td>Greater than</td>\n<td><code>score: { gt: 0.5 }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gte</code></td>\n<td>Greater than or equal</td>\n<td><code>timestamp: { gte: 2024-01-01 }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lt</code></td>\n<td>Less than</td>\n<td><code>price: { lt: 100 }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lte</code></td>\n<td>Less than or equal</td>\n<td><code>rating: { lte: 4.5 }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>in</code></td>\n<td>In array</td>\n<td><code>category: { in: [tech, science] }</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>not-in</code></td>\n<td>Not in array</td>\n<td><code>status: { not-in: [draft, deleted] }</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Distance Metrics</h2>\n<p>Choose appropriate distance metrics for your use case:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">method: search\nquery: ${input.query_vector}\nmetric_type: COSINE\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Available Metrics</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>COSINE</strong>: Cosine similarity (good for text embeddings)</li>\n<li><strong>L2</strong>: Euclidean distance (default for many applications)</li>\n<li><strong>IP</strong>: Inner product (for normalized vectors)</li>\n<li><strong>HAMMING</strong>: Hamming distance (for binary vectors)</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Batch Operations</h2>\n<p>Process multiple vectors efficiently:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  action:\n    collection: bulk_documents\n    method: insert\n    vector: ${input.embedding_batch}  # Array of vectors\n    vector_id: ${input.id_batch}      # Array of IDs\n    metadata: ${input.metadata_batch} # Array of metadata\n    batch_size: 100\n    output:\n      inserted_count: ${response.count}\n      batch_results: ${response.results}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration with Text Embeddings</h2>\n<p>Combine with model components for end-to-end workflows:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: document-indexing\n    jobs:\n      - id: generate-embedding\n        component: embedding-model\n        input:\n          text: ${input.document_text}\n        output:\n          embedding: ${output.embedding}\n      \n      - id: store-embedding\n        component: vector-store\n        action: add-document\n        input:\n          embedding: ${generate-embedding.output.embedding}\n          doc_id: ${input.document_id}\n          title: ${input.title}\n          content: ${input.document_text}\n        depends_on: [ generate-embedding ]\n\n  - id: semantic-search\n    jobs:\n      - id: query-embedding\n        component: embedding-model\n        input:\n          text: ${input.search_query}\n        output:\n          query_vector: ${output.embedding}\n      \n      - id: find-similar\n        component: vector-store\n        action: search-similar\n        input:\n          query_vector: ${query-embedding.output.query_vector}\n          search_category: ${input.category}\n        output:\n          search_results: ${output.similar_docs}\n        depends_on: [ query-embedding ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: embedding-model\n    type: model\n    task: text-embedding\n    model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text}\n\n  - id: vector-store\n    type: vector-store\n    driver: chroma\n    storage_dir: ./embeddings_db\n    actions:\n      - id: add-document\n        collection: documents\n        method: insert\n        vector: ${input.embedding}\n        vector_id: ${input.doc_id}\n        metadata:\n          title: ${input.title}\n          content: ${input.content}\n          category: ${input.category}\n      \n      - id: search-similar\n        collection: documents\n        method: search\n        query: ${input.query_vector}\n        top_k: 10\n        filter:\n          category: ${input.search_category}\n        output_fields: [ title, content ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Advanced Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>RAG System Implementation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: rag-query\n    jobs:\n      - id: embed-question\n        component: embedding-model\n        input:\n          text: ${input.question}\n      \n      - id: retrieve-context\n        component: vector-store\n        action: search-knowledge\n        input:\n          query_vector: ${embed-question.output.embedding}\n        depends_on: [ embed-question ]\n      \n      - id: generate-answer\n        component: chat-model\n        input:\n          messages:\n            - role: system\n              content: Answer based on the provided context.\n            - role: user\n              content: |\n                Context: ${retrieve-context.output.context}\n                Question: ${input.question}\n        depends_on: [ retrieve-context ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: vector-store\n    type: vector-store\n    driver: chroma\n    actions:\n      - id: search-knowledge\n        collection: knowledge_base\n        method: search\n        query: ${input.query_vector}\n        top_k: 5\n        output_fields: [ text, source ]\n        output:\n          context: ${response.results | join('\\n\\n')}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Recommendation System</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  actions:\n    - id: find-similar-items\n      collection: product_embeddings\n      method: search\n      query: ${input.user_preference_vector}\n      top_k: 20\n      filter:\n        category: ${input.preferred_category}\n        in_stock: true\n        price:\n          lte: ${input.max_price}\n      output_fields: [ name, description, price, rating ]\n      output:\n        recommendations: ${response.results}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Duplicate Detection</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: chroma\n  actions:\n    - id: find-duplicates\n      collection: documents\n      method: search\n      query: ${input.document_embedding}\n      top_k: 5\n      metric_type: COSINE\n      filter:\n        # Exclude the document itself\n        id: \n          neq: ${input.document_id}\n      output:\n        potential_duplicates: ${response.results | filter(score &gt; 0.95)}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Performance Optimization</h2>\n<h3>Indexing Strategy</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: milvus\n  action:\n    collection: large_corpus\n    method: search\n    # Use appropriate index for your data size\n    metric_type: L2\n    batch_size: 1000  # Process in batches for large operations\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Memory Management</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: faiss\n  index_path: ./large_index\n  # Configure for memory efficiency\n  batch_size: 500\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling</h2>\n<p>Vector store operations can fail for various reasons:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Connection Issues</strong>: Database server unreachable</li>\n<li><strong>Collection Errors</strong>: Collection doesn't exist or access denied</li>\n<li><strong>Data Validation</strong>: Invalid vector dimensions or metadata</li>\n<li><strong>Storage Limits</strong>: Insufficient disk space or quota exceeded</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Use workflow error handling to manage failures:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: store-vectors\n      component: vector-store\n      action: insert-embeddings\n      input:\n        vectors: ${input.embeddings}\n      on_error:\n        - id: retry-storage\n          component: backup-vector-store\n          input:\n            vectors: ${input.embeddings}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Vector store supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: ${env.VECTOR_DB_DRIVER | chroma}\n  action:\n    collection: ${input.collection_name}\n    method: ${input.operation}\n    vector: ${input.embedding}\n    metadata:\n      timestamp: ${now}\n      user_id: ${input.user_id}\n      source: ${env.DATA_SOURCE}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Vector Dimensions</strong>: Ensure consistent vector dimensions across operations</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Processing</strong>: Use batching for large-scale operations</li>\n<li><strong>Indexing</strong>: Create appropriate indexes for your query patterns</li>\n<li><strong>Metadata</strong>: Store relevant metadata for filtering and retrieval</li>\n<li><strong>Collection Management</strong>: Organize vectors into logical collections</li>\n<li><strong>Distance Metrics</strong>: Choose metrics appropriate for your embedding type</li>\n<li><strong>Filtering</strong>: Use filters to improve search precision and performance</li>\n<li><strong>Backup</strong>: Regularly backup vector data for production systems</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference vector store in workflow jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: process-documents\n      component: text-processor\n      input:\n        documents: ${input.documents}\n        \n    - id: generate-embeddings\n      component: embedding-model\n      input:\n        texts: ${process-documents.output.processed_texts}\n      depends_on: [ process-documents ]\n        \n    - id: store-vectors\n      component: vector-store\n      action: bulk-insert\n      input:\n        embeddings: ${generate-embeddings.output.embeddings}\n        metadata: ${process-documents.output.metadata}\n      depends_on: [ generate-embeddings ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Semantic Search</strong>: Find similar documents, products, or content</li>\n<li><strong>Recommendation Systems</strong>: Suggest similar items or content</li>\n<li><strong>RAG Applications</strong>: Retrieve relevant context for question answering</li>\n<li><strong>Duplicate Detection</strong>: Identify similar or duplicate content</li>\n<li><strong>Clustering</strong>: Group similar items based on vector similarity</li>\n<li><strong>Content Discovery</strong>: Enable content exploration through similarity</li>\n<li><strong>Personalization</strong>: Create personalized experiences using user vectors</li>\n<li><strong>Knowledge Management</strong>: Build searchable knowledge bases</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Vector Store Component"
      }
    },
