      "slug": "reference/compose/components/video-scene-detector",
      "html": "<h1>Video Scene Detector Component</h1>\n<p>The video scene detector component analyzes video files to detect scene changes and transitions. It supports multiple detection backends (drivers) including PySceneDetect, FFmpeg, and TransNetV2.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: video-scene-detector\n  driver: pyscenedetect\n  action:\n    video: ${input.video as file}\n    detector: adaptive\n    threshold: 27.0\n    output: ${result as json}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>video-scene-detector</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>pyscenedetect</code></td>\n<td>Detection backend: <code>pyscenedetect</code>, <code>ffmpeg</code>, <code>transnetv2</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of scene detection actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>video</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Video file path or <code>${input.video as file}</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>detector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>adaptive</code></td>\n<td>Detector type (pyscenedetect only): <code>adaptive</code>, <code>content</code>, <code>threshold</code>, <code>histogram</code>, <code>hash</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>threshold</code></td>\n<td>number</td>\n<td>varies</td>\n<td>Detection sensitivity threshold</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>start_time</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Start time for analysis (e.g., <code>00:01:00</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>end_time</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>End time for analysis (e.g., <code>00:05:00</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Output template</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Supported Drivers</h2>\n<h3>PySceneDetect</h3>\n<p>Python-based scene detection with multiple detector algorithms:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: video-scene-detector\n  driver: pyscenedetect\n  action:\n    video: ${input.video as file}\n    detector: adaptive\n    threshold: 27.0\n    output: ${result as json}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Auto-installed dependency:</strong> <code>scenedetect[opencv]</code></p>\n<h4>Detector Types</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Detector</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Default Threshold</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>adaptive</code></td>\n<td>Adaptive content detection based on rolling average (recommended)</td>\n<td>27.0</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>content</code></td>\n<td>Content-aware detection using frame-by-frame HSV difference</td>\n<td>27.0</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>threshold</code></td>\n<td>Fade-in/fade-out detection based on average pixel intensity</td>\n<td>12.0</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>histogram</code></td>\n<td>HSV histogram comparison between frames</td>\n<td>0.05</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>hash</code></td>\n<td>Perceptual hash-based detection for similar frame matching</td>\n<td>0.395</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>FFmpeg</h3>\n<p>Scene detection using FFmpeg's built-in scene change filter. No additional Python dependencies required — only FFmpeg needs to be installed on the system.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: video-scene-detector\n  driver: ffmpeg\n  action:\n    video: ${input.video as file}\n    threshold: 0.3\n    output: ${result as json}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Threshold range:</strong> <code>0.0</code> to <code>1.0</code></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>0.1</code> — Very sensitive (detects minor changes)</li>\n<li><code>0.3</code> — Default (balanced detection)</li>\n<li><code>0.5</code> — Less sensitive (major scene changes only)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>TransNetV2</h3>\n<p>Deep learning-based shot boundary detection using the TransNetV2 model:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: video-scene-detector\n  driver: transnetv2\n  action:\n    video: ${input.video as file}\n    threshold: 0.5\n    output: ${result as json}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Auto-installed dependency:</strong> <code>transnetv2</code></p>\n<p><strong>Threshold range:</strong> <code>0.0</code> to <code>1.0</code> (prediction confidence)</p>\n<h2>Output Format</h2>\n<p>All drivers return a standardized output structure:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;scenes&quot;: [\n    {\n      &quot;index&quot;: 0,\n      &quot;start&quot;: &quot;00:00:00.000&quot;,\n      &quot;end&quot;: &quot;00:00:12.345&quot;,\n      &quot;start_frame&quot;: 0,\n      &quot;end_frame&quot;: 370,\n      &quot;duration&quot;: &quot;00:00:12.345&quot;\n    },\n    {\n      &quot;index&quot;: 1,\n      &quot;start&quot;: &quot;00:00:12.345&quot;,\n      &quot;end&quot;: &quot;00:00:28.678&quot;,\n      &quot;start_frame&quot;: 370,\n      &quot;end_frame&quot;: 860,\n      &quot;duration&quot;: &quot;00:00:16.333&quot;\n    }\n  ],\n  &quot;total_scenes&quot;: 2\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Output Fields</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>List of detected scenes</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes[].index</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Scene index (0-based)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes[].start</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Scene start timecode (HH:MM:SS.mmm)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes[].end</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Scene end timecode (HH:MM:SS.mmm)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes[].start_frame</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Scene start frame number</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes[].end_frame</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Scene end frame number</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>scenes[].duration</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Scene duration timecode</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>total_scenes</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td>Total number of detected scenes</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple detection configurations:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: video-scene-detector\n  driver: pyscenedetect\n  actions:\n    - id: adaptive\n      video: ${input.video as file}\n      detector: adaptive\n      threshold: ${input.threshold as number | 27.0}\n      output: ${result as json}\n\n    - id: content\n      video: ${input.video as file}\n      detector: content\n      threshold: ${input.threshold as number | 27.0}\n      output: ${result as json}\n\n    - id: with-range\n      video: ${input.video as file}\n      detector: ${input.detector | adaptive}\n      threshold: ${input.threshold as number}\n      start_time: ${input.start_time}\n      end_time: ${input.end_time}\n      output: ${result as json}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<h3>Basic Scene Detection</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: detect-scenes\n    job:\n      component: scene-detector\n      output:\n        scenes: ${output as json}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: scene-detector\n    type: video-scene-detector\n    driver: pyscenedetect\n    action:\n      video: ${input.video as file}\n      detector: adaptive\n      output: ${result as json}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Scene Detection with Post-Processing</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: analyze-video\n    jobs:\n      - id: detect\n        component: scene-detector\n        output:\n          scenes: ${output as json}\n\n      - id: summarize\n        component: chat-model\n        input:\n          messages:\n            - role: user\n              content: |\n                Analyze the following scene data and provide a summary:\n                ${jobs.detect.output.scenes}\n        depends_on: [detect]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: scene-detector\n    type: video-scene-detector\n    driver: pyscenedetect\n    action:\n      video: ${input.video as file}\n      detector: adaptive\n      output: ${result as json}\n\n  - id: chat-model\n    type: http-client\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages: ${input.messages}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Driver Comparison</h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Feature</th>\n<th>PySceneDetect</th>\n<th>FFmpeg</th>\n<th>TransNetV2</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Detection method</td>\n<td>Classical CV</td>\n<td>Scene filter</td>\n<td>Deep learning</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Detector variety</td>\n<td>5 types</td>\n<td>1 type</td>\n<td>1 type</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Time range support</td>\n<td>Yes</td>\n<td>Yes</td>\n<td>No</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Dependencies</td>\n<td>scenedetect[opencv]</td>\n<td>FFmpeg binary</td>\n<td>transnetv2</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>GPU acceleration</td>\n<td>No</td>\n<td>No</td>\n<td>Yes</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Best for</td>\n<td>General use</td>\n<td>Lightweight/no Python deps</td>\n<td>High accuracy</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Driver Selection</strong>: Use <code>pyscenedetect</code> for most cases; <code>ffmpeg</code> when no Python deps are desired; <code>transnetv2</code> for highest accuracy</li>\n<li><strong>Threshold Tuning</strong>: Start with defaults and adjust based on video content — lower thresholds detect more scenes</li>\n<li><strong>Time Ranges</strong>: Use <code>start_time</code>/<code>end_time</code> to analyze specific segments of long videos</li>\n<li><strong>Detector Choice</strong>: <code>adaptive</code> works well for most content; use <code>threshold</code> for fade transitions</li>\n</ol>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Video Scene Detector Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/web-browser",
      "html": "<h1>Web Browser Component</h1>\n<p>The web browser component provides full browser automation with pluggable drivers. It supports navigation, clicking, text input, screenshots, JavaScript evaluation, element extraction, cookie management, scrolling, and waiting for elements.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  timeout: 30s\n  action:\n    method: navigate\n    url: https://example.com\n    wait_until: load\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>web-browser</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>chrome</code></td>\n<td>Browser driver: <code>chrome</code>, <code>playwright</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>30s</code></td>\n<td>Default timeout for all actions</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of browser actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Driver Types</h3>\n<h4>Chrome Driver</h4>\n<p>Connects to a running Chrome/Chromium instance via the Chrome DevTools Protocol.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>chrome</code></td>\n<td>Must be <code>chrome</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>endpoint</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Full WebSocket debugger URL (e.g. <code>ws://localhost:9222/devtools/page/&lt;id&gt;</code>). If set, <code>host</code>/<code>port</code> are ignored</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>host</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>localhost</code></td>\n<td>Host where Chrome remote debugging port is exposed</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>9222</code></td>\n<td>Chrome remote debugging port</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>target_index</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>0</code></td>\n<td>Index of the browser target to attach to when auto-discovering via <code>host</code>/<code>port</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Playwright Driver</h4>\n<p>Launches a browser instance using Playwright.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: playwright\n  browser: chromium\n  headless: true\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>playwright</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>browser</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>chromium</code></td>\n<td>Browser engine: <code>chromium</code>, <code>firefox</code>, <code>webkit</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headless</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Whether to run the browser in headless mode</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>args</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>Additional command-line arguments passed to the browser process</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Common Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>All web browser actions share these common settings:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Action method: <code>navigate</code>, <code>click</code>, <code>input-text</code>, <code>screenshot</code>, <code>evaluate</code>, <code>wait-for</code>, <code>extract</code>, <code>get-cookies</code>, <code>set-cookies</code>, <code>scroll</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Per-action timeout override. Falls back to component-level timeout</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Output variable mapping</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Action Methods</h2>\n<h3>Navigate</h3>\n<p>Navigate to a URL and wait for a page lifecycle event:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: navigate\n    url: https://example.com\n    wait_until: load\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Navigate Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>URL to navigate to</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait_until</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>load</code></td>\n<td>Event to wait for: <code>load</code>, <code>domcontentloaded</code>, <code>networkidle</code>, <code>commit</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> <code>{ &quot;url&quot;: &quot;...&quot;, &quot;frameId&quot;: &quot;...&quot; }</code></p>\n<h3>Click</h3>\n<p>Click an element by CSS selector, XPath, or coordinates:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: click\n    selector: &quot;button#submit&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Click Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector of the element to click</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath of the element to click</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>x</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Absolute X coordinate for direct mouse click</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>y</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Absolute Y coordinate for direct mouse click</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p>Exactly one of <code>selector</code>, <code>xpath</code>, or <code>x</code>+<code>y</code> must be provided.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> <code>{ &quot;x&quot;: 100, &quot;y&quot;: 200 }</code></p>\n<h3>Input Text</h3>\n<p>Type text into an input element:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: input-text\n    selector: &quot;input[name='search']&quot;\n    text: &quot;hello world&quot;\n    clear_first: true\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Input Text Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector of the target input</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath of the target input</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Text to type into the element</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>clear_first</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Clear existing content before typing</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p>Either <code>selector</code> or <code>xpath</code> must be provided (not both).</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> <code>{ &quot;typed&quot;: &quot;hello world&quot; }</code></p>\n<h3>Screenshot</h3>\n<p>Capture a screenshot of the page or a specific element:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: screenshot\n    full_page: true\n    format: png\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Screenshot Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>full_page</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Capture the full scrollable page</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector to capture only a specific element</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>format</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>png</code></td>\n<td>Image format: <code>png</code> or <code>jpeg</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>quality</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>JPEG quality (0-100). Only applicable when <code>format=jpeg</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> base64-encoded image string</p>\n<h3>Evaluate</h3>\n<p>Execute JavaScript in the page context:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: evaluate\n    expression: &quot;document.title&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Evaluate Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>expression</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>JavaScript expression to evaluate</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> the evaluated JavaScript value</p>\n<h3>Wait For</h3>\n<p>Wait for an element to appear, become visible, or become hidden:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: wait-for\n    selector: &quot;.results-loaded&quot;\n    condition: visible\n    timeout: 10s\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Wait For Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector to wait for</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath to wait for</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>condition</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>present</code></td>\n<td>Condition: <code>present</code>, <code>visible</code>, <code>hidden</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p>Either <code>selector</code> or <code>xpath</code> must be provided (not both).</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> <code>{ &quot;found&quot;: true }</code></p>\n<h3>Extract</h3>\n<p>Extract text, HTML, or attributes from page elements:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: extract\n    selector: &quot;.article-body&quot;\n    extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Extract Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath expression</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>extract_mode</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>Extraction mode: <code>text</code>, <code>html</code>, <code>attribute</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>attribute</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Attribute name (required when <code>extract_mode=attribute</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>multiple</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Return all matches as a list</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p>Either <code>selector</code> or <code>xpath</code> must be provided (not both).</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> extracted string (or list of strings when <code>multiple=true</code>)</p>\n<h3>Get Cookies</h3>\n<p>Retrieve cookies from the browser:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: get-cookies\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Get Cookies Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>urls</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Restrict returned cookies to these URLs. If omitted, returns all cookies</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> list of cookie objects</p>\n<h3>Set Cookies</h3>\n<p>Set cookies in the browser:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: set-cookies\n    cookies:\n      - name: session\n        value: abc123\n        domain: example.com\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Set Cookies Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cookies</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>List of cookie dicts (<code>name</code>, <code>value</code>, <code>domain</code>, <code>path</code>, ...)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> <code>{ &quot;set&quot;: &lt;count&gt; }</code></p>\n<h3>Scroll</h3>\n<p>Scroll the page or a specific element. The behavior depends on the combination of parameters:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>No selector/xpath</strong>: Scrolls the page by <code>x</code> and <code>y</code> pixels (<code>window.scrollBy</code>)</li>\n<li><strong>selector/xpath without x/y</strong>: Scrolls the element into view (<code>scrollIntoView</code>)</li>\n<li><strong>selector/xpath with x/y</strong>: Scrolls the element's internal content (<code>element.scrollBy</code>)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Page scroll:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: scroll\n    y: 500\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Scroll element into view:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: scroll\n    selector: &quot;#target-section&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Scroll element's internal content:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: scroll\n    selector: &quot;.scrollable-container&quot;\n    y: 300\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Scroll Configuration:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector of the target element</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath of the target element</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>x</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Horizontal scroll amount in pixels</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>y</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Vertical scroll amount in pixels</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p>Only one of <code>selector</code> or <code>xpath</code> can be provided.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Returns:</strong> <code>{ &quot;scrolled_x&quot;: 0, &quot;scrolled_y&quot;: 500 }</code></p>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define multiple browser actions in a single component:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: navigate\n      method: navigate\n      url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n      wait_until: networkidle\n\n    - id: click\n      method: click\n      selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n\n    - id: type-text\n      method: input-text\n      selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n      text: &quot;${input.text}&quot;\n\n    - id: screenshot\n      method: screenshot\n      full_page: false\n      format: png\n\n    - id: extract-text\n      method: extract\n      selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n      extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Page Navigation and Extraction</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  actions:\n    - id: go\n      method: navigate\n      url: &quot;https://example.com&quot;\n      wait_until: load\n\n    - id: get-title\n      method: evaluate\n      expression: &quot;document.title&quot;\n      output:\n        title: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Form Login</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: navigate\n      method: navigate\n      url: &quot;${input.login_url}&quot;\n      wait_until: networkidle\n\n    - id: fill-username\n      method: input-text\n      selector: &quot;input[name='username']&quot;\n      text: &quot;${input.username}&quot;\n\n    - id: fill-password\n      method: input-text\n      selector: &quot;input[name='password']&quot;\n      text: &quot;${input.password}&quot;\n\n    - id: submit\n      method: click\n      selector: &quot;button[type='submit']&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>CAPTCHA Detection with JavaScript</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  actions:\n    - id: check-captcha\n      method: evaluate\n      expression: &gt;\n        !!(document.querySelector('[id*=captcha],[class*=captcha]')\n          || document.querySelector('iframe[src*=captcha]')\n          || document.querySelector('#cf-challenge-running'))\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Element Extraction with XPath</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  actions:\n    - id: extract-links\n      method: extract\n      xpath: &quot;//a[@class='product-link']&quot;\n      extract_mode: attribute\n      attribute: href\n      multiple: true\n      output:\n        links: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Full Page Screenshot</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  actions:\n    - id: capture\n      method: screenshot\n      full_page: true\n      format: jpeg\n      quality: 80\n      output:\n        image: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Cookie Management</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n  actions:\n    - id: inject-cookies\n      method: set-cookies\n      cookies:\n        - name: session_id\n          value: &quot;${input.session}&quot;\n          domain: example.com\n          path: /\n\n    - id: read-cookies\n      method: get-cookies\n      urls:\n        - &quot;https://example.com&quot;\n      output:\n        cookies: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<h3>Scrape with CAPTCHA Human Fallback</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: scrape-with-fallback\n    jobs:\n      - id: navigate\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.url}\n\n      - id: detect-captcha\n        component: browser\n        action: check-captcha\n        interrupt:\n          after:\n            condition:\n              operator: eq\n              input: ${output}\n              value: true\n            message: &gt;\n              CAPTCHA detected! Please solve it via noVNC at:\n              http://localhost:6080/vnc.html\n        depends_on: [ navigate ]\n\n      - id: extract\n        component: browser\n        action: extract-text\n        input:\n          selector: ${input.selector}\n        depends_on: [ detect-captcha ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: browser\n    type: web-browser\n    driver: chrome\n    host: localhost\n    port: 9222\n    timeout: 30s\n    actions:\n      - id: navigate\n        method: navigate\n        url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n        wait_until: networkidle\n\n      - id: check-captcha\n        method: evaluate\n        expression: &gt;\n          !!(document.querySelector('[id*=captcha],[class*=captcha]')\n            || document.querySelector('iframe[src*=captcha]'))\n\n      - id: extract-text\n        method: extract\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Login and Scrape Protected Content</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: login-and-scrape\n    jobs:\n      - id: open-login\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.login_url}\n\n      - id: fill-username\n        component: browser\n        action: type-text\n        input:\n          selector: &quot;input[name='username']&quot;\n          text: ${input.username}\n        depends_on: [ open-login ]\n\n      - id: fill-password\n        component: browser\n        action: type-text\n        input:\n          selector: &quot;input[name='password']&quot;\n          text: ${input.password}\n        depends_on: [ fill-username ]\n\n      - id: submit\n        component: browser\n        action: click\n        input:\n          selector: &quot;button[type='submit']&quot;\n        depends_on: [ fill-password ]\n\n      - id: navigate-content\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.content_url}\n        depends_on: [ submit ]\n\n      - id: extract-content\n        component: browser\n        action: extract-text\n        input:\n          selector: ${input.selector}\n        depends_on: [ navigate-content ]\n        output:\n          content: ${output as text}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: browser\n    type: web-browser\n    driver: chrome\n    host: localhost\n    port: 9222\n    timeout: 30s\n    actions:\n      - id: navigate\n        method: navigate\n        url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n        wait_until: networkidle\n\n      - id: type-text\n        method: input-text\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        text: &quot;${input.text}&quot;\n\n      - id: click\n        method: click\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n\n      - id: extract-text\n        method: extract\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Chrome Connection</h2>\n<p>When using the chrome driver, the component connects to a running Chrome/Chromium instance via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. Chrome must be started with remote debugging enabled:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Start Chrome with remote debugging\ngoogle-chrome --remote-debugging-port=9222 --headless --no-sandbox\n\n# Or using Docker\ndocker run -d -p 9222:9222 -p 6080:6080 \\\n  chromedp/headless-shell:latest\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Connection Methods</h3>\n<p><strong>Auto-discovery (default):</strong>\nThe component queries <code>http://&lt;host&gt;:&lt;port&gt;/json</code> to discover browser targets and connects via WebSocket.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  host: localhost\n  port: 9222\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Direct WebSocket URL:</strong>\nSkip auto-discovery by providing the full WebSocket URL.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  driver: chrome\n  endpoint: &quot;ws://localhost:9222/devtools/page/ABC123&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Timeout Configuration</h2>\n<h3>Component-Level Timeout</h3>\n<p>Apply to all actions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: navigate\n      method: navigate\n      url: &quot;https://example.com&quot;\n\n    - id: extract\n      method: extract\n      selector: &quot;.content&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Action-Level Timeout</h3>\n<p>Override for specific actions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: quick-check\n      method: evaluate\n      expression: &quot;document.readyState&quot;\n      timeout: 5s\n\n    - id: slow-navigation\n      method: navigate\n      url: &quot;https://slow-site.example.com&quot;\n      wait_until: networkidle\n      timeout: 120s\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Human-in-the-Loop with noVNC</h2>\n<p>For human-in-the-loop workflows (e.g., CAPTCHA resolution), use the workflow <code>interrupt</code> feature with <code>metadata</code> to provide the noVNC URL. This keeps the VNC connection details in the workflow definition where the interrupt occurs, rather than in the component configuration.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: detect-captcha\n    component: browser\n    action: check-captcha\n    interrupt:\n      after:\n        condition:\n          operator: eq\n          input: ${job.output}\n          value: true\n        message: &quot;CAPTCHA detected! Please solve it via noVNC.&quot;\n        metadata:\n          novnc_url: &quot;http://localhost:6080/vnc.html&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p>The <code>metadata</code> is included in the interrupt response, allowing UIs to show a direct link to the browser session.</p>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Web browser actions support dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-browser\n  action:\n    method: ${input.action_method | &quot;navigate&quot;}\n    url: ${input.target_url}\n    selector: ${input.css_selector}\n    text: ${input.text_to_type}\n    wait_until: ${input.wait_event | &quot;load&quot;}\n    timeout: ${input.timeout | &quot;30s&quot;}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Use <code>networkidle</code> for SPAs</strong>: For single-page applications, use <code>wait_until: networkidle</code> to ensure content is fully loaded</li>\n<li><strong>Prefer CSS Selectors</strong>: CSS selectors are generally faster than XPath expressions</li>\n<li><strong>Set Appropriate Timeouts</strong>: Increase timeout for slow pages, reduce for quick checks</li>\n<li><strong>Use <code>wait-for</code> Before Extraction</strong>: Wait for dynamic content to render before extracting</li>\n<li><strong>Clear Fields Before Typing</strong>: Keep <code>clear_first: true</code> (default) to avoid appending to existing input values</li>\n<li><strong>Manage Cookies</strong>: Use <code>get-cookies</code>/<code>set-cookies</code> to preserve login state across sessions</li>\n<li><strong>Human Fallback</strong>: Use workflow <code>interrupt</code> with <code>metadata.novnc_url</code> for CAPTCHA or MFA scenarios</li>\n<li><strong>Headless Chrome</strong>: Run Chrome headless in production for better performance</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Web Scraping</strong>: Navigate and extract content from dynamic JavaScript-heavy sites</li>\n<li><strong>Form Automation</strong>: Fill and submit web forms programmatically</li>\n<li><strong>CAPTCHA Handling</strong>: Detect CAPTCHAs and pause for human resolution</li>\n<li><strong>Login Automation</strong>: Automate login flows to access protected content</li>\n<li><strong>Visual Testing</strong>: Capture screenshots for visual comparison</li>\n<li><strong>Cookie Management</strong>: Inject or export cookies for authenticated sessions</li>\n<li><strong>Page Monitoring</strong>: Periodically check page content for changes</li>\n<li><strong>Data Extraction</strong>: Extract structured data from web pages using CSS/XPath</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Web Browser Component"
      }
    },

      "slug": "reference/compose/components/web-scraper",
      "html": "<h1>Web Scraper Component</h1>\n<p>The web scraper component enables extracting data from web pages using CSS selectors or XPath expressions. It supports both simple HTTP requests and JavaScript rendering with browser automation, form submission, and cookie injection.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    selector: .content\n    extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>web-scraper</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Default HTTP headers to include in all requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cookies</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Default cookies to include in all requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>60s</code></td>\n<td>Default timeout for all requests</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of web scraping actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>Web scraper actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>URL to scrape</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>headers</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>HTTP headers to include in the request</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>cookies</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Cookies to include in the request</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector to extract elements (mutually exclusive with <code>xpath</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath expression to extract elements (mutually exclusive with <code>selector</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>extract_mode</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>Extraction mode: <code>text</code>, <code>html</code>, or <code>attribute</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>attribute</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Attribute name to extract when <code>extract_mode='attribute'</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>multiple</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Extract multiple elements (returns list) or single element</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>enable_javascript</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Enable JavaScript rendering (requires playwright)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait_for</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector to wait for when <code>enable_javascript=true</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Maximum time to wait for request completion</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>submit</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Form submission configuration (requires <code>enable_javascript=true</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Form Submission Configuration</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>selector</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector to locate form or submit button</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>xpath</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>XPath expression to locate form or submit button</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>form</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Form input values to fill. Keys are input selectors, values are input values</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait_for</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>CSS selector to wait for after form submission</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Page Scraping</h3>\n<p>Extract text content using CSS selector:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/blog\n    selector: article.post-content\n    extract_mode: text\n    output:\n      content: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Extract Multiple Elements</h3>\n<p>Scrape multiple items from a list:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://news.ycombinator.com\n    selector: .titleline &gt; a\n    extract_mode: text\n    multiple: true\n    output:\n      titles: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Extract Attributes</h3>\n<p>Get links from anchor tags:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    selector: a.product-link\n    extract_mode: attribute\n    attribute: href\n    multiple: true\n    output:\n      product_urls: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Using XPath</h3>\n<p>Extract data using XPath expressions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    xpath: //div[@class='price']/text()\n    extract_mode: text\n    output:\n      price: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>JavaScript Rendering</h3>\n<p>Scrape dynamic content that requires JavaScript:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://spa.example.com\n    enable_javascript: true\n    wait_for: .dynamic-content\n    selector: .data\n    extract_mode: text\n    output:\n      scraped_data: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Cookie Injection</h3>\n<p>Scrape authenticated pages using cookies:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/dashboard\n    cookies:\n      session_id: ${env.SESSION_ID}\n      auth_token: ${env.AUTH_TOKEN}\n    selector: .user-data\n    extract_mode: text\n    output:\n      user_info: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Custom Headers</h3>\n<p>Include custom headers in requests:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://api.example.com/data\n    headers:\n      User-Agent: &quot;Mozilla/5.0 (Custom Bot)&quot;\n      Accept-Language: &quot;en-US&quot;\n    selector: .api-response\n    extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Form Submission</h3>\n<p>Fill and submit forms before extraction:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/search\n    enable_javascript: true\n    submit:\n      selector: form#search-form\n      form:\n        input[name=&quot;q&quot;]: ${input.search_query}\n        input[name=&quot;category&quot;]: technology\n      wait_for: .search-results\n    selector: .result-item\n    extract_mode: text\n    multiple: true\n    output:\n      search_results: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Multiple Actions Component</h2>\n<p>Define multiple scraping tasks for different pages:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  headers:\n    User-Agent: &quot;Mozilla/5.0 (Custom Bot)&quot;\n  cookies:\n    session: ${env.SESSION_COOKIE}\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: scrape-homepage\n      url: https://example.com\n      selector: .hero-title\n      extract_mode: text\n      output:\n        title: ${result}\n\n    - id: scrape-products\n      url: https://example.com/products\n      selector: .product-card\n      extract_mode: html\n      multiple: true\n      output:\n        products: ${result}\n\n    - id: scrape-prices\n      url: https://example.com/products\n      selector: .price\n      extract_mode: text\n      multiple: true\n      output:\n        prices: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Advanced Configuration Examples</h2>\n<h3>Dynamic Scraping with Variable URLs</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/product/${input.product_id}\n    selector: .product-details\n    extract_mode: html\n    output:\n      details: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Scraping with Authentication</h3>\n<p>Combine cookies and headers for authenticated scraping:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://secure.example.com/data\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_TOKEN}\n      X-Request-ID: ${input.request_id}\n    cookies:\n      session_id: ${env.SESSION_ID}\n      preferences: ${input.user_prefs}\n    selector: .protected-content\n    extract_mode: text\n    output:\n      content: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multi-Step Scraping</h3>\n<p>Scrape data after multiple interactions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/search\n    enable_javascript: true\n    submit:\n      selector: form#search-form\n      form:\n        input[name=&quot;query&quot;]: ${input.search_term}\n        select[name=&quot;filter&quot;]: ${input.filter_option}\n      wait_for: .results-loaded\n    selector: .search-result\n    extract_mode: html\n    multiple: true\n    timeout: 60s\n    output:\n      results: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Extract Full Page Content</h3>\n<p>Get the entire page content without selectors:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/article\n    extract_mode: text\n    output:\n      full_text: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Extract Raw HTML</h3>\n<p>Get HTML source of specific elements:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    selector: article\n    extract_mode: html\n    output:\n      article_html: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration with Workflows</h2>\n<h3>Sequential Scraping</h3>\n<p>Scrape multiple pages in sequence:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: multi-page-scraper\n    jobs:\n      - id: scrape-list\n        component: list-scraper\n        input:\n          url: https://example.com/products\n        output:\n          product_links: ${output.links}\n\n      - id: scrape-details\n        component: detail-scraper\n        input:\n          urls: ${scrape-list.output.product_links}\n        depends_on: [ scrape-list ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: list-scraper\n    type: web-scraper\n    action:\n      url: ${input.url}\n      selector: a.product-link\n      extract_mode: attribute\n      attribute: href\n      multiple: true\n      output:\n        links: ${result}\n\n  - id: detail-scraper\n    type: web-scraper\n    action:\n      url: ${input.url}\n      selector: .product-description\n      extract_mode: text\n      output:\n        description: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Scraping and Processing</h3>\n<p>Combine scraping with data processing:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: scrape-and-analyze\n    jobs:\n      - id: scrape\n        component: web-scraper\n        input:\n          url: ${input.target_url}\n        output:\n          raw_content: ${output.content}\n\n      - id: analyze\n        component: text-analyzer\n        input:\n          text: ${scrape.output.raw_content}\n        depends_on: [ scrape ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: web-scraper\n    type: web-scraper\n    action:\n      url: ${input.url}\n      selector: .main-content\n      extract_mode: text\n      output:\n        content: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Authenticated Scraping Pipeline</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: authenticated-scraping\n    jobs:\n      - id: login\n        component: login-form\n        input:\n          username: ${env.USERNAME}\n          password: ${env.PASSWORD}\n        output:\n          session_cookie: ${output.cookie}\n\n      - id: scrape-protected\n        component: protected-scraper\n        input:\n          session: ${login.output.session_cookie}\n        depends_on: [ login ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: login-form\n    type: web-scraper\n    action:\n      url: https://example.com/login\n      enable_javascript: true\n      submit:\n        selector: form#login-form\n        form:\n          input[name=&quot;username&quot;]: ${input.username}\n          input[name=&quot;password&quot;]: ${input.password}\n        wait_for: .dashboard\n      # Extract session cookie from browser context\n      output:\n        cookie: ${result}\n\n  - id: protected-scraper\n    type: web-scraper\n    action:\n      url: https://example.com/protected/data\n      cookies:\n        session: ${input.session}\n      selector: .protected-content\n      extract_mode: text\n      output:\n        data: ${result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Extract Modes Comparison</h2>\n<h3>Text Mode</h3>\n<p>Extracts clean text content without HTML tags:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    selector: .article\n    extract_mode: text\n    # Output: &quot;This is the article content&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>HTML Mode</h3>\n<p>Extracts full HTML including tags:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    selector: .article\n    extract_mode: html\n    # Output: &quot;&lt;div class='article'&gt;This is the article content&lt;/div&gt;&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Attribute Mode</h3>\n<p>Extracts specific HTML attributes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com\n    selector: img.product\n    extract_mode: attribute\n    attribute: src\n    # Output: &quot;https://example.com/image.jpg&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Timeout Configuration</h2>\n<h3>Component-Level Timeout</h3>\n<p>Apply to all actions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: scrape-1\n      url: https://example.com/page1\n      selector: .content\n\n    - id: scrape-2\n      url: https://example.com/page2\n      selector: .content\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Action-Level Timeout</h3>\n<p>Override for specific actions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  timeout: 30s\n  actions:\n    - id: quick-scrape\n      url: https://example.com/fast\n      selector: .content\n      timeout: 10s\n\n    - id: slow-scrape\n      url: https://example.com/slow\n      selector: .content\n      timeout: 120s\n      enable_javascript: true\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Cookie Management</h2>\n<h3>Component-Level Cookies</h3>\n<p>Shared across all actions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  cookies:\n    session_id: ${env.SESSION_ID}\n    tracking_consent: &quot;true&quot;\n  actions:\n    - id: scrape-page-1\n      url: https://example.com/page1\n      selector: .content\n\n    - id: scrape-page-2\n      url: https://example.com/page2\n      selector: .content\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Action-Level Cookie Override</h3>\n<p>Override cookies for specific actions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  cookies:\n    default_cookie: &quot;value&quot;\n  actions:\n    - id: normal-scrape\n      url: https://example.com/public\n      selector: .content\n      # Uses default_cookie\n\n    - id: special-scrape\n      url: https://example.com/special\n      selector: .content\n      cookies:\n        special_auth: ${env.SPECIAL_TOKEN}\n        # Merges with default_cookie\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Dynamic Cookie Injection</h3>\n<p>Use variables for dynamic cookie values:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: https://example.com/user/profile\n    cookies:\n      user_id: ${input.user_id}\n      session_token: ${input.session}\n      preferences: ${input.prefs | &quot;default&quot;}\n    selector: .user-data\n    extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Use CSS Selectors for Simplicity</strong>: Prefer CSS selectors over XPath when possible</li>\n<li><strong>Enable JavaScript Sparingly</strong>: Only use <code>enable_javascript</code> when necessary (it's slower)</li>\n<li><strong>Set Appropriate Timeouts</strong>: Adjust timeout based on page complexity</li>\n<li><strong>Handle Multiple Elements</strong>: Use <code>multiple: true</code> for lists and collections</li>\n<li><strong>Respect robots.txt</strong>: Check site's scraping policy before deployment</li>\n<li><strong>Use Headers Wisely</strong>: Set realistic User-Agent and other headers</li>\n<li><strong>Cookie Security</strong>: Store sensitive cookies in environment variables</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Implement fallback strategies for failed scraping</li>\n<li><strong>Rate Limiting</strong>: Add delays between requests to avoid overwhelming servers</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Web scraper supports dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: web-scraper\n  action:\n    url: ${input.target_url}\n    selector: ${input.selector_pattern}\n    extract_mode: ${input.mode | &quot;text&quot;}\n    multiple: ${input.extract_multiple as boolean | false}\n    enable_javascript: ${input.needs_js as boolean | false}\n    headers:\n      User-Agent: ${input.user_agent | &quot;Mozilla/5.0&quot;}\n    cookies:\n      session: ${env.SESSION_COOKIE}\n      custom: ${input.custom_cookie}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Data Aggregation</strong>: Collect data from multiple web sources</li>\n<li><strong>Price Monitoring</strong>: Track product prices across e-commerce sites</li>\n<li><strong>Content Extraction</strong>: Extract articles, blog posts, or news content</li>\n<li><strong>SEO Analysis</strong>: Gather meta tags, headings, and page structure</li>\n<li><strong>Market Research</strong>: Collect competitor data and market intelligence</li>\n<li><strong>Form Automation</strong>: Auto-fill and submit web forms</li>\n<li><strong>Testing</strong>: Validate web page content and structure</li>\n<li><strong>Monitoring</strong>: Check website availability and content changes</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Web Scraper Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/components/workflow",
      "html": "<h1>Workflow Component</h1>\n<p>The workflow component enables invoking and orchestrating other workflows within your model-compose application. It allows for nested workflow execution, workflow composition, and building complex multi-step processes by combining simpler workflows.</p>\n<h2>Basic Configuration</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  action:\n    workflow: process-documents\n    input:\n      documents: ${input.document_list}\n      options: ${input.processing_options}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Configuration Options</h2>\n<h3>Component Settings</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>workflow</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>actions</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>List of workflow actions</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Action Configuration</h3>\n<p>Workflow actions support the following options:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>workflow</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>Name of the workflow to execute</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>input</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Input data supplied to the workflow</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Usage Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Workflow Invocation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  action:\n    workflow: text-processing\n    input:\n      text: ${input.document_text}\n      language: en\n    output:\n      processed_text: ${response.result}\n      metadata: ${response.metadata}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple Workflow Actions</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: preprocess-data\n      workflow: data-preprocessing\n      input:\n        raw_data: ${input.data}\n        cleaning_rules: ${input.rules}\n      output:\n        cleaned_data: ${response.processed_data}\n    \n    - id: analyze-data\n      workflow: data-analysis\n      input:\n        data: ${input.analysis_data}\n        parameters: ${input.analysis_params}\n      output:\n        analysis_results: ${response.results}\n        \n    - id: generate-report\n      workflow: report-generation\n      input:\n        analysis: ${input.analysis_results}\n        template: ${input.report_template}\n      output:\n        report: ${response.generated_report}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Conditional Workflow Execution</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: basic-processing\n      workflow: basic-text-processing\n      input:\n        text: ${input.text}\n      output:\n        basic_result: ${response.result}\n    \n    - id: advanced-processing\n      workflow: advanced-nlp-processing\n      input:\n        text: ${input.text}\n        enable_advanced: ${input.advanced_mode | false}\n      output:\n        advanced_result: ${response.result}\n        \n    - id: merge-results\n      workflow: result-merger\n      input:\n        basic: ${input.basic_result}\n        advanced: ${input.advanced_result}\n        merge_strategy: enhanced\n      output:\n        final_result: ${response.merged_result}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Workflow Composition Patterns</h2>\n<h3>Sequential Processing Pipeline</h3>\n<p>Create a pipeline of workflows that process data sequentially:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: document-processing-pipeline\n    jobs:\n      - id: extract-text\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: extract\n        input:\n          documents: ${input.documents}\n      \n      - id: clean-text\n        component: workflow-runner  \n        action: clean\n        input:\n          raw_text: ${extract-text.output.extracted_text}\n        depends_on: [ extract-text ]\n      \n      - id: analyze-sentiment\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: analyze\n        input:\n          clean_text: ${clean-text.output.cleaned_text}\n        depends_on: [ clean-text ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: workflow-runner\n    type: workflow\n    actions:\n      - id: extract\n        workflow: text-extraction\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: clean\n        workflow: text-cleaning\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: analyze\n        workflow: sentiment-analysis\n        input: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Parallel Workflow Execution</h3>\n<p>Execute multiple workflows in parallel and combine results:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: multi-model-analysis\n    jobs:\n      - id: model-a-analysis\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: run-model-a\n        input:\n          data: ${input.data}\n      \n      - id: model-b-analysis  \n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: run-model-b\n        input:\n          data: ${input.data}\n          \n      - id: model-c-analysis\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: run-model-c\n        input:\n          data: ${input.data}\n      \n      - id: ensemble-results\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: ensemble\n        input:\n          model_a_result: ${model-a-analysis.output}\n          model_b_result: ${model-b-analysis.output}\n          model_c_result: ${model-c-analysis.output}\n        depends_on: [ model-a-analysis, model-b-analysis, model-c-analysis ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: workflow-runner\n    type: workflow\n    actions:\n      - id: run-model-a\n        workflow: model-a-inference\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: run-model-b\n        workflow: model-b-inference\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: run-model-c\n        workflow: model-c-inference\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: ensemble\n        workflow: ensemble-combining\n        input: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Workflow Branching and Routing</h3>\n<p>Route data to different workflows based on conditions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: classify-document\n      workflow: document-classifier\n      input:\n        document: ${input.document}\n      output:\n        document_type: ${response.classification}\n        confidence: ${response.confidence}\n    \n    - id: process-legal-doc\n      workflow: legal-document-processor\n      input:\n        document: ${input.document}\n        # Only execute if classified as legal document\n        condition: ${input.document_type == legal}\n      output:\n        legal_analysis: ${response.analysis}\n    \n    - id: process-technical-doc\n      workflow: technical-document-processor\n      input:\n        document: ${input.document}\n        condition: ${input.document_type == technical}\n      output:\n        technical_analysis: ${response.analysis}\n        \n    - id: process-general-doc\n      workflow: general-document-processor\n      input:\n        document: ${input.document}\n        condition: ${input.document_type == general}\n      output:\n        general_analysis: ${response.analysis}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Error Handling and Fallbacks</h2>\n<p>Handle workflow failures with fallback workflows:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: primary-processing\n      workflow: advanced-text-processor\n      input:\n        text: ${input.text}\n        advanced_options: ${input.options}\n      output:\n        result: ${response.processed_text}\n      on_error:\n        - id: fallback-processing\n          workflow: basic-text-processor\n          input:\n            text: ${input.text}\n          output:\n            fallback_result: ${response.processed_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Workflow Nesting and Modularity</h2>\n<p>Build complex systems from modular workflow components:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Main orchestration workflow\nworkflows:\n  - id: content-management-system\n    jobs:\n      - id: content-ingestion\n        component: workflow-orchestrator\n        action: ingest-content\n        input:\n          sources: ${input.content_sources}\n      \n      - id: content-processing\n        component: workflow-orchestrator\n        action: process-content\n        input:\n          raw_content: ${content-ingestion.output.ingested_content}\n        depends_on: [ content-ingestion ]\n      \n      - id: content-indexing\n        component: workflow-orchestrator\n        action: index-content\n        input:\n          processed_content: ${content-processing.output.processed_content}\n        depends_on: [ content-processing ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: workflow-orchestrator\n    type: workflow\n    actions:\n      # Content ingestion sub-workflows\n      - id: ingest-content\n        workflow: content-ingestion-pipeline\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      # Content processing sub-workflows  \n      - id: process-content\n        workflow: content-processing-pipeline\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      # Content indexing sub-workflows\n      - id: index-content\n        workflow: content-indexing-pipeline\n        input: ${input}\n\n# Sub-workflows defined separately\nworkflows:\n  - id: content-ingestion-pipeline\n    jobs:\n      - id: fetch-sources\n        component: http-client\n        # ... fetch content from various sources\n      \n      - id: validate-content\n        component: validator\n        # ... validate content format\n        \n  - id: content-processing-pipeline\n    jobs:\n      - id: extract-text\n        component: text-extractor\n        # ... extract text from various formats\n      \n      - id: clean-text\n        component: text-cleaner\n        # ... clean and normalize text\n        \n      - id: generate-embeddings\n        component: embedding-model\n        # ... generate vector embeddings\n        \n  - id: content-indexing-pipeline\n    jobs:\n      - id: store-embeddings\n        component: vector-store\n        # ... store in vector database\n      \n      - id: update-search-index\n        component: search-indexer\n        # ... update search index\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Data Flow and Transformations</h2>\n<p>Transform data between workflows:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: extract-features\n      workflow: feature-extraction\n      input:\n        data: ${input.raw_data}\n        feature_types: [ textual, numerical, categorical ]\n      output:\n        features: ${response.extracted_features}\n        \n    - id: transform-features\n      workflow: feature-transformation\n      input:\n        raw_features: ${input.features}\n        transformations:\n          - type: normalize\n            columns: [ numerical_features ]\n          - type: encode  \n            columns: [ categorical_features ]\n      output:\n        transformed_features: ${response.features}\n        \n    - id: train-model\n      workflow: model-training\n      input:\n        features: ${input.transformed_features}\n        labels: ${input.labels}\n        model_type: random_forest\n      output:\n        trained_model: ${response.model}\n        metrics: ${response.evaluation_metrics}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Batch and Streaming Processing</h2>\n<p>Process data in batches or streams using workflows:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: batch-processing\n      workflow: document-batch-processor\n      input:\n        documents: ${input.document_batch}\n        batch_size: 50\n        processing_options:\n          extract_entities: true\n          generate_summaries: true\n      output:\n        processed_batch: ${response.results}\n        \n    - id: streaming-processing\n      workflow: real-time-processor\n      input:\n        data_stream: ${input.stream}\n        window_size: 5m\n        aggregation_function: mean\n      output:\n        aggregated_results: ${response.windowed_results}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Integration Patterns</h2>\n<h3>API Gateway Pattern</h3>\n<p>Use workflows to orchestrate API calls:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: authenticate-user\n      workflow: user-authentication\n      input:\n        credentials: ${input.auth_data}\n      output:\n        auth_token: ${response.token}\n        user_info: ${response.user}\n        \n    - id: authorize-request\n      workflow: request-authorization\n      input:\n        user_info: ${input.user_info}\n        requested_resource: ${input.resource}\n      output:\n        authorized: ${response.allowed}\n        permissions: ${response.permissions}\n        \n    - id: process-request\n      workflow: request-processor\n      input:\n        request_data: ${input.data}\n        user_permissions: ${input.permissions}\n      output:\n        response_data: ${response.result}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Event-Driven Processing</h3>\n<p>Chain workflows based on events:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  actions:\n    - id: handle-user-signup\n      workflow: user-registration-handler\n      input:\n        user_data: ${input.signup_data}\n      output:\n        user_id: ${response.created_user_id}\n        \n    - id: send-welcome-email\n      workflow: email-notification-sender\n      input:\n        user_id: ${input.user_id}\n        email_template: welcome\n      output:\n        email_sent: ${response.success}\n        \n    - id: setup-user-preferences\n      workflow: user-preference-initializer\n      input:\n        user_id: ${input.user_id}\n        default_preferences: ${input.defaults}\n      output:\n        preferences_created: ${response.success}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation</h2>\n<p>Workflow components support dynamic configuration:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: workflow\n  action:\n    workflow: ${input.selected_workflow | default-workflow}\n    input:\n      data: ${input.workflow_data}\n      options:\n        processing_mode: ${env.PROCESSING_MODE | standard}\n        max_retries: ${input.retry_count as integer | 3}\n        timeout: ${input.timeout_seconds as integer | 300}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Modularity</strong>: Design workflows as reusable, focused components</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Implement proper error handling and fallback workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Data Validation</strong>: Validate inputs before passing to sub-workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Resource Management</strong>: Monitor resource usage in nested workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Logging</strong>: Implement comprehensive logging across workflow chains</li>\n<li><strong>Testing</strong>: Test workflows independently and in combination</li>\n<li><strong>Documentation</strong>: Document workflow interfaces and dependencies</li>\n<li><strong>Performance</strong>: Monitor and optimize workflow execution times</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Main Workflows</h2>\n<p>Reference workflow components in main workflow definitions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: main-processing-workflow\n    jobs:\n      - id: preprocess-data\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: data-preprocessing\n        input:\n          raw_data: ${input.data}\n          \n      - id: run-analysis\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: data-analysis\n        input:\n          preprocessed_data: ${preprocess-data.output.data}\n        depends_on: [ preprocess-data ]\n        \n      - id: generate-insights\n        component: workflow-runner\n        action: insight-generation\n        input:\n          analysis_results: ${run-analysis.output.results}\n        depends_on: [ run-analysis ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: workflow-runner\n    type: workflow\n    actions:\n      - id: data-preprocessing\n        workflow: data-preprocessing-pipeline\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: data-analysis\n        workflow: statistical-analysis\n        input: ${input}\n        \n      - id: insight-generation\n        workflow: insight-generator\n        input: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Use Cases</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Microservice Orchestration</strong>: Coordinate calls to multiple microservices</li>\n<li><strong>Multi-Stage Processing</strong>: Build complex processing pipelines</li>\n<li><strong>Batch Job Management</strong>: Orchestrate batch processing workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Event Processing</strong>: Handle complex event-driven scenarios</li>\n<li><strong>API Composition</strong>: Combine multiple API calls into cohesive workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Data Pipeline Management</strong>: Orchestrate data processing stages</li>\n<li><strong>Business Process Automation</strong>: Automate complex business workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Integration Patterns</strong>: Connect disparate systems and services</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Workflow Component"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/compose/controller",
      "html": "<h1>Controller Configuration Reference</h1>\n<p>The controller section defines the server configuration for handling requests and managing workflows in model-compose. Controllers serve as the entry point for executing workflows and can be configured as HTTP servers, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, or queue subscribers for distributed task processing.</p>\n<h2>Basic Structure</h2>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server | mcp-server | queue-subscriber\n  name: optional-controller-name\n  host: 0.0.0.0\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  origins: &quot;*&quot;\n  max_concurrent_count: 1\n  threaded: false\n  runtime:\n    type: native | docker\n  queue:\n    driver: redis\n    url: redis://localhost:6379\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio | static | dynamic\n    host: 0.0.0.0\n    port: 8081\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Controller Types</h2>\n<h3>HTTP Server (<code>http-server</code>)</h3>\n<p>Creates an HTTP server that exposes workflows as REST API endpoints.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  host: 0.0.0.0        # Host address to bind the server to\n  port: 8080             # Port number for the HTTP server\n  base_path: /api      # Base path prefix for all API routes\n  origins: &quot;*&quot;           # CORS allowed origins (comma-separated)\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n</code></pre>\n<h3>MCP Server (<code>mcp-server</code>)</h3>\n<p>Creates an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for integration with MCP-compatible clients.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: mcp-server\n  host: 0.0.0.0        # Host address to bind the MCP server to\n  port: 8080             # Port number for the MCP server\n  base_path: /mcp      # Base path prefix for MCP endpoints\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Example:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: mcp-server\n  base_path: /mcp\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Queue Subscriber (<code>queue-subscriber</code>)</h3>\n<p>Creates a queue subscriber that consumes tasks from a message queue (e.g., Redis) and executes workflows. Used for distributed worker patterns where multiple model-compose instances process tasks from a shared queue.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Using URL\ncontroller:\n  type: queue-subscriber\n  driver: redis\n  url: redis://localhost:6379\n\n# Using host/port\ncontroller:\n  type: queue-subscriber\n  driver: redis\n  host: localhost\n  port: 6379\n</code></pre>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Note</strong>: Unlike <code>http-server</code> and <code>mcp-server</code>, the <code>queue-subscriber</code> type does not expose HTTP endpoints. It operates as a background worker that pulls tasks from the queue.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h4>Queue Subscriber Settings</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>driver</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Queue backend driver. Currently supported: <code>redis</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>name</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>model-compose:tasks</code></td>\n<td>Base name for task queues. Queue key: <code>{name}:{workflow_id}</code>. Result key: <code>{name}:{workflow_id}:{run_id}</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>result_ttl</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>3600</code></td>\n<td>TTL in seconds for result entries. <code>0</code> means no expiry</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>max_concurrent_count</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>1</code></td>\n<td>Maximum number of tasks processed concurrently</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>worker_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Unique worker identifier. Auto-generated (ULID) if not set</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>workflows</code></td>\n<td>list</td>\n<td><code>[&quot;__default__&quot;]</code></td>\n<td>Workflow IDs to handle. Each gets its own queue: <code>{name}:{workflow_id}</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>workflow</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Shorthand for single workflow. Inflated to <code>workflows: [value]</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Redis Driver Settings</h4>\n<p>Connection can be configured using either <code>url</code> or <code>host</code>/<code>port</code>/<code>secure</code> fields. If both <code>url</code> and <code>host</code> are provided, validation will fail.</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>url</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Redis connection URL (e.g., <code>redis://localhost:6379</code>, <code>rediss://localhost:6379</code> for TLS). Mutually exclusive with <code>host</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>host</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>localhost</code></td>\n<td>Redis server hostname or IP address. Mutually exclusive with <code>url</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>port</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>6379</code></td>\n<td>Redis server port number (1-65535)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>secure</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Use TLS/SSL for connections (equivalent to <code>rediss://</code> protocol)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>database</code></td>\n<td>integer</td>\n<td><code>0</code></td>\n<td>Redis database number (0-15)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>password</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Redis password.
