the most common job type.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: api-call\n    type: component\n    component: http-client\n    action: post-data\n    input:\n      data: ${input.payload}\n    repeat_count: 1\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration:</strong>\n| Field | Type | Default | Description |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| <code>type</code> | string | <code>component</code> | Job type (can be omitted, defaults to component) |\n| <code>component</code> | string/object | <code>&quot;__default__&quot;</code> | Component to execute |\n| <code>action</code> | string | <code>&quot;__default__&quot;</code> | Action to invoke on the component |\n| <code>input</code> | any | <code>null</code> | Input data for the component |\n| <code>repeat_count</code> | integer/string | <code>1</code> | Number of times to repeat execution |</p>\n<h3>Delay Job (<code>delay</code>)</h3>\n<p>Add time delays or wait conditions in workflow execution.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: wait\n    type: delay\n    mode: time-interval\n    interval: 5s\n    \n  - id: wait-for-condition\n    type: delay\n    mode: condition\n    condition: ${some.variable == &quot;ready&quot;}\n    timeout: 30s\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration:</strong>\n| Field | Type | Default | Description |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| <code>type</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Must be <code>delay</code> |\n| <code>mode</code> | string | <code>time-interval</code> | Delay mode: <code>time-interval</code> or <code>condition</code> |\n| <code>interval</code> | string | <code>null</code> | Time to wait (e.g., &quot;5s&quot;, &quot;2m&quot;) |\n| <code>condition</code> | string | <code>null</code> | Condition to wait for (condition mode) |\n| <code>timeout</code> | string | <code>null</code> | Maximum time to wait for condition |</p>\n<h3>Conditional Job (<code>if</code>)</h3>\n<p>Execute jobs based on conditions.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: conditional-step\n    type: if\n    condition: ${input.process_mode == &quot;advanced&quot;}\n    then:\n      - id: advanced-processing\n        component: advanced-processor\n    else:\n      - id: simple-processing\n        component: simple-processor\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration:</strong>\n| Field | Type | Default | Description |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| <code>type</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Must be <code>if</code> |\n| <code>condition</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Condition expression to evaluate |\n| <code>then</code> | array | <code>[]</code> | Jobs to execute if condition is true |\n| <code>else</code> | array | <code>[]</code> | Jobs to execute if condition is false |</p>\n<h3>Switch Job (<code>switch</code>)</h3>\n<p>Route execution based on multiple conditions.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: router\n    type: switch\n    value: ${input.operation_type}\n    cases:\n      create:\n        - id: create-job\n          component: creator\n      update:\n        - id: update-job\n          component: updater\n      delete:\n        - id: delete-job\n          component: deleter\n    default:\n      - id: error-job\n        component: error-handler\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration:</strong>\n| Field | Type | Default | Description |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| <code>type</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Must be <code>switch</code> |\n| <code>value</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Value expression to match against |\n| <code>cases</code> | object | <code>{}</code> | Map of case values to job lists |\n| <code>default</code> | array | <code>[]</code> | Jobs to execute if no case matches |</p>\n<h3>Random Router Job (<code>random-router</code>)</h3>\n<p>Randomly distribute execution across multiple job paths.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: load-balancer\n    type: random-router\n    routes:\n      - weight: 70\n        jobs:\n          - id: primary-server\n            component: server-a\n      - weight: 30\n        jobs:\n          - id: backup-server\n            component: server-b\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration:</strong>\n| Field | Type | Default | Description |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| <code>type</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Must be <code>random-router</code> |\n| <code>routes</code> | array | <strong>required</strong> | List of weighted route configurations |\n| <code>routes[].weight</code> | integer | <strong>required</strong> | Weight for this route (higher = more likely) |\n| <code>routes[].jobs</code> | array | <strong>required</strong> | Jobs to execute for this route |</p>\n<h3>Filter Job (<code>filter</code>)</h3>\n<p>Filter and transform data arrays.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: filter-data\n    type: filter\n    items: ${input.records}\n    condition: ${item.status == &quot;active&quot;}\n    output:\n      filtered_items: ${items}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration:</strong>\n| Field | Type | Default | Description |\n|-------|------|---------|-------------|\n| <code>type</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Must be <code>filter</code> |\n| <code>items</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Expression that returns an array to filter |\n| <code>condition</code> | string | <strong>required</strong> | Filter condition (use <code>item</code> to refer to current item) |</p>\n<h2>Job Dependencies and Execution Order</h2>\n<h3>Sequential Execution</h3>\n<p>Jobs execute in the order they are defined by default:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: step1\n    component: first-component\n    \n  - id: step2\n    component: second-component\n    input: ${step1.output}  # Uses output from step1\n    \n  - id: step3\n    component: third-component\n    input: ${step2.output}  # Uses output from step2\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Explicit Dependencies</h3>\n<p>Use <code>depends_on</code> to specify explicit dependencies:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: parallel-job-1\n    component: component-a\n    \n  - id: parallel-job-2 \n    component: component-b\n    \n  - id: final-job\n    component: component-c\n    depends_on: [&quot;parallel-job-1&quot;, &quot;parallel-job-2&quot;]\n    input:\n      result1: ${parallel-job-1.output}\n      result2: ${parallel-job-2.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Variable Interpolation and Data Flow</h2>\n<h3>Input Variables</h3>\n<p>Access workflow input data:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">input: ${input.user_prompt}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Job Outputs</h3>\n<p>Reference outputs from previous jobs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">input: ${previous-job.output}\n# or access specific fields\ninput: ${api-call.output.data.results[0].name}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Jobs Context</h3>\n<p>Access all job outputs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">input:\n  step1_result: ${jobs.step1.output}\n  step2_result: ${jobs.step2.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Type Conversion</h3>\n<p>Convert data types:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">input:\n  count: ${input.number as integer}\n  temperature: ${input.temp as number | 0.7}\n  enabled: ${input.flag as boolean}\n  data: ${response as json}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Default Values</h3>\n<p>Provide fallback values:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">input:\n  model: ${input.model | &quot;gpt-4o&quot;}\n  max_tokens: ${input.max_tokens | 1000}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Output Configuration</h2>\n<p>Define workflow outputs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: process\n      component: processor\n      \n  output:\n    result: ${process.output.data}\n    status: completed\n    metadata:\n      execution_time: ${process.execution_time}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Workflow Examples</h2>\n<h3>Simple Linear Workflow</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  title: Text Processing Pipeline\n  description: Process text input through multiple stages\n  jobs:\n    - id: clean-text\n      component: text-cleaner\n      input: ${input.text}\n      \n    - id: analyze-sentiment \n      component: sentiment-analyzer\n      input: ${clean-text.output}\n      \n    - id: generate-summary\n      component: summarizer\n      input: ${clean-text.output}\n      \n  output:\n    cleaned_text: ${clean-text.output}\n    sentiment: ${analyze-sentiment.output}\n    summary: ${generate-summary.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Conditional Workflow</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  title: Smart Image Processing\n  jobs:\n    - id: detect-content\n      component: image-analyzer\n      input: ${input.image}\n      \n    - id: process-image\n      type: if\n      condition: ${detect-content.output.has_faces == true}\n      then:\n        - id: face-processing\n          component: face-processor\n          input: ${input.image}\n      else:\n        - id: general-processing\n          component: general-processor\n          input: ${input.image}\n          \n  output: ${process-image.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Parallel Processing Workflow</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  title: Multi-Model Analysis\n  jobs:\n    - id: model-a-analysis\n      component: model-a\n      input: ${input}\n      \n    - id: model-b-analysis\n      component: model-b  \n      input: ${input}\n      \n    - id: model-c-analysis\n      component: model-c\n      input: ${input}\n      \n    - id: aggregate-results\n      component: aggregator\n      depends_on: [&quot;model-a-analysis&quot;, &quot;model-b-analysis&quot;, &quot;model-c-analysis&quot;]\n      input:\n        results:\n          - ${model-a-analysis.output}\n          - ${model-b-analysis.output}  \n          - ${model-c-analysis.output}\n          \n  output: ${aggregate-results.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Complex Routing Workflow</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  title: Request Router\n  jobs:\n    - id: classify-request\n      component: classifier\n      input: ${input}\n      \n    - id: route-request\n      type: switch\n      value: ${classify-request.output.category}\n      cases:\n        urgent:\n          - id: urgent-handler\n            component: urgent-processor\n            input: ${input}\n        normal:\n          - id: normal-handler\n            component: normal-processor\n            input: ${input}\n        bulk:\n          - id: bulk-handler\n            component: bulk-processor\n            input: ${input}\n      default:\n        - id: default-handler\n          component: default-processor\n          input: ${input}\n          \n  output: ${route-request.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Workflow Variable Types</h2>\n<p>When defining input/output schemas, workflows support rich variable types:</p>\n<h3>Basic Types</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">variables:\n  - name: user_input\n    type: text\n    required: true\n  - name: count  \n    type: integer\n    default: 10\n  - name: enabled\n    type: boolean\n    default: false\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Media Types</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">variables:\n  - name: profile_image\n    type: image\n    format: base64\n  - name: audio_file\n    type: audio\n    format: url\n  - name: document\n    type: file\n    format: path\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Selection Types</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">variables:\n  - name: model_choice\n    type: select\n    options: [&quot;gpt-4o&quot;, &quot;gpt-3.5-turbo&quot;, &quot;claude-3&quot;]\n    default: gpt-4o\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Job Naming</strong>: Use descriptive job IDs that indicate their purpose</li>\n<li><strong>Error Handling</strong>: Include error handling jobs for critical workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Dependencies</strong>: Use explicit <code>depends_on</code> for complex dependency graphs</li>\n<li><strong>Data Flow</strong>: Keep data transformations simple and readable</li>\n<li><strong>Testing</strong>: Test workflows with different input scenarios</li>\n<li><strong>Documentation</strong>: Use <code>title</code> and <code>description</code> fields for clarity</li>\n<li><strong>Modularity</strong>: Break complex workflows into smaller, reusable components</li>\n<li><strong>Performance</strong>: Consider parallel execution where possible</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Integration with Components</h2>\n<p>Workflows orchestrate components through the job system:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: api-client\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.example.com\n    \n  - id: data-processor\n    type: shell\n    command: python process.py\n\nworkflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: fetch-data\n      component: api-client\n      action: get-data\n      \n    - id: process-data\n      component: data-processor\n      input: ${fetch-data.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Common Patterns</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>ETL Pipelines</strong>: Extract, Transform, Load data processing</li>\n<li><strong>API Orchestration</strong>: Coordinating multiple API calls</li>\n<li><strong>Content Processing</strong>: Multi-stage content analysis and generation</li>\n<li><strong>Conditional Logic</strong>: Dynamic execution based on input or intermediate results</li>\n<li><strong>Error Recovery</strong>: Fallback and retry mechanisms</li>\n<li><strong>Load Balancing</strong>: Distributing work across multiple components</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Workflow Configuration Reference"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "reference/websocket",
      "html": "<h1>WebSocket Interface Reference</h1>\n<p>The <code>http-server</code> controller exposes a WebSocket endpoint for real-time, bidirectional communication. This reference documents every message type sent over that connection.</p>\n<p>For configuration options and usage patterns, see the <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/08-websocket-interface\">WebSocket Interface user guide</a>.</p>\n<h2>Endpoint</h2>\n<pre><code>ws://&lt;host&gt;:&lt;port&gt;&lt;base_path&gt;/ws\n</code></pre>\n<p>The path component (default <code>/ws</code>) is configurable via <code>controller.websocket.path</code>. The <code>base_path</code> prefix (e.g. <code>/api</code>) applies if set on the controller. When the controller is configured with <code>base_path: /api</code>, the endpoint is <code>ws://host:port/api/ws</code>.</p>\n<h3>Query Parameters</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Parameter</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session</code></td>\n<td>Client-supplied session ID. Auto-generated UUID if omitted. Duplicate connections with the same session are rejected with close code <code>4409</code>.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task</code></td>\n<td>Optional task ID to auto-subscribe to on connection. Equivalent to sending a <code>subscribe_task</code> message immediately after connect.</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Message Envelope</h2>\n<p>All messages are JSON objects with this shape:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;&lt;message_type&gt;&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;&lt;optional_request_id&gt;&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: { ... }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Message type identifier</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>no</td>\n<td>Echoed back in responses for request-response correlation</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>data</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td>varies</td>\n<td>Message payload. Some types (e.g. <code>ping</code>) accept an empty body.</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Client → Server Messages</h2>\n<h3><code>run_workflow</code></h3>\n<p>Execute a workflow.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;run_workflow&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-001&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;workflow_id&quot;: &quot;chat-completion&quot;,\n    &quot;input&quot;: { &quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;Hello&quot; },\n    &quot;metadata&quot;: { &quot;user&quot;: &quot;alice&quot; },\n    &quot;session_id&quot;: &quot;session-abc&quot;,\n    &quot;subscribe_task&quot;: true\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>workflow_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>__default__</code></td>\n<td>Workflow to execute</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>input</code></td>\n<td>object</td>\n<td><code>{}</code></td>\n<td>Workflow input parameters</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>metadata</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Free-form metadata stored on the task</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>connection session</td>\n<td>Override the session id for this task</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>subscribe_task</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Auto-subscribe to subsequent <code>task_state</code> / <code>job_event</code> updates</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Response:</strong> <code>workflow_started</code>, followed by <code>task_state</code> and <code>job_event</code> messages if subscribed.</p>\n<h3><code>subscribe_task</code></h3>\n<p>Subscribe to updates for an existing task.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;subscribe_task&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-002&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: { &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot; }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Target task ID (ULID)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Response:</strong> <code>task_subscribed</code> with the current state, followed by future <code>task_state</code> and <code>job_event</code> messages.</p>\n<h3><code>unsubscribe_task</code></h3>\n<p>Stop receiving updates for a task.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;unsubscribe_task&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-003&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: { &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot; }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Response:</strong> <code>task_unsubscribed</code>.</p>\n<h3><code>resume_task</code></h3>\n<p>Resume an interrupted workflow. Equivalent to <code>POST /tasks/{task_id}/resume</code>.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;resume_task&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-004&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n    &quot;job_id&quot;: &quot;review-step&quot;,\n    &quot;answer&quot;: { &quot;approved&quot;: true }\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Required</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Task to resume</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>job_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>yes</td>\n<td>Must match the interrupted job (<code>interrupt.job_id</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>answer</code></td>\n<td>any</td>\n<td>no</td>\n<td>Value passed to the workflow as the interrupt answer</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Response:</strong> <code>task_resumed</code> on success, or <code>error</code>.</p>\n<h3><code>get_task</code></h3>\n<p>Query a task's current state once. Does not create a subscription.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;get_task&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-005&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: { &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot; }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Response:</strong> <code>task_state</code> with the current snapshot.</p>\n<h3><code>ping</code></h3>\n<p>Connection liveness check.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{ &quot;type&quot;: &quot;ping&quot;, &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-006&quot; }\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Response:</strong> <code>pong</code>.</p>\n<h2>Server → Client Messages</h2>\n<h3><code>workflow_started</code></h3>\n<p>Sent in response to <code>run_workflow</code>. Acknowledges the task has been accepted and provides its identifier.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;workflow_started&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-001&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n    &quot;workflow_id&quot;: &quot;chat-completion&quot;,\n    &quot;status&quot;: &quot;pending&quot;\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>task_subscribed</code></h3>\n<p>Confirms a subscription and includes the current state at the moment of subscription.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;task_subscribed&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-002&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n    &quot;state&quot;: {\n      &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n      &quot;status&quot;: &quot;processing&quot;,\n      &quot;output&quot;: null,\n      &quot;error&quot;: null,\n      &quot;interrupt&quot;: null\n    }\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>task_unsubscribed</code></h3>\n<p>Confirms a subscription has been removed.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;task_unsubscribed&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-003&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: { &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot; }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>task_state</code></h3>\n<p>Latest-state snapshot of the workflow as a whole. Pushed automatically to subscribers when the task transitions between states.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;task_state&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n    &quot;status&quot;: &quot;completed&quot;,\n    &quot;output&quot;: { &quot;result&quot;: &quot;...&quot; },\n    &quot;error&quot;: null,\n    &quot;interrupt&quot;: null,\n    &quot;session_id&quot;: null,\n    &quot;metadata&quot;: null,\n    &quot;timestamp&quot;: &quot;2026-02-06T12:34:56.789Z&quot;\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Task ID</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>status</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>&quot;pending&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;processing&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;interrupted&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;completed&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;failed&quot;</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>any | null</td>\n<td>Final output on <code>completed</code>. Only JSON-serializable values; non-serializable outputs (e.g. raw images) become <code>null</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>error</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>Error message on <code>failed</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>interrupt</code></td>\n<td>object | null</td>\n<td>Interrupt details on <code>interrupted</code> (<code>job_id</code>, <code>phase</code>, <code>message</code>, <code>metadata</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>session_id</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>Session associated with the task</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>metadata</code></td>\n<td>any | null</td>\n<td>Metadata supplied at <code>run_workflow</code> time</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timestamp</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of state change</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3><code>job_event</code></h3>\n<p>Per-job lifecycle event. Pushed to subscribers as each job inside the workflow transitions through its lifecycle. Unlike <code>task_state</code> (which reflects the workflow as a whole), <code>job_event</code> provides fine-grained per-job visibility.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;job_event&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n    &quot;run_id&quot;: &quot;01HRUN...&quot;,\n    &quot;workflow_id&quot;: &quot;chat-completion&quot;,\n    &quot;job_id&quot;: &quot;job-quote&quot;,\n    &quot;event&quot;: &quot;completed&quot;,\n    &quot;elapsed&quot;: 1.78,\n    &quot;output&quot;: { &quot;quote&quot;: &quot;...&quot; },\n    &quot;error&quot;: null,\n    &quot;next_job_id&quot;: null,\n    &quot;timestamp&quot;: &quot;2026-02-06T12:34:56.789Z&quot;\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>task_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Parent task ID</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>run_id</code></td>\n<td>string | string[] | null</td>\n<td>Component action run ID(s). String for a single run, array when <code>repeat_count</code> produces multiple. <code>null</code> for non-component jobs (<code>delay</code>, <code>filter</code>, <code>switch</code>, etc.) or when not yet issued.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>workflow_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Workflow ID</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>job_id</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>Job ID from the workflow config</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>event</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>&quot;started&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;completed&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;failed&quot;</code> | <code>&quot;routed&quot;</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>elapsed</code></td>\n<td>number | null</td>\n<td>Seconds elapsed since job start. Present on <code>completed</code>, <code>failed</code>, <code>routed</code>; <code>null</code> on <code>started</code>.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>output</code></td>\n<td>any | null</td>\n<td>Job output on <code>completed</code> (JSON-serializable only; otherwise <code>null</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>error</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>Error message on <code>failed</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>next_job_id</code></td>\n<td>string | null</td>\n<td>Target job ID on <code>routed</code> (emitted by routing jobs like <code>switch</code>, <code>if</code>, <code>random_router</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>timestamp</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of event emission</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Event values:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th><code>event</code></th>\n<th>When emitted</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>started</code></td>\n<td>Job has been scheduled and its task has begun. <code>run_id</code> may be <code>null</code> because component run IDs are issued only when the action actually executes.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>completed</code></td>\n<td>Job finished successfully. Carries <code>elapsed</code>, <code>output</code>, and <code>run_id</code> when applicable.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>failed</code></td>\n<td>Job raised an exception. Carries <code>elapsed</code>, <code>error</code>, and <code>run_id</code> when applicable. The workflow itself will transition to <code>failed</code> shortly after.</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>routed</code></td>\n<td>A routing job returned a <code>RoutingTarget</code>. Carries <code>elapsed</code>, <code>next_job_id</code>, and <code>run_id</code>. The next job's own <code>started</code> event follows.</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Typical sequences:</strong></p>\n<pre><code>started → completed\nstarted → failed\nstarted → routed → started(next_job) → ...\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Notes:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Delivered to every client subscribed to the parent <code>task_id</code>. No separate <code>subscribe_job_event</code> is needed.</li>\n<li>Unlike <code>task_state</code> (latest-state), <code>job_event</code> is a one-shot event stream. Subscribers connected throughout the task receive each event exactly once; there is no retransmission on reconnect.</li>\n<li><code>output</code> on <code>completed</code> is omitted (or <code>null</code>) when the value isn't JSON-serializable.</li>\n</ul>\n<h3><code>task_resumed</code></h3>\n<p>Sent in response to a successful <code>resume_task</code>.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;task_resumed&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-004&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;task_id&quot;: &quot;01HXYZ...&quot;,\n    &quot;status&quot;: &quot;processing&quot;\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>pong</code></h3>\n<p>Response to <code>ping</code>.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;pong&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-006&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: { &quot;timestamp&quot;: &quot;2026-02-06T12:34:56.789Z&quot; }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3><code>error</code></h3>\n<p>Returned when a client request can't be processed. May carry the <code>id</code> of the request it failed.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;type&quot;: &quot;error&quot;,\n  &quot;id&quot;: &quot;msg-001&quot;,\n  &quot;data&quot;: {\n    &quot;code&quot;: &quot;WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND&quot;,\n    &quot;message&quot;: &quot;Workflow 'invalid-workflow' not found&quot;,\n    &quot;details&quot;: { &quot;workflow_id&quot;: &quot;invalid-workflow&quot; }\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Error codes:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Code</th>\n<th>Meaning</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>INVALID_REQUEST</code></td>\n<td>Malformed JSON or missing required fields</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>WORKFLOW_NOT_FOUND</code></td>\n<td>The specified workflow does not exist</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>TASK_NOT_FOUND</code></td>\n<td>The specified task does not exist</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>TASK_NOT_INTERRUPTED</code></td>\n<td><code>resume_task</code> was called on a task that isn't interrupted</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>JOB_ID_MISMATCH</code></td>\n<td><code>resume_task.job_id</code> doesn't match the current interrupt point</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>INTERNAL_ERROR</code></td>\n<td>Unexpected server-side error</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Close Codes</h2>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Code</th>\n<th>Reason</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>4409</code></td>\n<td>Session already connected (duplicate <code>session</code> parameter)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>4429</code></td>\n<td>Connection limit reached (<code>max_connection_count</code> exceeded)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Delivery Semantics</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong><code>task_state</code></strong> — emitted on every task status change. On subscription, the current state is delivered once via <code>task_subscribed.state</code>.</li>\n<li><strong><code>job_event</code></strong> — emitted once per job lifecycle transition (<code>started</code> / <code>completed</code> / <code>failed</code> / <code>routed</code>). Subscribers connected throughout the run receive all events in emission order.</li>\n<li><strong>Replay</strong> — neither message type is buffered after emission. Events emitted before a client subscribes are not replayed; subscribe at workflow start (e.g. <code>run_workflow</code> with <code>subscribe_task: true</code>) for full coverage.</li>\n<li><strong>Subscriptions</strong> — scoped to the WebSocket connection. Closing the connection removes all subscriptions for that client. The underlying workflow is not affected.</li>\n</ul>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "WebSocket Interface Reference"
      }
    },

      "html": "<h1>Model-Compose User Guide</h1>\n<p>Welcome to the <strong>model-compose</strong> user guide! This comprehensive documentation will help you master declarative AI workflow orchestration—from basic concepts to advanced deployment strategies.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>🚀 Quick Start</h2>\n<p>New to model-compose? Start here:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started\">Getting Started</a></strong> - Installation, first workflow, and basic concepts</li>\n<li><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/02-core-concepts\">Core Concepts</a></strong> - Understanding controllers, components, and workflows</li>\n<li><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/03-cli-usage\">CLI Usage</a></strong> - Master the command-line interface</li>\n</ol>\n<hr />\n<h2>📚 Complete Table of Contents</h2>\n<p><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/00-table-of-contents\">→ Full Table of Contents</a></strong></p>\n<h3>Essential Topics</h3>\n<h4>Foundation</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started\">Getting Started</a> - Install and run your first workflow</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/02-core-concepts\">Core Concepts</a> - Architecture and key components</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/03-cli-usage\">CLI Usage</a> - Command reference and examples</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Building Workflows</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/04-component-configuration\">Component Configuration</a> - Define reusable components</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/05-writing-workflows\">Writing Workflows</a> - Create multi-step pipelines</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/14-variable-binding\">Variable Binding</a> - Data flow and transformations</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Controllers &amp; UI</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/07-controller-configuration\">Controller Configuration</a> - HTTP and MCP servers</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/09-webui-configuration\">Web UI Configuration</a> - Visual workflow management</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>AI Models</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/10-local-ai-models\">Working with Local AI Models</a> - Run models locally</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/12-external-service-integration\">External Service Integration</a> - Connect to OpenAI, Claude, etc.</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/13-streaming-mode\">Streaming Mode</a> - Real-time output streaming</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>System Integration</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/15-system-integration\">System Integration</a> - Listeners, triggers, and gateways\n<ul>\n<li>HTTP Callback Listeners - Handle async webhooks</li>\n<li>HTTP Trigger Listeners - Event-driven workflows</li>\n<li>Gateway Support - Expose local services securely</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Deployment &amp; Production</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/16-deployment\">Deployment</a> - Docker, cloud, and production best practices</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/17-practical-examples\">Practical Examples</a> - Real-world use cases</li>\n<li><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/18-troubleshooting\">Troubleshooting</a> - Common issues and solutions</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>🎯 Learn By Example</h2>\n<p>Looking for hands-on examples? Check out:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>\n<p><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/17-practical-examples\">Practical Examples</a></strong> - Complete working examples:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Chatbots (OpenAI, Claude)</li>\n<li>Voice generation pipelines</li>\n<li>Image analysis and editing</li>\n<li>RAG systems with vector databases</li>\n<li>Slack bots with MCP</li>\n<li>Multimodal workflows</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong><a href=\"https://github.com/linyiru/model-compose/tree/4812ab15c0bf645fa6fd2dd55585102f6e94225c/examples\">Examples Directory</a></strong> - Ready-to-run YAML configurations</p>\n</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>🔍 Quick Reference</h2>\n<h3>Common Tasks</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>I want to...</th>\n<th>Go to...</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Install and run my first workflow</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started\">Getting Started</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Call external APIs (OpenAI, Claude)</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/12-external-service-integration\">External Service Integration</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Run local AI models</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/10-local-ai-models\">Local AI Models</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Create multi-step workflows</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/05-writing-workflows\">Writing Workflows</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Stream real-time outputs</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/13-streaming-mode\">Streaming Mode</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Handle webhooks and callbacks</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/15-system-integration\">System Integration</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Deploy to production</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/16-deployment\">Deployment</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Build a chatbot</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/17-practical-examples#171-building-a-chatbot\">Practical Examples § 17.1</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Set up a RAG system</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/17-practical-examples#172-rag-system-using-vector-db\">Practical Examples § 17.2</a></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Debug issues</td>\n<td><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/18-troubleshooting\">Troubleshooting</a></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Key Concepts</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Controller</strong>: HTTP or MCP server that hosts your workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Component</strong>: Reusable definition (API call, model, command)</li>\n<li><strong>Workflow</strong>: Named sequence of jobs</li>\n<li><strong>Job</strong>: Single step that executes a component</li>\n<li><strong>Listener</strong>: Receives HTTP callbacks or triggers workflows</li>\n<li><strong>Gateway</strong>: Tunnels local services to the internet</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>🛠 Configuration Reference</h2>\n<p>Looking for specific configuration options?</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/19-appendix#171-complete-configuration-file-schema\">Complete Configuration Schema</a></strong> - Full YAML reference</li>\n<li><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/04-component-configuration#41-component-types\">Component Types</a></strong> - All available component types</li>\n<li><strong><a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/14-variable-binding\">Variable Binding Syntax</a></strong> - Complete variable reference</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>💡 Tips for Learning</h2>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Start Simple</strong>: Begin with the <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started\">Getting Started</a> guide</li>\n<li><strong>Hands-On</strong>: Try the <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/17-practical-examples\">Practical Examples</a></li>\n<li><strong>Incremental</strong>: Add features one at a time</li>\n<li><strong>Explore</strong>: Check the <a href=\"https://github.com/linyiru/model-compose/tree/4812ab15c0bf645fa6fd2dd55585102f6e94225c/examples\">examples directory</a> for inspiration</li>\n<li><strong>Ask</strong>: Open an <a href=\"https://github.com/hanyeol/model-compose/issues\">issue</a> if you're stuck</li>\n</ol>\n<hr />\n<h2>🤝 Contributing to Docs</h2>\n<p>Found a typo or want to improve the documentation?</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Fork the repository</li>\n<li>Edit the Markdown files in <code>docs/user-guide/</code></li>\n<li>Submit a pull request</li>\n</ol>\n<p>We appreciate all contributions!</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>📬 Getting Help</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Documentation Issues</strong>: <a href=\"https://github.com/hanyeol/model-compose/issues\">File an issue</a></li>\n<li><strong>Questions</strong>: <a href=\"https://github.com/hanyeol/model-compose/discussions\">GitHub Discussions</a></li>\n<li><strong>Bug Reports</strong>: <a href=\"https://github.com/hanyeol/model-compose/issues\">Issue Tracker</a></li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>📖 Other Languages</h2>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>🇰🇷 한국어</strong>: <a href=\"./ko/README.md\">한국어 사용자 가이드</a></li>\n<li><strong>🇨🇳 简体中文</strong>: <a href=\"./zh-cn/README.md\">简体中文用户指南</a></li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Happy composing! 🎉</strong></p>\n",

      "html": "<h1>Table of Contents</h1>\n<p>This document outlines the structure of the model-compose user guide.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>1. <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started\">Getting Started</a></h2>\n<ul>\n<li>1.1 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started#11-introduction-and-overview\">Introduction and Overview</a></li>\n<li>1.2 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started#12-installation\">Installation</a></li>\n<li>1.3 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started#13-running-your-first-workflow\">Running Your First Workflow</a>\n<ul>\n<li>1.3.1 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started#131-simple-example-openai-api-call\">Simple Example (OpenAI API Call)</a></li>\n<li>1.3.2 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started#132-running-a-workflow-run-command\">Running a Workflow (run command)</a></li>\n<li>1.3.3 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/01-getting-started#133-starting-the-controller-and-using-web-ui\">Starting the Controller and Using Web UI</a></li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>1.4 <a Schema</a>\n<ul>\n<li>19.1.1 <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/19-appendix#1911-top-level-structure\">Top-Level Structure</a></li>\n<li>19.1.2 <a
