HuggingFace Hub (provider: huggingface)</h4>\n<p><strong>Simple method (string)</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n  # Automatically loads from HuggingFace Hub\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Detailed configuration</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n    revision: main                  # Branch or commit hash\n    filename: pytorch_model.bin     # Specific file\n    cache_dir: /custom/cache        # Cache directory\n    local_files_only: false         # Use local cache only\n    token: ${env.HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN} # Private model token\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>HuggingFace configuration fields:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>repository</code>: HuggingFace model repository (required)</li>\n<li><code>revision</code>: Model version or branch (default: <code>main</code>)</li>\n<li><code>filename</code>: Specific file within repository (optional)</li>\n<li><code>cache_dir</code>: Model file cache directory (default: <code>~/.cache/huggingface/</code>)</li>\n<li><code>local_files_only</code>: Use local cache only (default: <code>false</code>)</li>\n<li><code>token</code>: Private model access token (optional)</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>2. Local Files (provider: local)</h4>\n<p><strong>Simple method (path string)</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: /path/to/model\n  # Automatically recognized as local path\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Detailed configuration</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model:\n    provider: local\n    path: /path/to/model\n    format: pytorch  # pytorch, safetensors, onnx, gguf, tensorrt\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Local configuration fields:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>path</code>: Model file or directory path (required)</li>\n<li><code>format</code>: Model file format (default: <code>pytorch</code>)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Local path recognition rules:</strong></p>\n<p>Strings starting with these patterns are automatically recognized as local paths:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Absolute path: <code>/path/to/model</code></li>\n<li>Relative path: <code>./model</code>, <code>../model</code></li>\n<li>Home directory: <code>~/models/model</code></li>\n<li>Windows drive: <code>C:\\models\\model</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p>Others are recognized as HuggingFace Hub repositories:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf</code></li>\n<li><code>gpt2</code></li>\n<li><code>username/custom-model</code></li>\n</ul>\n<h3>HuggingFace Model Download</h3>\n<p>Models are automatically downloaded on first run, and required packages are installed automatically:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: chat-completion\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf\n  # Downloaded to ~/.cache/huggingface/ on first run\n</code></pre>\n<p>Manual download:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Pre-download with HuggingFace CLI\npip install huggingface-hub\nhuggingface-cli download meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Accessing Private Models</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n    token: ${env.HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<p>Environment variable setup:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=hf_your_token_here\nmodel-compose up\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Using Specific Model Versions</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n    revision: v1.0  # Specific tag\n    # Or commit hash: revision: a1b2c3d4\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Offline Mode</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: gpt2\n    local_files_only: true  # Load from local cache only\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>10.3 Supported Task Types</h2>\n<p>model-compose supports the following task types:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Task</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Primary Use Cases</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text-generation</code></td>\n<td>Text generation</td>\n<td>Story writing, code generation</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>chat-completion</code></td>\n<td>Conversational completion</td>\n<td>Chatbots, assistants</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text-classification</code></td>\n<td>Text classification</td>\n<td>Sentiment analysis, topic classification</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text-embedding</code></td>\n<td>Text embedding</td>\n<td>Semantic search, RAG</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>image-to-text</code></td>\n<td>Image captioning</td>\n<td>Image description, VQA</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text-to-image</code></td>\n<td>Image generation</td>\n<td>Text-to-image conversion</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>image-upscale</code></td>\n<td>Image upscaling</td>\n<td>Resolution enhancement</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text-to-speech</code></td>\n<td>Text-to-speech synthesis</td>\n<td>Voice generation, cloning, design</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>face-embedding</code></td>\n<td>Face embedding</td>\n<td>Face recognition, comparison</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>10.3.1 text-generation</h3>\n<p>Generates text based on prompts.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  action:\n    text: ${input.prompt as text}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 32768\n      temperature: 0.7\n      top_p: 0.9\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key parameters:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>max_output_length</code>: Maximum tokens to generate</li>\n<li><code>temperature</code>: Generation randomness (0.0~2.0, lower is more deterministic)</li>\n<li><code>top_p</code>: Nucleus sampling threshold</li>\n<li><code>top_k</code>: Top-K sampling</li>\n<li><code>repetition_penalty</code>: Repetition prevention (1.0~2.0)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>10.3.2 chat-completion</h3>\n<p>Processes conversational messages.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: chat-completion\n  model: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B\n  action:\n    messages:\n      - role: system\n        content: ${input.system_prompt}\n      - role: user\n        content: ${input.user_prompt}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 2048\n      temperature: 0.7\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Message format:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>role</code>: <code>system</code>, <code>user</code>, <code>assistant</code></li>\n<li><code>content</code>: Message content</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>10.3.3 text-classification</h3>\n<p>Classifies text into categories.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-classification\n  model: distilbert-base-uncased-finetuned-sst-2-english\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    output:\n      label: ${result.label}\n      score: ${result.score}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>10.3.4 text-embedding</h3>\n<p>Converts text into high-dimensional vectors.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-embedding\n  model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    output:\n      embedding: ${result.embedding}\n</code></pre>\n<p>Usage example (RAG system):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  title: Document Search\n  jobs:\n    - id: embed-query\n      component: embedder\n      input:\n        text: ${input.query}\n      output:\n        query_vector: ${result.embedding}\n\n    - id: search\n      component: vector-store\n      action: search\n      input:\n        vector: ${jobs.embed-query.output.query_vector}\n        top_k: 5\n</code></pre>\n<h3>10.3.5 image-to-text</h3>\n<p>Analyzes images and generates text.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: image-to-text\n  model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large\n  architecture: blip\n  action:\n    image: ${input.image as image}\n    prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Supported architectures:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>blip</code>: Image captioning</li>\n<li><code>git</code>: Generative Image-to-Text</li>\n<li><code>vit-gpt2</code>: Vision Transformer + GPT-2</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>10.3.6 text-to-image</h3>\n<p>Generates images from text prompts.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-image\n  architecture: flux\n  model: black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev\n  action:\n    prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n    params:\n      width: 1024\n      height: 1024\n      num_inference_steps: 50\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Supported architectures:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>flux</code>: FLUX model</li>\n<li><code>sdxl</code>: Stable Diffusion XL</li>\n<li><code>hunyuan</code>: HunyuanDiT</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>10.3.7 image-upscale</h3>\n<p>Enhances image resolution.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: image-upscale\n  architecture: real-esrgan\n  model: RealESRGAN_x4plus\n  action:\n    image: ${input.image as image}\n    params:\n      scale: 4\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Supported architectures:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>real-esrgan</code>: Real-ESRGAN</li>\n<li><code>esrgan</code>: ESRGAN</li>\n<li><code>swinir</code>: SwinIR</li>\n<li><code>ldsr</code>: Latent Diffusion Super Resolution</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>10.3.8 text-to-speech</h3>\n<p>Synthesizes speech audio from text. This task uses <code>driver: custom</code> with a <code>family</code> field to select the model family, and a <code>method</code> field to choose the generation method.</p>\n<p><strong>Available methods:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Method</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Required Fields</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>generate</code></td>\n<td>Generate speech using a built-in voice</td>\n<td><code>voice</code>, <code>instructions</code> (optional)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>clone</code></td>\n<td>Clone a voice from reference audio</td>\n<td><code>ref_audio</code>, <code>ref_text</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>design</code></td>\n<td>Design a new voice from a description</td>\n<td><code>instructions</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<p><strong>Common fields:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>method</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Generation method: <code>generate</code>, <code>clone</code>, <code>design</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>text</code></td>\n<td>string/array</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Text to synthesize into speech</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>language</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>null</code></td>\n<td>Language of the text (auto-detected if not specified)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Generate method</h4>\n<p>Generate speech using a built-in voice with optional style instructions:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-speech\n  driver: custom\n  family: qwen\n  model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice\n  device: cuda:0\n  action:\n    method: generate\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    voice: ${input.voice | vivian}\n    instructions: ${input.instructions | &quot;&quot;}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>voice</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>vivian</code></td>\n<td>Built-in voice name</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>instructions</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>&quot;&quot;</code></td>\n<td>Emotion/style instructions for the voice</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Clone method</h4>\n<p>Clone a voice from reference audio:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-speech\n  driver: custom\n  family: qwen\n  model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base\n  device: cuda:0\n  action:\n    method: clone\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    ref_audio: ${input.ref_audio as audio}\n    ref_text: ${input.ref_text as text}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>ref_audio</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Path or URL to the reference audio for voice cloning</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>ref_text</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Transcription text of the reference audio</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Design method</h4>\n<p>Design a new voice from a natural language description:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-to-speech\n  driver: custom\n  family: qwen\n  model: Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign\n  device: cuda:0\n  action:\n    method: design\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    instructions: ${input.instructions as text}\n</code></pre>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>instructions</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Natural language description of the desired voice</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Supported models (Qwen family)</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Method</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-CustomVoice</code></td>\n<td><code>generate</code></td>\n<td>Built-in voices with style control</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-Base</code></td>\n<td><code>clone</code></td>\n<td>Voice cloning from reference audio</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign</code></td>\n<td><code>design</code></td>\n<td>Voice design from text description</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>10.3.9 face-embedding</h3>\n<p>Extracts feature vectors from face images.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: face-embedding\n  model: buffalo_l\n  action:\n    image: ${input.image as image}\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>10.4 Model Configuration (Device, Precision, Batch Size)</h2>\n<h3>Device Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: gpt2\n  device: cuda         # 'cuda', 'cpu', 'mps' (Apple Silicon)\n  device_mode: single  # 'single', 'auto' (multi-GPU)\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Device options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>cuda</code>: NVIDIA GPU</li>\n<li><code>cpu</code>: CPU only</li>\n<li><code>mps</code>: Apple Silicon GPU (M1/M2/M3)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Device modes:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>single</code>: Single GPU</li>\n<li><code>auto</code>: Automatic distribution across multiple GPUs</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Multi-GPU example:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-70b-hf\n  device: cuda\n  device_mode: auto  # Automatically distribute across GPUs\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Precision Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n  precision: float16  # 'auto', 'float32', 'float16', 'bfloat16'\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Precision options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>auto</code>: Automatic selection (float16 for GPU, float32 for CPU)</li>\n<li><code>float32</code>: Highest accuracy, most memory usage</li>\n<li><code>float16</code>: Half memory, faster inference (CUDA)</li>\n<li><code>bfloat16</code>: Alternative to float16, more stable (modern GPUs)</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Precision comparison:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Precision</th>\n<th>Memory</th>\n<th>Speed</th>\n<th>Accuracy</th>\n<th>Recommended Use</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>float32</td>\n<td>100%</td>\n<td>Baseline</td>\n<td>Highest</td>\n<td>CPU, high accuracy needed</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>float16</td>\n<td>50%</td>\n<td>2x faster</td>\n<td>Slightly reduced</td>\n<td>CUDA GPU</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>bfloat16</td>\n<td>50%</td>\n<td>2x faster</td>\n<td>More stable than float16</td>\n<td>Modern GPUs (A100, H100)</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Quantization</h3>\n<p>Quantization to reduce memory and increase speed:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n  quantization: int8  # 'none', 'int8', 'int4', 'nf4'\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Quantization options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>none</code>: No quantization (default)</li>\n<li><code>int8</code>: 8-bit integer (requires bitsandbytes)</li>\n<li><code>int4</code>: 4-bit integer (requires bitsandbytes)</li>\n<li><code>nf4</code>: 4-bit NormalFloat (for QLoRA)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Batch Size</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-classification\n  model: distilbert-base-uncased\n  batch_size: 32  # Number of inputs to process at once\n</code></pre>\n<p>Batch size selection guide:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Small batch (1-8)</strong>: Low latency, real-time inference</li>\n<li><strong>Medium batch (16-32)</strong>: Balanced throughput/latency</li>\n<li><strong>Large batch (64+)</strong>: Maximum throughput, batch processing</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Low-Memory Loading</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-70b-hf\n  low_cpu_mem_usage: true  # Minimize CPU RAM usage\n  device: cuda\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>10.5 Using LoRA/PEFT Adapters</h2>\n<p>LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is a technique for adapting models to specific tasks by adding small adapter modules without fine-tuning the entire model.</p>\n<h3>Applying LoRA Adapters</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n  peft_adapters:\n    - type: lora\n      name: alpaca\n      model: tloen/alpaca-lora-7b\n      weight: 1.0\n  action:\n    text: ${input.prompt as text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multiple LoRA Adapters</h3>\n<p>Multiple LoRA adapters can be applied simultaneously:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n    token: ${env.HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN}\n  peft_adapters:\n    - type: lora\n      name: alpaca\n      model: tloen/alpaca-lora-7b\n      weight: 0.7\n    - type: lora\n      name: assistant\n      model: plncmm/guanaco-lora-7b\n      weight: 0.8\n  action:\n    text: ${input.prompt as text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Adapter Weights</h3>\n<p>Control adapter influence with the <code>weight</code> parameter:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">peft_adapters:\n  - type: lora\n    name: style-adapter\n    model: user/style-lora\n    weight: 0.5  # 50% influence\n</code></pre>\n<ul>\n<li><code>weight: 0.0</code>: Disable adapter</li>\n<li><code>weight: 0.5</code>: 50% applied</li>\n<li><code>weight: 1.0</code>: 100% applied (default)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Local LoRA Adapters</h3>\n<p>Using adapters from local filesystem:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">peft_adapters:\n  - type: lora\n    name: custom-lora\n    model:\n      provider: local\n      path: /path/to/lora/adapter\n    weight: 1.0\n</code></pre>\n<h3>LoRA Use Cases</h3>\n<p><strong>1. Domain Adaptation</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Medical domain specialized model\npeft_adapters:\n  - type: lora\n    name: medical\n    model: medalpaca/medalpaca-lora-7b\n    weight: 1.0\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>2. Style Control</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Combining multiple writing styles\npeft_adapters:\n  - type: lora\n    name: formal\n    model: user/formal-writing-lora\n    weight: 0.6\n  - type: lora\n    name: technical\n    model: user/technical-lora\n    weight: 0.4\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>3. Multilingual Support</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Enhancing Korean language support\npeft_adapters:\n  - type: lora\n    name: korean\n    model: beomi/llama-2-ko-7b-lora\n    weight: 1.0\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>10.6 Model Serving Frameworks</h2>\n<p>For large-scale production environments or high-performance inference, dedicated model serving frameworks can be used.</p>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Important:</strong> Model serving frameworks like vLLM and Ollama use local models but are accessed through <code>http-server</code> or <code>http-client</code> components via HTTP API, not <code>model</code> components. This is because a separate server process loads and serves the model.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h3>vLLM</h3>\n<p>vLLM is a high-performance inference engine for large language models.</p>\n<h4>vLLM Features</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>PagedAttention</strong>: Memory-efficient attention mechanism</li>\n<li><strong>Continuous batching</strong>: High throughput</li>\n<li><strong>Fast inference</strong>: Optimized CUDA kernels</li>\n<li><strong>OpenAI-compatible API</strong>: Easy integration with existing code</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>vLLM Configuration Example</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  manage:\n    install:\n      - bash\n      - -c\n      - |\n        eval &quot;$(pyenv init -)&quot; &amp;&amp;\n        (pyenv activate vllm 2&gt;/dev/null || pyenv virtualenv $(python --version | cut -d' ' -f2) vllm) &amp;&amp;\n        pyenv activate vllm &amp;&amp;\n        pip install vllm\n    start:\n      - bash\n      - -c\n      - |\n        eval &quot;$(pyenv init -)&quot; &amp;&amp;\n        pyenv activate vllm &amp;&amp;\n        python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server\n          --model Qwen/Qwen2-7B-Instruct\n          --port 8000\n          --served-model-name qwen2-7b-instruct\n          --max-model-len 2048\n  port: 8000\n  method: POST\n  path: /v1/chat/completions\n  headers:\n    Content-Type: application/json\n  body:\n    model: qwen2-7b-instruct\n    messages:\n      - role: user\n        content: ${input.prompt as text}\n    max_tokens: 512\n    temperature: ${input.temperature as number | 0.7}\n    streaming: true\n  stream_format: json\n  output: ${response[].choices[0].delta.content}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>vLLM Parameters</h4>\n<p><strong>Server parameters:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>--model</code>: Model name or path</li>\n<li><code>--port</code>: Server port</li>\n<li><code>--host</code>: Bind host</li>\n<li><code>--served-model-name</code>: Model name for API</li>\n<li><code>--max-model-len</code>: Maximum sequence length</li>\n<li><code>--tensor-parallel-size</code>: Tensor parallelism (multi-GPU)</li>\n<li><code>--dtype</code>: Data type (auto, float16, bfloat16)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Inference parameters:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>max_tokens</code>: Maximum tokens to generate</li>\n<li><code>temperature</code>: Generation randomness</li>\n<li><code>top_p</code>: Nucleus sampling</li>\n<li><code>streaming</code>: Enable streaming response</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Ollama</h3>\n<p>Ollama is a simple tool for running large language models locally.</p>\n<h4>Ollama Features</h4>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Easy installation</strong>: One-click install</li>\n<li><strong>Model library</strong>: Pre-optimized models</li>\n<li><strong>Low barrier to entry</strong>: No complex configuration</li>\n<li><strong>REST API</strong>: Simple HTTP interface</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Ollama Automatic Management (http-server component)</h4>\n<p>When model-compose automatically installs and runs Ollama:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  manage:\n    install:\n      - bash\n      - -c\n      - |\n        # macOS/Linux\n        curl -fsSL https://ollama.ai/install.sh | sh\n        # Download model\n        ollama pull llama2\n    start: [ ollama, serve ]\n  port: 11434\n  method: POST\n  path: /api/generate\n  headers:\n    Content-Type: application/json\n  body:\n    model: llama2\n    prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n    stream: false\n  output:\n    response: ${response.response}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Streaming example:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  manage:\n    start: [ ollama, serve ]\n  port: 11434\n  method: POST\n  path: /api/generate\n  body:\n    model: llama2\n    prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n    stream: true\n  stream_format: json\n  output: ${response[].response}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Chat API:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-server\n  manage:\n    start: [ ollama, serve ]\n  port: 11434\n  method: POST\n  path: /api/chat\n  body:\n    model: llama2\n    messages: ${input.messages}\n  output:\n    message: ${response.message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Using Existing Ollama Server (http-client)</h4>\n<p>When an Ollama server is already running:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  endpoint: http://localhost:11434/api/generate\n  method: POST\n  body:\n    model: llama2\n    prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n  output:\n    response: ${response.response}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>TGI (Text Generation Inference)</h3>\n<p>HuggingFace's production-level inference server.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  endpoint: http://localhost:8080/generate\n  method: POST\n  headers:\n    Content-Type: application/json\n  body:\n    inputs: ${input.prompt as text}\n    parameters:\n      max_new_tokens: 512\n      temperature: 0.7\n      top_p: 0.9\n  output:\n    generated_text: ${response.generated_text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Framework Comparison</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Framework</th>\n<th>Pros</th>\n<th>Cons</th>\n<th>Recommended Use</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>vLLM</strong></td>\n<td>Best performance, high throughput</td>\n<td>Complex setup, CUDA only</td>\n<td>Production, large-scale services</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Ollama</strong></td>\n<td>Easy installation, low barrier</td>\n<td>Limited models, limited control</td>\n<td>Development, prototyping, personal use</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>TGI</strong></td>\n<td>HuggingFace integration, stability</td>\n<td>Slower than vLLM</td>\n<td>When using HuggingFace ecosystem</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>transformers</strong></td>\n<td>Maximum compatibility, customization</td>\n<td>Lower performance</td>\n<td>Research, experiments, custom models</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr />\n<h2>10.7 Performance Optimization Tips</h2>\n<h3>1. Choose Appropriate Precision</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># With GPU\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  model: large-model\n  precision: float16  # or bfloat16 (modern GPUs)\n  device: cuda\n\n# CPU only\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  model: small-model\n  precision: float32  # float32 more stable on CPU\n  device: cpu\n</code></pre>\n<h3>2. Use Quantization</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># When memory is limited\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-hf\n  quantization: int8  # ~50% memory reduction\n  device: cuda\n</code></pre>\n<h3>3. Appropriate Batch Size</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Optimize throughput\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  task: text-classification\n  model: bert-base\n  batch_size: 32  # Adjust to GPU memory\n</code></pre>\n<h3>4. Model Caching</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Cache for model reuse\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  model:\n    provider: huggingface\n    repository: gpt2\n    cache_dir: /data/model-cache  # Use fast SSD\n</code></pre>\n<h3>5. Use Multiple GPUs</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Model parallelism\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-70b-hf\n  device: cuda\n  device_mode: auto  # Automatically distribute across GPUs\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Common Performance Issues and Solutions</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Issue</th>\n<th>Cause</th>\n<th>Solution</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td>Slow first run</td>\n<td>Model download, compilation</td>\n<td>Pre-download model, warmup</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>OOM (Out of Memory)</td>\n<td>Model larger than GPU memory</td>\n<td>Quantization, lower precision, smaller batch</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Low throughput</td>\n<td>Small batch size</td>\n<td>Increase batch size</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>High latency</td>\n<td>Large batch size</td>\n<td>Decrease batch size, real-time processing</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td>Unstable output</td>\n<td>float16 precision issue</td>\n<td>Use bfloat16 or float32</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>Try it out:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Test various models from HuggingFace Hub</li>\n<li>Experiment with quantization and precision settings</li>\n<li>Load and merge LoRA adapters</li>\n<li>Optimize throughput with batch processing</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/11-model-training\">11. Model Training</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Chapter 10: Working with Local AI Models"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "user-guide/11-model-training",
      "html": "<h1>11. Model Training</h1>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>⚠️ Development Status</strong>: This feature is currently under development. The configuration schema is defined, but the training execution service is not yet implemented. Updates will be provided in future releases.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p>This chapter explains how to configure model training using model-compose.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.1 Training Overview</h2>\n<h3>11.1.1 Supported Training Tasks</h3>\n<p>model-compose provides configurations for the following training tasks:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)</strong>: Supervised learning-based fine-tuning</li>\n<li><strong>Classification</strong>: Classification model training</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.1.2 Training Component Structure</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft                      # or classification\n\n    # LoRA configuration (optional)\n    peft_adapter: lora\n    lora_r: 8\n    lora_alpha: 16\n\n    # Training parameters\n    learning_rate: 5e-5\n    num_epochs: 3\n    output_dir: ./trained-model\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.2 Dataset Preparation</h2>\n<h3>11.2.1 Dataset Component Overview</h3>\n<p>The dataset component provides tools for preparing training data.</p>\n<p><strong>Supported Features:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Load datasets from HuggingFace Hub</li>\n<li>Load datasets from local files</li>\n<li>Merge and transform datasets</li>\n<li>Row/column selection and filtering</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.2.2 Loading HuggingFace Datasets</h3>\n<p><strong>Basic Configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset-loader\n    type: datasets\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: tatsu-lab/alpaca          # HuggingFace Hub path\n    split: train                    # train, test, validation, etc.\n    fraction: 1.0                   # Fraction of data (0.0 ~ 1.0)\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Advanced Configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset-loader\n    type: datasets\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n    name: default                   # Dataset configuration name\n    split: train\n    fraction: 0.1                   # Use only 10%\n    streaming: false                # Streaming mode\n    cache_dir: ./cache/datasets     # Cache directory\n    revision: main                  # Model revision\n    trust_remote_code: false        # Allow remote code execution\n    token: ${env.HF_TOKEN}          # HuggingFace token\n    shuffle: true                   # Shuffle data\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Workflow Example:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: load-training-data\n    jobs:\n      - id: load\n        component: dataset-loader\n        input:\n          path: ${input.dataset | tatsu-lab/alpaca}\n          split: train\n          fraction: 1.0\n        output: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.2.3 Loading Local Datasets</h3>\n<p><strong>JSON Files:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: local-dataset\n    type: datasets\n    provider: local\n    loader: json                    # json, csv, parquet, text\n    data_files: ./data/train.json   # File path\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>CSV Files:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: local-dataset\n    type: datasets\n    provider: local\n    loader: csv\n    data_files:\n      - ./data/train.csv\n      - ./data/validation.csv\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Directories:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: local-dataset\n    type: datasets\n    provider: local\n    loader: json\n    data_dir: ./data/training       # All JSON files in directory\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.2.4 Dataset Manipulation</h3>\n<p><strong>Merging Datasets:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: merge-datasets\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-first\n        component: dataset-loader\n        input:\n          path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n          split: train\n\n      - id: load-second\n        component: dataset-loader\n        input:\n          path: yahma/alpaca-cleaned\n          split: train\n\n      - id: concat\n        component: dataset-ops\n        method: concat\n        input:\n          datasets:\n            - ${jobs.load-first.output}\n            - ${jobs.load-second.output}\n        depends_on: [ load-first, load-second ]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Column Selection:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: select-columns\n    jobs:\n      - id: load\n        component: dataset-loader\n        input:\n          path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n          split: train\n\n      - id: select\n        component: dataset-ops\n        method: select\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n          axis: columns\n          columns: [ instruction, input, output ]\n        depends_on: [ load ]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Row Selection:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: select-rows\n    jobs:\n      - id: load\n        component: dataset-loader\n        input:\n          path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n          split: train\n\n      - id: select\n        component: dataset-ops\n        method: select\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n          axis: rows\n          indices: [ 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 ]    # First 5 rows\n        depends_on: [ load ]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Data Filtering:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset-ops\n    type: datasets\n    method: filter\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    condition: ${input.condition}    # Filter condition\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Data Mapping:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset-ops\n    type: datasets\n    method: map\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    template: ${input.template}      # Data transformation template\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.2.5 Dataset Formats</h3>\n<p><strong>Data Format for SFT Training:</strong></p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Single Text Column:</strong></li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;text&quot;: &quot;Complete training text here...&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li><strong>Prompt-Response Format:</strong></li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;User question or instruction&quot;,\n  &quot;response&quot;: &quot;Model's expected response&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"3\">\n<li><strong>Instruction Format (Alpaca Style):</strong></li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;instruction&quot;: &quot;Task instruction&quot;,\n  &quot;input&quot;: &quot;Optional context&quot;,\n  &quot;output&quot;: &quot;Expected output&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"4\">\n<li><strong>Conversation Format:</strong></li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;system&quot;: &quot;You are a helpful assistant&quot;,\n  &quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;User message&quot;,\n  &quot;response&quot;: &quot;Assistant response&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.3 Training Configuration</h2>\n<h3>11.3.1 Basic Training Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Dataset\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n\n    # Learning rate and batch size\n    learning_rate: 5e-5\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 8\n    per_device_eval_batch_size: 8\n    num_epochs: 3\n\n    # Output directory\n    output_dir: ./output/model\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.3.2 Optimizer Configuration</h3>\n<p><strong>Supported Optimizers:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    optimizer: adamw_torch          # Default\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Optimizer Types:</strong></p>\n<p><strong>AdamW Variants:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>adamw_torch</code>: PyTorch default AdamW</li>\n<li><code>adamw_torch_fused</code>: Fused AdamW (faster)</li>\n<li><code>adamw_8bit</code>: 8-bit AdamW (memory efficient)</li>\n<li><code>adamw_bnb_8bit</code>: BitsAndBytes 8-bit AdamW</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Memory-Efficient Optimizers:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>adafactor</code>: Adafactor (memory efficient)</li>\n<li><code>lomo</code>: LOMO (Low-Memory Optimization)</li>\n<li><code>galore_adamw</code>: GaLore AdamW</li>\n<li><code>galore_adamw_8bit</code>: GaLore AdamW 8-bit</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Advanced Optimizers:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>grokadamw</code>: Grok AdamW</li>\n<li><code>stableadamw</code>: Stable AdamW</li>\n<li><code>schedule_free_radamw</code>: Schedule-Free RAdamW</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Traditional Optimizers:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>sgd</code>: Stochastic Gradient Descent</li>\n<li><code>adagrad</code>: Adagrad</li>\n<li><code>rmsprop</code>: RMSprop</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.3.3 Learning Rate Scheduler</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    lr_scheduler_type: linear       # Default\n    warmup_steps: 100\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Scheduler Types:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>linear</code>: Linear decay</li>\n<li><code>cosine</code>: Cosine decay</li>\n<li><code>cosine_with_restarts</code>: Cosine with restarts</li>\n<li><code>polynomial</code>: Polynomial decay</li>\n<li><code>constant</code>: Constant learning rate</li>\n<li><code>constant_with_warmup</code>: Constant with warmup</li>\n<li><code>inverse_sqrt</code>: Inverse square root decay</li>\n<li><code>reduce_lr_on_plateau</code>: Reduce on plateau</li>\n<li><code>cosine_with_min_lr</code>: Cosine with minimum learning rate</li>\n<li><code>warmup_stable_decay</code>: Warmup-Stable-Decay</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.3.4 Optimization Settings</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Weight decay (regularization)\n    weight_decay: 0.01\n\n    # Gradient clipping\n    max_grad_norm: 1.0\n\n    # Gradient accumulation\n    gradient_accumulation_steps: 4\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Gradient Accumulation:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Effective batch size = <code>per_device_train_batch_size × gradient_accumulation_steps × num_gpus</code></li>\n<li>When out of memory, reduce batch size and increase accumulation steps</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.3.5 Evaluation and Saving</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Evaluation\n    eval_steps: 500                 # Evaluate every 500 steps\n    eval_dataset: ${input.eval_dataset}\n\n    # Checkpoint saving\n    save_steps: 500                 # Save every 500 steps\n\n    # Logging\n    logging_steps: 10               # Log every 10 steps\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.3.6 Memory Optimization</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Gradient checkpointing\n    gradient_checkpointing: true    # Save memory, reduce speed\n\n    # Mixed precision\n    fp16: true                      # FP16 (V100, RTX series)\n    # or\n    bf16: true                      # BF16 (recommended for A100, H100)\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Memory Optimization Options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>gradient_checkpointing</code>: Saves ~30-40% memory, reduces speed by ~20%</li>\n<li><code>fp16</code>: FP16 mixed precision, saves memory and improves speed</li>\n<li><code>bf16</code>: BF16 mixed precision, better numerical stability (Ampere+ GPUs)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.3.7 Reproducibility Settings</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    seed: 42                        # Random seed\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.4 Fine-Tuning</h2>\n<h3>11.4.1 SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)</h3>\n<p><strong>Basic Configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: sft-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Dataset\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    eval_dataset: ${input.eval_dataset}\n\n    # Data format\n    text_column: text               # Single text column\n    max_seq_length: 512\n\n    # Training settings\n    learning_rate: 5e-5\n    num_epochs: 3\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 4\n    output_dir: ./output/sft-model\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Prompt-Response Format:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: sft-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n\n    # Conversation format\n    prompt_column: prompt\n    response_column: response\n    system_column: system           # Optional\n\n    max_seq_length: 1024\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Data Validation:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Either <code>text_column</code> or <code>prompt_column</code> + <code>response_column</code> is required</li>\n<li>Error if both are specified</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.4.2 Sequence Packing</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: sft-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    text_column: text\n\n    # Sequence packing\n    packing: true                   # Combine short samples into one sequence\n    max_seq_length: 512\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Packing Advantages:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Improves training efficiency with many short samples</li>\n<li>Increases GPU utilization</li>\n<li>Reduces training time</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Packing Disadvantages:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Sample boundaries may not be clear</li>\n<li>May reduce performance on some tasks</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.5 LoRA Training</h2>\n<h3>11.5.1 LoRA Overview</h3>\n<p>LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) is an efficient technique for fine-tuning large models.</p>\n<p><strong>Advantages:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Drastically reduces trainable parameters (&lt;1%)</li>\n<li>Reduces memory usage</li>\n<li>Faster training</li>\n<li>Multiple LoRA adapters can be applied to one base model</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.5.2 Basic LoRA Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: lora-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Enable LoRA\n    peft_adapter: lora\n\n    # LoRA hyperparameters\n    lora_r: 8                       # LoRA rank (lower = more memory savings)\n    lora_alpha: 16                  # LoRA scaling (typically 2x of r)\n    lora_dropout: 0.05              # Dropout rate\n\n    # Dataset and training settings\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    learning_rate: 1e-4             # LoRA typically uses higher learning rate\n    num_epochs: 3\n    output_dir: ./output/lora-adapter\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.5.3 Target Module Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: lora-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    peft_adapter: lora\n\n    # Specify target modules\n    lora_target_modules:\n      - q_proj                      # Query projection\n      - v_proj                      # Value projection\n      - k_proj                      # Key projection\n      - o_proj                      # Output projection\n\n    lora_r: 16\n    lora_alpha: 32\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Common Target Modules:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Transformer Attention</strong>: <code>q_proj</code>, <code>k_proj</code>, <code>v_proj</code>, <code>o_proj</code></li>\n<li><strong>MLP</strong>: <code>gate_proj</code>, <code>up_proj</code>, <code>down_proj</code></li>\n<li><strong>Embedding</strong>: <code>embed_tokens</code>, <code>lm_head</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Target Module Selection Guide:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>More modules: Better performance, more memory</li>\n<li>Attention only: Memory efficient, sufficient for most cases</li>\n<li>Attention + MLP: Better performance, more memory</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.5.4 LoRA Bias Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: lora-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n    peft_adapter: lora\n\n    lora_bias: none                 # none, all, lora_only\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Bias Options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>none</code>: Don't train bias (default, memory efficient)</li>\n<li><code>all</code>: Train all biases</li>\n<li><code>lora_only</code>: Train only LoRA layer biases</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.5.5 QLoRA (Quantized LoRA)</h3>\n<p>QLoRA applies LoRA to a quantized base model for even more memory savings.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: qlora-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # LoRA settings\n    peft_adapter: lora\n    lora_r: 64\n    lora_alpha: 16\n\n    # 4-bit quantization\n    quantization: nf4               # int4 or nf4\n    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype: bfloat16\n    bnb_4bit_use_double_quant: true\n\n    # Dataset and training\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    learning_rate: 2e-4\n    num_epochs: 1\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 4\n    gradient_accumulation_steps: 4\n\n    # Memory optimization\n    gradient_checkpointing: true\n    bf16: true\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Quantization Options:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>nf4</code>: NormalFloat 4-bit (recommended)</li>\n<li><code>int4</code>: 4-bit integer quantization</li>\n<li><code>int8</code>: 8-bit integer quantization</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>QLoRA Recommended Settings:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Higher <code>lora_r</code> (64+)</li>\n<li>Higher learning rate (2e-4)</li>\n<li>BF16 mixed precision</li>\n<li>Gradient checkpointing</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.5.6 LoRA Hyperparameter Guide</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Parameter</th>\n<th>Low Value</th>\n<th>High Value</th>\n<th>Recommended Use</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lora_r</code></td>\n<td>4-8</td>\n<td>64-128</td>\n<td>Standard: 8-16, QLoRA: 64</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lora_alpha</code></td>\n<td>8-16</td>\n<td>32-64</td>\n<td>Typically 2x of r</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>lora_dropout</code></td>\n<td>0.0</td>\n<td>0.1</td>\n<td>Small datasets: 0.05-0.1</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>learning_rate</code></td>\n<td>1e-5</td>\n<td>5e-4</td>\n<td>Full FT: 5e-5, LoRA: 1e-4</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.6 Training Monitoring</h2>\n<h3>11.6.1 Logging Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # Logging\n    logging_steps: 10               # Log output interval\n    eval_steps: 100                 # Evaluation interval\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Expected Log Output:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Training loss</li>\n<li>Learning rate</li>\n<li>Gradient norm</li>\n<li>Training speed (samples/sec)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.6.2 Evaluation Metrics</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    eval_dataset: ${input.eval_dataset}\n    eval_steps: 500\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Expected Evaluation Metrics:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Evaluation loss</li>\n<li>Perplexity</li>\n<li>Task-specific metrics (classification accuracy, etc.)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>11.6.3 TensorBoard Integration (Coming Soon)</h3>\n<p>TensorBoard integration will be added in future releases:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Expected usage\ntensorboard --logdir ./output/runs\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.7 Checkpoint Management</h2>\n<h3>11.7.1 Checkpoint Saving</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    output_dir: ./output/checkpoints\n    save_steps: 500                 # Save every 500 steps\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Expected Directory Structure:</strong></p>\n<pre><code>output/checkpoints/\n  ├── checkpoint-500/\n  │   ├── model.safetensors\n  │   ├── config.json\n  │   ├── training_args.bin\n  │   └── optimizer.pt\n  ├── checkpoint-1000/\n  └── checkpoint-1500/\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.7.2 Resuming from Checkpoint</h3>\n<p>To be supported in future releases:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    resume_from_checkpoint: ./output/checkpoints/checkpoint-1000\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.7.3 Saving Final Model</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    output_dir: ./output/final-model\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Expected Final Model Structure:</strong></p>\n<pre><code>output/final-model/\n  ├── model.safetensors\n  ├── config.json\n  ├── tokenizer.json\n  ├── tokenizer_config.json\n  └── special_tokens_map.json\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>11.8 Practical Examples</h2>\n<h3>11.8.1 Alpaca-Style Fine-Tuning</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: alpaca-loader\n    type: datasets\n    provider: huggingface\n    path: tatsu-lab/alpaca\n    split: train\n\n  - id: alpaca-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # LoRA settings\n    peft_adapter: lora\n    lora_r: 16\n    lora_alpha: 32\n    lora_dropout: 0.05\n    lora_target_modules: [q_proj, v_proj]\n\n    # Data settings\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    prompt_column: instruction\n    response_column: output\n    max_seq_length: 512\n\n    # Training settings\n    learning_rate: 1e-4\n    num_epochs: 3\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 4\n    gradient_accumulation_steps: 4\n\n    # Optimization\n    gradient_checkpointing: true\n    fp16: true\n\n    output_dir: ./output/alpaca-lora\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: train-alpaca\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-data\n        component: alpaca-loader\n\n      - id: train\n        component: alpaca-trainer\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.load-data.output}\n        depends_on: [load-data]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.8.2 Training Large Models with QLoRA</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: qlora-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    # QLoRA settings\n    peft_adapter: lora\n    lora_r: 64\n    lora_alpha: 16\n    quantization: nf4\n    bnb_4bit_compute_dtype: bfloat16\n\n    # Data\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    text_column: text\n    max_seq_length: 2048\n    packing: true\n\n    # Training\n    learning_rate: 2e-4\n    num_epochs: 1\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 1\n    gradient_accumulation_steps: 16\n\n    # Optimization\n    optimizer: adamw_8bit\n    gradient_checkpointing: true\n    bf16: true\n\n    output_dir: ./output/qlora-model\n</code></pre>\n<h3>11.8.3 Custom Dataset Preparation and Training</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: local-data\n    type: datasets\n    provider: local\n    loader: json\n    data_files: ./data/custom_train.json\n\n  - id: data-processor\n    type: datasets\n    method: map\n\n  - id: custom-trainer\n    type: model-trainer\n    task: sft\n\n    peft_adapter: lora\n    lora_r: 8\n    lora_alpha: 16\n\n    dataset: ${input.dataset}\n    prompt_column: user_input\n    response_column: assistant_response\n\n    learning_rate: 5e-5\n    num_epochs: 5\n    per_device_train_batch_size: 8\n\n    output_dir: ./output/custom-model\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: train-custom\n    jobs:\n      - id: load\n        component: local-data\n\n      - id: process\n        component: data-processor\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.load.output}\n          template: ${input.template}\n        depends_on: [load]\n\n      - id: train\n        component: custom-trainer\n        input:\n          dataset: ${jobs.process.output}\n        depends_on: [process]\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>After learning about dataset preparation:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Chapter 12</strong>: External Service Integration - Utilizing API services</li>\n<li><strong>Chapter 10</strong>: Using Local AI Models - Loading LoRA adapters and inference</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Currently Available Features:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Dataset loading and manipulation (HuggingFace, local files)</li>\n<li>Dataset merging, filtering, selection</li>\n<li>Inference with LoRA adapters (see Chapter 10)</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Features to be Added:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Model training execution</li>\n<li>Checkpoint management</li>\n<li>Training monitoring and visualization</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/12-external-service-integration\">12. External Service Integration</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "11. Model Training"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "user-guide/12-external-service-integration",
      "html": "<h1>Chapter 12: External Service Integration</h1>\n<p>This chapter covers integrating external AI services with model-compose.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.1 OpenAI API</h2>\n<p>OpenAI API provides various AI services including chat completions, image generation, and audio processing.</p>\n<h3>12.1.1 Chat Completions</h3>\n<p>Use GPT-4o, GPT-4, and GPT-3.5 models for text generation tasks.</p>\n<h4>Basic Configuration</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt as text}\n      temperature: ${input.temperature as number | 0.7}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Available Models</h4>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Use Case</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gpt-4o</code></td>\n<td>Multimodal model, fastest GPT-4</td>\n<td>General tasks, image analysis</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gpt-4-turbo</code></td>\n<td>High-performance GPT-4</td>\n<td>Complex reasoning</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gpt-4</code></td>\n<td>Standard GPT-4 model</td>\n<td>Deep analysis</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gpt-3.5-turbo</code></td>\n<td>Fast and cost-effective</td>\n<td>Simple tasks</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h4>Key Parameters</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">body:\n  model: gpt-4o\n  messages:\n    - role: system\n      content: &quot;You are a helpful assistant.&quot;\n    - role: user\n      content: ${input.prompt as text}\n  temperature: 0.7           # 0.0-2.0, creativity control\n  max_tokens: 1000           # Maximum response length\n  top_p: 1.0                 # Nucleus sampling\n  frequency_penalty: 0.0     # Reduce repetition\n  presence_penalty: 0.0      # Topic diversity\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Environment Variables</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...\n</code></pre>\n<h3>12.1.2 Image Generation (DALL-E)</h3>\n<p>DALL-E 3 and DALL-E 2 for AI image generation.</p>\n<h4>Basic Configuration</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /images/generations\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      model: dall-e-3\n      prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n      size: ${input.size | &quot;1024x1024&quot;}\n      quality: ${input.quality | &quot;standard&quot;}\n      n: 1\n    output:\n      image_url: ${response.data[0].url}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Available Options</h4>\n<p><strong>Models:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>dall-e-3</code>: High-quality, detailed images</li>\n<li><code>dall-e-2</code>: Fast generation</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Sizes (DALL-E 3):</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>1024x1024</code></li>\n<li><code>1792x1024</code></li>\n<li><code>1024x1792</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Quality:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>standard</code>: Standard quality</li>\n<li><code>hd</code>: High detail</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>12.1.3 Audio (TTS, Transcriptions)</h3>\n<h4>Text-to-Speech</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /audio/speech\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      model: tts-1\n      voice: ${input.voice | &quot;alloy&quot;}\n      input: ${input.text as text}\n    output: ${response as base64}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Available Voices:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>alloy</code>, <code>echo</code>, <code>fable</code>, <code>onyx</code>, <code>nova</code>, <code>shimmer</code></li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Speech-to-Text</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /audio/transcriptions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      model: whisper-1\n      file: ${input.audio as base64}\n      language: ${input.language | &quot;en&quot;}\n    output:\n      text: ${response.text}\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.2 Anthropic Claude API</h2>\n<p>Claude API provides state-of-the-art language models.</p>\n<h3>Basic Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.anthropic.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /messages\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      x-api-key: ${env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}\n      anthropic-version: &quot;2023-06-01&quot;\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt as text}\n      max_tokens: ${input.max_tokens as number | 1024}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.content[0].text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Available Models</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Use Case</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022</code></td>\n<td>Latest Claude 3.5 Sonnet</td>\n<td>General tasks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>claude-3-5-haiku-20241022</code></td>\n<td>Fast, cost-effective</td>\n<td>Simple tasks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>claude-3-opus-20240229</code></td>\n<td>Highest capability</td>\n<td>Complex reasoning</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>claude-3-sonnet-20240229</code></td>\n<td>Balanced performance</td>\n<td>General use</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Key Parameters</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">body:\n  model: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\n  messages:\n    - role: user\n      content: ${input.prompt as text}\n  max_tokens: 1024           # Maximum response length (required)\n  temperature: 1.0           # 0.0-1.0, creativity control\n  top_p: 1.0                 # Nucleus sampling\n  top_k: 0                   # Top-k sampling\n  system: &quot;You are a helpful assistant.&quot;  # System prompt\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Variables</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant-...\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.3 Google Gemini API</h2>\n<p>Google Gemini provides multimodal AI capabilities.</p>\n<h3>Basic Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta\n  action:\n    path: /models/gemini-pro:generateContent\n    method: POST\n    params:\n      key: ${env.GOOGLE_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      contents:\n        - parts:\n            - text: ${input.prompt as text}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Available Models</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Use Case</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gemini-pro</code></td>\n<td>Text generation</td>\n<td>General tasks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gemini-pro-vision</code></td>\n<td>Multimodal model</td>\n<td>Image + text</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gemini-1.5-pro</code></td>\n<td>Latest model</td>\n<td>Advanced tasks</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>gemini-1.5-flash</code></td>\n<td>Fast inference</td>\n<td>Simple tasks</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Multimodal Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta\n  action:\n    path: /models/gemini-pro-vision:generateContent\n    method: POST\n    params:\n      key: ${env.GOOGLE_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      contents:\n        - parts:\n            - text: ${input.prompt as text}\n            - inline_data:\n                mime_type: image/jpeg\n                data: ${input.image as base64}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Variables</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export GOOGLE_API_KEY=AIza...\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.4 ElevenLabs (TTS)</h2>\n<p>ElevenLabs provides high-quality text-to-speech services.</p>\n<h3>Basic Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1\n  action:\n    path: /text-to-speech/${input.voice_id}\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      xi-api-key: ${env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      text: ${input.text as text}\n      model_id: eleven_multilingual_v2\n      voice_settings:\n        stability: ${input.stability | 0.5}\n        similarity_boost: ${input.similarity_boost | 0.75}\n    output: ${response as base64}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Available Models</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Languages</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>eleven_multilingual_v2</code></td>\n<td>Multilingual model</td>\n<td>29 languages</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>eleven_monolingual_v1</code></td>\n<td>English-optimized</td>\n<td>English only</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>eleven_turbo_v2</code></td>\n<td>Fast generation</td>\n<td>English + multilingual</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Voice Selection</h3>\n<p>Use the List Voices API to get available voices:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1\n  action:\n    path: /voices\n    method: GET\n    headers:\n      xi-api-key: ${env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY}\n    output: ${response.voices}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Variables</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=sk_...\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.5 Stability AI (Image Generation)</h2>\n<p>Stability AI provides Stable Diffusion models for image generation.</p>\n<h3>Basic Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.stability.ai/v2beta\n  action:\n    path: /stable-image/generate/sd3\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.STABILITY_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n      model: sd3-large\n      aspect_ratio: ${input.aspect_ratio | &quot;1:1&quot;}\n      output_format: ${input.output_format | &quot;png&quot;}\n    output:\n      image: ${response.image as base64}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Available Models</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Model</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n<th>Use Case</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>sd3-large</code></td>\n<td>Stable Diffusion 3 Large</td>\n<td>Highest quality</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>sd3-medium</code></td>\n<td>Stable Diffusion 3 Medium</td>\n<td>Balanced</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>sdxl-1.0</code></td>\n<td>Stable Diffusion XL</td>\n<td>High resolution</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Key Parameters</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">body:\n  prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n  negative_prompt: ${input.negative_prompt | &quot;&quot;}\n  model: sd3-large\n  aspect_ratio: &quot;1:1&quot;        # 1:1, 16:9, 21:9, 2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 9:21\n  seed: 0                     # Reproducibility\n  output_format: png          # png, jpeg, webp\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Variables</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export STABILITY_API_KEY=sk-...\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.6 Replicate</h2>\n<p>Replicate provides access to various open-source AI models.</p>\n<h3>Basic Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.replicate.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /predictions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.REPLICATE_API_TOKEN}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      version: ${input.model_version}\n      input: ${input.params}\n    output:\n      prediction_id: ${response.id}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Example: FLUX Image Generation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.replicate.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /predictions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.REPLICATE_API_TOKEN}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      version: &quot;black-forest-labs/flux-schnell&quot;\n      input:\n        prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n        num_outputs: 1\n        aspect_ratio: &quot;1:1&quot;\n    output:\n      prediction_id: ${response.id}\n      status: ${response.status}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Example: Llama 3 Text Generation</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.replicate.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /predictions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.REPLICATE_API_TOKEN}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      version: &quot;meta/meta-llama-3-70b-instruct&quot;\n      input:\n        prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n        max_tokens: 512\n        temperature: 0.7\n    output:\n      prediction_id: ${response.id}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Polling for Results</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.replicate.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /predictions/${input.prediction_id}\n    method: GET\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.REPLICATE_API_TOKEN}\n    output:\n      status: ${response.status}\n      result: ${response.output}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Environment Variables</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export REPLICATE_API_TOKEN=r8_...\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.7 Custom HTTP API</h2>\n<p>Integrate any REST API using the <code>http-client</code> component.</p>\n<h3>Basic Pattern</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n  action:\n    path: /v1/endpoint\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body: ${input}\n    output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Authentication Methods</h3>\n<h4>Bearer Token</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>API Key Header</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  X-API-Key: ${env.API_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<h4>Basic Authentication</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  Authorization: Basic ${env.BASIC_AUTH_TOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Query Parameters</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n  action:\n    path: /search\n    method: GET\n    params:\n      q: ${input.query}\n      limit: 10\n      offset: ${input.offset | 0}\n    output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Multi-Action Component</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.example.com\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n  actions:\n    - id: create\n      path: /resources\n      method: POST\n      body: ${input}\n      output: ${response}\n\n    - id: get\n      path: /resources/${input.id}\n      method: GET\n      output: ${response}\n\n    - id: update\n      path: /resources/${input.id}\n      method: PUT\n      body: ${input}\n      output: ${response}\n\n    - id: delete\n      path: /resources/${input.id}\n      method: DELETE\n      output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<p>Usage:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: create\n      component: api\n      action: create\n      input:\n        name: &quot;Example&quot;\n\n    - id: get\n      component: api\n      action: get\n      input:\n        id: ${jobs.create.output.id}\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>12.8 External Service Integration Best Practices</h2>\n<h3>1. API Key Management</h3>\n<p><strong>Use environment variables:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">headers:\n  Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export API_KEY=your-secret-key\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Never hardcode API keys:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Bad - Don't do this\nheaders:\n  Authorization: Bearer sk-hardcoded-key\n</code></pre>\n<h3>2. Error Handling</h3>\n<p>Add error handling in workflows:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: api-call\n      component: external-api\n      on_error:\n        action: retry\n        max_retry_count: 3\n        backoff: exponential\n</code></pre>\n<h3>3. Cost Optimization</h3>\n<p><strong>Use appropriate models:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Use cheaper models for simple tasks\nbody:\n  model: gpt-3.5-turbo  # Instead of gpt-4o for simple tasks\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Limit response length:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">body:\n  max_tokens: 256  # Set reasonable limits\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Cache responses:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  cache:\n    enabled: true\n    ttl: 3600  # Cache for 1 hour\n</code></pre>\n<h3>4. Rate Limiting</h3>\n<p>External APIs typically have rate limits on requests. Exceeding these limits can result in rejected requests or additional costs.</p>\n<p><strong>Component-level limits:</strong></p>\n<p><code>http-client</code> components accept an optional <code>rate_limit</code> field. Two gates can be combined: a token bucket (<code>requests</code>/<code>period</code>/<code>burst</code>) and a minimum gap between consecutive requests (<code>interval</code>). When a limit would be exceeded, the call is suspended with <code>asyncio.sleep</code> until it can proceed — no exception is raised. Polling and callback completions are not throttled by this limiter.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  rate_limit:\n    requests: 60        # Maximum 60 requests per period\n    period: 1m          # Window size (e.g. '1s', '500ms', '1m')\n    burst: 10           # Token bucket capacity (defaults to 'requests')\n    interval: 100ms     # Minimum gap between consecutive requests\n  action:\n    endpoint: https://api.example.com/v1/process\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.API_KEY}\n    body: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Shorthand form:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  rate_limit: 10/s      # → { requests: 10, period: 1s }\n</code></pre>\n<p>Supported shorthand: <code>&lt;int&gt;/&lt;duration&gt;</code>, e.g. <code>10/s</code>, <code>60/m</code>, <code>1000/h</code>, <code>5/500ms</code>. Use the object form when you need <code>burst</code> or <code>interval</code>.</p>\n<p><strong>Min-interval only:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  rate_limit:\n    interval: 250ms     # At least 250ms between requests\n</code></pre>\n<blockquote>\n<p>Migration note: earlier docs referenced <code>requests_per_minute</code> / <code>requests_per_day</code>. These field names were never implemented. Use <code>requests</code> + <code>period</code> instead — for example, <code>requests_per_minute: 60</code> becomes <code>requests: 60, period: 1m</code> (or the shorthand <code>60/m</code>).</p>\n</blockquote>\n<p><strong>Add delays in workflows:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: api-call-1\n      component: external-api\n      input: ${input}\n\n    - id: delay\n      component: shell\n      command: [&quot;sleep&quot;, &quot;1&quot;]  # Wait 1 second\n\n    - id: api-call-2\n      component: external-api\n      input: ${input}\n</code></pre>\n<p>Common rate limits:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>OpenAI: 3,500 requests/min (Tier 1), 10,000 requests/min (Tier 2)</li>\n<li>Anthropic: 50 requests/min (Free), 1,000 requests/min (Pro)</li>\n<li>Google Gemini: 60 requests/min (Free)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>5. Logging and Monitoring</h3>\n<p>When using external APIs, it's important to track usage and request/response information for cost management and troubleshooting.</p>\n<p><strong>Track usage:</strong></p>\n<p>Extract token usage from API responses to monitor costs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: call-gpt\n      component: openai-chat\n      input: ${input}\n      output:\n        message: ${output.choices[0].message.content}\n        prompt_tokens: ${output.usage.prompt_tokens}\n        completion_tokens: ${output.usage.completion_tokens}\n        total_tokens: ${output.usage.total_tokens}\n</code></pre>\n<p>You can log or store this token information in a database to analyze usage patterns.</p>\n<p><strong>Log requests/responses:</strong></p>\n<p>Record API request IDs and metadata for debugging and tracking:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body: ${input}\n    output:\n      response: ${response}\n      request_id: ${response.id}       # Request ID for tracking\n      model: ${response.model}         # Model used\n      created: ${response.created}     # Timestamp\n</code></pre>\n<p>This information is useful for:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Providing request_id when reporting issues to API providers</li>\n<li>Analyzing response times and monitoring performance</li>\n<li>Verifying the actual model used (can change due to fallbacks)</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>Try experimenting with:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Combining multiple AI services in workflows</li>\n<li>Building multi-modal applications</li>\n<li>Creating custom API integrations</li>\n<li>Optimizing for cost and performance</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/13-streaming-mode\">13. Streaming Mode</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "Chapter 12: External Service Integration"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "user-guide/13-streaming-mode",
      "html": "<h1>13. Streaming Mode</h1>\n<p>This chapter explains how to use model-compose's streaming capabilities to generate and process real-time responses.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>13.1 Streaming Overview</h2>\n<h3>13.1.1 What is Streaming?</h3>\n<p>Streaming mode delivers partial results as they are generated, rather than waiting for the complete response from a model or API.</p>\n<p><strong>Benefits:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Immediate feedback to users</li>\n<li>Reduced time-to-first-token (TTFT) for long responses</li>\n<li>Build real-time streaming applications</li>\n<li>Better user experience (typing effect)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Use Cases:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Chatbot conversations (ChatGPT-style)</li>\n<li>Real-time text generation</li>\n<li>Long document summarization</li>\n<li>Translation services</li>\n<li>Code generation</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>13.1.2 Supported Components</h3>\n<p>Components that support streaming:</p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Component Type</th>\n<th>Streaming Support</th>\n<th>Configuration</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code> (text-generation)</td>\n<td>✅</td>\n<td><code>streaming: true</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code> (chat-completion)</td>\n<td>✅</td>\n<td><code>streaming: true</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>model</code> (image-to-text)</td>\n<td>✅</td>\n<td><code>streaming: true</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>agent</code></td>\n<td>✅</td>\n<td><code>streaming: true</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>http-client</code></td>\n<td>✅</td>\n<td><code>stream_format: json/text</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>http-server</code></td>\n<td>✅</td>\n<td><code>stream_format: json/text</code></td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<blockquote>\n<p><strong>Note on <code>model</code> vs <code>agent</code> streaming</strong></p>\n<p>The <code>streaming</code> flag on a <code>model</code> component yields <strong>tokens</strong> as the model decodes them within a single response.\nThe <code>streaming</code> flag on an <code>agent</code> component yields <strong>whole messages</strong> (assistant replies and tool results) as the ReAct loop produces them across multiple model calls.\nThe two flags operate at different granularities and can be enabled independently. An agent with <code>streaming: true</code> does not automatically enable token streaming on the underlying model — it always consumes complete model responses and forwards them as message-level chunks.</p>\n</blockquote>\n<h3>13.1.3 Streaming Protocol</h3>\n<p>model-compose uses the <strong>SSE (Server-Sent Events)</strong> protocol.</p>\n<p><strong>SSE Format:</strong></p>\n<pre><code>data: chunk1\n\ndata: chunk2\n\ndata: chunk3\n\n</code></pre>\n<p>Each chunk is sent with a <code>data:</code> prefix and separated by blank lines.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>13.2 Component-Specific Streaming Configuration</h2>\n<h3>13.2.1 Model Components</h3>\n<h4>Basic Configuration</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: facebook/bart-large-cnn\n  streaming: true                  # Enable streaming\n  action:\n    text: ${input.text as text}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 150\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Important Constraints:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>batch_size</code> must be <code>1</code></li>\n<li>Only single input supported (no batch processing)</li>\n<li>Recommended <code>num_beams: 1</code> during streaming</li>\n</ul>\n<h4>Text Generation Streaming</h4>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  task: text-generation\n  model: gpt2\n  streaming: true\n  action:\n    text: ${input.prompt as text}\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 200\n      do_sample: false               # Deterministic
