URL from callback\n        width: ${output.width}\n        height: ${output.height}\n\n    # Step 2: Image optimization (sync)\n    - id: optimize\n      component: image-optimizer\n      input:\n        url: ${jobs.generate.output.image_url}\n      output:\n        final_url: ${output.optimized_url}\n        original_size: ${output.original_size}\n        compressed_size: ${output.compressed_size}\n        savings: ${output.original_size - output.compressed_size}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>15.5.2 Architecture Diagram</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">sequenceDiagram\n    participant User as User/Workflow\n    participant Gateway as Gateway&lt;br/&gt;(ngrok, Port 8090)\n    participant Listener as Listener&lt;br/&gt;(Port 8090)\n    participant External as External AI Service&lt;br/&gt;(api.image-ai.com)\n\n    Note over User,External: 1. Image Generation Request\n    User-&gt;&gt;External: POST /generate&lt;br/&gt;callback_url: https://abc123.ngrok.io/webhooks/image/completed\n    External--&gt;&gt;User: 202 Accepted&lt;br/&gt;task_id: task-123\n\n    Note over User: 2. Waiting for Callback\n\n    Note over External: 3. Background Processing (AI Image Generation)\n\n    Note over External,Listener: 4. Callback After Completion\n    External-&gt;&gt;Gateway: POST https://abc123.ngrok.io/webhooks/image/completed&lt;br/&gt;{task_id, status, image_url}\n    Gateway-&gt;&gt;Listener: Forward to local port 8090\n\n    Note over Listener: 5. Callback Processing\n    Listener-&gt;&gt;Listener: Find waiting workflow by task_id\n    Listener-&gt;&gt;User: Deliver result (image_url)\n\n    Note over User: 6. Workflow Continues\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Flow explanation:</strong></p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Request stage</strong>: Workflow sends image generation request to external AI service (gateway public URL as callback URL)</li>\n<li><strong>Wait stage</strong>: Workflow waits until callback is received</li>\n<li><strong>Processing stage</strong>: External service generates image in background</li>\n<li><strong>Callback stage</strong>: After completion, sends callback to gateway public URL → gateway forwards to local listener</li>\n<li><strong>Matching stage</strong>: Listener finds waiting workflow by task_id</li>\n<li><strong>Completion stage</strong>: Delivers result to workflow and proceeds to next step</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>15.5.3 Production Environment Considerations</h3>\n<p><strong>Local development:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">gateway:\n  type: http-tunnel\n  driver: ngrok  # Use ngrok during development\n  port: 8080\n\nlistener:\n  host: 0.0.0.0\n  port: 8090\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Production environment:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Remove gateway configuration (use public IP/domain)\n\ncontroller:\n  type: http-server\n  host: 0.0.0.0\n  port: 443  # HTTPS\n  # Add SSL configuration\n\nlistener:\n  host: 0.0.0.0\n  port: 8090\n\ncomponents:\n  service:\n    action:\n      body:\n        # Use production domain\n        callback_url: https://api.yourdomain.com/webhooks/callback\n        callback_id: ${context.run_id}\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>15.6 System Integration Best Practices</h2>\n<h3>1. Listener Security</h3>\n<p><strong>Timeout configuration:</strong></p>\n<p>Set timeouts so async tasks don't wait indefinitely:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  service:\n    type: http-client\n    timeout: 300000  # 5 minute timeout\n    action:\n      body:\n        callback_url: ${gateway:8090.public_url}/callback\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Signature verification:</strong></p>\n<p>Verify signatures to confirm authenticity of callback requests:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">listener:\n  callbacks:\n    - path: /webhook\n      # Signature verification requires custom logic\n      identify_by: ${body.id}\n      # Verify signature in header: ${header.X-Signature}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>2. Gateway Usage</h3>\n<p><strong>Use in development only:</strong></p>\n<p>Use gateways primarily in development/test environments. Use public IPs/domains in production.</p>\n<p><strong>Free plan limitations:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>ngrok free plan: Connection limits, hourly request limits</li>\n<li>Cloudflare: Unlimited on free plan</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>3. Error Handling</h3>\n<p><strong>Callback failure handling:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: async-task\n      component: async-service\n      input: ${input}\n      on_error:\n        - id: retry\n          component: async-service\n          input: ${input}\n          retry:\n            max_retry_count: 3\n            delay: 5000\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Retry logic:</strong></p>\n<p>Implement retry logic as external services may fail to send callbacks.</p>\n<h3>4. Logging and Monitoring</h3>\n<p><strong>Callback logging:</strong></p>\n<p>Store all callback request information for debugging and troubleshooting:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">listener:\n  callbacks:\n    - path: /webhook\n      identify_by: ${body.task_id}\n      result:\n        task_id: ${body.task_id}      # Task ID\n        status: ${body.status}        # Task status\n        timestamp: ${body.timestamp}  # Callback receipt time\n        data: ${body}                 # Store full payload (for debugging)\n</code></pre>\n<p>This stored information is used for:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Root cause analysis when callbacks fail</li>\n<li>Monitoring external service response times</li>\n<li>Data integrity verification</li>\n<li>Audit log generation</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Workflow execution tracking:</strong></p>\n<p>Track entire flow of each workflow execution:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: request\n      component: external-api\n      input: ${input}\n      output:\n        request_time: ${context.timestamp}\n        task_id: ${output.task_id}\n\n    - id: log-request\n      component: logger\n      input:\n        level: info\n        message: &quot;Task requested: task_id=${jobs.request.output.task_id}&quot;\n        data: ${jobs.request.output}\n\n    # Wait for callback and receive result\n\n    - id: log-result\n      component: logger\n      input:\n        level: info\n        message: &quot;Task completed: task_id=${jobs.request.output.task_id}&quot;\n        data: ${output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Gateway URL verification:</strong></p>\n<p>Verify and record public URL after gateway starts:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up\n# Check gateway URL in logs\n# [Gateway] Public URL: https://abc123.ngrok.io\n\n# Register public URL with external service\n# e.g., Slack Event Subscriptions, GitHub Webhooks, etc.\n</code></pre>\n<p>Since gateway may generate new URLs each startup, recommend extracting URL from automated deployment scripts and auto-registering with external services.</p>\n<p><strong>Performance metrics collection:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">listener:\n  callbacks:\n    - path: /webhook\n      identify_by: ${body.task_id}\n      result:\n        task_id: ${body.task_id}  # Task ID\n        result: ${body.result}    # Actual result data\n        metrics:\n          processing_time: ${body.processing_time_ms}  # Actual processing time (ms)\n          queue_time: ${body.queue_time_ms}            # Queue wait time (ms)\n          total_time: ${body.processing_time_ms + body.queue_time_ms}  # Total time\n</code></pre>\n<p>Use these metrics to:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Calculate average processing time of external services</li>\n<li>Detect performance degradation and send alerts</li>\n<li>Monitor SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>15.7 Systems - Infrastructure Management</h2>\n<p>Systems provide declarative management of infrastructure services (such as Docker Compose stacks) that your components depend on. When you run <code>model-compose up</code>, systems are started automatically before components; when you run <code>model-compose down</code>, they are stopped after components.</p>\n<h3>15.7.1 Systems Overview</h3>\n<p>Systems are useful when your components require external infrastructure:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Database servers (PostgreSQL, Redis, etc.)</li>\n<li>Browser automation (Chromium + noVNC)</li>\n<li>Message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.)</li>\n<li>Any service defined in a Docker Compose file</li>\n</ul>\n<p>Without systems, you would need to manually run <code>docker compose up -d</code> before starting model-compose. With systems, this is handled automatically.</p>\n<h3>15.7.2 Docker Compose System</h3>\n<p>The <code>docker-compose</code> system type manages services defined in Docker Compose files.</p>\n<p><strong>Basic configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">system:\n  type: docker-compose\n  file: docker-compose.yml\n  wait: true\n  wait_timeout: 60s\n</code></pre>\n<p>This runs <code>docker compose -f docker-compose.yml up -d --wait</code> on startup and <code>docker compose -f docker-compose.yml down</code> on shutdown.</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration options:</strong></p>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Field</th>\n<th>Type</th>\n<th>Default</th>\n<th>Description</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><code>type</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><strong>required</strong></td>\n<td>Must be <code>docker-compose</code></td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>file</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Path to a single docker-compose file</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>files</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td><code>[]</code></td>\n<td>Paths to multiple docker-compose files</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>project_name</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Docker Compose project name (<code>-p</code> flag)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>profiles</code></td>\n<td>array</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Docker Compose profiles to activate</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>env_file</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td>-</td>\n<td>Path to environment file</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>build</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>false</code></td>\n<td>Build images before starting (<code>--build</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait</code></td>\n<td>boolean</td>\n<td><code>true</code></td>\n<td>Wait for services to be healthy (<code>--wait</code>)</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><code>wait_timeout</code></td>\n<td>string</td>\n<td><code>60s</code></td>\n<td>Timeout for health check waiting</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>15.7.3 Multiple Systems</h3>\n<p>You can define multiple systems when different infrastructure stacks are needed:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">systems:\n  - id: database\n    type: docker-compose\n    file: docker-compose.db.yml\n    wait: true\n\n  - id: browser-infra\n    type: docker-compose\n    file: docker-compose.browser.yml\n    wait: true\n    wait_timeout: 120s\n</code></pre>\n<h3>15.7.4 Complete Example: Browser Automation</h3>\n<p>This example shows how systems integrate with components to automate browser tasks:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">systems:\n  - id: browser-infra\n    type: docker-compose\n    file: docker-compose.yml\n    wait: true\n    wait_timeout: 60s\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: browser\n    type: web-browser\n    host: localhost\n    port: 9222\n    actions:\n      - id: navigate\n        method: navigate\n        url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n        wait_until: networkidle\n\n      - id: extract-text\n        method: extract\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        extract_mode: text\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: scrape\n    title: Web Scraper\n    input:\n      - id: url\n        type: string\n      - id: selector\n        type: string\n    jobs:\n      - id: navigate\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.url}\n\n      - id: extract\n        component: browser\n        action: extract-text\n        input:\n          selector: ${input.selector}\n        depends_on: [navigate]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>What happens when you run <code>model-compose up</code>:</strong></p>\n<ol>\n<li>System <code>browser-infra</code> starts: <code>docker compose up -d --wait</code></li>\n<li>Docker Compose starts Chromium and noVNC containers</li>\n<li>model-compose waits until containers are healthy</li>\n<li>Component <code>browser</code> connects to Chromium on port 9222</li>\n<li>Controller starts accepting workflow requests</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>What happens when you run <code>model-compose down</code>:</strong></p>\n<ol>\n<li>Controller stops</li>\n<li>Component <code>browser</code> disconnects</li>\n<li>System <code>browser-infra</code> stops: <code>docker compose down</code></li>\n</ol>\n<h3>15.7.5 Lifecycle Order</h3>\n<p>Systems follow a specific lifecycle order relative to other sections:</p>\n<pre><code>Startup:  Systems → Gateways → Listeners → Components → Controller\nShutdown: Controller → Components → Listeners → Gateways → Systems\n</code></pre>\n<p>Systems start first because they provide the infrastructure that other sections depend on, and stop last to ensure graceful shutdown.</p>\n<h3>15.7.6 Prerequisites</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Docker</strong> must be installed and available in PATH</li>\n<li><strong>Docker Compose</strong> plugin must be available (<code>docker compose</code> subcommand)</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>Experiment with these scenarios:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>External async API integration</li>\n<li>Testing webhooks in local environment</li>\n<li>Slack/Discord bot development</li>\n<li>Payment gateway webhook handling</li>\n<li>Browser automation with Docker Compose systems</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/16-deployment\">16. Deployment</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "15. System Integration"
      }

      "slug": "user-guide/16-deployment",
      "html": "<h1>16. Deployment</h1>\n<p>This chapter explains how to run model-compose applications in local environments or deploy them as Docker containers.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>16.1 Local Execution</h2>\n<h3>16.1.1 Basic Execution</h3>\n<p>model-compose runs directly in the local environment using native runtime by default.</p>\n<p><strong>Starting the controller:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up\n</code></pre>\n<p>Default behavior:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Loads <code>model-compose.yml</code> from current directory</li>\n<li>Starts services with native runtime</li>\n<li>Runs in foreground mode (log output)</li>\n<li>Exit with Ctrl+C</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Background execution:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up -d\n</code></pre>\n<p>In background mode:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Services run in a separate process</li>\n<li>Stop with <code>model-compose down</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Stopping the controller:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose down\n</code></pre>\n<p>Stop process:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Creates <code>.stop</code> file</li>\n<li>Controller detects file (polls every 1 second)</li>\n<li>Graceful service shutdown</li>\n<li>Resource cleanup</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>16.1.2 Environment Variable Management</h3>\n<p><strong>Using <code>.env</code> file:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Create .env file\ncat &gt; .env &lt;&lt;EOF\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-...\nMODEL_CACHE_DIR=/models\nLOG_LEVEL=info\nEOF\n\n# Automatically loads .env file\nmodel-compose up\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Custom <code>.env</code> file:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up --env-file .env.production\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Individual environment variable override:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up -e OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-... -e LOG_LEVEL=debug\n</code></pre>\n<p>Environment variable priority:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Values passed via <code>--env</code> / <code>-e</code> flag (highest priority)</li>\n<li>File specified with <code>--env-file</code></li>\n<li>Default <code>.env</code> file</li>\n<li>System environment variables</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>16.1.3 Specifying Configuration File</h3>\n<p><strong>Using custom configuration file:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up -f custom-compose.yml\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Merging multiple configuration files:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up -f base.yml -f override.yml\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.1.4 Running Workflow Standalone</h3>\n<p>Run workflow only without controller:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose run my-workflow --input '{&quot;text&quot;: &quot;Hello&quot;}'\n</code></pre>\n<p>Features:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Does not start controller</li>\n<li>Executes workflow once and exits</li>\n<li>Useful for CI/CD pipelines or batch jobs</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Passing input from JSON file:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose run my-workflow --input @input.json\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.1.5 Debugging Options</h3>\n<p><strong>Detailed log output:</strong></p>\n<p>Specify logger level in configuration file:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n\nlogger:\n  - type: console\n    level: debug        # debug, info, warning, error, critical\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>16.2 Docker Runtime</h2>\n<h3>16.2.1 Basic Docker Configuration</h3>\n<p><strong>Simple Docker runtime configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime: docker                 # String format\n</code></pre>\n<p>This configuration expands to:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    # Uses default image (auto-build)\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Specifying image:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    image: my-registry/model-compose:latest\n    container_name: my-controller\n</code></pre>\n<p>Execution flow:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Attempts to pull image from registry</li>\n<li>Falls back to local build if pull fails</li>\n<li>Creates and starts container</li>\n<li>Streams logs (foreground) or detaches (background)</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Port mapping:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    ports:\n      - &quot;5000:8080&quot;                # host:container\n      - 8081                       # Same port (8081:8081)\n</code></pre>\n<p>Port formats:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>String: <code>&quot;host_port:container_port&quot;</code></li>\n<li>Integer: <code>port</code> (same for host and container)</li>\n<li>Object: Advanced configuration (see below)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>16.2.2 Advanced Docker Options</h3>\n<p><strong>Image build configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    build:\n      context: .                   # Build context path\n      dockerfile: Dockerfile       # Custom Dockerfile\n      args:                        # Build arguments\n        PYTHON_VERSION: &quot;3.11&quot;\n        MODEL_NAME: &quot;llama-2&quot;\n      target: production           # Multi-stage build target\n      cache_from:                  # Cache images\n        - my-registry/cache:latest\n      labels:\n        app: model-compose\n        version: &quot;1.0&quot;\n      network: host                # Network mode during build\n      pull: true                   # Always pull base images\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Advanced port configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    ports:\n      - target: 8080               # Container port\n        published: 5000            # Host port\n        protocol: tcp              # tcp or udp\n        mode: host                 # host or ingress\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Network configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    networks:\n      - my-network                 # Connect to existing network\n      - bridge                     # Docker default bridge\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Container run options:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    hostname: model-compose-host   # Container hostname\n    command:                       # Override CMD\n      - python\n      - -m\n      - mindor.cli.compose\n      - up\n      - --verbose\n    entrypoint: /bin/bash          # Override ENTRYPOINT\n    working_dir: /app              # Working directory\n    user: &quot;1000:1000&quot;              # User:group ID\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Resource limits:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    mem_limit: 2g                  # Memory limit (512m, 2g, etc.)\n    memswap_limit: 4g              # Memory + swap limit\n    cpus: &quot;2.0&quot;                    # CPU allocation (0.5, 2.0, etc.)\n    cpu_shares: 1024               # Relative CPU weight\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Restart policy:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    restart: always                # no, always, on-failure, unless-stopped\n</code></pre>\n<p>Restart policy descriptions:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>no</code>: Do not restart (default)</li>\n<li><code>always</code>: Always restart</li>\n<li><code>on-failure</code>: Restart only on error exit</li>\n<li><code>unless-stopped</code>: Restart until manually stopped</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Health check:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [ &quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;curl&quot;, &quot;-f&quot;, &quot;http://localhost:8080/health&quot; ]\n      interval: 30s                # Check interval\n      timeout: 10s                 # Timeout\n      max_retry_count: 3           # Maximum retry count\n      start_period: 40s            # Grace period\n</code></pre>\n<p>Or simply:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    healthcheck:\n      test: &quot;curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Security options:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    privileged: false              # Privileged mode (not recommended)\n    security_opt:\n      - apparmor=unconfined\n      - seccomp=unconfined\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Logging configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    logging:\n      driver: json-file\n      options:\n        max-size: &quot;10m&quot;\n        max-file: &quot;3&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Labels:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    labels:\n      environment: production\n      team: ml-ops\n      version: &quot;1.0.0&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.2.3 Volumes and Environment Variables</h3>\n<p><strong>Volume mount - simple format:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    volumes:\n      - ./models:/models           # Bind mount\n      - ./cache:/cache:ro          # Read-only\n      - model-data:/data           # Named volume\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Volume mount - detailed format:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    volumes:\n      # Bind mount\n      - type: bind\n        source: ./models           # Host path\n        target: /models            # Container path\n        read_only: false\n        bind:\n          propagation: rprivate\n\n      # Named volume\n      - type: volume\n        source: model-data         # Volume name\n        target: /data\n        volume:\n          nocopy: false\n\n      # tmpfs (temporary memory)\n      - type: tmpfs\n        target: /tmp\n        tmpfs:\n          size: 1073741824         # 1GB (bytes)\n          mode: 1777\n</code></pre>\n<p>Volume type descriptions:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>bind</code>: Mount host directory/file to container</li>\n<li><code>volume</code>: Named volume managed by Docker</li>\n<li><code>tmpfs</code>: Memory-based temporary filesystem (deleted on container stop)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Environment variable configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    environment:\n      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}   # Pass host environment variable\n      MODEL_CACHE_DIR: /models\n      LOG_LEVEL: info\n      WORKERS: 4\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Environment variable file:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    env_file:\n      - .env                       # Single file\n      - .env.production            # Multiple files\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>16.3 Docker Container Build and Deployment</h2>\n<h3>16.3.1 Automatic Build Process</h3>\n<p>model-compose automatically builds images when using Docker runtime.</p>\n<p><strong>Build context preparation:</strong></p>\n<p>When running <code>model-compose up</code>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Creates <code>.docker/</code> directory</li>\n<li>Copies source code (mindor package)</li>\n<li>Copies/creates <code>requirements.txt</code></li>\n<li>Creates <code>model-compose.yml</code> (converted to native runtime)</li>\n<li>Copies webui directories (if configured)</li>\n<li>Copies Dockerfile or uses default Dockerfile</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Default Dockerfile:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-dockerfile\">FROM ubuntu:22.04\n\nWORKDIR /app\n\n# Install Python 3.11\nRUN apt update &amp;&amp; apt install -y \\\n    python3.11 \\\n    python3.11-venv \\\n    python3-pip \\\n    gcc \\\n    &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*\n\n# Python symlinks\nRUN ln -sf /usr/bin/python3.11 /usr/bin/python &amp;&amp; \\\n    ln -sf /usr/bin/python3.11 /usr/bin/python3\n\n# Install base dependencies\nRUN python -m pip install --upgrade pip\nRUN pip install --no-cache-dir \\\n    click pyyaml pydantic python-dotenv \\\n    aiohttp requests fastapi uvicorn \\\n    'mcp&gt;=1.10.1' pyngrok ulid gradio Pillow\n\n# Install project dependencies\nCOPY requirements.txt .\nRUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt\n\n# Copy application files\nCOPY src .\nCOPY webui ./webui\nCOPY model-compose.yml .\n\n# Default command\nCMD [ &quot;python&quot;, &quot;-m&quot;, &quot;mindor.cli.compose&quot;, &quot;up&quot; ]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.3.2 Using Custom Dockerfile</h3>\n<p>To use a project-specific Docker image, you can create a custom Dockerfile.</p>\n<p><strong>Project directory structure:</strong></p>\n<pre><code>my-project/\n├── model-compose.yml    # Workflow configuration\n├── Dockerfile           # Custom Docker image\n├── requirements.txt     # Python dependencies (optional)\n└── .env                 # Environment variables (optional)\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Note</strong>: To use a custom Dockerfile, you must explicitly specify it in the <code>build</code> section. The Dockerfile can be placed in the project root or any desired location.</p>\n<p><strong>Dockerfile example:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-dockerfile\"># Dockerfile\nFROM python:3.11-slim\n\nWORKDIR /app\n\n# Install system dependencies\nRUN apt update &amp;&amp; apt install -y \\\n    git \\\n    curl \\\n    &amp;&amp; rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*\n\n# Install model-compose\nCOPY requirements.txt .\nRUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt\n\n# Pre-download models\nRUN python -c &quot;from transformers import AutoModel; AutoModel.from_pretrained('bert-base-uncased')&quot;\n\n# Copy application\nCOPY . .\n\nCMD [ &quot;model-compose&quot;, &quot;up&quot; ]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Specifying custom Dockerfile in configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    build:\n      context: .\n      dockerfile: Dockerfile       # Custom Dockerfile\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.3.3 Multi-stage Build</h3>\n<p><strong>Separating development/production:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-dockerfile\"># Stage 1: Build environment\nFROM python:3.11 AS builder\n\nWORKDIR /app\n\nCOPY requirements.txt .\nRUN pip install --user --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt\n\nCOPY src ./src\n\n# Stage 2: Runtime environment\nFROM python:3.11-slim AS runtime\n\nWORKDIR /app\n\n# Copy packages from builder\nCOPY --from=builder /root/.local /root/.local\nCOPY --from=builder /app/src ./src\n\n# Update PATH\nENV PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH\n\nCOPY model-compose.yml .\n\nCMD [ &quot;model-compose&quot;, &quot;up&quot; ]\n\n# Stage 3: Development environment\nFROM runtime AS development\n\nRUN pip install --no-cache-dir pytest black flake8\n\nCMD [ &quot;model-compose&quot;, &quot;up&quot;, &quot;--verbose&quot; ]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Specifying target in configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Production\ncontroller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    build:\n      context: .\n      target: runtime\n\n---\n# Development\ncontroller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    build:\n      context: .\n      target: development\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.3.4 Using Image Registry</h3>\n<p><strong>Building and pushing image:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Local build\ndocker build -t my-registry.com/model-compose:1.0 .\n\n# Push to registry\ndocker push my-registry.com/model-compose:1.0\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Using registry image in configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    image: my-registry.com/model-compose:1.0\n    container_name: model-compose-prod\n</code></pre>\n<p>On execution:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Pulls image from registry</li>\n<li>Creates and starts container</li>\n<li>Skips local build process</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>16.3.5 Private Registry Authentication</h3>\n<p><strong>Docker login:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">docker login my-registry.com\n</code></pre>\n<p>Or with environment variables:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export DOCKER_USERNAME=myuser\nexport DOCKER_PASSWORD=mypass\ndocker login -u $DOCKER_USERNAME -p $DOCKER_PASSWORD my-registry.com\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Authentication credentials are stored in <code>~/.docker/config.json</code>.</strong></p>\n<hr />\n<h2>16.4 Production Environment Considerations</h2>\n<h3>16.4.1 Concurrency Control</h3>\n<p><strong>Controller-level concurrency:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  max_concurrent_count: 10         # Maximum 10 concurrent workflows\n  threaded: false                  # Thread-based execution (default: false)\n</code></pre>\n<p>Concurrency settings:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>max_concurrent_count: 0</code>: Unlimited (default, use with caution)</li>\n<li><code>max_concurrent_count: N</code>: Maximum N concurrent executions</li>\n<li><code>threaded: true</code>: Run each workflow in separate thread</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Component-level concurrency:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: api-client\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.example.com\n    max_concurrent_count: 5        # Max 5 concurrent requests for this component\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.4.2 Resource Limits</h3>\n<p><strong>Memory limits:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    mem_limit: 4g                  # Maximum 4GB memory\n    memswap_limit: 6g              # Memory + swap 6GB\n</code></pre>\n<p>Memory units:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>b</code>: bytes</li>\n<li><code>k</code>: kilobytes</li>\n<li><code>m</code>: megabytes</li>\n<li><code>g</code>: gigabytes</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>CPU limits:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    cpus: &quot;2.0&quot;                    # Maximum 2 CPU cores\n    cpu_shares: 1024               # Relative CPU weight\n</code></pre>\n<p>CPU settings:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>cpus</code>: Absolute CPU limit (0.5 = 50%, 2.0 = 200%)</li>\n<li><code>cpu_shares</code>: Relative weight (default 1024)</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>16.4.3 Restart Policy</h3>\n<p><strong>Auto-restart configuration:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    restart: unless-stopped        # Always restart until manually stopped\n</code></pre>\n<p>Production recommendations:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>always</code>: Always restart (including system reboot)</li>\n<li><code>unless-stopped</code>: Restart until manually stopped</li>\n<li><code>on-failure</code>: Restart only on error</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>16.4.4 Health Check</h3>\n<p><strong>HTTP endpoint health check:</strong></p>\n<p>model-compose provides <code>/health</code> endpoint by default.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [ &quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;curl&quot;, &quot;-f&quot;, &quot;http://localhost:8080/health&quot; ]\n      interval: 30s\n      timeout: 10s\n      max_retry_count: 3\n      start_period: 40s\n</code></pre>\n<p>Health check response:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;status&quot;: &quot;ok&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Custom health check:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [ &quot;CMD-SHELL&quot;, &quot;python -c 'import requests; requests.get(\\&quot;http://localhost:8080/health\\&quot;)' || exit 1&quot; ]\n      interval: 20s\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.4.5 Security Considerations</h3>\n<p><strong>Running in non-privileged mode:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    privileged: false              # Always false recommended\n    user: &quot;1000:1000&quot;              # Non-root user\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Secret management:</strong></p>\n<p>Passing sensitive information via environment variables:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    environment:\n      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}     # Injected from host\n      DB_PASSWORD: ${env.DB_PASSWORD}\n</code></pre>\n<p>On execution:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-...\nexport DB_PASSWORD=secret\nmodel-compose up\n</code></pre>\n<p>Or using <code>.env</code> file (do not commit to repository):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># .env.production\nOPENAI_API_KEY=sk-proj-...\nDB_PASSWORD=secret\n</code></pre>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose up --env-file .env.production\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Network isolation:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    networks:\n      - isolated-network           # Use isolated network\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.4.6 Data Persistence</h3>\n<p><strong>Preserving data with volume mounts:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    volumes:\n      - ./data:/data               # Local data directory\n      - model-cache:/cache         # Named volume\n      - ./logs:/app/logs           # Log directory\n</code></pre>\n<p>Creating named volume:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">docker volume create model-cache\n</code></pre>\n<p>Checking volumes:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">docker volume ls\ndocker volume inspect model-cache\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>16.5 Monitoring and Logging</h2>\n<h3>16.5.1 Logger Configuration</h3>\n<p><strong>Console logger:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">logger:\n  - type: console\n    level: info                    # debug, info, warning, error, critical\n</code></pre>\n<p>Log levels:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>debug</code>: All logs (for development)</li>\n<li><code>info</code>: General information (default)</li>\n<li><code>warning</code>: Warning messages</li>\n<li><code>error</code>: Error messages</li>\n<li><code>critical</code>: Critical errors</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>File logger:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">logger:\n  - type: file\n    path: ./logs/run.log           # Log file path\n    level: info\n</code></pre>\n<p>Directories are created automatically.</p>\n<p><strong>Using multiple loggers:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">logger:\n  - type: console\n    level: warning                 # Only warnings to console\n\n  - type: file\n    path: ./logs/all.log\n    level: debug                   # All logs to file\n\n  - type: file\n    path: ./logs/errors.log\n    level: error                   # Error-only log\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.5.2 Docker Container Logs</h3>\n<p><strong>Viewing logs in real-time:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Automatic streaming in foreground mode\nmodel-compose up\n\n# Check logs after background execution\ndocker logs -f &lt;container-name&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Saving logs:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    container_name: model-compose-prod\n    logging:\n      driver: json-file\n      options:\n        max-size: &quot;10m&quot;            # Maximum size per file\n        max-file: &quot;5&quot;              # Maximum file count\n</code></pre>\n<p>Log location: <code>/var/lib/docker/containers/&lt;container-id&gt;/&lt;container-id&gt;-json.log</code></p>\n<p><strong>Log driver options:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    logging:\n      driver: syslog               # json-file, syslog, journald, gelf, fluentd, etc.\n      options:\n        syslog-address: &quot;tcp://192.168.0.42:514&quot;\n        tag: &quot;model-compose&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.5.3 Workflow Execution Logging</h3>\n<p><strong>Logging with logger component:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: logger\n    type: logger\n    level: info\n\n  - id: api-client\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.example.com\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: process-with-logging\n    jobs:\n      - id: log-start\n        component: logger\n        input:\n          message: &quot;Workflow started: ${context.run_id}&quot;\n\n      - id: api-call\n        component: api-client\n        input: ${input}\n\n      - id: log-result\n        component: logger\n        input:\n          message: &quot;Result: ${output}&quot;\n\n      - id: log-end\n        component: logger\n        input:\n          message: &quot;Workflow completed&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.5.4 Metrics Collection</h3>\n<p><strong>Tracking execution time:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: timed-workflow\n    jobs:\n      - id: start-time\n        component: shell\n        command: echo $(date +%s%3N)       # Millisecond timestamp\n        output: ${stdout.trim()}\n\n      - id: process\n        component: api-client\n        input: ${input}\n\n      - id: end-time\n        component: shell\n        command: echo $(date +%s%3N)\n        output: ${stdout.trim()}\n\n      - id: log-duration\n        component: logger\n        input:\n          message: &quot;Execution time: ${output.end-time - output.start-time}ms&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Performance metrics logging:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: metrics-workflow\n    jobs:\n      - id: api-call\n        component: api-client\n        input: ${input}\n\n      - id: log-metrics\n        component: logger\n        input:\n          run_id: ${context.run_id}\n          status: ${output.status}\n          response_time: ${output.response_time_ms}\n          tokens_used: ${output.usage.total_tokens}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.5.5 External Monitoring Systems</h3>\n<p><strong>Prometheus integration example:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: prometheus-push\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: http://prometheus-pushgateway:9091\n    path: /metrics/job/model-compose\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Content-Type: text/plain\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: monitored-workflow\n    jobs:\n      - id: process\n        component: my-component\n        input: ${input}\n\n      - id: push-metrics\n        component: prometheus-push\n        input:\n          body: |\n            workflow_execution_duration_seconds ${output.duration}\n            workflow_execution_total 1\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Log aggregation system (ELK Stack):</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    logging:\n      driver: gelf                 # Graylog Extended Log Format\n      options:\n        gelf-address: &quot;udp://logstash:12201&quot;\n        tag: &quot;model-compose&quot;\n        labels: &quot;environment,service&quot;\n    labels:\n      environment: production\n      service: model-compose\n</code></pre>\n<h3>16.5.6 Tracer Configuration</h3>\n<p>Tracers send structured tracing data from workflow and job executions to external observability tools like Langfuse.</p>\n<p><strong>Basic Langfuse tracer:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">tracer:\n  driver: langfuse\n  public_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}\n  secret_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<p>This sends workflow-level and job-level traces to Langfuse Cloud.</p>\n<p><strong>Self-hosted Langfuse:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">tracer:\n  driver: langfuse\n  public_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}\n  secret_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}\n  base_url: http://localhost:3000\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Capture settings:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">tracer:\n  driver: langfuse\n  public_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}\n  secret_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}\n  capture:\n    input: true\n    output: true\n    redact_keys:                     # Redact sensitive keys\n      - Authorization\n      - api_key\n    max_payload_bytes: 1048576       # 1MB limit\n</code></pre>\n<p>Capture settings:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>input</code>: Include input data in traces (default: <code>true</code>)</li>\n<li><code>output</code>: Include output data in traces (default: <code>true</code>)</li>\n<li><code>redact_keys</code>: Keys to replace with <code>[redacted]</code> (case-insensitive, recursive)</li>\n<li><code>max_payload_bytes</code>: Max payload size; exceeded payloads replaced with <code>[truncated]</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Session grouping:</strong></p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">model-compose run chat --session-id my-session -i '{&quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;hello&quot;}'\n</code></pre>\n<p>Traces with the same <code>session_id</code> are grouped together in Langfuse UI.</p>\n<p><strong>Key behaviors:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Tracer events are non-blocking (queued and sent asynchronously)</li>\n<li>Tracer failures never impact workflow execution</li>\n<li><code>langfuse&gt;=4.0</code> is installed automatically on first use</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>16.6 Deployment Best Practices</h2>\n<h3>Environment-specific Deployment Strategies</h3>\n<p><strong>Local development environment:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Native runtime for rapid iteration</li>\n<li>Manage environment variables with <code>.env</code> file</li>\n<li>Use console logger (<code>level: debug</code>)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Staging/testing environment:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Docker runtime to mimic production</li>\n<li>File logger for log retention</li>\n<li>Validate resource limits and health checks</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Production environment:</strong></p>\n<ul>\n<li>Docker runtime required</li>\n<li><code>restart: unless-stopped</code> for auto-recovery</li>\n<li>Apply resource limits (<code>mem_limit</code>, <code>cpus</code>)</li>\n<li>Configure health checks and monitoring</li>\n<li>Ensure data persistence with volumes</li>\n<li>Manage secrets via environment variables</li>\n<li>Integrate with log aggregation system</li>\n<li>Configure concurrency control</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Performance Optimization</h3>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Concurrency tuning</strong>: Configure <code>max_concurrent_count</code> for workload</li>\n<li><strong>Resource allocation</strong>: Monitor CPU/memory usage and set appropriate limits</li>\n<li><strong>Log level</strong>: Use <code>info</code> or higher in production (exclude debug logs)</li>\n<li><strong>Log rotation</strong>: Control disk usage with Docker logging options</li>\n<li><strong>Volume mounts</strong>: Consider tmpfs for performance-critical data</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>Security Hardening</h3>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Least privilege principle</strong>: Run containers as non-root user</li>\n<li><strong>Secret separation</strong>: Use environment variables, never commit secrets to repository</li>\n<li><strong>Network isolation</strong>: Use dedicated networks when needed</li>\n<li><strong>Regular updates</strong>: Regularly update base images and dependencies</li>\n<li><strong>Security scanning</strong>: Use vulnerability scanning tools during image builds</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>Reliability Improvements</h3>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Health checks</strong>: Always configure health checks</li>\n<li><strong>Restart policy</strong>: Use <code>always</code> or <code>unless-stopped</code> in production</li>\n<li><strong>Graceful shutdown</strong>: Ensure proper termination via signal handling</li>\n<li><strong>Backups</strong>: Regular backups for critical data</li>\n<li><strong>Monitoring</strong>: Set up real-time metrics and alerts</li>\n</ol>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>Try it out:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Deploy controller to production environment</li>\n<li>Multi-container configuration with Docker Compose</li>\n<li>Kubernetes cluster deployment</li>\n<li>CI/CD pipeline integration</li>\n<li>Build monitoring dashboards</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/17-practical-examples\">17. Practical Examples</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "16. Deployment"
      }

    {
      "slug": "user-guide/17-practical-examples",
      "html": "<h1>17. Practical Examples</h1>\n<p>This chapter provides step-by-step explanations of real-world use cases using model-compose. Each example includes complete configuration and execution instructions.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.1 Building a Chatbot</h2>\n<h3>17.1.1 OpenAI GPT-4o Chatbot</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a simple conversational chatbot using OpenAI GPT-4o</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong> (<code>model-compose.yml</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Chat with OpenAI GPT-4o\n  description: Generate text responses using OpenAI's GPT-4o\n  input: ${input}\n  output: ${output}\n\ncomponent:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      Content-Type: application/json\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt as text}\n      temperature: ${input.temperature as number | 0.7}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Environment Variables</strong> (<code>.env</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>How to Run</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Start controller\nmodel-compose up\n\n# Access Web UI\n# http://localhost:8081\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key Features</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Automatic Gradio Web UI generation</li>\n<li>Adjustable temperature parameter</li>\n<li>Real-time response display</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Architecture Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User] --&gt;|① Input prompt| B[Web UI&lt;br/&gt;Port 8081]\n    B --&gt;|② HTTP request| C[Controller&lt;br/&gt;Port 8080]\n    C --&gt;|③ Execute workflow| D[http-client&lt;br/&gt;component]\n    D --&gt;|④ API call| E[OpenAI GPT-4o&lt;br/&gt;API]\n    E --&gt;|⑤ Response| D\n    D --&gt;|⑥ Result| C\n    C --&gt;|⑦ JSON response| B\n    B --&gt;|⑧ Display text| A\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.1.2 Streaming Chatbot</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a streaming chatbot with real-time typing effect</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Streaming Chat\n  output: ${output as sse-text}\n\ncomponent:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt as text}\n      stream: true\n    stream_format: json\n    output: ${response[].choices[0].delta.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Features</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Real-time streaming using SSE protocol</li>\n<li>Automatic typing effect in Gradio</li>\n<li>Immediate feedback for long responses</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Streaming Flow Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">sequenceDiagram\n    participant U as User\n    participant W as Web UI\n    participant C as Controller\n    participant HC as http-client\n    participant API as OpenAI API\n\n    U-&gt;&gt;W: Input prompt\n    W-&gt;&gt;C: POST /api/workflows/runs&lt;br/&gt;(wait_for_completion: true)\n    C-&gt;&gt;HC: Execute workflow&lt;br/&gt;(stream: true)\n    HC-&gt;&gt;API: POST /chat/completions&lt;br/&gt;(stream: true)\n\n    Note over API: Start generating response\n\n    API--&gt;&gt;HC: SSE: chunk 1\n    HC--&gt;&gt;C: ${response[]} chunk 1\n    C--&gt;&gt;W: SSE: &quot;data: Once&quot;\n    W--&gt;&gt;U: Display &quot;Once&quot;\n\n    API--&gt;&gt;HC: SSE: chunk 2\n    HC--&gt;&gt;C: ${response[]} chunk 2\n    C--&gt;&gt;W: SSE: &quot;data:  upon&quot;\n    W--&gt;&gt;U: Append &quot; upon&quot;\n\n    API--&gt;&gt;HC: SSE: chunk 3\n    HC--&gt;&gt;C: ${response[]} chunk 3\n    C--&gt;&gt;W: SSE: &quot;data:  a&quot;\n    W--&gt;&gt;U: Append &quot; a&quot;\n\n    Note over API: Response complete\n    API--&gt;&gt;HC: [DONE]\n    HC--&gt;&gt;C: Stream ended\n    C--&gt;&gt;W: Close connection\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.2 RAG System (Using Vector DB)</h2>\n<h3>17.2.1 Text Embedding Search with ChromaDB</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Generate text embeddings, store in ChromaDB, and perform similarity search</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: insert-sentence-embedding\n    title: Insert Text Embedding\n    description: Generate text embedding and insert it into ChromaDB vector store\n    jobs:\n      - id: embedding-sentence\n        component: embedding-model\n        input: ${input}\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: insert-embedding\n        component: vector-store\n        action: insert\n        input:\n          vector: ${jobs.embedding-sentence.output}\n          metadata: ${input}\n        output: ${output as json}\n        depends_on: [ embedding-sentence ]\n\n  - id: search-sentence-embeddings\n    title: Search Similar Embeddings\n    description: Generate query embedding and search for similar vectors in ChromaDB\n    jobs:\n      - id: embedding-sentence\n        component: embedding-model\n        input: ${input}\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: search-embeddings\n        component: vector-store\n        action: search\n        input:\n          vector: ${jobs.embedding-sentence.output}\n        output: ${output as object[]/id,score,metadata.text}\n        depends_on: [ embedding-sentence ]\n\n  - id: delete-sentence-embedding\n    title: Delete Text Embedding\n    description: Remove a specific vector from the ChromaDB collection\n    component: vector-store\n    action: delete\n    input: ${input}\n    output: ${output as json}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: vector-store\n    type: vector-store\n    driver: chroma\n    actions:\n      - id: insert\n        collection: test\n        method: insert\n        vector: ${input.vector}\n        metadata: ${input.metadata}\n\n      - id: search\n        collection: test\n        method: search\n        query: ${input.vector}\n        output_fields: [ text ]\n\n      - id: delete\n        collection: test\n        method: delete\n        vector_id: ${input.vector_id}\n\n  - id: embedding-model\n    type: model\n    task: text-embedding\n    model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>API Usage Examples</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># 1. Insert text\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/insert-sentence-embedding/runs \\\n  -H &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \\\n  -d '{&quot;input&quot;: {&quot;text&quot;: &quot;model-compose is a declarative AI orchestrator&quot;}}'\n\n# 2. Search similar text\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/search-sentence-embeddings/runs \\\n  -H &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \\\n  -d '{&quot;input&quot;: {&quot;text&quot;: &quot;AI workflow tool&quot;}}'\n\n# 3. Delete\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/delete-sentence-embedding/runs \\\n  -H &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \\\n  -d '{&quot;input&quot;: {&quot;vector_id&quot;: &quot;id123&quot;}}'\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.2.2 RAG System with Milvus</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: High-performance RAG system using Milvus vector database</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: rag-query\n    title: RAG Query\n    description: Retrieve relevant documents and generate answer\n    jobs:\n      - id: embed-query\n        component: embedding-model\n        input:\n          text: ${input.query}\n        output: ${output}\n\n      - id: search-docs\n        component: milvus-store\n        action: search\n        input:\n          vector: ${jobs.embed-query.output}\n        output: ${output}\n        depends_on: [ embed-query ]\n\n      - id: generate-answer\n        component: llm\n        input:\n          context: ${jobs.search-docs.output}\n          query: ${input.query}\n        output: ${output}\n        depends_on: [ search-docs ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: embedding-model\n    type: model\n    task: text-embedding\n    model: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text}\n\n  - id: milvus-store\n    type: vector-store\n    driver: milvus\n    host: localhost\n    port: 19530\n    actions:\n      - id: search\n        collection: documents\n        method: search\n        query: ${input.vector}\n        top_k: 5\n        output_fields: [ text, source ]\n\n  - id: llm\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages:\n          - role: system\n            content: Answer based on the following context: ${input.context}\n          - role: user\n            content: ${input.query}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Features</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>3-stage pipeline: Embedding → Search → Generation</li>\n<li>Milvus high-performance vector search</li>\n<li>Context-based answer generation using GPT-4o</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>RAG Pipeline Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User Query&lt;br/&gt;input.query] --&gt;|① Start| B[Job 1: embed-query&lt;br/&gt;embedding-model]\n    B --&gt;|② Text embedding| C[Embedding Vector&lt;br/&gt;768 dimensions]\n\n    C --&gt;|③ Vector input| D[Job 2: search-docs&lt;br/&gt;milvus-store]\n    D --&gt;|④ Vector similarity search| E[(Milvus DB&lt;br/&gt;documents collection)]\n    E --&gt;|⑤ Top 5 docs returned| D\n\n    D --&gt;|⑥ Search results&lt;br/&gt;text + source| F[Job 3: generate-answer&lt;br/&gt;llm GPT-4o]\n    F --&gt;|⑦ Context-based query| G[OpenAI API]\n    G --&gt;|⑧ Answer generation| F\n\n    F --&gt;|⑨ Final answer| H[Result Return]\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.3 Graph Store (Knowledge Graphs &amp; Social Networks)</h2>\n<h3>17.3.1 Knowledge Graph with Neo4j</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a knowledge graph to store people and their relationships, then traverse connections</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong> (<code>model-compose.yml</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  adapter:\n    type: http-server\n    port: 8080\n    base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: add-person\n    title: Add Person\n    description: Add a person node to the knowledge graph\n    jobs:\n      - id: insert-node\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: add-person\n        input: ${input}\n        output: ${output as json}\n\n  - id: add-friendship\n    title: Add Friendship\n    description: Create a KNOWS relationship between two people\n    jobs:\n      - id: insert-rel\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: add-relationship\n        input: ${input}\n        output: ${output as json}\n\n  - id: find-connections\n    title: Find Connections\n    description: Traverse the graph to find connected people\n    jobs:\n      - id: traverse\n        component: knowledge-graph\n        action: find-connections\n        input: ${input}\n        output: ${output as json}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: knowledge-graph\n    type: graph-store\n    driver: neo4j\n    url: bolt://localhost:7687\n    username: neo4j\n    password: password\n    actions:\n      - id: add-person\n        method: insert\n        nodes:\n          label: Person\n          properties:\n            name: ${input.name}\n            age: ${input.age}\n\n      - id: add-relationship\n        method: insert\n        relationships:\n          type: KNOWS\n          from: ${input.from_id}\n          to: ${input.to_id}\n          properties:\n            since: ${input.since}\n\n      - id: find-person\n        method: query\n        query: &quot;MATCH (p:Person {name: $name}) RETURN p&quot;\n        params:\n          name: ${input.name}\n\n      - id: find-connections\n        method: traverse\n        start_node: ${input.node_id}\n        direction: both\n        max_depth: 2\n        relationship_types: [KNOWS]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Prerequisites</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Neo4j running locally (<code>docker run -p 7687:7687 -e NEO4J_AUTH=neo4j/password neo4j</code>)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Running</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Start the service\nmodel-compose up\n\n# Add people\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/add-person/run \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{&quot;input&quot;: {&quot;name&quot;: &quot;Alice&quot;, &quot;age&quot;: 30}}'\n\n# Create a friendship\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/add-friendship/run \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{&quot;input&quot;: {&quot;from_id&quot;: &quot;&lt;alice_node_id&gt;&quot;, &quot;to_id&quot;: &quot;&lt;bob_node_id&gt;&quot;, &quot;since&quot;: 2020}}'\n\n# Find connections\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/find-connections/run \\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\n  -d '{&quot;input&quot;: {&quot;node_id&quot;: &quot;&lt;alice_node_id&gt;&quot;}}'\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key Points</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>method: insert</code> with <code>nodes</code> creates graph nodes; with <code>relationships</code> creates edges</li>\n<li><code>method: traverse</code> discovers connected nodes up to <code>max_depth</code> hops away</li>\n<li><code>method: query</code> executes raw Cypher for full flexibility</li>\n<li><code>detach: true</code> (default) on delete ensures connected relationships are also removed</li>\n<li>Node IDs are returned by Neo4j in <code>elementId()</code> format (e.g., <code>4:abc:0</code>)</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Pipeline Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User Input&lt;br/&gt;name, age] --&gt;|① Insert| B[Job: add-person&lt;br/&gt;CREATE &amp;#40;:Person&amp;#41;]\n    B --&gt; C[Node ID returned]\n    D[User Input&lt;br/&gt;from_id, to_id] --&gt;|② Connect| E[Job: add-relationship&lt;br/&gt;CREATE -[:KNOWS]-&gt;]\n    F[User Input&lt;br/&gt;node_id] --&gt;|③ Traverse| G[Job: find-connections&lt;br/&gt;MATCH path *1..2]\n    G --&gt; H[Connected Nodes]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.3.2 Social Graph with ArangoDB</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a social network graph and find mutual friends using ArangoDB</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: social-graph\n    type: graph-store\n    driver: arangodb\n    host: localhost\n    port: 8529\n    username: root\n    password: password\n    database: social\n    actions:\n      - id: add-person\n        method: insert\n        collection: persons\n        nodes:\n          label: persons\n          properties:\n            name: ${input.name}\n            age: ${input.age}\n\n      - id: add-friendship\n        method: insert\n        edge_collection: friendships\n        graph: social_graph\n        relationships:\n          type: friendships\n          from: ${input.from_id}\n          to: ${input.to_id}\n\n      - id: mutual-friends\n        method: query\n        query: |\n          FOR f1 IN OUTBOUND @person1 friendships\n            FOR f2 IN OUTBOUND @person2 friendships\n              FILTER f1._id == f2._id\n              RETURN f1\n        params:\n          person1: ${input.person1_id}\n          person2: ${input.person2_id}\n\n      - id: find-network\n        method: traverse\n        start_node: ${input.person_id}\n        graph: social_graph\n        direction: both\n        max_depth: 3\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key Points</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>ArangoDB uses <code>collection/key</code> format for document IDs (e.g., <code>persons/12345</code>)</li>\n<li>Named graphs (<code>graph: social_graph</code>) must be created in ArangoDB beforehand</li>\n<li>AQL queries use <code>@param</code> syntax for parameter binding</li>\n<li>Traversal maps <code>out</code>→<code>outbound</code>, <code>in</code>→<code>inbound</code>, <code>both</code>→<code>any</code> internally</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.4 Key-Value Store (Caching &amp; Sessions)</h2>\n<h3>17.4.1 API Response Caching</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Cache LLM API responses in Redis to avoid duplicate calls for identical prompts</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong> (<code>model-compose.yml</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  adapter:\n    type: http-server\n    port: 8080\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: cached-chat\n    title: Cached Chat\n    jobs:\n      - id: check-cache\n        component: cache\n        action: get-response\n        input:\n          prompt: ${input.prompt}\n\n      - id: generate\n        component: openai\n        condition: ${jobs.check-cache.output.cached == null}\n        input:\n          prompt: ${input.prompt}\n\n      - id: save-cache\n        component: cache\n        action: set-response\n        condition: ${jobs.check-cache.output.cached == null}\n        input:\n          prompt: ${input.prompt}\n          response: ${jobs.generate.output.message}\n    output:\n      message: ${jobs.check-cache.output.cached ?? jobs.generate.output.message}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: cache\n    type: key-value-store\n    driver: redis\n    host: localhost\n    port: 6379\n    actions:\n      - id: get-response\n        method: get\n        key: &quot;chat:${input.prompt}&quot;\n        output:\n          cached: ${result.value}\n      - id: set-response\n        method: set\n        key: &quot;chat:${input.prompt}&quot;\n        value: ${input.response}\n        ttl: 3600\n\n  - id: openai\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages:\n          - role: user\n            content: ${input.prompt as text}\n      output:\n        message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>API Usage</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># First call - generates and caches\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/workflows/runs \\\n  -H &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \\\n  -d '{&quot;workflow_id&quot;: &quot;cached-chat&quot;, &quot;input&quot;: {&quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;What is Redis?&quot;}}'\n\n# Second call with same prompt - returns cached result instantly\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/workflows/runs \\\n  -H &quot;Content-Type: application/json&quot; \\\n  -d '{&quot;workflow_id&quot;: &quot;cached-chat&quot;, &quot;input&quot;: {&quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;What is Redis?&quot;}}'\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Pipeline Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User Input&lt;br/&gt;prompt] --&gt;|① Check cache| B[Job 1: check-cache&lt;br/&gt;key-value-store GET]\n    B --&gt;|cache miss| C[Job 2: generate&lt;br/&gt;OpenAI API]\n    B --&gt;|cache hit| F[Result&lt;br/&gt;cached response]\n    C --&gt;|③ Save to cache| D[Job 3: save-cache&lt;br/&gt;key-value-store SET]\n    D --&gt; E[Result&lt;br/&gt;fresh response]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.4.2 Session Management</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Store user session data with automatic expiration</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: session\n    type: key-value-store\n    driver: redis\n    url: redis://localhost:6379/1\n    actions:\n      - id: save\n        method: set\n        key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n        value:\n          history: ${input.history}\n          preferences: ${input.preferences}\n        ttl: 86400\n\n      - id: load\n        method: get\n        key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n        output:\n          session: ${result.value}\n\n      - id: logout\n        method: delete\n        key: &quot;session:${input.user_id}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key Points</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>TTL of 86400 seconds (24 hours) automatically expires sessions</li>\n<li>Complex objects (dict, list) are serialized as JSON and deserialized on retrieval</li>\n<li><code>url</code> and <code>host</code>/<code>port</code> are mutually exclusive connection options</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.5 Multimodal Workflows</h2>\n<h3>17.5.1 Image → Text → Speech Pipeline</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Analyze image, generate description, and convert to speech</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Image to Speech Pipeline\n  description: Analyze image, generate description, and convert to speech\n  jobs:\n    - id: analyze-image\n      component: image-analyzer\n      input:\n        image: ${input.image}\n      output: ${output}\n\n    - id: enhance-description\n      component: gpt4o\n      input:\n        prompt: |\n          Make this image description more engaging and detailed:\n          ${jobs.analyze-image.output.text}\n      output: ${output}\n      depends_on: [ analyze-image ]\n\n    - id: text-to-speech\n      component: tts\n      input:\n        text: ${jobs.enhance-description.output.message}\n      output:\n        description: ${jobs.enhance-description.output.message}\n        audio: ${output as audio}\n      depends_on: [ enhance-description ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-analyzer\n    type: model\n    task: image-to-text\n    model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large\n    action:\n      image: ${input.image as image}\n      output:\n        text: ${result}\n\n  - id: gpt4o\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages:\n          - role: user\n            content: ${input.prompt}\n      output:\n        message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n\n  - id: tts\n    type: http-client\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: tts-1\n        input: ${input.text}\n        voice: nova\n      output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>3-Stage Pipeline</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Image Analysis</strong>: BLIP model generates image description</li>\n<li><strong>Text Enhancement</strong>: GPT-4o rewrites description to be more detailed and engaging</li>\n<li><strong>Speech Conversion</strong>: OpenAI TTS converts text to speech</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Multimodal Pipeline Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[Image Input&lt;br/&gt;input.image] --&gt;|① Start| B[Job 1: analyze-image&lt;br/&gt;BLIP Model]\n    B --&gt;|② Image→Text&lt;br/&gt;Local inference| C[Basic Description&lt;br/&gt;output.text]\n\n    C --&gt;|③ Description text| D[Job 2: enhance-description&lt;br/&gt;GPT-4o]\n    D --&gt;|④ Description enhancement&lt;br/&gt;API call| E[Detailed Description&lt;br/&gt;output.message]\n\n    E --&gt;|⑤ Enhanced text| F[Job 3: text-to-speech&lt;br/&gt;OpenAI TTS]\n    F --&gt;|⑥ Text→Speech&lt;br/&gt;API call| G[Final Result&lt;br/&gt;description: Text&lt;br/&gt;audio: Audio]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.5.2 Speech → Text → Translation → Speech Pipeline</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Translate spoken language to another language with speech output</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Voice Translation Pipeline\n  description: Transcribe audio, translate to target language, and synthesize speech\n  jobs:\n    - id: transcribe\n      component: whisper\n      input:\n        audio: ${input.audio}\n      output: ${output}\n\n    - id: translate\n      component: translator\n      input:\n        text: ${jobs.transcribe.output.text}\n        target_lang: ${input.target_lang}\n      output: ${output}\n      depends_on: [ transcribe ]\n\n    - id: synthesize\n      component: tts\n      input:\n        text: ${jobs.translate.output.text}\n      output:\n        original: ${jobs.transcribe.output.text}\n        translated: ${jobs.translate.output.text}\n        audio: ${output as audio}\n      depends_on: [ translate ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: whisper\n    type: http-client\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        file: ${input.audio as audio}\n        model: whisper-1\n      output:\n        text: ${response.text}\n\n  - id: translator\n    type: model\n    task: translation\n    model: Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-en-ko\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text as text}\n      output:\n        text: ${result}\n\n  - id: tts\n    type: http-client\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: tts-1\n        input: ${input.text}\n        voice: nova\n      output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>4-Stage Pipeline</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Speech Recognition</strong>: Whisper converts speech to text</li>\n<li><strong>Translation</strong>: Helsinki-NLP model translates text</li>\n<li><strong>Speech Synthesis</strong>: OpenAI TTS converts translated text to speech</li>\n<li><strong>Output</strong>: Original text, translated text, and translated audio</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Voice Translation Pipeline Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[Audio Input&lt;br/&gt;input.audio] --&gt;|① Start| B[Job 1: transcribe&lt;br/&gt;Whisper]\n    B --&gt;|② Speech→Text&lt;br/&gt;OpenAI API| C[Original Text&lt;br/&gt;output.text]\n\n    C --&gt;|③ Original text| D[Job 2: translate&lt;br/&gt;Helsinki-NLP]\n    D --&gt;|④ Text translation&lt;br/&gt;Local model| E[Translated Text&lt;br/&gt;output.text]\n\n    E --&gt;|⑤ Translated text| F[Job 3: synthesize&lt;br/&gt;OpenAI TTS]\n    F --&gt;|⑥ Text→Speech&lt;br/&gt;API call| G[Final Result&lt;br/&gt;original: Original&lt;br/&gt;translated: Translation&lt;br/&gt;audio: Speech]\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.6 Voice Generation Pipeline</h2>\n<h3>17.6.1 Text-to-Speech (OpenAI TTS)</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Convert text to speech using OpenAI TTS API</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Generate Speech with OpenAI TTS\n  description: Convert input text into natural-sounding speech using OpenAI's TTS models.\n  jobs:\n    - id: speak\n      component: openai-text-to-speech\n      input: ${input}\n      output: ${output as audio}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: openai-text-to-speech\n    type: http-client\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        model: ${input.model as select/tts-1,tts-1-hd,gpt-4o-mini-tts | tts-1}\n        input: ${input.text}\n        voice: ${input.voice as select/alloy,ash,ballad,coral,echo,fable,onyx,nova,sage,shimmer,verse | nova}\n        response_format: mp3\n      output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Supported Voices</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>alloy</code>, <code>ash</code>, <code>ballad</code>, <code>coral</code>, <code>echo</code>, <code>fable</code></li>\n<li><code>onyx</code>, <code>nova</code>, <code>sage</code>, <code>shimmer</code>, <code>verse</code></li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Supported Models</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>tts-1</code>: Fast response</li>\n<li><code>tts-1-hd</code>: High-quality audio</li>\n<li><code>gpt-4o-mini-tts</code>: Latest model</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>17.6.2 Inspiring Quote Voice Generation</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Generate motivational quotes with GPT-4o and convert to speech with ElevenLabs TTS</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Inspire with Voice\n  description: Generate a motivational quote using GPT-4o and bring it to life by converting it into natural speech with ElevenLabs TTS.\n  jobs:\n    - id: job-quote\n      component: write-inspiring-quote\n      input: ${input}\n      output: ${output}\n\n    - id: job-voice\n      component: text-to-speech\n      input:\n        text: ${jobs.job-quote.output.quote}\n        voice_id: ${input.voice_id | JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb}\n      output:\n        quote: ${jobs.job-quote.output.quote}\n        audio: ${output as audio/mp3;base64}\n      depends_on: [ job-quote ]\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: write-inspiring-quote\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages:\n          - role: user\n            content: |\n              Write an inspiring quote similar to the example below.\n              Don't say anything else—just give me the quote.\n              Aim for around 30 words.\n              Example – Never give up. If there's something you want to become, be proud of it. Give yourself a chance.\n              Don't think you're worthless—there's nothing to gain from that. Aim high. That's how life should be lived.\n      output:\n        quote: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n\n  - id: text-to-speech\n    type: http-client\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/${input.voice_id}?output_format=mp3_44100_128\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/json\n        xi-api-key: ${env.ELEVENLABS_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        text: ${input.text}\n        model_id: eleven_multilingual_v2\n      output: ${response as base64}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Environment Variables</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...\nELEVENLABS_API_KEY=...\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Workflow Description</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>GPT-4o generates an inspiring quote</li>\n<li>ElevenLabs API converts quote to speech</li>\n<li>Web UI displays both text and audio</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Workflow Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User Input] --&gt;|① Input| B[Job 1: job-quote&lt;br/&gt;write-inspiring-quote]\n    B --&gt;|② GPT-4o API call| C[OpenAI API]\n    C --&gt;|③ Quote text returned| B\n    B --&gt;|④ output.quote&lt;br/&gt;depends_on: job-quote| D[Job 2: job-voice&lt;br/&gt;text-to-speech]\n    D --&gt;|⑤ TTS API call&lt;br/&gt;jobs.job-quote.output.quote| E[ElevenLabs API]\n    E --&gt;|⑥ Audio data returned&lt;br/&gt;Base64| D\n    D --&gt;|⑦ Final output| F[Result&lt;br/&gt;quote: Text&lt;br/&gt;audio: Base64]\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.7 Image Analysis and Editing</h2>\n<h3>17.7.1 Image Captioning (Image-to-Text)</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Generate image descriptions using a local Vision model</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Generate Text from Image\n  description: Generate text based on a given image using a pretrained vision model.\n  input: ${input}\n  output:\n    generated: ${output}\n\ncomponent:\n  type: model\n  task: image-to-text\n  model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large\n  architecture: blip\n  action:\n    image: ${input.image as image}\n    prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Execution Example</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Run workflow\nmodel-compose run default --input '{&quot;image&quot;: &quot;path/to/image.jpg&quot;, &quot;prompt&quot;: &quot;Describe this image&quot;}'\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Supported Models</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><code>Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large</code></li>\n<li><code>Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-base</code></li>\n<li><code>nlpconnect/vit-gpt2-image-captioning</code></li>\n</ul>\n<h3>17.7.2 Image Editing (OpenAI DALL-E)</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Edit images using OpenAI DALL-E</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type:
