http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflow:\n  title: Edit Image with DALL-E\n  description: Edit an existing image using OpenAI's DALL-E API\n  component: dalle-edit\n  input: ${input}\n  output: ${output as image}\n\ncomponent:\n  id: dalle-edit\n  type: http-client\n  action:\n    endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/images/edits\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      image: ${input.image as image}\n      mask: ${input.mask as image}\n      prompt: ${input.prompt as text}\n      n: ${input.n as integer | 1}\n      size: ${input.size as select/256x256,512x512,1024x1024 | 1024x1024}\n    output: ${response.data[0].url}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Use Cases</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Change image backgrounds</li>\n<li>Modify specific regions</li>\n<li>Style transfer</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.8 Browser Automation</h2>\n<h3>17.8.1 Web Scraping with CAPTCHA Fallback</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Navigate to a page, detect CAPTCHAs, pause for human resolution via noVNC, then extract content</p>\n<p><strong>Prerequisites</strong>:</p>\n<p>Start a headless Chrome with noVNC:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">docker run -d -p 9222:9222 -p 6080:6080 \\\n  chromedp/headless-shell:latest\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: scrape-with-fallback\n    title: Scrape with CAPTCHA Fallback\n    input:\n      - id: url\n        type: string\n        description: Target URL to scrape\n      - id: selector\n        type: string\n        description: CSS selector for content extraction\n    jobs:\n      - id: navigate\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.url}\n\n      - id: detect-captcha\n        component: browser\n        action: check-captcha\n        interrupt:\n          after:\n            condition:\n              operator: eq\n              input: ${output}\n              value: true\n            message: &gt;\n              CAPTCHA detected! Please solve it via noVNC at:\n              http://localhost:6080/vnc.html\n        depends_on: [ navigate ]\n\n      - id: extract\n        component: browser\n        action: extract-text\n        input:\n          selector: ${input.selector}\n        depends_on: [ detect-captcha ]\n        output:\n          content: &quot;${output as text}&quot;\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: browser\n    type: web-browser\n    host: localhost\n    port: 9222\n    timeout: 30s\n    actions:\n      - id: navigate\n        method: navigate\n        url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n        wait_until: networkidle\n\n      - id: check-captcha\n        method: evaluate\n        expression: &gt;\n          !!(document.querySelector('[id*=captcha],[class*=captcha]')\n            || document.querySelector('iframe[src*=captcha]')\n            || document.querySelector('#cf-challenge-running'))\n\n      - id: extract-text\n        method: extract\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Workflow</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Navigate to the target URL</li>\n<li>Evaluate JavaScript to detect CAPTCHA elements</li>\n<li>If CAPTCHA found, workflow interrupts and shows noVNC URL for human resolution</li>\n<li>After human resolves CAPTCHA, workflow resumes and extracts content</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Workflow Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User Input&lt;br/&gt;url, selector] --&gt;|① Navigate| B[Job 1: navigate&lt;br/&gt;web-browser]\n    B --&gt;|② Check CAPTCHA| C[Job 2: detect-captcha&lt;br/&gt;evaluate JS]\n    C --&gt;|③ CAPTCHA found?| D{Interrupt?}\n    D --&gt;|Yes| E[Human resolves via noVNC&lt;br/&gt;http://localhost:6080]\n    E --&gt;|Resume| F[Job 3: extract&lt;br/&gt;extract text]\n    D --&gt;|No| F\n    F --&gt;|④ Return content| G[Result&lt;br/&gt;content: extracted text]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.8.2 Login and Scrape Protected Content</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Automate login to a website and extract protected content</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: login-and-scrape\n    title: Login then Scrape\n    input:\n      - id: login_url\n        type: string\n      - id: username\n        type: string\n      - id: password\n        type: string\n      - id: content_url\n        type: string\n      - id: selector\n        type: string\n    jobs:\n      - id: open-login\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.login_url}\n\n      - id: fill-username\n        component: browser\n        action: type-text\n        input:\n          selector: &quot;input[name='username']&quot;\n          text: ${input.username}\n        depends_on: [ open-login ]\n\n      - id: fill-password\n        component: browser\n        action: type-text\n        input:\n          selector: &quot;input[name='password']&quot;\n          text: ${input.password}\n        depends_on: [ fill-username ]\n\n      - id: submit\n        component: browser\n        action: click\n        input:\n          selector: &quot;button[type='submit']&quot;\n        depends_on: [ fill-password ]\n\n      - id: navigate-content\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.content_url}\n        depends_on: [ submit ]\n\n      - id: extract-content\n        component: browser\n        action: extract-text\n        input:\n          selector: ${input.selector}\n        depends_on: [ navigate-content ]\n        output:\n          content: ${output as text}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: browser\n    type: web-browser\n    host: localhost\n    port: 9222\n    timeout: 30s\n    actions:\n      - id: navigate\n        method: navigate\n        url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n        wait_until: networkidle\n\n      - id: type-text\n        method: input-text\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        text: &quot;${input.text}&quot;\n\n      - id: click\n        method: click\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n\n      - id: extract-text\n        method: extract\n        selector: &quot;${input.selector}&quot;\n        extract_mode: text\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>6-Step Pipeline</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Navigate to login page</li>\n<li>Fill username field</li>\n<li>Fill password field</li>\n<li>Click submit button</li>\n<li>Navigate to protected content page</li>\n<li>Extract content with CSS selector</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>17.8.3 AI-Powered Web Content Analysis</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Navigate to a page, extract content, and analyze it with GPT-4o</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: analyze-page\n    title: Analyze Web Page with AI\n    input:\n      - id: url\n        type: string\n        description: URL to analyze\n      - id: question\n        type: string\n        description: Question to ask about the page content\n    jobs:\n      - id: navigate\n        component: browser\n        action: navigate\n        input:\n          url: ${input.url}\n\n      - id: extract\n        component: browser\n        action: extract-body\n        depends_on: [ navigate ]\n\n      - id: analyze\n        component: gpt4o\n        input:\n          context: ${jobs.extract.output.content}\n          question: ${input.question}\n        depends_on: [ extract ]\n        output:\n          answer: ${output.message}\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: browser\n    type: web-browser\n    host: localhost\n    port: 9222\n    timeout: 30s\n    actions:\n      - id: navigate\n        method: navigate\n        url: &quot;${input.url}&quot;\n        wait_until: networkidle\n\n      - id: extract-body\n        method: extract\n        selector: &quot;body&quot;\n        extract_mode: text\n        output:\n          content: ${result}\n\n  - id: gpt4o\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages:\n          - role: system\n            content: |\n              Answer questions based on the following web page content:\n              ${input.context}\n          - role: user\n            content: ${input.question}\n      output:\n        message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>3-Stage Pipeline</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Navigate</strong>: Load the target page and wait for network idle</li>\n<li><strong>Extract</strong>: Pull all text content from the page body</li>\n<li><strong>Analyze</strong>: Send content to GPT-4o with the user's question</li>\n</ol>\n<p><strong>Pipeline Diagram</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-mermaid\">graph TD\n    A[User Input&lt;br/&gt;url, question] --&gt;|① Navigate| B[Job 1: navigate&lt;br/&gt;web-browser]\n    B --&gt;|② Extract text| C[Job 2: extract&lt;br/&gt;body text]\n    C --&gt;|③ Page content + question| D[Job 3: analyze&lt;br/&gt;GPT-4o]\n    D --&gt;|④ AI analysis| E[Result&lt;br/&gt;answer: AI response]\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.9 Slack Bot (MCP)</h2>\n<h3>17.9.1 Building a Slack Bot with MCP Server</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a Slack bot using MCP (Model Context Protocol) server</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: mcp-server\n  base_path: /mcp\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: send-message\n    title: Send Message to Slack Channel\n    description: Send a text message to a specified Slack channel using the Slack Web API\n    action: chat-post-message\n    input:\n      channel: ${input.channel | ${env.DEFAULT_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID} @(description Slack channel ID for sending a message)}\n      text: ${input.message @(description Message to send to Slack)}\n    output: ${output as json}\n\n  - id: list-channels\n    title: List Slack Channels\n    description: Retrieve a list of all available channels in the Slack workspace\n    action: conversations-list\n    output: ${output as object[]}\n\n  - id: join-channel\n    title: Join Slack Channel\n    description: Join a specified Slack channel for the bot user\n    action: conversations-join\n    input:\n      channel: ${input.channel | ${env.DEFAULT_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID}}\n    output: ${output as json}\n\ncomponent:\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://slack.com/api\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.SLACK_APP_TOKEN}\n  actions:\n    - id: chat-post-message\n      path: /chat.postMessage\n      method: POST\n      body:\n        channel: ${input.channel}\n        text: ${input.text}\n        attachments: ${input.attachments}\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      output: ${response}\n\n    - id: conversations-list\n      path: /conversations.list\n      method: GET\n      params:\n        limit: ${input.limit as integer | 200 @(description Maximum number of channels to retrieve)}\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded\n      output: ${response.channels as object[]/id,name}\n\n    - id: conversations-join\n      path: /conversations.join\n      method: POST\n      body:\n        channel: ${input.channel}\n      headers:\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      output: ${response}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Environment Variables</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">SLACK_APP_TOKEN=xoxb-...\nDEFAULT_SLACK_CHANNEL_ID=C...\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>MCP Server Features</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Integration with MCP clients like Claude Desktop</li>\n<li>Expose multiple workflows as tools</li>\n<li>Provide parameter descriptions using <code>@(description ...)</code> annotations</li>\n</ul>\n<p><strong>Claude Desktop Configuration</strong> (<code>claude_desktop_config.json</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;mcpServers&quot;: {\n    &quot;slack-bot&quot;: {\n      &quot;command&quot;: &quot;npx&quot;,\n      &quot;args&quot;: [\n        &quot;-y&quot;,\n        &quot;@modelcontextprotocol/server-stdio&quot;,\n        &quot;http://localhost:8080/mcp&quot;\n      ]\n    }\n  }\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>17.9.2 AI-Powered Slack Auto-Reply Bot</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a bot that automatically responds to Slack messages using AI</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n\nlisteners:\n  - id: slack-events\n    type: http-callback\n    path: /slack/events\n    method: POST\n    callback:\n      url: https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN}\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        channel: ${webhook.event.channel}\n        text: ${jobs.generate-reply.output.message}\n\ngateway:\n  type: ngrok\n  port: 8080\n\nworkflow:\n  title: AI Slack Reply\n  jobs:\n    - id: generate-reply\n      component: gpt4o\n      input:\n        prompt: ${input.event.text}\n      output: ${output}\n\ncomponent:\n  id: gpt4o\n  type: http-client\n  base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n  action:\n    path: /chat/completions\n    method: POST\n    headers:\n      Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n    body:\n      model: gpt-4o\n      messages:\n        - role: user\n          content: ${input.prompt}\n    output:\n      message: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Workflow</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Slack message event occurs</li>\n<li>Workflow triggered via ngrok tunnel</li>\n<li>GPT-4o generates response</li>\n<li>Listener callback sends response to Slack</li>\n</ol>\n<hr />\n<h2>17.10 Chatbot with Conversation Memory</h2>\n<h3>17.10.1 Stateful Chatbot (model-memory)</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Build a chatbot that remembers previous conversation context across multiple turns using the <code>model-memory</code> component.</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong> (<code>model-compose.yml</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  base_path: /api\n  webui:\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: gpt-4o\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages: ${input.messages}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n\n  - id: chat-memory\n    type: model-memory\n    storage:\n      driver: sqlite\n      path: ./memory.db\n    window: 20\n    summary:\n      component: gpt-4o\n      input:\n        messages: ${messages}\n      instruction: &quot;Summarize the following conversation concisely:&quot;\n    actions:\n      - id: load\n        method: load\n      - id: save\n        method: save\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: chat\n    title: Chatbot with Memory\n    description: A chatbot that remembers conversation history\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: load\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id | default-session}\n\n      - id: generate\n        component: gpt-4o\n        input:\n          messages:\n            - role: system\n              content: You are a helpful assistant.\n            - role: system\n              content: &quot;Previous conversation summary: ${jobs.load-memory.output.summary}&quot;\n            - ...${jobs.load-memory.output.messages}\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.message as text}\n        depends_on: [load-memory]\n\n      - id: save-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: save\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id | default-session}\n          messages:\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.message}\n            - role: assistant\n              content: ${jobs.generate.output}\n        depends_on: [generate]\n    output: ${jobs.generate.output}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Environment Variables</strong> (<code>.env</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-...\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>How to Run</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Start controller\nmodel-compose up\n\n# Test via CLI\nmodel-compose run chat --input '{&quot;session_id&quot;: &quot;user-1&quot;, &quot;message&quot;: &quot;My name is Alice&quot;}'\nmodel-compose run chat --input '{&quot;session_id&quot;: &quot;user-1&quot;, &quot;message&quot;: &quot;What is my name?&quot;}'\n# → The bot remembers: &quot;Your name is Alice&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Workflow</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Load conversation history from SQLite storage</li>\n<li>Include summary + recent messages as context for GPT-4o</li>\n<li>Generate response with full conversation awareness</li>\n<li>Save user message + assistant response to memory</li>\n<li>Old messages beyond the window are automatically summarized</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>17.10.2 Multi-User Chat with Redis Memory</h3>\n<p><strong>Goal</strong>: Production-ready multi-user chatbot using Redis for shared memory storage.</p>\n<p><strong>Configuration File</strong> (<code>model-compose.yml</code>):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: gpt-4o\n    type: http-client\n    base_url: https://api.openai.com/v1\n    action:\n      path: /chat/completions\n      method: POST\n      headers:\n        Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n        Content-Type: application/json\n      body:\n        model: gpt-4o\n        messages: ${input.messages}\n      output: ${response.choices[0].message.content}\n\n  - id: chat-memory\n    type: model-memory\n    storage:\n      driver: redis\n      url: ${env.REDIS_URL}\n      password: ${env.REDIS_PASSWORD}\n    window:\n      max_turn_count: 30\n      max_message_count: 100\n    summary:\n      component: gpt-4o\n      instruction: &quot;Provide a brief summary of this conversation:&quot;\n    actions:\n      - id: load\n        method: load\n      - id: save\n        method: save\n      - id: delete\n        method: delete\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: chat\n    jobs:\n      - id: load-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: load\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n\n      - id: generate\n        component: gpt-4o\n        input:\n          messages:\n            - role: system\n              content: ${input.system_prompt | You are a helpful assistant.}\n            - role: system\n              content: &quot;Context: ${jobs.load-memory.output.summary}&quot;\n            - ...${jobs.load-memory.output.messages}\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.message as text}\n        depends_on: [load-memory]\n\n      - id: save-memory\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: save\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n          messages:\n            - role: user\n              content: ${input.message}\n            - role: assistant\n              content: ${jobs.generate.output}\n        depends_on: [generate]\n    output: ${jobs.generate.output}\n\n  - id: clear-history\n    jobs:\n      - id: delete\n        component: chat-memory\n        action: delete\n        input:\n          session_id: ${input.session_id}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key Points</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Redis storage enables sharing memory across multiple server instances</li>\n<li><code>max_turn_count</code> and <code>max_message_count</code> provide dual windowing control</li>\n<li>Separate <code>clear-history</code> workflow for session cleanup</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>Practice:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Run each example locally</li>\n<li>Modify examples to build custom workflows</li>\n<li>Combine multiple examples to create complex pipelines</li>\n<li>Deploy to production environment</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/18-troubleshooting\">18. Troubleshooting</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "17. Practical Examples"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "user-guide/18-troubleshooting",
      "html": "<h1>18. Troubleshooting</h1>\n<p>This chapter covers common issues and solutions when using model-compose.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>18.1 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)</h2>\n<h3>18.1.1 Installation and Environment Setup</h3>\n<p><strong>Q: What are the Python version requirements?</strong></p>\n<p>A: model-compose requires Python 3.9 or higher. Python 3.11 or higher is recommended.</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">python --version  # Check for Python 3.9+\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: I can't find the <code>model-compose</code> command after installation.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Check your PATH environment variable:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># If installed with pip\npip show model-compose\n\n# Install in development mode\npip install -e .\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: GPU is not recognized when using Docker runtime.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Verify that NVIDIA Container Toolkit is installed:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Check GPU availability in Docker\ndocker run --rm --gpus all nvidia/cuda:11.8.0-base-ubuntu22.04 nvidia-smi\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.1.2 Component Configuration</h3>\n<p><strong>Q: I get out-of-memory errors when loading model components.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Try these approaches:</p>\n<ol>\n<li><strong>Use quantization</strong>:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  model: meta-llama/Llama-2-7b-hf\n  quantization: int8  # or int4, nf4\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li><strong>Reduce batch size</strong>:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  batch_size: 1\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"3\">\n<li><strong>Use CPU</strong>:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  device: cpu\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: I'm getting timeout errors with HTTP client.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Increase timeout or add retry settings:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  timeout: 120  # seconds\n  max_retries: 5\n  retry_delay: 2\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: Vector store connection fails.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Verify host and port settings:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: vector-store\n  driver: milvus\n  host: localhost\n  port: 19530\n</code></pre>\n<p>Check if the server is running:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Milvus\ndocker ps | grep milvus\n\n# ChromaDB (standalone)\ndocker ps | grep chroma\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.1.3 Workflow Execution</h3>\n<p><strong>Q: I get &quot;variable not found&quot; errors when executing workflows.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Verify your variable binding syntax is correct:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Incorrect\noutput: ${result}  # result is not defined\n\n# Correct\noutput: ${output}\noutput: ${jobs.job-id.output}\noutput: ${input.field}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: Job dependencies don't work properly.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Ensure you specify the correct job ID in <code>depends_on</code>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: job1\n    component: comp1\n\n  - id: job2\n    component: comp2\n    depends_on: [job1]  # Executes after job1 completes\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: Streaming responses are not outputting.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Check the following:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Enable streaming in component:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  stream_format: json\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li>Use streaming reference in workflow output:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  output: ${result[]}  # Per-chunk output\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"3\">\n<li>Specify response format in controller:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  output: ${output as sse-text}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.1.4 Web UI</h3>\n<p><strong>Q: Gradio Web UI doesn't start.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Verify Gradio is installed:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">pip install gradio\n</code></pre>\n<p>Check for port conflicts:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">lsof -i :8081  # Default Web UI port\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: File uploads don't work in Web UI.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Ensure input types are correctly specified:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  input:\n    image: ${input.image as image}\n    document: ${input.doc as file}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.1.5 Listeners and Gateways</h3>\n<p><strong>Q: Listener is not accessible from external sources.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Configure a gateway:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">gateway:\n  type: ngrok\n  port: 8080\n  authtoken: ${env.NGROK_AUTHTOKEN}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Q: ngrok gateway connection fails.</strong></p>\n<p>A: Verify auth token is configured:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">echo $NGROK_AUTHTOKEN\n</code></pre>\n<p>Check if ngrok is installed:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">ngrok version\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>18.2 Common Errors and Solutions</h2>\n<h3>18.2.1 Model Loading Errors</h3>\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Insufficient GPU memory</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Use a smaller model</li>\n<li>Apply quantization (<code>quantization: int8</code> or <code>int4</code>, <code>nf4</code>)</li>\n<li>Reduce batch size</li>\n<li>Use CPU (<code>device: cpu</code>)</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: model\n  model: smaller-model\n  device: cuda\n  quantization: int8\n  batch_size: 1\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>OSError: Can't load tokenizer for 'model-name'</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Model or tokenizer download failed</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Check internet connection</li>\n<li>Set HuggingFace token (for private models):</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export HF_TOKEN=your_token_here\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"3\">\n<li>Check cache directory:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">ls ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h3>18.2.2 Network Errors</h3>\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>ConnectionError: Failed to connect to API</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Failed to connect to API endpoint</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Verify endpoint URL</li>\n<li>Check API key</li>\n<li>Verify network connection</li>\n<li>Increase timeout</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  endpoint: https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions\n  headers:\n    Authorization: Bearer ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n  timeout: 60\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>SSLError: certificate verify failed</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: SSL certificate verification failed</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Update certificates:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">pip install --upgrade certifi\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li>Or disable verification (not recommended):</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  verify_ssl: false\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h3>18.2.3 Configuration File Errors</h3>\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>ValidationError: Invalid configuration</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: YAML syntax error or missing required fields</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Check YAML syntax:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">python -c &quot;import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('model-compose.yml'))&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li>Verify required fields using schema reference (Chapter 19)</li>\n<li>Check indentation (use 2 spaces)</li>\n</ol>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>KeyError: 'component-id'</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Referenced component ID does not exist</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:\nVerify component ID is defined:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: my-component  # Use this ID\n    type: model\n\nworkflow:\n  component: my-component  # Reference same ID\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h3>18.2.4 Variable Binding Errors</h3>\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>ValueError: Cannot resolve variable '${input.field}'</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Variable path is incorrect or data is missing</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Check variable path</li>\n<li>Add default value:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">output: ${input.field | &quot;default-value&quot;}\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"3\">\n<li>Output entire object for debugging:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">output: ${input}  # Check entire input\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>TypeError: Object of type 'bytes' is not JSON serializable</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Attempting to serialize binary data as JSON</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:\nUse Base64 encoding:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">output: ${binary_data as base64}\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h3>18.2.5 Docker Runtime Errors</h3>\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>docker.errors.ImageNotFound</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Docker image not found</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<ol>\n<li>Pull image:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">docker pull python:3.11\n</code></pre>\n<ol start=\"2\">\n<li>Or use custom build:</li>\n</ol>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n    build:\n      context: .\n      dockerfile: Dockerfile\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Error</strong>: <code>PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied</code></p>\n<p><strong>Cause</strong>: Insufficient permissions for Docker socket</p>\n<p><strong>Solution</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Add current user to docker group\nsudo usermod -aG docker $USER\nnewgrp docker\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>18.3 Debugging Tips</h2>\n<h3>18.3.1 Enable Logging</h3>\n<p>Set logger level to DEBUG for detailed logs:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">logger:\n  type: console\n  level: DEBUG\n  format: &quot;%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p>Or use environment variable:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">export LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG\nmodel-compose up\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.2 Check Variable Values</h3>\n<p>Add temporary output to check variable values during workflow:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">jobs:\n  - id: debug-job\n    component: shell-component\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: shell-component\n    type: shell\n    actions:\n      - id: default\n        command:\n          - echo\n          - &quot;Input: ${input}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.3 Step-by-Step Execution</h3>\n<p>Test complex workflows by breaking them into steps:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Step 1: Test first job only\nworkflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: step1\n      component: comp1\n\n# Step 2: Add second job\nworkflow:\n  jobs:\n    - id: step1\n      component: comp1\n    - id: step2\n      component: comp2\n      depends_on: [step1]\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.4 Check API Responses</h3>\n<p>To verify HTTP client responses:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:\n  type: http-client\n  endpoint: https://api.example.com/v1/resource\n  output: ${response}  # Output entire response\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.5 Docker Container Logs</h3>\n<p>Check container logs when using Docker runtime:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Check running containers\ndocker ps\n\n# View logs\ndocker logs &lt;container-id&gt;\n\n# Follow logs in real-time\ndocker logs -f &lt;container-id&gt;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.6 Verify Environment Variables</h3>\n<p>Check if environment variables are properly set:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Use .env file\ncat .env\n\n# Print environment variables\nenv | grep OPENAI\n</code></pre>\n<p>Test environment variables in workflow:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflow:\n  component: shell-env-test\n\ncomponent:\n  id: shell-env-test\n  type: shell\n  actions:\n    - id: default\n      command:\n        - echo\n        - ${env.OPENAI_API_KEY}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.7 Check Port Conflicts</h3>\n<p>Check if port is already in use:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Linux/Mac\nlsof -i :8080\n\n# Windows\nnetstat -ano | findstr :8080\n</code></pre>\n<p>Use a different port:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  port: 8081  # Change to different port\n</code></pre>\n<h3>18.3.8 Verify Dependencies</h3>\n<p>Check if required Python packages are installed:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">pip list | grep transformers\npip list | grep torch\npip list | grep gradio\n</code></pre>\n<p>Install missing packages:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\">pip install transformers torch gradio\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>If issues persist:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Search for similar issues in <a href=\"https://github.com/your-repo/model-compose/issues\">GitHub Issues</a></li>\n<li>When creating a new issue, include:\n<ul>\n<li>model-compose version</li>\n<li>Python version</li>\n<li>Operating system</li>\n<li>Complete error message</li>\n<li>Minimal reproducible configuration file</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>Ask for help in community forums</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Next Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/19-appendix\">19. Appendix</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "18. Troubleshooting"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "user-guide/19-appendix",
      "html": "<h1>19. Appendix</h1>\n<p>This chapter provides advanced reference materials for model-compose.</p>\n<hr />\n<h2>19.1 Complete Configuration File Schema</h2>\n<h3>19.1.1 Top-Level Structure</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:        # Required: HTTP or MCP server configuration\n  type: http-server | mcp-server\n  # ... detailed configuration\n\ncomponents:        # Optional: Reusable component list\n  - id: component-id\n    type: model | http-client | http-server | ...\n    # ... component-specific configuration\n\nworkflows:         # Optional: Workflow definitions\n  - id: workflow-id\n    title: Workflow Title\n    # ... workflow configuration\n\nlisteners:         # Optional: Async callback listeners\n  - id: listener-id\n    type: http-callback\n    # ... listener configuration\n\ngateways:          # Optional: HTTP tunnel gateways\n  - type: ngrok | cloudflare | ssh-tunnel\n    # ... gateway configuration\n\nloggers:           # Optional: Logger configuration\n  - type: console | file\n    # ... logger configuration\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Shorthand Syntax</strong> (single item):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">component:         # Instead of components: [ ... ]\nworkflow:          # Instead of workflows: [ ... ]\nlistener:          # Instead of listeners: [ ... ]\ngateway:           # Instead of gateways: [ ... ]\nlogger:            # Instead of loggers: [ ... ]\naction:            # Instead of actions: [ ... ] (within a component)\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.2 Controller Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>HTTP Server</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080                           # Default: 8080\n  host: 0.0.0.0                        # Default: 0.0.0.0\n  base_path: /api                      # Default: /\n  max_concurrency: 10                  # Default: unlimited\n\n  webui:                               # Optional: Web UI configuration\n    driver: gradio | static\n    port: 8081\n    root: ./static                     # For static driver\n\n  runtime:                             # Optional: Docker runtime\n    type: docker\n    image: python:3.11\n    # ... Docker options\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>MCP Server</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: mcp-server\n  port: 8080                           # Optional\n  base_path: /mcp                      # Default: /\n\n  webui:                               # Optional\n    driver: gradio\n    port: 8081\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.3 Component Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>Model Component</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: model-id\n    type: model\n    task: text-generation | chat-completion | translation | ...\n    model: model-name-or-path\n\n    # Model configuration\n    device: cuda | cpu | mps\n    dtype: float32 | float16 | bfloat16 | int8 | int4\n    batch_size: 1\n    streaming: false                   # text-generation / chat-completion / image-to-text only\n\n    # Parameters\n    params:\n      max_output_length: 100\n      temperature: 0.7\n      top_p: 0.9\n      do_sample: true\n\n    # LoRA adapters\n    peft_adapters:\n      - type: lora\n        name: adapter-name\n        model: path/to/adapter\n        weight: 1.0\n\n    # Single action (action:) - input/output mapping\n    action:\n      text: ${input.text as text}\n      messages: [ ... ]\n      image: ${input.image as image}\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>HTTP Client</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: http-client-id\n    type: http-client\n\n    # Endpoint\n    base_url: https://api.example.com\n\n    # Advanced configuration\n    timeout: 30\n    max_retries: 3\n    retry_delay: 1\n\n    # Single action (action:)\n    action:\n      endpoint: https://api.example.com/v1/resource\n      method: GET | POST | PUT | DELETE | PATCH\n      path: /resource\n      headers: { ... }\n      params: { ... }\n      body: { ... }\n      stream_format: json | text\n\n    # Or multiple actions (actions:)\n    actions:\n      - id: action-id\n        path: /action-path\n        method: POST\n        # ...\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>HTTP Server</strong> (Managed):</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: http-server-id\n    type: http-server\n\n    # Server start command\n    start:\n      - vllm\n      - serve\n      - model-name\n      - --port\n      - &quot;8000&quot;\n\n    # Server configuration\n    port: 8000\n    healthcheck:\n      path: /health\n      interval: 5s\n      timeout: 10s\n      retries: 3\n\n    # HTTP client configuration (after server starts)\n    method: POST\n    path: /v1/completions\n    body: { ... }\n    stream_format: json\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Vector Store</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: vector-store-id\n    type: vector-store\n    driver: chroma | milvus | qdrant | faiss\n\n    # Driver-specific configuration\n    host: localhost              # milvus, qdrant\n    port: 19530                  # milvus, qdrant\n    path: ./chroma_db            # chroma\n\n    # Actions\n    actions:\n      - id: insert\n        collection: collection-name\n        method: insert\n        vector: ${input.vector}\n        metadata: ${input.metadata}\n\n      - id: search\n        collection: collection-name\n        method: search\n        query: ${input.vector}\n        top_k: 5\n        output_fields: [ field1, field2 ]\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Key-Value Store</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: kv-store-id\n    type: key-value-store\n    driver: redis\n\n    # Connection (url or host/port)\n    url: redis://localhost:6379/0\n    # host: localhost\n    # port: 6379\n    # password: ${env.REDIS_PASSWORD}\n    # database: 0\n\n    # Actions\n    actions:\n      - id: set\n        method: set\n        key: &quot;cache:${input.key}&quot;\n        value: ${input.value}\n        ttl: 3600\n\n      - id: get\n        method: get\n        key: &quot;cache:${input.key}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>File Store</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: file-store-id\n    type: file-store\n    driver: local | aws-s3 | gcp-storage | azure-blob\n\n    # Common\n    base_path: workflows/        # logical prefix (optional)\n\n    # Driver-specific\n    bucket: my-bucket            # aws-s3, gcp-storage\n    container: my-container      # azure-blob\n    region: us-east-1            # aws-s3\n    access_key_id: ${env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}\n    secret_access_key: ${env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}\n    # endpoint_url: http://minio.local:9000   # S3-compatible\n    # connection_string: ${env.AZURE_STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING}  # azure-blob\n\n    # Actions\n    actions:\n      - id: put\n        method: put\n        path: ${input.path}\n        source: ${input.file}          # UploadFile / StreamResource / bytes / str\n        content_type: image/png\n\n      - id: get\n        method: get\n        path: ${input.path}\n        # destination: /tmp/${input.path}     # save to local file\n        # streaming: true                     # lazy stream to next job\n\n      - id: delete\n        method: delete\n        path: ${input.path}\n\n      - id: exists\n        method: exists\n        path: ${input.path}\n\n      - id: list\n        method: list\n        path: images/\n        max_results: 100\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Dataset</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: dataset-id\n    type: datasets\n    provider: huggingface | local\n\n    # HuggingFace\n    dataset: dataset-name\n    split: train\n    subset: subset-name\n\n    # Local\n    path: ./data\n    format: json | csv | parquet\n\n    # Operations\n    select: [ column1, column2 ]\n    filter: ${condition}\n    map: ${transformation}\n    shuffle: true\n    sample: 100\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Text Splitter</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: text-splitter-id\n    type: text-splitter\n    text: ${input.text}\n    chunk_size: 1000\n    chunk_overlap: 200\n    separator: &quot;\\n\\n&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Shell Command</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: shell-id\n    type: shell\n    command: echo\n    args:\n      - ${input.message}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.4 Workflow Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>Basic Structure</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: workflow-id\n    title: Workflow Title\n    description: Workflow description\n\n    # Single component\n    component: component-id\n    input: ${input}\n    output: ${output}\n\n    # Or multiple jobs\n    jobs:\n      - id: job-id\n        component: component-id\n        action: action-id        # Optional: for multi-action components\n        input: { ... }\n        output: { ... }\n        depends_on: [ job-id ]   # Optional: dependencies\n        condition: ${expression} # Optional: conditional execution\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Job Types</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># 1. Component job (default - executes component)\n- id: job1\n  type: component        # Can be omitted (default)\n  component: component-id\n  action: action-id      # Optional: for multi-action components\n  input: ${input}\n  output: ${output}\n\n# 2. If job (conditional branching)\n- id: job2\n  type: if\n  operator: eq\n  input: ${input.status}\n  value: &quot;active&quot;\n  if_true: job-success\n  if_false: job-fail\n\n# 3. Delay job (wait)\n- id: job3\n  type: delay\n  duration: 5s           # Wait 5 seconds\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.5 Listener Schema</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">listeners:\n  - id: listener-id\n    type: http-callback\n\n    # Webhook endpoint\n    path: /webhook\n    method: POST\n\n    # Workflow trigger\n    workflow: workflow-id\n\n    # Callback configuration\n    callback:\n      url: https://api.example.com/callback\n      method: POST\n      headers: { ... }\n      body: { ... }\n\n    # Bulk processing\n    bulk:\n      enabled: true\n      size: 10\n      interval: 60\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.6 Gateway Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>ngrok</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">gateways:\n  - type: ngrok\n    port: 8080\n    authtoken: ${env.NGROK_AUTHTOKEN}\n    region: us | eu | ap | au | sa | jp | in\n    domain: custom-domain.ngrok.io\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>Cloudflare</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">gateways:\n  - type: cloudflare\n    port: 8080\n    tunnel_id: ${env.CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_ID}\n    credentials_file: ~/.cloudflared/credentials.json\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>SSH Tunnel</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">gateways:\n  - type: ssh-tunnel\n    port: 8080\n    connection:\n      host: remote-server.com\n      port: 22\n      auth:\n        type: keyfile\n        username: user\n        keyfile: ~/.ssh/id_rsa\n      # Or\n      auth:\n        type: password\n        username: user\n        password: ${env.SSH_PASSWORD}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.7 Logger Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>Console Logger</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">loggers:\n  - type: console\n    level: DEBUG | INFO | WARNING | ERROR\n    format: &quot;%(asctime)s - %(name)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<p><strong>File Logger</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">loggers:\n  - type: file\n    level: INFO\n    path: ./logs/app.log\n    format: &quot;%(asctime)s - %(levelname)s - %(message)s&quot;\n    rotation:\n      max_bytes: 10485760        # 10MB\n      backup_count: 5\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.8 Tracer Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>Langfuse Tracer</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">tracers:\n  - driver: langfuse\n    public_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY}\n    secret_key: ${env.LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY}\n    base_url: https://cloud.langfuse.com   # Optional\n    timeout: 30                             # Optional (seconds)\n    capture:\n      input: true                          # Include input in traces\n      output: true                         # Include output in traces\n      redact_keys:                         # Keys to redact\n        - Authorization\n        - api_key\n      max_payload_bytes: 1048576           # Max payload size (bytes)\n</code></pre>\n<h3>19.1.9 Runtime Schema</h3>\n<p><strong>Docker Runtime</strong>:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  runtime:\n    type: docker\n\n    # Image\n    image: python:3.11\n    build:                       # Optional: custom build\n      context: .\n      dockerfile: Dockerfile\n      args:\n        ARG_NAME: value\n\n    # Resources\n    mem_limit: 4g\n    cpus: &quot;2.0&quot;\n    gpus: all | &quot;device=0,1&quot;\n    shm_size: 1g\n\n    # Volumes\n    volumes:\n      - ./data:/data\n      - model-cache:/cache\n\n    # Environment variables\n    environment:\n      VAR_NAME: value\n      API_KEY: ${env.API_KEY}\n\n    # Network\n    network_mode: bridge | host\n    ports:\n      - &quot;8080:8080&quot;\n\n    # Policy\n    restart: no | always | on-failure | unless-stopped\n\n    # Healthcheck\n    healthcheck:\n      test: [ &quot;CMD&quot;, &quot;curl&quot;, &quot;-f&quot;, &quot;http://localhost:8080/health&quot; ]\n      interval: 30s\n      timeout: 10s\n      retries: 3\n</code></pre>\n<hr />\n<h2>Next Steps</h2>\n<p>Try these exercises:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Configure advanced settings using the complete schema reference</li>\n<li>Design components and workflows for your project</li>\n</ul>\n<hr />\n<p><strong>Previous Chapter</strong>: <a href=\"/model-compose/user-guide/18-troubleshooting\">18. Troubleshooting</a></p>\n",
      "data": {
        "title": "19. Appendix"
      }
    },
    {
      "slug": "user-guide/image-handling",
      "html": "<h1>Image Handling Guide</h1>\n<p>This guide covers working with images in model-compose, including upload, processing, format support, and best practices for image-based AI workflows.</p>\n<h2>Overview</h2>\n<p>model-compose supports various image processing tasks:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Image-to-Text</strong>: Generate descriptions and captions</li>\n<li><strong>Image Classification</strong>: Classify and categorize images</li>\n<li><strong>Image Upscaling</strong>: Enhance image resolution</li>\n<li><strong>Object Detection</strong>: Identify objects within images</li>\n<li><strong>Image Analysis</strong>: Extract features and metadata</li>\n</ul>\n<h2>Image Upload Methods</h2>\n<h3>API Upload (multipart/form-data)</h3>\n<p>For web APIs, images are uploaded using multipart form data:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Basic image upload\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/runs \\\n  -F &quot;image=@/path/to/image.jpg&quot; \\\n  -F &quot;input={\\&quot;image\\&quot;: \\&quot;@image\\&quot;}&quot;\n\n# Multiple images\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/runs \\\n  -F &quot;image1=@/path/to/first.jpg&quot; \\\n  -F &quot;image2=@/path/to/second.png&quot; \\\n  -F &quot;input={\\&quot;images\\&quot;: [\\&quot;@image1\\&quot;, \\&quot;@image2\\&quot;]}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h3>CLI (File Path)</h3>\n<p>For command-line usage, specify file paths directly:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Single image\nmodel-compose run image-workflow --input '{&quot;image&quot;: &quot;/path/to/image.jpg&quot;}'\n\n# Multiple images\nmodel-compose run image-workflow --input '{\n  &quot;images&quot;: [\n    &quot;/path/to/first.jpg&quot;,\n    &quot;/path/to/second.png&quot;\n  ]\n}'\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Base64 Encoding</h3>\n<p>Images can also be provided as base64-encoded strings:</p>\n<pre><code class=\"language-json\">{\n  &quot;image_data&quot;: &quot;data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQAAAQ...&quot;\n}\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Supported Image Formats</h2>\n<h3>Common Formats</h3>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>JPEG/JPG</strong>: Most widely used, good compression</li>\n<li><strong>PNG</strong>: Lossless compression, supports transparency</li>\n<li><strong>BMP</strong>: Uncompressed bitmap format</li>\n<li><strong>TIFF</strong>: High-quality format for professional use</li>\n<li><strong>GIF</strong>: Supports animation (static frames processed)</li>\n<li><strong>WebP</strong>: Modern format with excellent compression</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Format Recommendations</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Use Case</th>\n<th>Recommended Format</th>\n<th>Why</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Photos</strong></td>\n<td>JPEG</td>\n<td>Good compression, small file size</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Screenshots</strong></td>\n<td>PNG</td>\n<td>Crisp text and graphics</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Logos/Icons</strong></td>\n<td>PNG/SVG</td>\n<td>Transparency support, scalability</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Print Quality</strong></td>\n<td>TIFF</td>\n<td>Highest quality, no compression loss</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Web Optimization</strong></td>\n<td>WebP</td>\n<td>Best compression for web</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Image Configuration</h2>\n<h3>Basic Image Input</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: image-processor\n    type: model\n    model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large\n    task: image-to-text\n    input:\n      image: ${input.image as image}\n</code></pre>\n<h3>Advanced Configuration</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: advanced-image-processor\n    type: model\n    model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large\n    task: image-to-text\n    input:\n      image: ${input.image as image}\n\n    # Model parameters\n    params:\n      max_length: 50\n      num_beams: 3\n      temperature: 1.0\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Image Preprocessing</h2>\n<h3>Automatic Preprocessing</h3>\n<p>model-compose automatically handles:</p>\n<ul>\n<li><strong>Format Conversion</strong>: Converts all formats to RGB</li>\n<li><strong>Resizing</strong>: Scales images to model requirements</li>\n<li><strong>Normalization</strong>: Adjusts pixel values to expected range</li>\n<li><strong>Memory Optimization</strong>: Efficient loading and processing</li>\n</ul>\n<h3>Manual Preprocessing Options</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\"># Custom preprocessing pipeline\ncomponents:\n  - id: preprocessor\n    type: shell\n    command: [ python, preprocess_image.py ]\n    input:\n      image_path: ${input.image}\n      \n  - id: model\n    type: model\n    model: microsoft/DialoGPT-medium\n    task: image-to-text\n    input:\n      image: ${jobs.preprocessor.output.processed_image}\n    depends_on: [ preprocessor ]\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Image Size and Memory Management</h2>\n<h3>Size Limits</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Component</th>\n<th>Recommended Max Size</th>\n<th>Memory Usage</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Image-to-Text</strong></td>\n<td>2048x2048 px</td>\n<td>~500MB</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Classification</strong></td>\n<td>1024x1024 px</td>\n<td>~200MB</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Upscaling</strong></td>\n<td>512x512 px input</td>\n<td>~1GB+</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Object Detection</strong></td>\n<td>1280x1280 px</td>\n<td>~800MB</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h3>Memory Optimization</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">components:\n  - id: memory-efficient-processor\n    type: model\n    model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-base  # Use smaller model\n    task: image-to-text\n    \n    # Memory optimization settings\n    device_map: auto\n    torch_dtype: float16          # Half precision\n    low_cpu_mem_usage: true       # Reduce CPU memory\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Batch Processing</h2>\n<h3>Multiple Images in Single Request</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">workflows:\n  - id: batch-image-processing\n    jobs:\n      - id: process-images\n        component: image-processor\n        input:\n          images: ${input.image_list}\n        params:\n          batch_size: 4             # Process 4 images at once\n</code></pre>\n<h3>API Batch Upload</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-bash\"># Batch processing via API\ncurl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/workflows/runs \\\n  -F &quot;image1=@photo1.jpg&quot; \\\n  -F &quot;image2=@photo2.jpg&quot; \\\n  -F &quot;image3=@photo3.jpg&quot; \\\n  -F &quot;input={\\&quot;images\\&quot;: [\\&quot;@image1\\&quot;, \\&quot;@image2\\&quot;, \\&quot;@image3\\&quot;]}&quot;\n</code></pre>\n<h2>Image Quality Guidelines</h2>\n<h3>Optimal Image Characteristics</h3>\n<ol>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Resolution</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Minimum: 224x224 pixels</li>\n<li>Optimal: 512x512 to 1024x1024 pixels</li>\n<li>Maximum: 2048x2048 pixels (depending on task)</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Quality</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Good lighting and contrast</li>\n<li>Sharp focus on main subjects</li>\n<li>Minimal noise and artifacts</li>\n<li>Proper exposure (not too dark/bright)</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Composition</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Clear subject matter</li>\n<li>Minimal clutter in background</li>\n<li>Standard orientation (not rotated)</li>\n<li>Centered or well-composed subjects</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>Quality Issues and Solutions</h3>\n<table>\n<thead>\n<tr>\n<th>Issue</th>\n<th>Impact</th>\n<th>Solution</th>\n</tr>\n</thead>\n<tbody>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Blurry Images</strong></td>\n<td>Poor accuracy</td>\n<td>Use sharper images or image enhancement</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Low Resolution</strong></td>\n<td>Missing details</td>\n<td>Upscale images or use higher resolution</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Poor Lighting</strong></td>\n<td>Reduced performance</td>\n<td>Improve lighting or use image enhancement</td>\n</tr>\n<tr>\n<td><strong>Heavy Compression</strong></td>\n<td>Artifacts affect results</td>\n<td>Use higher quality images</td>\n</tr>\n</tbody>\n</table>\n<h2>Best Practices</h2>\n<h3>Image Preparation</h3>\n<ol>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Optimize Before Processing</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Resize to appropriate dimensions</li>\n<li>Compress without losing essential details</li>\n<li>Enhance contrast and brightness if needed</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Batch Processing</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Group similar images together</li>\n<li>Process multiple images concurrently</li>\n<li>Use appropriate batch sizes for memory</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Caching Strategy</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Cache processed results</li>\n<li>Store common images locally</li>\n<li>Use CDN for frequently accessed images</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n</ol>\n<h3>Workflow Design</h3>\n<ol>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Error Handling</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Validate images before processing</li>\n<li>Implement fallback strategies</li>\n<li>Log errors for debugging</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Resource Management</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Monitor memory usage</li>\n<li>Set appropriate timeouts</li>\n<li>Clean up temporary files</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n<li>\n<p><strong>Quality Control</strong>:</p>\n<ul>\n<li>Review AI-generated results</li>\n<li>Implement confidence scoring</li>\n<li>Use human validation for critical tasks</li>\n</ul>\n</li>\n</ol>\n<h2>Example Workflows</h2>\n<h3>Complete Image Analysis Pipeline</h3>\n<pre><code class=\"language-yaml\">controller:\n  type: http-server\n  port: 8080\n  webui:\n    port: 8081\n\ncomponents:\n  - id: image-validator\n    type: shell\n    command: [ python, validate_image.py ]\n    \n  - id: image-enhancer\n    type: shell\n    command: [ python, enhance_image.py ]\n    \n  - id: caption-generator\n    type: model\n    model: Salesforce/blip-image-captioning-large\n    task: image-to-text\n    \n  - id: classifier\n    type: model\n    model: microsoft/DialoGPT-medium\n    task: image-classification\n\nworkflows:\n  - id: complete-image-analysis\n    jobs:\n      - id: validate\n        component: image-validator\n        input:\n          image: ${input.image}\n          \n      - id: enhance\n        component: image-enhancer\n        input:\n          image: ${input.image}\n        depends_on: [ validate ]\n        condition: ${jobs.validate.output.valid}\n        \n      - id: generate-caption\n        component: caption-generator\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.enhance.output.enhanced_image}\n        depends_on: [ enhance ]\n        \n      - id: classify\n        component: classifier\n        input:\n          image: ${jobs.enhance.output.enhanced_image}\n        depends_on: [ enhance ]\n        \n      - id: combine-results\n        component: result-combiner\n        input:\n          caption: ${jobs.generate-caption.output.generated}\n          classification: ${jobs.classify.output.label}\n          confidence: ${jobs.classify.output.score}\n        depends_on: [
